chapters.title: Chapter 4001: Fighting over the mine
paragraphs: “Rob their stores?” Chi Xuan was taken aback. This step was really too big. “Do you have a better idea?” Ling Han asked.
Chi Xuan only hesitated slightly, then nodded, “All right.”
They continued to observe, capturing the rhythm of these people.
“Every ten days, the Ghost Spirit Crystals dug out will be transported away.”
“The three guards are Spiritual Transformation Tier Yin souls, and the weakest is the one in the middle.”
“We’ll start with him.”

Ling Han and the empress waited. The three Spirit Transformation True Lord yin souls would take turns to stand guard here. The strength of their souls were early stage, middle stage, and late stage Spirit Transformation Tier. Thus, if they wanted to make a move, they would definitely have to wait until the early stage Spirit Transformation Tier yin soul was on duty. When that Yin soul arrived, Ling Han and Chi Xuan counted the days, and it was right until the tenth day, when they moved.

They had long since figured out the location of the storehouse. In truth, it could not really be considered a store. The crystals simply stacked together. That Yin soul of the early stage Spirit Transformation Tier was standing guard at the side, and in theory, it could be claimed to be absolutely safe.
“Are you really confident?” Chi Xuan asked.

They were both only in the Core Formation Tier. Though their souls were strong and healthy, and had advanced into the True Self Tier, there was still a gap of a major tier between their cultivation levels and Spirit Transformation Tier. This gap was extraordinarily wide.
Ling Han nodded, “Don’t worry, I won’t go to my death.”
Although Chi Xuan was still worried, she could only trust him.
The value of the Ghost Spirit Crystal was too great.

With a leap, Ling Han had already charged towards that great yin soul. At this time, he no longer had to suppress the undulations of the soul, and flames of light instantly rushed out of his body, incredibly bright.

In the Netherworld, a living soul was practically a small walking sun, incredibly dazzling. “Yi?” That great yin soul immediately looked over, revealing an astounded expression, “There is actually a living soul that dares to attack? Haha, just in time, to satisfy this lord’s craving!”
A True Self Tier living soul could only be considered a delicious feast for it, but could not increase the strength of its soul by much.
Its palm struck over, and its arm actually continued to extend. From afar, it had already arrived in front of Ling Han.
Indeed, there was no need for the soul to be restricted by size. Extending one’s arm was naturally no big deal.
Boom, a palm strike shot out, its power astonishing.
Spiritual Transformation Tier!

If this were the Living Realm, and Ling Han encountered a Spiritual Transformation True Lord, he would definitely turn around and leave without another word. Otherwise, he would spit out the Heavenly Dao Flames from the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
However, this place was different. The strength of his soul was comparable to the middle stage of the True Self Tier, and the Destructive Energy had a powerful restraining effect on Yin souls.
‘Come!’
Boom, Destructive Energy surged and entwined around his fists. Ling Han let out a loud roar, and shot out punches like rain.
“What!” The Spirit Transformation Tier Yin soul was shocked. Destructive Energy struck it, and it felt as if even its soul was trembling.
However, it had taken the initiative to attack, so how could it hold back now? Peng! It collided with Ling Han.
“Ah!” It immediately released a terrible scream, and one of its palms immediately melted. It was like water that had encountered fierce flames, and had been forcefully evaporated.
It hurriedly retracted its arm, its face filled with fury and shock.
With just a single strike, it had lost the soul in one of its arms, which could be said to have been a very heavy injury.

Meanwhile, Ling Han shook his head internally. As expected of a Spirit Transformation Tier Yin soul. The damage caused by this strike was far below his expectations. Furthermore, he had also been completely numbed by the other’s palm strike, and felt indescribably terrible. If they continued to exchange blows like this, it was hard to say whether he would destroy the other completely first, or the other would shatter his soul first.
However, no matter what, he could not lose in terms of bearing.

Ling Han laughed loudly, and took the initiative to rush forwards, beginning to attack. For a moment, the Spirit Transformation Tier Yin soul didn’t dare to face this head-on. That attack just now had caused it to lose more than one percent of its soul, and it didn’t want to lose any more.
One had to realize, was it easy for it to advance another step further?

There was no way to cultivate in the Netherworld, so he could only rely on devouring those at the same cultivation level to improve his soul. Moreover, the higher one’s cultivation level, the fewer yin souls there would be at the same cultivation level. Thus, it was extremely difficult to even raise one’s cultivation level by a tiny bit.
The more Ling Han looked like he was putting his life on the line, the more wary he would be, and the more cowardly he would appear.
Under Ling Han’s coercion, it continued to retreat.
Chi Xuan took the chance to run over, and began to collect the Ghost Spirit Crystals – she was only a spirit now, so she naturally stored the Ghost Spirit Crystals inside her own body.
“How dare you!” the Spirit Transformation Tier Yin soul roared loudly, and was just about to charge towards Chi Xuan.
However, Ling Han moved forcefully, forcing this Spirit Transformation Tier yin soul to retreat.
It really didn’t want to fight Ling Han head-on at all.
It was only nine days’ worth of mining, and sacrificing one’s own soul for it was not worth it
at all.
With such a passive attitude, it allowed Chi Xuan to take away all the Ghost Spirit Crystals. “Thank you for your cooperation. See you next time.” Ling Han laughed loudly, and strode
off.
That Spirit Transformation Tier Yin soul only chased a few steps before stopping. So what if it caught up?
Previously, when Ling Han had fought all out with it, it had only been continuously dodging. It had not wanted to clash head-on with Ling Han, and lose even the slightest bit of its soul. If
it caught up with them now, it would definitely be the same result.

It could be said that even if the Western Desert King moved, and could kill Ling Han with a single strike, he would definitely lose some of his soul. However, for a Sect Master-level Yin soul, this little loss was negligible.
Ling Han strode away, and very soon caught up to Chi Xuan. The two of them did not hesitate, and immediately exited the formation, and fled into the distance.
Perhaps the Western Desert King would soon arrive. If a Sect Master-level Yin soul made a move, they would only be waiting for death.
After they had walked far away, the two of them stopped, and shared the Ghost Spirit Crystals
evenly.
However, when Ling Han stored the crystals that belonged to him into his body, a strange
feeling rose up in him.
That was because this was something that had just been stored in Chi Xuan’s soul. There
seemed to still be a sliver of her soul fluctuation remaining, which gave rise to an
indescribably amazing feeling.
Chi Xuan also seemed to realize this, and couldn’t help but blush.
F***, this little girl clearly looked ordinary, but why could she give him a feeling of
wonderful enjoyment?
Ling Han hurriedly composed himself. He had more Ghost Spirit Crystals to refine.

“The two of you, please put down the Ghost Spirit Crystals.” A voice rang out, and a young man also walked out. His whole body was exuding white light, and his features were unclear, but it could be seen that his head was completely bald.
The soul could change form in a myriad of ways, but usually, it would simulate the original. Could it be that this guy itself was also bald?
“The Imperial Son of the Buddhist Race, Shi Yongming!” Chi Xuan’s expression became
serious.

“Benefactor actually recognizes this humble monk?” This bald young man gave a Buddhist proclamation, “Good, good, good. Previously, I was in the same team as the female benefactor. You claim that you are only a minor character in the Donglin Imperial Clan, but from the look of things now, the female benefactor should have an extraordinary
background.”
Ling Han also agreed internally. If she did not have some skill, she would have long since died
at the mine.
“Put down the Ghost Spirit Crystals, and you two can leave safely.” Shi Yongming said calmly, “I do not like to commit murder, so please do not make things difficult for me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4002: Battling Buddha Son
paragraphs: Ling Han shook his head, and said, “I have a line about f*ck you, but I don’t know if I should say it or not.”
Shi Yongming faltered at first, then showed a sliver of anger.

You’ve already f****** said it, and you still want to ask if you should speak or not? “Benefactor is Ding Yi, right?” Shi Yongming gave another Buddhist proclamation, “I heard that you are very extraordinary. When you were in the Cauldron Forging Tier, you already possessed battle prowess above Third Heaven. However, even if you have advanced into the Core Formation Tier, it is not enough in front of me. Furthermore, this is the Netherworld, which can be considered my territory.”

The most awesome thing about the Buddhist Race was that they could exorcise the souls of the dead. Thus, if they battled with their souls, Shi Yongming would be able to unleash 200% of his battle prowess. In fact, he would be able to unleash even more battle prowess.
“The two of you, I am a monk. I am a benevolent monk, and do not like to commit murder, so please do not make things difficult for me,” Shi Yongming repeated.
Ling Han looked at Chi Xuan, and asked, “Which Heavenly Realm’s Buddha Son is this?”
“West Heavenly Realm,” Chi Xuan replied.

Ling Han gave an ‘oh’, “Among the four Heavenly Realms, West Heavenly Realm is ranked third. Thus, compared to the Buddha Sons of the East and South Heavenly Realms, you should be considerably inferior, right?”
When these words fell, Shi Yongming finally looked furious.

The four Heavenly Realms formed their own circle, and there was always endless comparison among them. Furthermore, the Buddhist Race had their own strongholds in the Heavenly Realms, and had established four Buddhist Sons respectively. Naturally, there was also much competition among them.

However, Ling Han had hit the nail on the head. He was no match for the Buddha Sons of the East and South Heavenly Realms. This was a scar on him, and after Ling Han exposed it, he was naturally extremely displeased.

“Benefactor Ding, your mouth is truly toxic. You are so determined to anger me, and turn me into an angry Guardian Deity!” Shi Yongming stated calmly, but killing intent was already circulating within him.
Ling Han stretched out his right hand, then retracted his four fingers, leaving only his index finger sticking out. He hooked his finger, “Come on then!”
This was a provocation!
How could Shi Yongming hold back any longer? He immediately charged over.
“An!” He opened his mouth, and called out the Six Characters Bright King Curse. Instantly, it turned into a massive golden character that blasted towards Ling Han.
This was a Buddhist Race technique that could suppress evil and obliterate souls.

Ling Han humphed and wrapped his fists in Heavenly Dao Flames, greeting the An. Peng, peng, peng! Under his barrage of attacks, this “An” character was instantly shattered. Shi Yongming appeared slightly surprised. He had not thought that Ling Han’s attack would be so powerful, that he could even stand against the Buddhist Race’s Six Characters Bright King Curse, an Imperial Technique that countered the soul.
However, he immediately opened his mouth again, “Oh!”
The Six Characters Bright King Curse was continuously fired out, turning into multiple golden characters that pressed down on Ling Han.
Peng, peng, peng! All of the attacks were shattered by Ling Han.
Ling Han shouted loudly. He had never been the type to take a beating passively, and immediately began his counterattack.

Xiu, he charged towards Shi Yongming, the power of his fist blazing, as he shot out a punch. “Subduing Demons, Expiating Evil Spirits!” Shi Yongming chanted softly, and also shot out a punch. Instantly, a vast and mighty aura surged out. His whole person was glowing, and a halo of Buddhist light formed behind his head.

In the Living Realm, the Buddhist halo looked pure and holy, but it was only boosted in terms of aura, making it appear grand. However, in the Netherworld, the Buddhist halo definitely didn’t just look awesome, but was really awesome.
This light was incredibly intense, and had a colossal destructive and deterrent effect on the soul. It was a natural restraint.
Ling Han instantly felt as if his body were about to split apart. It was as if if if he went any further, his whole person would be torn into pieces.
The Buddhist Race was indeed skilled in dealing with souls.

Buddha Ah Han became an Emperor because of this, and Buddha Doga also wanted to travel through hell and become an Emperor in a different way, which showed how amazing the Dao of the soul was. After reaching Great Accomplishment level, one was completely capable of becoming an Emperor, becoming an Ancestral King.
However, he wanted Ling Han to back off just like that?
Impossible.
Ling Han channelled the Destructive Energy, and as his attack landed, the light of Buddha immediately shattered, and he had forcefully carved out a path for himself.

Shi Yongming was moved. He was a Buddha Son, and had grasped a great many amazing techniques that targeted the soul, but whether it was the Six Characters Bright King Curse or the Buddha Halo, they were all neutralized by Ling Han. What kind of freak was this guy?

When it came to dealing with Yin souls, there should be no one more awesome than the Buddhist Race. In the past, the reason why Buddha Ah Han could become an Emperor was because he had expiated countless dead souls, and was loved by the heaven and earth. Only then did he manage to take that step that only a few dozen or over a hundred people in history had the right to take.
“Who exactly are you?” he couldn’t help but shout.
“Your grandpa!” Ling Han had already rushed over, and shot out a punch, “Grandson, take this.”

Shi Yongming almost twisted his nose in anger. How could there be such a tasteless person? They were all prodigies, so which of them didn’t respect their own status? However, Ling Han didn’t care about his image at all. He was simply outrageously vulgar.

“Humph, though Buddha is merciful, subduing demons and eliminating demons is also part of our duty.” Shi Yongming moved, and delivered a palm strike. Golden light dazzled, like he was an enlightened monk, boosted by the heaven and earth’s righteousness.
In truth, he had indeed expiated a considerable number of dead souls, and had gained the approval of the heaven and earth, so he had meritorious service.
Yet Ling Han did not care. Whether the heaven and earth acknowledged you was the business of the heaven and earth, but if I want to beat you up, so what if the heavens come?
Fight!
He unleashed the murderous aura attack, with Destructive Energy entwined around his fists. He didn’t need anything else. This was the most terrifying killing move against the soul.
Shi Yongming didn’t dare to face it head-on either. He summoned a Soul Tool, a demon- subduing staff, and blocked the furious barrage of fists that Ling Han continuously threw at
him.

However, Ling Han’s battle became more and more intense, with each punch becoming fiercer and fiercer. Shi Yongming was shocked to discover that even his soul was trembling, as if it was about to be shattered.
This was too terrifying. How could this person’s soul be so powerful?

He was the Imperial Son of the Buddhist Race. Since childhood, he had cultivated the most brilliant cultivation technique in the world, and cultivation resources could be obtained with a wave of his hand. Furthermore, there was no shortage of natural treasures. Thus, the strength of his soul far surpassed any ordinary Core Formation Tier cultivator. However, after clashing with Ling Han, he discovered that his soul was actually weaker than Ling Han’s. How could he accept this?
Consummate level of Core Formation Tier, Imperial Son of the Buddhist Race, and the strength of his soul was actually inferior to an unorthodox early stage Core Formation Tier?
How was this possible?
However, this was the reality. Ling Han’s iron fists rained down, beating Shi Yongming so
hard that he couldn’t fight back at all.
Shi Yongming felt extremely sullen. He was the Buddha Son of the West Heavenly Realm, and
he would be able to attain venerate Tier in future, at the very least. Yet now, he was being bashed by a person whose cultivation level was lower than his, which was completely unacceptable to him.
However, even if he didn’t want to accept it, he had to accept it. In the cultivation world, strength was all that mattered. They didn’t believe in tears or defiance.
Shi Yongming roared in fury, then turned around and left quickly.
Ling Han set off in pursuit, causing Shi Yongming to pay the price of losing an arm before he
finally stopped his pursuit.
It was not that he wanted to let Shi Yongming off the hook, but rather that he had sensed a frightening fluctuation of aura, and did not dare to pursue any further.
Probably, the Western Desert King knew about the robbery of the mine, and in his fury, personally came to hunt down living souls like them.
In front of such a great monster, Ling Han naturally chose to retreat.
In any case, Shi Yongming would not be able to escape. He would call him to account in future.

In truth, he had indeed expiated a considerable number of dead souls, and had gained the approval of the heaven and earth, so he had meritorious service.
Yet Ling Han did not care.
Whether the heaven and earth acknowledged you was the business of the heaven and earth, but if I want to beat you up, so what if the heavens come?
Fight!
He unleashed the murderous aura attack, with Destructive Energy entwined around his fists.
He didn’t need anything else.
This was the most terrifying killing move against the soul.
Shi Yongming didn’t dare to face it head-on either.
He summoned a Soul Tool, a demon- subduing staff, and blocked the furious barrage of fists that Ling Han continuously threw at
him.
However, Ling Han’s battle became more and more intense, with each punch becoming fiercer and fiercer.
Shi Yongming was shocked to discover that even his soul was trembling, as if it was about to be shattered.
This was too terrifying.
How could this person’s soul be so powerful?
He was the Imperial Son of the Buddhist Race.
Since childhood, he had cultivated the most brilliant cultivation technique in the world, and cultivation resources could be obtained with a wave of his hand.
Furthermore, there was no shortage of natural treasures.
Thus, the strength of his soul far surpassed any ordinary Core Formation Tier cultivator.
However, after clashing with Ling Han, he discovered that his soul was actually weaker than Ling Han’s.
How could he accept this?
Consummate level of Core Formation Tier, Imperial Son of the Buddhist Race, and the strength of his soul was actually inferior to an unorthodox early stage Core Formation Tier?
How was this possible?
However, this was the reality.
Ling Han’s iron fists rained down, beating Shi Yongming so
hard that he couldn’t fight back at all.
Shi Yongming felt extremely sullen.
He was the Buddha Son of the West Heavenly Realm, and
he would be able to attain venerate Tier in future, at the very least.
Yet now, he was being bashed by a person whose cultivation level was lower than his, which was completely unacceptable to him.
However, even if he didn’t want to accept it, he had to accept it.
In the cultivation world, strength was all that mattered.
They didn’t believe in tears or defiance.
Shi Yongming roared in fury, then turned around and left quickly.
Ling Han set off in pursuit, causing Shi Yongming to pay the price of losing an arm before he
finally stopped his pursuit.
It was not that he wanted to let Shi Yongming off the hook, but rather that he had sensed a frightening fluctuation of aura, and did not dare to pursue any further.
Probably, the Western Desert King knew about the robbery of the mine, and in his fury, personally came to hunt down living souls like them.
In front of such a great monster, Ling Han naturally chose to retreat.
In any case, Shi Yongming would not be able to escape.
He would call him to account in future.

chapters.title: Chapter 4003: Her Imperial Highness, the Princess
paragraphs: Ling Han and Chi Xuan went into hiding, and began to refine the Ghost Spirit Crystals.
They were ambitious, and wanted to snatch a few more Ghost Spirit Crystals, because the Western Desert King couldn’t personally oversee the mine, right? Moreover, even if he did,
how many days could he stay?
Furthermore, if the strength of their souls could soar all the way up, then even if it was a Yin soul on the level of Sect Master, so what? They were completely unafraid.
However, after only three days, Ling Han sensed that someone was approaching.
He immediately stood up, and assumed a stance to greet an incoming attack.
“Enemies?” Chi Xuan asked. The strength of her soul wasn’t as high as Ling Han’s.
“I don’t know yet, but someone is coming over,” Ling Han said.
When these words fell, three people walked out from a pile of rocks.
“Your Highness!” Without waiting for Ling Han or Chi Xuan to speak, the three people quickly rushed over, all of them filled with excitement as they looked at Chi Xuan.
Yi, a princess?

Ling Han faltered. Though he knew that Chi Xuan’s status in the Donglin Imperial Clan was definitely not weak, he had still underestimated her. She was actually the princess of the Donglin Imperial Clan.
Hold on, even if it was an Imperial Clan, how many princesses could there be?
Chi Xuan frowned, but since her identity had already been exposed, she had no intention of trying to make things right again. Thus, she nodded, “Why have you guys come in?”

“Your Highness, the tokens of the clansmen accompanying you have all been shattered, and only yours is still here. Thus, Ancestor was worried, and ordered us to enter in batches to find Your Highness,” one of them said.
Chi Xuan nodded, “We failed in our assault on the mine, and suffered heavy losses.”
“Then, Your Highness, what should we do next?”
“I have my own measures,” Chi Xuan said.
“Understood.” The three of them obeyed strictly.
One of them looked towards Ling Han, humphed, and said, “How dare you, you actually dare to sit casually in front of Her Highness, the Princess. Hurry up and stand up!”
Yi, am I in the way of others by sitting here?
Ling Han pursed his lips, and looked towards that person. Looks like someone was asking for a beating.
Chi Xuan knew Ling Han’s pride and abilities, and immediately shouted, “This is Ding Yi, Brother Ding. Don’t be rude.”
“Yes, yes, Your Highness.” That person hurriedly bowed and agreed. His flattery had completely failed, which made him feel very depressed.
“Brother Ding, apologies for the rudeness,” Chi Xuan apologized to Ling Han.

Seeing their princess actually think so highly of Ling Han, the three of them were extremely stunned. It should be known that they were members of the Imperial Clan, and Chi Xuan was the brightest pearl of their clan, and she actually took the initiative to apologize to another.
This was too scary. What was so amazing about this Ding Yi?
Meanwhile, Ling Han smiled proudly, “For the sake of ‘Your Highness’, I’ll forget this matter.”
He emphasized the words ‘Your Highness’.
Chi Xuan smiled, “Brother Ding, are you blaming me for deliberately concealing my identity?”
“Dare I ask, Your Highness, Chi Xuan should not be your real name, right?” Ling Han countered.
“Brother Ding, Ding Yi isn’t your real name, is it?” Chi Xuan countered.

Ling Han secretly blamed himself for being too casual when coming up with a name, but how shameless was he? He declared boldly, “That is naturally my real name. I, Ding Yi, will not change my name, and will not change my surname no matter what!”
Chi Xuan laughed delicately, and shook her head, “All right. In any case, you will find out eventually. Chi Xuan is indeed not my real name. That is a cousin of mine, and my name is... Chi Menghan.”
Yi?
The Imperial Daughter of the Donglin Imperial Clan was using as a gimmick this time? However, did the seductive beauty ranked third on the Beauty Roll look like this?
Ling Han teased, “If Your Highness looks like this, then I definitely won’t be the ideal son- in-law.”

“How dare you!” the three members of the Donglin Imperial Clan shouted in unison. Chi Menghan, meanwhile, waved her hand dismissively, “I’m really sorry that my looks are not up to expectations, and have been the cause of regrets for Brother Ding.” Ling Han felt a chill in his heart. Previously, he had deliberately provoked this Imperial Daughter. He had not thought that she would be so subtle, and would not be provoked at all. Being able to become the Imperial Daughter, it was indeed not just her natural talent that was astonishing, but also her temperament that was outstanding.
“I hope that when my soul returns, I can have a good conversation with Your Highness,” Ling Han said.
“If there’s a chance, yes,” Chi Menghuan said.
This woman was really calm, as if she was immune to all poisons. Who knew if the large black dog would be able to make her lose her composure.

“We have to refine the Ghost Spirit Crystals as soon as possible. When the soul is strong enough, perhaps even a middle stage or even late stage Spirit Transformation Tier Yin soul would be nothing to fear,” Chi Menghan said.
“All right.”
The two of them began to refine the Ghost Spirit Crystals again. After close to a month, they finally refined all of the Ghost Spirit Crystals.
Ling Han frowned, and said, “Shouldn’t we return once? After all, it’s been too long since I left my physical body.”
Without the vitality brought about by the soul, the physical body would gradually wilt.
Chi Menghan smiled, “I forgot to tell Brother Ding that the flow of time here is different from the flow of time in the Living Realm. Ten days have passed here, and only one day has passed
in the outside world.”
Yi?
Ling Han looked at Chi Menghan. This Imperial Daughter deliberately concealed such important information. What was her purpose?
“Brother Ding, I only forgot to mention it. You didn’t ask, did you?” Chi Menghan asked with
a smile.
It would be strange if he believed her.
Ling Han sighed. Now, not only were these seductive beauties on the Exquisite Leaderboard astonishingly beautiful, they were also so smart that it gave him a headache?
Couldn’t she be simpler like Hu Niu? Couldn’t she be proud like the empress?
How tiring was it to place all one’s intelligence on scheming and plotting?
“What level has the strength of your soul reached now?” Ling Han asked. “The middle stage of the True Self Tier,” Chi Menghan said, “What about you?”
“A little higher than you, late stage.”

Chi Menghan pondered for a moment before saying, “Although our strength has increased to a certain extent, we probably still can’t rival a Yin soul at the middle stage of the Spiritual Transformation Tier, let alone a late stage Spiritual Transformation Tier.”

“If we want to strengthen the soul, we have to either hunt down Yin souls that are similarly in the True Self Tier, or snatch the Ghost Spirit Crystals. We seem to have entered a dead end, and we still have to clash with a yin soul at Spirit Transformation Tier,” Ling Han said.
“I have a technique that requires two people to cultivate and use it at the same time. It’s boundlessly powerful.” Chi Menghan paused for a moment before continuing, “Brother Ding,
do you want to learn it?”
Yi, could this be the Heavenly Brilliance Technique?
Ling Han immediately nodded, “Sure!” Whether it was or not, there was no harm in learning another technique.
“Your Highness!” The three members of the Donglin Imperial Clan were extremely anxious.
This was an Imperial Technique, so how could it be taught so easily?
Chi Menghan ignored them completely, and said, “You should have guessed by now. That is the Heavenly Brilliance Technique.”
“Imperial Technique?” Ling Han rubbed his hands, appearing very expectant.

“That’s right.” Chi Menghan nodded, “This was created by Ancestral King Donglin, but at the beginning, our clansmen could not learn it no matter what we tried. Afterwards, an extremely talented Saint Tier ancestor appeared. He said that the Heavenly Brilliance Technique was too powerful, and could not possibly be used alone by one who was not an Ancestral King. Thus, it was split into two, and was to be used through the combined efforts of two people.” Hearing her say this, Ling Han’s brain whirred, “Then if one’s aptitude was even slightly inferior, wouldn’t it be possible if three or four people worked together?”

chapters.title: Chapter 4004: Heavenly Brilliance Technique
paragraphs: When Ling Han said this, the four members of the Chi Clan, including Chi Menghan, were all moved.
Especially those three people. Their expressions were even more exaggerated, as if they had seen a ghost.
Yi, have you guys encountered a ghost?

“Brother Ding, you’re really good at making inferences,” Chi Menghan said with a nod. “That’s right. The Heavenly Brilliance Technique can be unleashed by two people at the same time, or three people at the same time. In fact, it can be unleased by even 100 people at the same time.”
“This is the most widely known Imperial Technique of our clan. Usually, we use it in groups of ten, and when they work together, the might is astonishingly great.”
Ling Han laughed loudly. As it turned out, his casual words had hit the nail on the head. He was really too much of a prodigy.
“Come, come, come. Your Highness, let us now cultivate dual cultivation.”
Chi Menghan rolled her eyes. This guy must have done it on purpose. They were both cultivating a simultaneous Technique, not a double cultivation technique. He was really too shameless.
“All right, I will teach you the precious technique,” she said.
“Your Highness!” the other three members of the Chi Clan exclaimed again.
“Don’t be so shocked, it’ll scare people, all right?” Ling Han immediately rebuked.
Really, they kept wanting to stop him from learning the precious technique.
Chi Menghan waved her hand dismissively, “It’s fine. I know what I’m doing.”

She would only teach Ling Han half of the Heavenly Brilliance Technique, not the complete Heavenly Brilliance Technique. And if he only learnt half of the Imperial Technique, then casting it alone would not have the slightest bit of power.

In history, the Chi Clan had also taught half of their Imperial Technique to outsiders, but so what? Countless years had passed, and the Heavenly Brilliance Technique was still the ultimate technique that belonged solely to the Chi Clan. There was no outsider that could use it at all.

Chi Menghan began to teach Ling Han the Heavenly Brilliance Technique. This was an Imperial Technique, and it was targeted at the soul. Its might was astonishing, and even Saints were unable to cast it alone. They could only rely on numbers to make up for it.
The more prodigious a cultivator was, the fewer people they would need to use the secret technique together.

Chi Menghan was the Imperial Daughter, so there was naturally nothing to be said about her natural talent. Meanwhile, Ling Han had been able to pummel even an Imperial Son along the way, so there was naturally no need to mention his natural talent or abilities. He was one of the top in the world.
If the two of them weren’t qualified to cultivate the Heavenly Brilliance Technique together, then there wouldn’t be a second pair of prodigies in the world that were qualified to do so.

Chi Menghan taught him the verbal chant, and this also involved a large amount of seals and Spiritual Power channelling techniques. It was extremely complicated, and even a prodigy like Ling Han felt a headache coming on.
It was too complicated. Was this really something that could be understood by humans?
Ling Han calmed down and tried his best to search for the core of the technique. He would then expand upon this core.

Chi Menghan had been cultivating this Imperial Technique since childhood. Thus, there was naturally no problem with her half. Once Ling Han had a slight grasp of it, the two of them would be able to cultivate it together.
The flow of time here was different, so it could be said to be a good place for comprehending Dao.
Yi, the Time Chamber on the Galaxy Network, could it be that it was based on this place? He had digressed, he had digressed.
Ling Han hurriedly pulled his attention back, and completely immersed himself in the understanding of the Heavenly Brilliance Technique.

“Hmph, wanting to cultivate the Heavenly Brilliance Technique to be used by two people, this requirement is too high.” A member of the Chi Clan smirked coldly, “If you ask me, it would already be good enough if he can cultivate to Small Accomplishment in three years.” “Even if the flow of time here is faster, it would take at least a few months,” another person said.
“Perhaps he’ll need even longer,” the third person said.
A look of displeasure spread across Chi Menghan’s face, and she shouted softly, “Leave.”
The three of them shuddered. They knew that they had angered this Imperial Daughter, so they hurriedly stepped back respectfully.
Three months later, Ling Han finally had some idea. Another month later, he had already achieved some minor accomplishments.
Ling Han was naturally overjoyed. However, he remained calm and collected, and said to Chi Menghan, “Er, the half I cultivated is too difficult. Why don’t we trade?”
-If the large black dog was here, he would definitely be incredibly pleased. He had completely obtained the true essence of Grandpa Dog’s shamelessness.
Chi Menghan didn’t fall for it. “The two halves of the Heavenly Brilliance Technique are both
the same.”
“I don’t believe it. Show me.” Ling Han began to act shamelessly.
Chi Menghan shook her head, and said, “Brother Ding, you’ve already mastered the Heavenly Brilliance Technique, haven’t you?”
‘What?’
The other three members of the Chi Clan were shocked. This was too exaggerated, wasn’t it? Only four months had passed, and this guy had already grasped half of the Heavenly Brilliance
Technique?
It should be known that even their Imperial Daughter, a supreme prodigy like Chi Menghan, had taken close to two years to succeed.
Ling Han sighed upon seeing this. This woman was far too intelligent, so it wasn’t easy to
deceive her.

“Cough, cough, how could that be possible!” Ling Han shook his head, “Let me take a look at the other half of the Heavenly Brilliance Technique. Who knows, I might be able to comprehend it by analogy. It would have great reference value, right?”
Chi Menghan acted as if she hadn’t heard anything, and said, “Brother Ding, come, let’s cultivate the precious technique together!”
F***, can you listen to me properly?
Ling Han was exasperated. No matter how shameless he was, he couldn’t continue
pretending.

The two of them began to cultivate the technique together. Ling Han couldn’t help but be impressed. The Saint that had dismantled the technique was really too prodigious. The Heavenly Brilliance Technique that he had cultivated was extremely complex, but the might it delivered was pitifully small, but used together with Chi Menghan, it was completely
different.
This might had surpassed the Demonic Monkey Fists.
Why? Could it be that Ancestral King Donglin was even more awesome than the Battle Saint
Emperor?
Impossible.
Ling Han shook his head. The Ancestral King had already reached the pinnacle of the Celestial Path, so which one of them wasn’t a prodigy among prodigies? Who would be weaker than the
other?
Standing at such a height, though the techniques they created were all different, their might should be more or less the same.
Why had the Heavenly Brilliance Technique surpassed the Demonic Monkey Fists?

Firstly, it should be the two of them working together, so their combined power would naturally be greater than one person. Secondly, the Imperial Technique was too powerful. Without reaching this cultivation level, how could one possibly attain the true essence and unleash its true might?
Ling Han believed it. If Ancestral King Donglin used the Holy Emperor to clash with the Battle Saint Emperor using the Demonic Monkey Fists, the two of them should be equal in power/
However, it was a shame that only one Emperor would appear in a single era. There was no way to truly battle to see who was the strongest in all of history.
Ling Han put away his wild thoughts and focused on cultivating the technique with Chi
Mengguan.
Another month passed, and the two of them had already developed enough tacit
understanding.
It couldn’t be helped. They were in a pure soul state now, so how could they not cooperate
well? “Right now, we’re powerful enough to rival elites at the early stage of the Spiritual Transformation Tier,” Chi Menghan said.

Ling Han nodded. The Heavenly Brilliance Technique was truly terrifying. The combined power of the two of them could rival the Yin soul of an early stage Spirit Transformation cultivator. This was a head-on confrontation, and not relying on Destructive Energy to scare the latter into not daring to fight.

Now, with the Heavenly Brilliance Technique, he could withstand the Yin soul of an early stage Spirit Transformation Tier elite head-on. Then, he could use the Destructive Energy to attack, and it would not be impossible for him to kill an early stage Spirit Transformation Tier
yin soul.
“Come, let’s go to the mine.”

They once again arrived at the mine, but did not act rashly. Instead, they waited until the Yin soul of the early stage Spirit Transformation Tier took up his position again, and only then did they immediately move out, charging over.
“It’s the two of you again!” The yin soul gritted its teeth, feeling an urge to explode in anger.
‘You guys did it on purpose, didn’t you? Just when I was on duty, you came over.’
Was he very easy to bully?
“You guys have miscalculated this time. Right now, there isn’t even a single Ghost Spirit
Crystal!” he laughed loudly.
“We didn’t miscalculate. We’re here to kill you,” Ling Han said calmly.

The more prodigious a cultivator was, the fewer people they would need to use the secret technique together.
Chi Menghan was the Imperial Daughter, so there was naturally nothing to be said about her natural talent.
Meanwhile, Ling Han had been able to pummel even an Imperial Son along the way, so there was naturally no need to mention his natural talent or abilities.
He was one of the top in the world.
If the two of them weren’t qualified to cultivate the Heavenly Brilliance Technique together, then there wouldn’t be a second pair of prodigies in the world that were qualified to do so.
Chi Menghan taught him the verbal chant, and this also involved a large amount of seals and Spiritual Power channelling techniques.
It was extremely complicated, and even a prodigy like Ling Han felt a headache coming on.
It was too complicated.
Was this really something that could be understood by humans?
Ling Han calmed down and tried his best to search for the core of the technique.
He would then expand upon this core.
Chi Menghan had been cultivating this Imperial Technique since childhood.
Thus, there was naturally no problem with her half.
Once Ling Han had a slight grasp of it, the two of them would be able to cultivate it together.
The flow of time here was different, so it could be said to be a good place for comprehending Dao.
Yi, the Time Chamber on the Galaxy Network, could it be that it was based on this place?
He had digressed, he had digressed.
Ling Han hurriedly pulled his attention back, and completely immersed himself in the understanding of the Heavenly Brilliance Technique.

“Hmph, wanting to cultivate the Heavenly Brilliance Technique to be used by two people, this requirement is too high.” A member of the Chi Clan smirked coldly, “If you ask me, it would already be good enough if he can cultivate to Small Accomplishment in three years.” “Even if the flow of time here is faster, it would take at least a few months,” another person said.
“Perhaps he’ll need even longer,” the third person said.
A look of displeasure spread across Chi Menghan’s face, and she shouted softly, “Leave.”
The three of them shuddered.
They knew that they had angered this Imperial Daughter, so they hurriedly stepped back respectfully.
Three months later, Ling Han finally had some idea.
Another month later, he had already achieved some minor accomplishments.
Ling Han was naturally overjoyed.
However, he remained calm and collected, and said to Chi Menghan, “Er, the half I cultivated is too difficult.
Why don’t we trade?”
-If the large black dog was here, he would definitely be incredibly pleased.
He had completely obtained the true essence of Grandpa Dog’s shamelessness.
Chi Menghan didn’t fall for it.
“The two halves of the Heavenly Brilliance Technique are both
the same.”
“I don’t believe it.
Show me.” Ling Han began to act shamelessly.
Chi Menghan shook her head, and said, “Brother Ding, you’ve already mastered the Heavenly Brilliance Technique, haven’t you?”
‘What?’
The other three members of the Chi Clan were shocked.
This was too exaggerated, wasn’t it?
Only four months had passed, and this guy had already grasped half of the Heavenly Brilliance
Technique?
It should be known that even their Imperial Daughter, a supreme prodigy like Chi Menghan, had taken close to two years to succeed.
Ling Han sighed upon seeing this.
This woman was far too intelligent, so it wasn’t easy to
deceive her.
“Cough, cough, how could that be possible!” Ling Han shook his head, “Let me take a look at the other half of the Heavenly Brilliance Technique.
Who knows, I might be able to comprehend it by analogy.
It would have great reference value, right?”
Chi Menghan acted as if she hadn’t heard anything, and said, “Brother Ding, come, let’s cultivate the precious technique together!”
F***, can you listen to me properly?
Ling Han was exasperated.
No matter how shameless he was, he couldn’t continue
pretending.
The two of them began to cultivate the technique together.
Ling Han couldn’t help but be impressed.
The Saint that had dismantled the technique was really too prodigious.
The Heavenly Brilliance Technique that he had cultivated was extremely complex, but the might it delivered was pitifully small, but used together with Chi Menghan, it was completely
different.
This might had surpassed the Demonic Monkey Fists.
Why?
Could it be that Ancestral King Donglin was even more awesome than the Battle Saint
Emperor?
Impossible.
Ling Han shook his head.
The Ancestral King had already reached the pinnacle of the Celestial Path, so which one of them wasn’t a prodigy among prodigies?
Who would be weaker than the
other?
Standing at such a height, though the techniques they created were all different, their might should be more or less the same.
Why had the Heavenly Brilliance Technique surpassed the Demonic Monkey Fists?
Firstly, it should be the two of them working together, so their combined power would naturally be greater than one person.
Secondly, the Imperial Technique was too powerful.
Without reaching this cultivation level, how could one possibly attain the true essence and unleash its true might?
Ling Han believed it.
If Ancestral King Donglin used the Holy Emperor to clash with the Battle Saint Emperor using the Demonic Monkey Fists, the two of them should be equal in power/
However, it was a shame that only one Emperor would appear in a single era.
There was no way to truly battle to see who was the strongest in all of history.
Ling Han put away his wild thoughts and focused on cultivating the technique with Chi
Mengguan.
Another month passed, and the two of them had already developed enough tacit
understanding.
It couldn’t be helped.
They were in a pure soul state now, so how could they not cooperate
well?
“Right now, we’re powerful enough to rival elites at the early stage of the Spiritual Transformation Tier,” Chi Menghan said.
Ling Han nodded.
The Heavenly Brilliance Technique was truly terrifying.
The combined power of the two of them could rival the Yin soul of an early stage Spirit Transformation cultivator.
This was a head-on confrontation, and not relying on Destructive Energy to scare the latter into not daring to fight.
Now, with the Heavenly Brilliance Technique, he could withstand the Yin soul of an early stage Spirit Transformation Tier elite head-on.
Then, he could use the Destructive Energy to attack, and it would not be impossible for him to kill an early stage Spirit Transformation Tier
yin soul.
“Come, let’s go to the mine.”
They once again arrived at the mine, but did not act rashly.
Instead, they waited until the Yin soul of the early stage Spirit Transformation Tier took up his position again, and only then did they immediately move out, charging over.
“It’s the two of you again!” The yin soul gritted its teeth, feeling an urge to explode in anger.
‘You guys did it on purpose, didn’t you?
Just when I was on duty, you came over.’
Was he very easy to bully?
“You guys have miscalculated this time.
Right now, there isn’t even a single Ghost Spirit
Crystal!” he laughed loudly.
“We didn’t miscalculate.
We’re here to kill you,” Ling Han said calmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 4005: Waiting for an opportunity
paragraphs: Hearing Ling Han and Chi Menghan’s words, the early stage Spirit Transformation Tier great yin soul was immediately enraged.

The crystals had been snatched by Ling Han and Chi Menghan once, and he had already been harshly scolded by the Western Desert King. Now, not only had these two people come over when he was on duty, they were even shamelessly boasting that they would kill him.
Hehe, were living souls all so fond of jokes?
“You guys are really courting death!” it said balefully.
“Kill it!” Chi Menghan commanded.
“All right!”
Ling Han joined forces with her. The Heavenly Brilliance Technique was used, and instantly, their souls lit up. Shua, shua, shua! Multiple rays of brilliant light shot out like arrows from the sky.

The Yin soul in the early stage of the Spiritual Transformation Tier was shocked. The strength of these two living souls were only on par with the True Self Tier, so how could their combined might actually reach the level of the Spiritual Transformation Tier, and actually be capable of matching it?
However, it was naturally unafraid.
This giant monster approached, exchanging blows with Ling Han and Chi Menghan.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The Heavenly Brilliance Technique unleashed its full might. With a single strike, the giant monster stumbled, and actually looked like it was outmatched.
The large monster was astounded. Were these two living souls transcendent above the gods? How could they be so terrifying?

Ling Han laughed loudly. His right hand and Chi Menghan unleashed the Heavenly Brilliance Technique together. Meanwhile, his left hand was wrapped with Destructive Energy, and he launched a barrage of attacks at the Spirit Transformation Tier yin soul.
This would be fatal.
In the first place, the large monster was already experiencing great strain, and now added with the Destructive Energy, it had become the last straw that was pressing down on it.
It didn’t dare to fight anymore, and hurriedly turned around to run.

However, how could Ling Han and Chi Menghan allow it to do as it pleased? The Heavenly Brilliance Technique unleashed its might, firmly trapping it. Then, the Destructive Energy unleashed its might, blasting its soul into continuous destruction.
Spiritual Transformation Tier elites were indeed powerful, but they couldn’t withstand this kind of expenditure. In less than half an hour, it was exhausted to death by Ling Han and Chi Mengguan.

Er, it was a yin soul in the first place, and was as dead as could be. Exhausting it to death was not a very appropriate word. In short, this time, it was really gone, completely disappearing from the world.
“We now have ten days.”

Ling Han and Chi Menghan moved, eliminating all the Yin souls that had been mining here. Then, the Donglin Imperial Clan sent a large number of people to replace the original miners, and began to mine madly.

The next time the Western Desert King sent someone over, that would be ten days later. It should be a Yin soul of middle stage Spiritual Transformation Tier. At present, even if Ling Han and Chi Menghan joined forces, they would only be able to fight to a tie, at most, but would not be able to destroy it.
Thus, when the time came, the yin soul only had to retreat, and bring the Western Desert King over. Then, Ling Han and the others would be completely wiped out.
In just ten days, they would dig with all their might!

They had a large number of people, so the efficiency of mining was naturally incomparable to those Yin souls from before. Meanwhile, Ling Han and Chi Menghan were personally mining as if their lives depended on it.

However, they were all souls, and the soul technique only had great destructive power against souls. However, against these mountain rocks, the effects were far inferior. The best method was still to use the Soul Tool as a tool to cut open the stone.
Ten days passed very quickly. They had also dug up a large pile of Ghost Spirit Crystals, and the Spirit Transformation Tier Yin soul under the command of the Western Desert King also
came.

Ling Han and Chi Menghan joined forces to fight, but though they could match this great monster, they couldn’t trap it. Though there was only a gap of a minor cultivation level between them, it was still much, much stronger.
Finally, this giant monster was scared off by Destructive Energy.
“Retreat.”
It was clear that the late stage, or consummate stage of Spirit Transformation Tier, and even the Western Desert King would be personally making a move next. It would be too dangerous to stay.
Moreover, they had mined for ten days, and their gains were already huge enough.
They retreated to the place where they had just entered. Most of the members of the Chi Clan had to return, and Ling Han and Chi Menghan still planned to stay here for a while longer.
In terms of the distribution of Ghost Spirit Crystals, Ling Han received 30%, while the Chi Clan received 70%.

This seemed very unfair to Ling Han, but firstly, this was indeed the territory of the Chi Clan, and secondly, the Chi Clan had also mobilized a large number of people to excavate. If it was Ling Han alone, his gains definitely wouldn’t be so great.
Actually, the fact that he was given 30% was because Chi Menghan had fought for it. Otherwise, giving him 10% would have been enough.

Ling Han only felt rueful about this, and that was Chi Menghan was indeed very good at conducting herself. She was generous, and her future prospects should be very amazing. The two of them had great ambitions. In fact, they even wanted to kill the Western Desert King, but this would require them to increase the strength of their souls to at least Spiritual Transformation Tier.
Thus, they began to refine the Ghost Spirit Crystals with all their might.
However, when the strength of Ling Han’s soul reached the peak stage of the True Self Tier,
he discovered that he couldn’t take another step further.
Just like how the strength of his soul had advanced into the True Self Tier, killing ordinary Yin souls would have no effect on him, and it was the same now.
He wasn’t the only one. Chi Menghan was the same.
This could only mean one thing, and that was there was an upper limit to how much the Ghost Spirit Crystals could improve one’s Spiritual Power, and that was the peak stage of the True
Self Tier.

Now, if they joined forces, they could even match Yin soul elites at the peak stage of Spirit Transformation Tier. However, against Yin soul elites at the level of Sect Master, they could only flee in panic, completely outmatched.
No wonder those Spirit Transformation Tier yin souls didn’t think of stealing from the Ghost Spirit Crystals they were guarding at all, because this was completely useless to them.
Ling Han still had many Ghost Spirit Crystals in his possession. Of course, these were still useful, as he could bring them out for the empress and the others.
“What do we do? Are we just going to retreat like this?” Chi Menghan was unwilling to give
up.

If they could kill the Western Desert King, the entire mine would belong to the Chi Clan. At that time, the younger generation of the Chi Clan would be able to cultivate their soul to an astonishing level, far surpassing their peers.
Ling Han remained silent. After a while, he turned to look at Chi Menghan, only to see that she was also looking at him. Her eyes were burning, and it was as if her entire soul was glowing.
“You’re not thinking the same as me, are you?” the two of them asked at the same time.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “The Western Desert King has been nurturing troops all this while. Sooner or later, a battle will break out, and at that time, we will take advantage of the opening
to cut him off!”
“That suits me,” Chi Menghan said with a smile.
The two of them were really extremely bold. They actually dared to cut them off and reap the gains of an existence like that.
“Let’s have a good discussion. If we really get into a battle, how should we proceed?”

The two of them were in high spirits. Now, the only thing that could make them wary was the Sect Master yin soul, and once the Western Desert King started fighting with other yin soul forces, their attention would definitely be focused on the Sect Master yin souls.
This gave them a chance to fish in troubled waters.
Of course, this was also plucking chestnuts from the fire, so it would definitely be extremely
dangerous.
They were livinb souls, so no matter how much they suppressed their aura, as long as they were close enough, they would naturally be seen clearly.
However, this was a great opportunity, and they didn’t want to miss it.

Time passed faster here, and Ling Han began to deduce formation techniques. He and Chi Menghan cultivated the Heavenly Brilliance Technique together, trying their best to unearth the profound secrets contained within.
This was an Imperial Technique. It would not be an exaggeration to say that one would gain new comprehensions even if he cultivated diligently for his whole life.
Just like that, a month passed, and the two of them finally saw their chance.
The Western Desert King was about to mobilize his troops against the Heavenly River King.

chapters.title: Chapter 4006: Fishing in troubled waters
paragraphs: The chance had finally come.

Ling Han and Chi Menghan were both rubbing their fists. This was the best chance for them to break through to the Spirit Transformation Tier in terms of strength of their souls, and what made the two of them feel that it was a pity was that that early stage Spirit Transformation Tier yin soul shouldn’t have been killed so early, but should have been used to help them break through.
It was too late for regrets now.

Thankfully, they didn’t necessarily require a great yin soul of Spirit Transformation Tier to take this step, but rather one in True Self Tier was enough, so they would have a greater range of choices.
They waited patiently. A month later, they saw the Western Desert King lead an army into battle. All his elite subordinates followed him, and there was no one to mine or guard the
mine.
This opportunity naturally could not be missed. Chi Menghuan once again summoned the clan members to continue mining, while she and Ling Han set out with the Western Desert King’s team.
The army travelled for three days, and another army appeared ahead of them. It was vast and boundless, and the weakest was at the level of the Core Formation Tier.
The two sides did not speak any nonsense, and immediately began an intense battle.
Boom!

The commanders-in-chief of both sides also moved. They were all Sect Master-level great yin souls. In a clash of blows, the yin soul elites in the surroundings instantly collapsed in droves, causing the remaining yin souls to hide far away, not daring to approach and deliver themselves to their deaths.
“This is our chance.” Ling Han and Chi Menghan exchanged a glance before charging forward together.
‘Die!’
They used the Heavenly Brilliance Technique. Multiple rays of dazzling light flickered, and the Yin souls in the surroundings also collapsed continuously.
“Mere living souls dare to take advantage of the crisis!” A great Yin soul charged over. This was a Spirit Transformation Tier, and a late stage at that.
Ling Han and Chi Menghan merely defended and didn’t attack this large monster. They roamed around and started to massacre the other small monsters.

Countless Yin souls collapsed, and there was no shortage of True Self Tier ones among them, causing the strength of Ling Han and Chi Menghan’s souls to begin to slowly increase again, charging towards Spiritual Transformation Tier.
In this kind of war, they were not the only ones who had improved.

It could be seen that there was an endless stream of Core Formation Tier yin souls breaking through to True Self Tier, and True Self Tier yin souls breaking through to Spiritual Transformation Tier. However, comparatively speaking, there were pitifully few yin souls breaking through to Spiritual Transformation Tier.
Boom, amidst a terrifying aura fluctuation, a Spiritual Transformation Tier peak stage Yin soul also completed its breakthrough, leaping into Sect Master-level in a single stroke.
However, this was the beginning of its misfortune.

The Western Desert King and Heavenly River King, who were battling fiercely, immediately stopped. Then, they charged towards the Yin soul that had just broken through to Sect Master Tier. The two of them actually joined forces.

Their strength far surpassed the early stage of Minor Advanced Tier, and it was the two of them working together at that. How could the newly promoted Sect Master Yin soul possibly match them? It was only about a hundred moves, and it was forcefully torn to shreds.

Then, its copious amount of soul energy was immediately absorbed by the Western Desert King and the Heavenly River King, causing their strength to increase by a significant amount. Seeing this scene, Ling Han couldn’t help but curse internally. Then, he looked towards Chi Menghan, and the two of them had the same thought.

-Had this Western Desert King and Heavenly River King attained previous agreement? Their opposition was only an act, and their true motive was to have their subordinates develop and improve, so that they would be able to devour them?

Perhaps there were other Yin souls that thought the same, but now that the flames of war were raging, no one could turn back. Otherwise, they would be overwhelmed by the boundless Yin souls. Additionally, every Yin soul that was still alive was becoming stronger, and this had also become a powerful temptation that they were unwilling to give up.
Becoming stronger, this was a longing that was written in their bones.
“Something’s not right. Let’s go after breaking through to Spirit Transformation Tier.”
“All right.”

Ling Han and Chi Menghan also set their targets. Although the longer they battled here, the better. However, if they were too greedy, the consequences would also be extremely severe. Both of them had great intelligence, as well as great decisiveness, and knew that this was not a good place, and they could not stay too long.
Not long after, another Spiritual Transformation Tier Yin soul broke through, but it immediately suffered the same fate, being jointly killed by the Western Desert King and the Heavenly River King.
It was as if they were rearing venomous insects, waiting for the strongest to appear, and then kill and devour them.
Ling Han suddenly thought that the Netherworld beings should not only be Yin souls on the level of Sect Master. Then what about Yin souls on the level of Venerate Tier, or even Saint-level?
Were they hiding in the dark, waiting for the breakthrough of Sect Master-level yin souls? Then, would they move, and use these Yin souls as nutrients to improve themselves?
F***, this place was really chaotic.
After battling for a while longer, Ling Han and Chi Menghan both lit up. They had broken
through.
Spiritual Transformation Tier!
They could not be greedy to the point of insatiableness.
The two of them exchanged a glance before turning around to leave.
“Humph, you still want to flee?” A cold laugh rang out, and the Western Desert King suddenly abandoned the Heavenly River King and charged towards the two of them, “Since you’re
already here, then just stay behind.”
It stretched out a hand to grab, and with a single hand, it could blot out the skies. It was a dark mass, and there were endless seals flickering, terrifying without bounds.

Ling Han and Chi Menghan hurriedly shot out the Heavenly Brilliance Technique. The Imperial Technique was naturally extraordinary. Boundless brilliance dazzled, raising their battle prowess to the level of Sect Master.
However, their battle prowess was at most at the early stage of Minor Advanced Tier, but the Western Desert King’s strength was at the middle stage of Minor Advanced Tier. The gap was
huge.
Peng!
With just a single strike, Ling Han and Chi Menghan were both sent flying.
“Let’s go!”
Though their souls were trembling violently, they did not even recover for a moment, and
immediately began to flee.

“You think you can leave?” Heavenly River King also charged over, a cold smile on his lips. “What a pity. Such a delicious living soul has to be eaten when it’s so weak. If I could wait until you attain Minor Advanced Tier, that would really be delicious and nourishing.” “Humph, these two living souls have mastered an amazing technique. When they advance into Minor Advanced Tier, will you still be a match for them?” the Western Desert King
scoffed.
“True.” Heavenly River King nodded.
F***, these two Yin souls had indeed long since collaborated. The so-called war was merely breeding venomous insects.
How could Ling Han and Chi Menghan dare to continue fighting? They hurriedly leaped into
the air and fled.
However, their cultivation level was far inferior, so how could their speed compare to the Western Desert King and Heavenly River King’s? They quickly caught up to them.
As Ling Han attacked, he said, “Are you two Ghost Kings going to chase out just like this?
Aren’t you afraid that one of your lackeys will break through to the level of Sect Master, sneak away, and establish their own forces?”
“Humph, it won’t take much time to kill the two of you!” The Western Desert King was
unmoved.
Ling Han’s left hand shook. Boom! Destructive Energy surged, and he said proudly, “Then why don’t you guys give it a try!”
Seeing the black energy, a hint of wariness appeared on the Western Desert King and Heavenly
River King’s faces.

Though Ling Han was so weak that he couldn’t even withstand a single blow from them, this black energy was incredibly terrifying. To them, it was definitely a deadly weapon, and possessed an indescribable threat.
“How about it?” Ling Han asked calmly. “It’s indeed possible that you people will kill us.
However, it’s hard to say how much time you’ll need. Moreover, if I put my life on the line,
one of you will definitely be severely wounded. At that time... hoho, I wonder if the other person will be benevolent?”
When these words fell, both the Western Desert King and the Heavenly River King looked
hesitant.

Ling Han and Chi Menghan were both rubbing their fists.

This was the best chance for them to break through to the Spirit Transformation Tier in terms of strength of their souls, and what made the two of them feel that it was a pity was that that early stage Spirit Transformation Tier yin soul shouldn’t have been killed so early, but should have been used to help them break through.
It was too late for regrets now.

Thankfully, they didn’t necessarily require a great yin soul of Spirit Transformation Tier to take this step, but rather one in True Self Tier was enough, so they would have a greater range of choices.
They waited patiently.
A month later, they saw the Western Desert King lead an army into battle.
All his elite subordinates followed him, and there was no one to mine or guard the
mine.
This opportunity naturally could not be missed.
Chi Menghuan once again summoned the clan members to continue mining, while she and Ling Han set out with the Western Desert King’s team.
The army travelled for three days, and another army appeared ahead of them.
It was vast and boundless, and the weakest was at the level of the Core Formation Tier.
The two sides did not speak any nonsense, and immediately began an intense battle.
Boom!
The commanders-in-chief of both sides also moved.
They were all Sect Master-level great yin souls.

In a clash of blows, the yin soul elites in the surroundings instantly collapsed in droves, causing the remaining yin souls to hide far away, not daring to approach and deliver themselves to their deaths.
“This is our chance.” Ling Han and Chi Menghan exchanged a glance before charging forward together.
‘Die!’
They used the Heavenly Brilliance Technique.
Multiple rays of dazzling light flickered, and the Yin souls in the surroundings also collapsed continuously.
“Mere living souls dare to take advantage of the crisis!” A great Yin soul charged over.
This was a Spirit Transformation Tier, and a late stage at that.
Ling Han and Chi Menghan merely defended and didn’t attack this large monster.
They roamed around and started to massacre the other small monsters.

Countless Yin souls collapsed, and there was no shortage of True Self Tier ones among them, causing the strength of Ling Han and Chi Menghan’s souls to begin to slowly increase again, charging towards Spiritual Transformation Tier.
In this kind of war, they were not the only ones who had improved.
It could be seen that there was an endless stream of Core Formation Tier yin souls breaking through to True Self Tier, and True Self Tier yin souls breaking through to Spiritual Transformation Tier.
However, comparatively speaking, there were pitifully few yin souls breaking through to Spiritual Transformation Tier.
Boom, amidst a terrifying aura fluctuation, a Spiritual Transformation Tier peak stage Yin soul also completed its breakthrough, leaping into Sect Master-level in a single stroke.
However, this was the beginning of its misfortune.
The Western Desert King and Heavenly River King, who were battling fiercely, immediately stopped.
Then, they charged towards the Yin soul that had just broken through to Sect Master Tier.
The two of them actually joined forces.
Their strength far surpassed the early stage of Minor Advanced Tier, and it was the two of them working together at that.
How could the newly promoted Sect Master Yin soul possibly match them?
It was only about a hundred moves, and it was forcefully torn to shreds.
Then, its copious amount of soul energy was immediately absorbed by the Western Desert King and the Heavenly River King, causing their strength to increase by a significant amount.
Seeing this scene, Ling Han couldn’t help but curse internally.
Then, he looked towards Chi Menghan, and the two of them had the same thought.
-Had this Western Desert King and Heavenly River King attained previous agreement?
Their opposition was only an act, and their true motive was to have their subordinates develop and improve, so that they would be able to devour them?
Perhaps there were other Yin souls that thought the same, but now that the flames of war were raging, no one could turn back.
Otherwise, they would be overwhelmed by the boundless Yin souls.
Additionally, every Yin soul that was still alive was becoming stronger, and this had also become a powerful temptation that they were unwilling to give up.
Becoming stronger, this was a longing that was written in their bones.
“Something’s not right.
Let’s go after breaking through to Spirit Transformation Tier.”
“All right.”
Ling Han and Chi Menghan also set their targets.
Although the longer they battled here, the better.
However, if they were too greedy, the consequences would also be extremely severe.
Both of them had great intelligence, as well as great decisiveness, and knew that this was not a good place, and they could not stay too long.
Not long after, another Spiritual Transformation Tier Yin soul broke through, but it immediately suffered the same fate, being jointly killed by the Western Desert King and the Heavenly River King.
It was as if they were rearing venomous insects, waiting for the strongest to appear, and then kill and devour them.

Then what about Yin souls on the level of Venerate Tier, or even Saint-level?
Were they hiding in the dark, waiting for the breakthrough of Sect Master-level yin souls?
Then, would they move, and use these Yin souls as nutrients to improve themselves?
F***, this place was really chaotic.

They had broken
through.
Spiritual Transformation Tier!
They could not be greedy to the point of insatiableness.
The two of them exchanged a glance before turning around to leave.

already here, then just stay behind.”

Boundless brilliance dazzled, raising their battle prowess to the level of Sect Master.

The gap was
huge.
Peng!

immediately began to flee.

scoffed.

chapters.title: Chapter 4007: Persuasion
paragraphs: Though Ling Han’s words were a little exaggerated, they were not without reason.

Though this living soul was not strong, and the black energy was not very strong either, just that little bit was enough to wound them, and even if they were only slightly injured, it would cause a change in the comparison of strength between the two great Sect Master yang soul yin souls.
Once the balance was broken, it would be impossible for them to continue cooperating. Instead, they would fight to the death.
“Thus, you all had best go and reap the rewards of your subordinates,” Ling Han once again tossed out his suggestion.
The Western Desert King and Heavenly River King looked at each other, both unwilling.
Let the living souls escape?
It would be a pity to let go of such a delicious dessert. Furthermore, this was also a matter of pride.
But Ling Han was right. This would lead to a stalemate.
The two great Yin souls were both resolute. They had been preparing for this battle for a very long time, and definitely could not allow a mishap to happen just because of two mere living souls.
Let’s go.
Ling Han breathed a sigh of relief. He looked toward Chi Menghan, only to discover that she was also drenched in cold sweat. This was despite the fact that they were both in spirit form.

They didn’t dare to stay any longer. In any case, they had already successfully raised the strength of their souls to the Spiritual Transformation Tier. Now that they had achieved their goal, there was naturally no need for them to stay any longer.

The two of them turned around, and arrived at the place where they had first entered. After sending out a signal, the elite of the Donglin Imperial Clan immediately controlled the green-skinned gourd, and sucked out their souls.
Instantly, Ling Han discovered that his body was light and airy, as if he could not be restrained at all, and was naturally incredibly close with the heaven and earth.
He had absolutely no wish to return to his own body. That would cause him to be heavily bound.
But the moment this thought arose, he hurriedly suppressed it.
Without the support of his physical body, how was he supposed to cultivate?
If there was only a soul, he would be like duckweed without roots, and could not be maintained for long.
He hurriedly returned to his physical body and fused into his mind. Instantly, he felt a swelling pain in his mind, as if it was about to explode.
This was very normal. His spirit had suddenly advanced from the Core Formation Tier to the Spiritual Transformation Tier. It was much, much stronger, and the mind was still unable to adapt to it.
His entire body was glowing. His soul was too powerful, surpassing the cultivation level of the physical body, as if it was about to burst out.
Ling Han worked hard for a long time, and finally allowed his body to accommodate his soul. However, if he wanted to completely fuse with his body like before, he still needed some time.
“Why hasn’t our prized heir returned yet?” someone shouted loudly.
This was a Dao Protector. He looked indescribably old, and was definitely not a prodigy that had come this time.
“Why hasn’t the Dao Child of our sect woken up for so long?” another Dao Protector cried out in grief.
Obviously, the souls of these people had all been obliterated in the Netherworld, and it was eternally impossible for them to come back to life.
The Donglin Imperial Clan only expressed regret about this. As for compensation, they didn’t mention it at all.
They had already expressed that it was extremely dangerous to enter into the Netherworld, and anyone who entered would bear the consequences.

If this were any other force, the likes of the Soaring Snake Holy Land and the Three Flowers Sect would definitely not let the matter go. However, this was the Imperial Clan, so who dared to behave atrociously? Wouldn’t they be afraid that the Saint of this clan would appear and destroy everything?
Thus, they naturally could only swallow this humiliation.

Ling Han and Chi Menghan were the last to return, but they weren’t too late either. Because time passed differently, even if they stayed in the Netherworld for a few dozen more days, only a few days had passed here.
As long as they could come back alive, they would all receive great benefits. The strength of their souls would at least reach the level of the True Self Tier.

This couldn’t help them advance their battle prowess to the True Self Tier, but it did help them establish a firm foundation in advance. In the future, once they advanced to the True Self Tier, their battle prowess would definitely be able to crush their peers.

None of the kickass prodigies died, such as Sha Yang, Yi Yuanrong, Zhu Yixiu. They all received astonishing benefits, their whole person exuding light, as if they could take that crucial step at any time, and advance into the True Self Tier.

“Brother Ding, welcome back,” Shen Yutang said to Ling Han with a smile as he walked over. Ling Han also nodded. He glanced at this guy, and felt that this person was becoming deeper and deeper. His aura was hidden, and he was hiding his strength.

“Hahaha, young friends, congratulations on your return. You can be considered to have passed the second round of the assessment,” the old Sect Master of the Donglin Imperial Clan said. He glanced at each of them, but his gaze lingered on Ling Han for a moment longer. Though it was really a very negligible instant, Ling Han could still sense it.
“Next, it will be the final test.”

The old Sect Master smiled calmly, “It just so happens that a mother tree of our clan has ripened, and a total of seven fruits can be plucked. Thus, this time, we plan to invite seven young friends to enter into our clan, and share the celestial fruits with us.”
Mother tree!

Instantly, everyone’s eyes lit up. This was the mother tree, something that a planet could only nurture one of. That was at least a Venerate Tier Celestial Plant, so just how nutritious would the fruits it produced be?
However, there were only seven spots!
Everyone looked at each other. Meanwhile, those prodigies of consummate level Core Formation Tier smiled. These seven people would definitely only come from among them.

“In martial arts, though strength is the most important, one also has to see potential. You can’t think that you’re definitely the strongest just because you’ve cultivated a few years earlier and have a higher cultivation level.” The old Sect Master spoke again, “So, next, please attack with all your might on the Black Heaven Stone.”
“This Black Heaven Stone was created by a Saint of our clan. It can examine the cultivation level, age, and battle prowess of the user in a comprehensive manner, and ultimately obtain a
potential value.”
“This may not be the most accurate, but the gap would not be too far.”
Hearing his words, those Core Formation Tier cultivators who were at the consummate level all frowned, while those who were at a lower cultivation level smiled.
In a comparison of strength, with a higher cultivation level, it was indeed very difficult to compensate for the difference. However, this was a comparison of potential, and that was a
different story.
They were all supreme prodigies, so who would be afraid of who?
Very soon, a large rock was brought over. It looked very ordinary.

The old Sect Master smiled calmly, and said, “This is the stone that the Saint of our clan has been sitting on to comprehend Dao. At first, it was very ordinary, but in the end, it has become a precious treasure. You all can use your full power to attack it. The potential value is shown in terms of the number of stars you have. The more stars you have, the higher your potential.”
“Dare I ask, senior, how many stars would qualify?” someone asked.

The old Sect Master pondered for a moment, then said, “Those who have reached Three Stars in the test of our Clan, the lowest accomplishment would be Sect Master, and those who have reached Five Stars have all become Venerate Tier.”
This involuntarily caused everyone’s interest to be piqued. Though they all firmly believed that they could become Venerates, having such clear proof could still make them more
confident.
“Senior, may I know how many Stars can the most prodigious prodigy of your noble clan blast out?” another person asked.
The old Sect Master’s eyes involuntarily lit up. He seemed to have thought of someone, and a relieved expression appeared on his face, “In our race, the strongest person has lit up seven
stars!”
Hiss, if he could become a Venerate with a result of five Stars, then seven Stars... could he
become a Saint?
Who was it?
The old Sect Master smiled calmly, “Becoming a Saint does not only require potential, but also luck. Thus, it is not certain. It is not definite.”
Though he said that it was not definite, that smug look on his face clearly signified that he
was extremely proud.
