chapters.title: Chapter 4008: Black Heaven Stone
paragraphs: Everyone was curious. Which clansman of the Donglin Imperial Clan was so awesome?

It was either the Imperial Son or the Imperial Daughter. Furthermore, he or she must be from the present generation. Otherwise, the old Sect Master would have had a nostalgic expression on his face, and not this incredibly proud expression.
Who exactly was it?
Yet a thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind, and he thought of someone.
Chi Menghan.
Though he had only come into contact with her soul, Ling Han had a feeling that this woman was very strong.
“Hehe, young friends, come on.” The old Sect Master withdrew his smugness, and beckoned everyone over.

“I’ll go!” Immediately, a man walked out. He was in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, and couldn’t be considered the strongest among them. However, this Black Heaven Stone was only a test of potential, and cultivation level wasn’t the key.

“How about this? Each person has three chances to make a move,” the old Sect Master said. “Among the three chances, take the one with the best result. However, after the first time is over, don’t drag things out any longer.”
“Understood,” the man replied with a nod. He then composed himself before throwing another punch at the Black Heaven Stone.
This punch was really terrifying. He had even stimulated high-level energy. Multiple patterns lit up, and there were also multiple shattered seals, exuding an incredibly terrifying aura.
Boom!
When this punch landed, a fierce light suddenly exploded on the Black Heaven Stone, as if nothing could be seen clearly even if one’s eyes were open.

After a while, the brilliance dispersed completely, and the man still maintained the posture of having his right fist land on the Black Heaven Stone, while the Black Heaven Stone was completely unmoved.

This surprised everyone. That was because the Black Heaven Stone was only laid out on the ground, and had not been fixed with any kind of technique, but such a fierce punch actually did not move it in the slightest.
Something that the Saint had once used was really that amazing.

Everyone looked again, and saw that multiple stars had also lit up on the Black Heaven Stone. Upon counting, there were a total of three stars, and the third one was still flickering, as if it would dim at any moment.
However, in the end, this star still stabilized, and maintained its brightness.
Three Stars!

The man immediately looked disappointed. Though from the experience of the Donglin Imperial Clan, his future accomplishments would be at least Sect Master, he was one of the top hundred of the Galaxy Network, and Sect Master was definitely not his ultimate goal. “Hehe, young friend, you don’t have to be concerned. There are still two chances,” the old Sect Master said. “You’re allowed to use the Spirit Tool, but it can’t be activated.”

Allowing the use of a Spirit Tool was to ensure that those who were skilled in using weapons would not be at a disadvantage, and the fact that it could not be activated was also for the sake of fairness. That was because added with one’s own power and the power of a Spirit Tool, battle prowess would definitely soar greatly.
This wasn’t a competition of Spirit Tools.
The man nodded, and took out a sword. After standing quietly for a while, he had already accumulated enough power, and struck out with the sword again.
It was still three stars, but this time, the third star did not flicker continuously. Instead, it had long since stabilized.
The man refused to give up, and delivered another powerful strike. In the end, it was still only three stars, and he was not even able to make the fourth star flicker for a moment.
He was defiant, and was just about to deliver another strike, when someone pushed him aside.
“Trash, step aside.” The person who pushed him was a burly man. His right hand pushed the person away, while his left hand delivered a palm strike.
Barely four stars!

Previously, the man had wanted to flip out, but when he saw that the other had actually activated his fourth star, his aura instantly weakened. Added with the fact that the old Sect Master’s sharp gaze was already directed at him, his heart trembled, and he chose to swallow his anger.
In the end, the sturdy man’s result was still four stars after three strikes.
This was not an easy feat. If he worked harder in future, he may even be able to become a Venerate.

Everyone stepped forward to undergo the test, one after another. They could see that the majority of them were Three Stars, and only a rare few could reach Four Stars. This caused those who had achieved a result of Four Stars to look pleased.
The mother tree’s celestial fruits were in sight.
Slowly, the majority had completed the test, and only a few people were left.
These people were either keeping a low profile or wanting to show off.
Ling Han was also among them, but he naturally didn’t think that he was showing off. Really, he was just keeping a low profile.
“Let me take the lead.” Zhu Yixiu walked out. He was ranked fourth in Core Formation Tier on the Galaxy Network, and was also the top Core Formation Tier of the East Heavenly Realm.
Thus, when they saw him walk out, those who had achieved a result of four stars all showed expressions of interest.
This person was a great rival.

chapters.title: Chapter 4009: Pseudo-Eight Stars
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Hehe.” A cold laugh rang out, and Fu Huoyang walked out.
Fu Huoyang, Imperial Clan!
Of course, he was only from a side branch of the Imperial Clan, but being able to be associated with the Imperial Clan meant that he was powerful.
Fu Huoyang didn’t activate his Spirit Tool. Instead, he casually delivered a palm strike, and after the Black Heaven Stone trembled for a while, six stars lit up at the same time.
p***l
Immediately, exclamations of shock rang out from the crowd. A six-star genius had actually appeared.
Meanwhile, Fu Huoyang frowned slightly. Before the test, everyone thought that they would definitely be overwhelmingly awesome, but ideals always went against reality.
Six stars, compared to the prodigy of the Donglin Imperial Clan, he was still one star short.
Even though it was only one star and didn’t seem like much, top-notch prodigies like Yi Yuanrong and Zhu Yixiu were only five stars. It could be seen just how colossal the gap of one star was.
Fu Huoyang launched two more attacks, but this still didn’t change his final result of six stars.

He stepped to one side, slightly displeased, but the gazes that everyone directed at him were filled with envy and jealousy. This was the Imperial Clan. Merely a side branch clansman was capable of producing a result of six stars. What would happen if the Fu Clan sent the real Imperial Son or Imperial Daughter, over?
Seven stars?

So that the Chi Clan would not be the only shining star ahead of them? Subsequently, Zhu Chengyun, who had once been the strongest person in the Cauldron Forging Tier, also stepped forward to take the test. At present, he was only in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, but this was not a competition of battle prowess, so he too had achieved a result of five stars. This caused those four-star geniuses to complain internally. Looks like the awesome people were all lined up behind them. If there were a few more five-star geniuses, they would all be eliminated.
Calculating, there were already three five-stars and one six-star.

Sha Yang also went up, but though he was the second in the current generation of the Core Formation Tier, he was still unable to change his destiny of five stars, and was unable to break through to six stars.
“Let me try.” Shi Yongming walked out.
The Buddhist Race’s Imperial Son. Of course, he was from the branch in the West Heavenly Realm,
Everyone couldn’t help but widen their eyes, watching carefully.
This was an Imperial Son, so he should not be inferior to Fu Huoyang, or even surpass Fu Huoyang.
Peng!
Shi Yongming shot out a strike, and multiple stars immediately popped up on the Black Heaven Stone.
Six!
No, five stars.
The sixth star indeed lit up, but after flickering for a moment, it dimmed again. What did this mean?
Shi Yongming was no match for Fu Huoyang.
What a joke. The Imperial Son was actually inferior to a clansman from the branch family?
Could it be that the Buddhist Race was far inferior to the Fu Clan?

It could not be said that way, because Fu Huoyang possessed the bloodline of the Great Emperor of the Fu Clan, and the Buddhist Race was too unique. As long as one believed in the Ancestral Buddha, he would be able to become a member of the Buddhist Race. Even the Imperial Son actually did not have any relation in terms of bloodline.
Something like bloodline really could not be underestimated.

And Ling Han had a further deduction, and that was the Buddha Son of the East, South, West and North Heavenly Realms were all not the true trump cards of the Buddhist Race. That was because Prosperous Heaven had once said that the true land of the Buddhist Race lay beyond the thirty three Heavens. Was there no Buddha Son there?
The true inheritance of the Buddhist Race should belong to the Buddhist Son there.

After three consecutive attacks, Shi Yongming was still unable to completely stabilize his record of six stars. He could only be considered close to six stars. This caused him to be ranked second now. Taking into account the number of people remaining, he would definitely pass, but second place was obviously not enough to satisfy him. Thus, his expression was still very tense.
Shen Yutang looked towards Ling Han, and asked, “You first?”
“You go first,” Ling Han said.
“AU right.” Shen Yutang did not hold back. He walked in front of the Black Heaven Stone, and tapped out a finger, which he pressed onto the stone.
He didn’t show any anger, and it was as if he were doing this casually. There was no flash of brilliance.
This caused quite a number of people to shake their heads. Everyone was trying their best to perform, yet you are so casual. Aren’t you afraid of angering the Imperial Clan?
Pu, the attack landed, and seven stars flickered.
What!
Everyone was numb with shock. This was too terrifying, wasn’t it? Seven stars and he had caught up to that prodigy from the Donglin Imperial Clan.
No, the seventh star has dimmed,” someone immediately said.
“That’s right!”
Although Shen Yutang’s attack had activated seven stars, the seventh star was not stable. It seemed to be hesitating whether or not to give him a judgement of seven stars.
After a while, the seventh star finally dimmed.
Six stars, but it could also be considered close to seven stars.
First place!
Though Fu Huoyang was also a six-star genius, he was not even qualified to make the seventh star light up. Compared to Shen Yutang, the gap was very obvious.
Instantly, the gazes everyone directed at Shen Yutang changed. This guy, it was possible that he would become a Saint in future. In this world, Saints were the most powerful!
Shen Yutang, meanwhile, scratched his head, looking completely laidback. He did not launch a second or third attack, but rather returned with his hands clasped behind his back.
“Young friend, you still have two chances!” the old Sect Master reminded.
“No need, it’s fine as long as it is a pass,” Shen Yutang said.
F***, just how lazy was this guy? He was not even willing to fight for a better result.
Hehe, good, good.” The old Sect Master smiled, and the gaze he directed at Shen Yutang was very gentle. Clearly, he was extremely satisfied with this young man.
Counting again now, four five stars, one pseudo six stars, one six stars, one pseudo seven stars... fine, the seven spots had all been filled.
Those four-star geniuses all sighed in despair. They had been smug for so long, yet in the end, their hopes had all been dashed.
“Brother Ding, go,” Shen Yutang said calmly to Ling Han as he walked back to him.
Ling Han nodded, and walked forwards.
Ding Yi arrived.

Many people “recognized” him. This was the newly risen super genius in the West Heavenly Realm recently, it was said that he was capable of defeating Core Formation Tiers when he was only in Cauldron Forging Tier, and was overwhelmingly awesome.
How many stars could he unleash?

Previously, everyone had hoped that the fewer stars that others could light up, the better, so that they could pass the test, but now, there was no hope at all. ’ Their mentality immediately changed. Instead, they hoped that Ling Han could light up a result of five or six stars.
In this way, even five-star geniuses were destined to be eliminated, which made them feel much better.
You see, even the five-star geniuses had been eliminated, so they didn’t feel that it was unjust.
“Ding Yi, go!”
“I have a high opinion of you.”
“Don’t cower, just do it!”
Ling Han was rendered speechless. He was going to test his potential; what did this have to do with these people?

He walked closer, raised his right fist, and thought for a moment. He did not use any technique, nor did he draw on any high-level energy. He merely unleashed his mystical power, unleashed his full power, and then blasted it onto the Black Heaven Stone.
Instantly, a series of stars lit up.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven... eight!
p***l

All of a sudden, everyone’s eyes widened, as if they had seen a ghost. Though everyone hoped that Ling Han would achieve a good result, and thus disrupt the situation, none of them had expected that Ling Han would actually be so awesome, to actually blast out eight stars.
Eight stars, even surpassing the one from the Donglin Imperial Clan.
“Yi, not eight stars.”
“The eighth star is flickering.”
“It’s getting dark.”
Everyone exclaimed in shock, and saw that the eighth star was not stable It was flickering, and after a while, it finally dimmed, and became seven stars..

chapters.title: Chapter 4010: Psychic fruits of cultivation
paragraphs: Even if the result of eight stars hadn’t been stabilized, this still caused an incomparable commotion.
Seven stars!
To be more precise, it was close to eight stars.

Could the person from the Donglin Imperial Clan compare? More importantly, Ling Han’s attack had been too casual. He hadn’t used the celestial technique, nor had he drawn on high- level energy. Everyone could see this clearly.

If he could deliver an attack that was close to eight stars with such an attack, then if he delivered a full-power attack, to say nothing of nine stars, it should be no problem to stabilize it at eight stars.
At this moment, everyone was dumbfounded as they stared at Ling Han. They were rendered completely speechless.
Fu Huoyang’s expression instantly became as dark as could be.

He was a six-star genius, and there was a gap of almost two stars between his potential and Ling Han’s pseudo eight stars. This was too terrifying, and it meant that as long as their cultivation levels were equal, he probably wouldn’t even be able to block a single move from Ling Han.
As a member of the Imperial Clan, he was actually inferior to Ling Han?
It should be known that this person was also his enemy – though he did not take him to heart at all, from the look of things now, this could possibly become a great danger to him.
Damn it, what natural treasures had this brat ingested?

However, it was also precisely because of this that Fu Huoyang wanted even more to obtain Ling Han’s blood. The Ten Thousand Spirit Blood Pill that he concocted from this should have extremely good effects.

Shi Yongming’s expression didn’t look any better. He had attempted to rob Ling Han in the Netherworld, yet he had been defeated by Ling Han in the end. He had fled in a sorry state, and now that he saw that Ling Han’s potential was far superior to his, he was extremely embarrassed.
Even Shen Yutang was slightly surprised. Though he already had a very high opinion of Ling Han, he had not expected that the latter’s potential would actually surpass his own.
However, his temperament was calm, and he couldn’t be bothered to compete with others. Thus, he only smiled and left.

Meanwhile, Ling Han gritted his teeth. See, he had initially wanted to keep a low profile, and deliberately did not use celestial techniques, Destructive Energy, and so on. He wanted to pass the test without being too high-profile.
Unexpectedly, he had only thrown an ordinary punch, and it was actually a result that was close to eight stars.
Sigh.
Forget it. Since it had already come to this, it would be useless even if he regretted it.
Ling Han smiled, turned around and walked back.
“Young friend, are you not going to try again?” the old Sect Master asked.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “No, it’s better to keep a low profile.”
‘You want to keep a low profile?’

F***, showing off, he was really too good at showing off.

“Now, you four five-star geniuses will have to go through a selection. One has to be eliminated.” The old Sect Master looked towards Zhu Yixiu and the others. They had all achieved a result of five stars.
There was no need for Ling Han to worry about this. He only had to wait to eat the celestial fruits after entering into the Donglin Imperial Clan.

Who had been eliminated?
Yi Yuanrong.
Why her?

Ling Han felt that the biggest reason was because she was a woman, and the Donglin Imperial Clan had held this prodigy gathering in the name of finding a husband for Chi Menghuan. What was the point of having a woman here? So that they could develop homos*xual love?

They entered into a Transfer Formation, and then arrived at the true ancestral grounds of the Imperial Clan.
This was a celestial mountain, and the heaven and earth here was extremely abundant with
energy.
Ling Han felt like every single hair on his body was floating, as if they were feathers that could
ascend to the heavens.
“F***, Black Spirit Ginseng.”
“Great Yin Flower.”
“Heaven’s Fortune Vine!”

Everyone was exclaiming in shock. This was practically a paradise on earth. There were incredibly valuable Celestial medicines everywhere, and their grade was not low either. They were at least Four Stars. In fact, there was no shortage of Six or Seven Stars Great Herbs, and they were just growing along the path.
Was this the Imperial Clan? They were far too wealthy!
They climbed the mountain, and arrived halfway up the mountain. Aside from the Celestial medicines that were still scattered all over this place, there were also numerous divine beasts
resting here.
There were Azure Phoenixes, White Tigers, and Qilins. Of course, these definitely weren’t pure-blooded Divine Beasts, because pure-blooded Divine Beasts had already been
exterminated since ancient times.
Ling Han couldn’t help but drool. Even if it wasn’t a pure-blooded Divine Beast, it should be
very nutritious to eat.
“Brother Ding, you’re drooling,” Shen Yutang said from the sidelines. He was slightly
surprised. What was wrong with him?
Ling Han sighed. Too bad, he could look but not eat. This was practically a tragedy of life.

After walking for a while, they arrived at a courtyard at the waist of the mountain. There were walkways and pavilions here, and every stone and pillar exuded Spiritual Qi. “Please sit, please sit,” the old Sect Master said. There was a long stone table here. By now, the highest-ranking person dispatched by the Donglin Imperial Clan was only this old Sect Master. It couldn’t be helped. These prodigies were only at the Core Formation Tier, at most. How could it be that the Imperial Clan would send out Venerate Tiers or even Saints
to receive them?
The Imperial Clan was the strongest force in the world, and did not need to curry the favour of
anyone.
The seven of them sat down respectively, and the old Sect Master also waved his hand. Immediately, someone delivered seven jade boxes, which he placed in front of each of them.

“This is the Spiritual Dao Fruit that my clan has just harvested,” the old Sect Master said. “The Spiritual Dao Fruit was formed by the mother tree, and flowers only bloom once every million years. After all, Saints could only live for millions of years. If they were unlucky, they definitely wouldn’t encounter the ripening period.

“The effect of the Spiritual Dao Fruit is to improve one’s physique in all aspects. Furthermore, it also has a hidden effect, and that is if you suffer a fatal injury, the medicinal effects can still take effect once, saving your lives,” the old Sect Master said solemnly.

The fruit being unable to increase their cultivation level caused the seven of them to feel slightly disappointed, but true treasured medicine actually did not increase their cultivation level, but rather increased their natural talent and potential, paving the way for their future.
And the Spiritual Dao Fruit actually had a life-saving effect, which was naturally even more
miraculous.
“However, this life-saving effect has an upper limit, and that is Sect Master-level.” The old Sect Master continued, “If you guys become Venerate Tier elites, the medicinal effects would
be greatly reduced.”
When these words fell, the seven of them knew that this mother tree was Venerate Tier-level. Thus, its effects on Venerate Tier-level elites were much worse.
This was very normal. They weren’t any relation to the Donglin Imperial Clan, so why would the Donglin Imperial Clan give them the fruit of a Saint-level mother tree?

chapters.title: Chapter 4011: Stunning
paragraphs: A Treasured Fruit from a Venerate Tier-level mother tree was still overwhelmingly awesome.
The seven of them opened the jade box, and saw that there was a fruit that looked like a peach, but also looked like a plum. It was not big, and was slightly smaller than a fist. It was
completely crystalline, like crystal, and its surface was covered with veined patterns, having an indescribable Dao rhythm.
Including Fu Huoyang and Shi Yongming, everyone picked up the celestial fruit and started to eat it.
Treasured Fruits like this would lose a portion of their effects with every second that passed after they were plucked. Thus, the sooner they were consumed, the better.

Ling Han didn’t eat it at the first instant. Although he was a glutton, he didn’t crave it at this moment. He held this Spiritual Dao Fruit and examined it carefully, because he discovered that the veined patterns on it intrigued him even more.
In truth, he also thought that his natural talent was high enough, so a Venerate Tier-level celestial fruit may not be able to improve him much.
What he valued was actually the life-saving effects of the Spiritual Dao Fruit.
However, the veined patterns on the fruit gave him a great appreciation.
When the others had finished eating, Ling Han turned to the old Sect Master and asked, “Senior, would I be qualified to observe that mother tree?”
Yi, what would you be observing the mother tree for?

The old Sect Master had not expected that Ling Han would make such a request, and couldn’t help but feel a little confused. Though the mother tree was the most precious treasure of the world, the process of blooming and bearing fruit was too long. Now that the Treasured Fruits had just been plucked, so what if you went to take a look?
Even if the mother tree was gifted to you, you would not be able to live until the next time the fruits ripened.
“All right, I will agree on behalf of Uncle Wenrui.” A pleasant female voice rang out, and a woman with an exquisite figure also walked over.
How could there be someone with such a perfect figure?

Though she was dressed in a very loose palace dress, it still could not hide the graceful bearing of her figure. Where she should be thin, it was slender enough to be just barely held with a single hand, and where she should be shapely, she would be surging, making one sigh at how big she could be.
Unfortunately, there was actually a veil covering her face, concealing her appearance. Chi Menghan!
Hearing this voice, Ling Han immediately felt a sense of familiarity. Wasn’t this the Imperial Daughter of the Donglin Imperial Clan?
The old Sect Master was stunned for a moment, then nodded, “Since Menghan has already agreed, it would not be proper for me to refuse, so I will agree.”
“Thank you, Senior,” Ling Han said with a bow. He then nodded at Chi Menghan before starting to eat the celestial fruit.

He was a glutton, and in a few moments, he had eaten the whole celestial fruit. This caused Fu Huoyang, Shi Yongming and the others to all cast him looks of disdain. ‘You are too uncultured, and have no image at all.’
However, was this masked woman Chi Menghan?
Everyone looked intoxicated, and even Shi Yongming was no exception.

Although Chi Menghan hadn’t revealed her true appearance, her figure alone was already breathtaking enough. Moreover, with such a beautiful figure, her appearance was definitely breathtakingly beautiful as well. After all, she had been seen by others before, and she was stunningly beautiful. She was ranked third on the Exquisite Leaderboard.
Fu Huoyang was extremely assertive, and he immediately said with a smile, “I’m Fu Huoyang. May I have the honor to see the princess’s true appearance?”

If he could marry the Imperial Daughter of the Donglin Imperial Clan, then not only would he be able to obtain the Imperial Technique of the Chi Clan, even the Fu Clan would view him in a new light, and freely teach him the Imperial Technique.
Thus, he definitely had to seize this opportunity.
Chi Menghan smiled faintly, “You want to see my true appearance? Simple, just defeat me.”
“Your Highness, though this is a bit abrupt, I still want to ask for some guidance from you.” Fu Huoyang stood up, and clasped his hands in Chi Menghan’s direction.
Chi Menghan stepped into the air, and said, “Then, let’s battle in the sky!”
“Wait!” Ling Han wiped his mouth, then smiled at Chi Menghan. “Er, princess, can you leave this person to me?”
‘Hmm?’
Chi Menghan hesitated slightly, then nodded, “All right.”
She stepped lightly with her lotus feet, and returned to the ground.

Fu Huoyang instantly exploded in fury. ‘It wasn’t easy for me to use sparring as an excuse and win the chance to interact with Chi Menghan at close range. Why the f*ck are you butting in?’ “Fu Huoyang, just because you’re a major tier higher than me, you’re bullying me just because my abilities are inferior to yours. You even sent some random nobodies to apprehend me,” Ling Han said with a shake of his head. “Today, we’ll settle this debt.”

He felt very regretful that he had not been able to meet Fu Huoyang in the Netherworld. Otherwise, with the strength of his soul, and the terrifying destructive power of Destructive Energy, killing Fu Huoyang should have been a piece of cake.

In this place, even if his battle prowess overwhelmed Fu Huoyang’s, the Donglin Imperial Clan definitely wouldn’t allow him to kill a person from another Imperial Clan. Otherwise, conflicts might arise between the two great Imperial Clans, and that would be a huge matter. However, even if he couldn’t kill him, he couldn’t let him do as he pleased. No matter what, he had to make him suffer a little.
This had indeed taken effect. Fu Huoyang’s expression was as dark as the bottom of a pot.

“Are you in such a rush to die?” Fu Huoyang asked coldly. In the first place, he had no plans to spare Ling Han, but he also knew that he could not possibly kill anyone in the Imperial Clan. How could it be that the Donglin Imperial Clan did not want face?
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Come!”
He was the first to fly into the air, stepping on empty space. This was the unique ability of Core Formation Tier.
Fu Huoyang also ascended step after step. He felt extremely sullen.

Ling Han was only in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier. He could tell, and so could everyone else. Meanwhile, he was in the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, so defeating Ling Han was only a matter of course. Thus, seeing as he couldn’t kill Ling Han, what benefits
would this battle bring him?
But if he did not fight, he would be even more displeased.
“You are really outrageously bold!” Fu Huoyang shouted loudly, and shot out a punch at Ling
Han.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and also threw a punch, “Fu Huoyang, without the identity of the Imperial Clan, what else do you have?”
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow. Fu Huoyang’s battle prowess of fourteen Heavens exploded, instantly sending Ling Han flying.
However, Ling Han’s current raw power had reached Ninth Heaven. Though this blow had
sent him flying, the Primal Chaos Celestial Core in his body gave a light tremor, and dispersed
all the power that was assailing him.
After flying for several hundred meters, Ling Han finally stopped. He stood with his hands clasped behind his back, completely unharmed.
This!
Everyone was stunned. Though there was no shortage of super geniuses whose battle prowess

had surpassed twenty Heavens, and any one of them was stronger than Fu Huoyang and Ling Han, once Fu Huoyang and Ling Han exchanged blows, they could roughly deduce the battle prowess of the two of them.
One was around Fourteenth Heaven, while the other was only Ninth Heaven, and at most Tenth Heaven. There was a gap of at least four Heavens of battle prowess between them, and
the result was actually a tie?
That’s right. Ling Han was sent flying, but he was completely unscathed. This could only be
considered a tie.
What a freak!
What did it mean by having high battle prowess?
‘I’m stronger than you, so that’s what it means to have higher battle prowess, but now,
someone with higher battle prowess actually didn’t get the upper hand. This is completely
illogical.’
“What a freak!” someone murmured.
This won everyone’s resonance. In fact, even the eyes of that old Sect Master shone with a strange light. Then, he glanced at Chi Menghan, and somewhat understood why the pearl of
their clan would agree to Ling Han’s request.
His performance was too stunning.

their clan would agree to Ling Han’s request.
His performance was too stunning.

chapters.title: Chapter 4012: Fighting Fu Huoyang
paragraphs: Fu Huoyang’s expression instantly became extremely ugly.

It wasn’t that he didn’t know about Ling Han’s freakishness. At that time, when Ling Han was only in the Cauldron Forging Tier, he would only spit out a little blood after taking a strike from him. His freakishness index was off the charts.
But at the time, at least, he had been able to wound Ling Han, and could pose a threat to him, but now?
With this strike, Ling Han actually looked like he was completely unscathed.
How could he accept this?
“Damn it!” he cursed softly, and charged towards Ling Han.
This time, he activated the Imperial Technique. When he launched another attack, the sky was filled with brilliant seals, as if even the heavens could be suppressed.
Battle prowess... Fifteenth Heaven!

Ling Han humphed. The Primal Chaos Celestial Core surged out, releasing the aura of Primal Chaos. Instantly, Fu Huoyang’s battle prowess was pulled downwards in a straight line, falling as much as three Heavens.
Fu Huoyang couldn’t help but feel shocked. This time, his battle prowess had dropped by three Heavens. This was inconceivable, and he was completely stupefied.
Ling Han greeted Fu Huoyang’s attack with his God Slaying Technique.
Boom!
The two of them exchanged another blow, and instantly, it was a draw.
‘Holy motherf*cker!’
Everyone’s eyes widened in shock.
‘Holy f*ck! Is he even human?!’

The early stage of the Core Formation Tier against the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, and it was an Imperial Clan member like Fu Huoyang at that, a prodigy with potential value of six stars, and they actually fought to a tie.
F***, so this was pseudo eight stars?
Fu Huoyang couldn’t accept this either. He stared blankly at Ling Han, but Ling Han threw another punch, forcing him to parry at the first instant.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
The two of them exchanged blows.

At present, Fu Huoyang did not have the sligthest advantage in terms of battle prowess. Under the clash of Imperial Techniques, the rebound of every blow caused his blood to boil, making him feel extremely terrible.

On the other hand, Ling Han’s Primal Chaos Celestial Core replaced the effects of the only Celestial Cauldron, which could disperse all power attacks within six Heavens. Naturally, he was completely unscathed.
How could Fu Huoyang withstand this?
Furthermore, how many moves of Imperial Technique could he channel?

It was only a few times, and his battle prowess had already fallen to Eleventh Heaven. He had no choice but to switch to using the Saint Technique. However, Ling Han was using the God Slaying Technique, and it would last for a much longer time. Instantly, he possessed the advantage of battle prowess of one Heaven, and was completely unafraid of being devoured by the power of the Saint Technique.
In this way, Ling Han’s advantage was naturally extremely obvious.
When one had reached a height like they had, could they afford the gap in battle prowess of one Heaven?
Peng, peng, peng! Fu Huoyang was instantly suppressed. Not only was he in an extremely sorry state, but he was even beginning to suffer injuries. His image was instantly ruined.
“Ah!” Fu Huoyang roared in fury, his eyes turning bloodshot.
He could not tolerate this kind of humiliation. He was a member of the Imperial Clan, so how could he lose at the hands of an ordinary person?
If this matter spread out, not only would he be completely humiliated, he would even be looked at with disdain by his clansmen. In future, he would never be able to raise his head again.

“You are really courting death!” he shouted loudly. Boom, his whole person exuded a frightening aura, and his body was also rapidly expanding, turning into a golden giant that was as tall as 150 meters.
He ignited the Imperial Bloodline, causing his battle prowess to soar.
Shua, he sent out a palm strike. Ling Han brandished his fist to parry, but he was completely outmatched, and his whole person was instantly sent flying.
With a bang, a circle of clouds appeared in the skies.
Ling Han felt a powerful power surge over, making him want to vomit blood.

After combusting his Imperial Bloodline, Fu Huoyang’s battle prowess soared by a whopping ten Heavens. In other words, Fu Huoyang was now ahead of Ling Han by nine Heavens in terms of battle prowess. This had far surpassed the upper limit of the Primal Chaos Celestial
Core.
Thankfully, Ling Han had already activated his Starlight Screen in advance when he sensed the danger. Even so, he was still blasted quite terribly.
The gap in battle prowess was really too wide.
However, the spectators were even more astonished.
“After Fu Huoyang combusts his Imperial Blood, his battle prowess probably reaches 24
Heavens!”
“But Ding Yi’s battle prowess is twelve Heavens.”
“Hiss, there is a whole gap of twelve Heavens, and he only suffered a slight injury after taking
a blow head-on?”
“F***, what kind of freak is this?”

Because everyone was too far away, they did not realize that Fu Huoyang had been affected by Ling Han’s Primal Chaos Celestial Core so his battle prowess had dropped by three Heavens. they would still be incredibly stunned, because there was still a gap of
But even if they
nine Heavens in battle prowess between them.
This was an absolutely one-sided battle. With a single strike, no matter how prodigious you were, taking it head-on would definitely lead to your death.
However, Ling Han didn’t die, and he only suffered some minor injuries. Just how
inconceivable was this?

The old Sect Master looked stunned. He had already lived for a very, very long time, and was used to seeing what ordinary people considered prodigies, as well as what prodigies considered freakish prodigies, but now that he had seen it with his own eyes, he could say with absolute certainty that this was definitely a freakish prodigy, freakish among freaks.
Menghan really had good taste.

However, even Chi Menghan hadn’t expected that Ling Han would be so freakish. Her beautiful eyes lit up, and it was as if she were making some kind of decision. Unfortunately, no one could see the expression on her face.
Fu Huoyang faltered upon hearing this. He hadn’t expected that he would still be unable to defeat Ling Han even though he was being suppressed by an advantage of nine Heavens in
battle prowess.
If nine Heavens was not enough? Then ten Heavens!
He charged over, his power boiling, and channelled out the Imperial Technique again.

Previously, his body had already been overwhelmed, but after combusting the Imperial Blood, not only had his bodily functions recovered to peak stage, they had also far surpassed that. Naturally, he could cast the Imperial Technique again.
This time, Fu Huoyang’s battle prowess reached twenty two Heavens, suppressing Ling Han
by a whole ten Heavens!

Ling Han was calm and collected. He used his eye technique, capturing the weak points or weaknesses in Fu Huoyang’s attacks. Then, he charged over, and with a shake of his fist, Destructive Energy surged.
The strengthening of the soul would naturally affect all skills related to Spiritual Power.

The murderous aura attack was one of them. With a thought from Ling Han, the murderous aura attack had already blasted into Fu Huoyang’s mind. The murderous aura actually took the form of a small black figure that wreaked havoc in Fu Huoyang’s mind.
This tiny figure had a terrifying destructive ability against the soul. As it wreaked havoc, Fu Huoyang only felt a sharp pain in his head, and couldn’t help but cry out in pain. The attacks
The shot out naturally had no accuracy.
Yi?
Ling Han also hadn’t imagined that the murderous aura would become so powerful after his
soul returned to his body.

However, thinking about it, it made sense. The strength of his Spiritual Power had advanced into the Spiritual Transformation Tier, and theoretically far surpassed the Core Formation Tier. If this wasn’t powerful, then it couldn’t be justified, right?
Ling Han took advantage of the opening to charge out, and shot out a punch.
Peng!
Fu Huoyang’s colossal body was instantly sent flying. It was as if a golden mountain were
dancing in the sky.
However, he had, after all, burnt all his Imperial Blood. Whether it was battle prowess or recovery ability, they were both indescribably strong. When the tiny black figure disappeared,
he immediately recovered, and steadied his footing in the skies.
He looked at Ling Han, flames burning in his eyes.
For him, this was too damaging to his pride. His battle prowess had an overwhelming advantage of ten Heavens, but not only had he not managed to insta-kill Ling Han, Ling Han
had instead succeeded in his counterattack.
This was utterly humiliating.

chapters.title: Chapter 4013: Great Monster
paragraphs: To Fu Huoyang, he was only enraged from embarrassment, and to others, this was no different from the sky collapsing down on them.
Just how powerful was Fu Huoyang now?

Everyone naturally knew that battle prowess was at 24 or 25 Heavens, and what about Ling Han? He was only at the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, and couldn’t burn Imperial Blood, so battle prowess was at most around 10 Heavens.

Of course, this fact alone was enough to scare them to death, because even a Buddha Son like Shi Yongming only had battle prowess of Eighth Heaven when he reached the end of the early stage of the Core Formation Tier. Compared to Ling Han, he was not just a little bit weaker.
But now, it was even more terrifying. This guy faced Fu Huoyang, whose battle prowess was 24 or 25 Heavens, and actually had the upper hand?
‘Holy f*ck!’
Everyone couldn’t believe their eyes. Even the old Sect Master, who had been preparing to stop the battle, looked constipated. He forcefully retracted his foot.
They were witnessing a miracle.
Heavens, how could there be such a freak?
Even in the past, did the Great Emperor have that kind of strength?
Everyone exchanged looks, and shook their heads. This kind of battle prowess was too nature-defying, so how could it be allowed to exist in this world?

The old Sect Master looked at Chi Menghan again, and a look of realization appeared on his face. The pearl of their clan truly had foresight, and had long since formed a friendship with Ling Han. By the looks of it, this ideal son-in-law would not be able to escape from the grasp of the Chi Clan.
Wonderful! Wonderful!

Perhaps, another Great Emperor would emerge from their Chi Clan. At the very least, they could also produce an incredibly powerful Saint, who would similarly be able to sweep aside all opposition in the world.
If a Great Emperor did not appear, who would be able to match him?
Fu Huoyang naturally could see the expressions of the people below him. His fists were clenched tightly, and his heart was practically weeping blood.

He had “stepped out” this time because he wanted to form some kind of friendship with Chi Menghan first. He hadn’t expected that with Ling Han’s interference, he would become a clown and embarrass himself.
His battle prowess was ten Heavens ahead of Ling Han, yet he was still no match for Ling Han. How could he accept this?
Who would still take him seriously?
“Damn it! Damn it!” His eyes were bloodshot, and he further ignited his Imperial Bloodline, guarding his mind tightly. Then, he charged towards Ling Han again.
Weng!

Ling Han unleashed a barrage of murderous aura attacks. However, Fu Huoyang was fully prepared this time. The tiny black figure hadn’t even entered Fu Huoyang’s mind yet, when it was completely burnt by the Imperial Blood.
It could not be helped. This was Imperial Blood, and its level was too high.
“Hahaha!” Fu Huoyang couldn’t help but laugh loudly upon discovering that the Imperial Blood had taken effect. He leaped over, clasped his palms together, and smashed them down at Ling Han.
With his current colossal size of more than 150 meters, the combined smash of his hands was no less than a great mountain crashing downwards.
Ling Han frowned. The murderous aura attack was ineffective?
He used Imminent Skyline to dodge. If he clashed head-on with Fu Huoyang at this moment, it would truly be a foolish idea.
Hehe, how long can your Imperial Bloodline burn for?

Fu Huoyang attacked madly. However, Ling Han had activated his eye technique, which allowed him to clearly see the weak points or weaknesses in his attacks, and added with the fact that Imminent Skyline was no weaker than the movement technique that he had grasped, he was actually unable to attack for the moment.

Hong, hong, hong! From the surface, he was completely on the upper hand, beating Ling Han so hard that he could only dodge, but in truth, he did not manage to wound Ling Han at all. He was only wasting his energy in vain.
He gradually became anxious. If this continued, what would he do when the burning of the Imperial Blood ended?
At that time, he would return to his previous routine, where he would be ruthlessly beaten up by Ling Han.
No!

He went berserk, and his offensive became even more rapid. Imperial Techniques and Saint Techniques channelled endlessly in his hands, their might world-shaking. However, Ling Han wasn’t facing him head-on at all. Instead, he was circling around in the sky.

No matter how strong your attack was, what was the use if it could not hit its target? “Hehe, all right, all right. Young man, don’t be so angry. Enough is enough,” the old Sect Master said with a smile. He stretched out both hands, and they both turned into a colossal hand that grabbed Ling Han and Fu Huoyang respectively, forcibly bringing them back to the
ground.
Ling Han and Fu Huoyang didn’t make another move. A Sect Master had already made a move, and if they still dared to fight, wasn’t that not giving him face?
Ling Han naturally didn’t mind. He hadn’t suffered any losses this time, and as for Fu
Huoyang?
He had ignited his Imperial Bloodline.

After burning the Imperial Bloodline, it would take a very long time to recover. As for how much time it would take, that would depend on the purity of the bloodline. For those who had thinned their bloodline, they would only be able to recover two to three times in their
lifetime, at most.
Hence, after Fu Huoyang’s burst of power this time, the next burst of power could possibly be a hundred years, or a thousand years later.
Fu Huoyang naturally knew this as well. His expression was dark, and ugly to the extreme. He couldn’t bring himself to flirt with Chi Menghan anymore.
“Fairy Menghan, I would like to ask for guidance.” Zhu Yixiu stood up, clasping his hands in greeting towards Chi Menghan.

His potential certainly wasn’t as high as Fu Huoyang’s, and his battle prowess at the same cultivation level was far inferior to Ling Han’s. However, what he was competing in now wasn’t potential and battle prowess at the same cultivation level! He was the consummate level of Core Formation Tier, and his battle prowess was as high as 24 Heavens, so he was naturally qualified to battle her.
Chi Menghan stepped into the air, her white dress fluttering, as if she was a celestial being.
“Please.”
The two of them rose into the air, and then began fighting.
At first, Zhu Yixiu was very restrained, but after a few moves, he had no choice but to go all
out.

Chi Menghan was far too powerful. Even though each of her attacks didn’t carry any heat and were extremely ethereal, they still exerted a tremendous amount of pressure on him. He couldn’t hold back at all as he unleashed all of his powerful attacks.
However, this still didn’t change the outcome of the battle. He was strong, and Chi Menghan’s battle prowess also increased accordingly. She continued to maintain a huge
pressure on him.
After about a hundred moves, Zhu Yixiu took the initiative to admit defeat.

He had no choice but to admit defeat. He wasn’t an idiot, so he could naturally tell that Chi Menghan still had power. Moreover, Chi Menghan was a member of the Imperial Clan, and she could also combust her Imperial Bloodline. Thus, she had many more trump cards.
Thus, taking advantage of the fact that he was only at a disadvantage at this moment, he obediently admitted defeat. Otherwise, he would be in a difficult position.

Seeing Zhu Yixiu admit defeat, Sha Yang and Zhu Chengyun both shook their heads. Sha Yang was not much stronger than Zhu Yixiu, and Zhu Chengyun’s cultivation level was too low. His battle prowess was not even at 10 Heavens, so how was he supposed to fight?
Now, it was only up to Shi Yongming and Shen Yutang now.
Shi Yongming stepped out first, and said with a smile, “Please give guidance, Fairy
Menghan.”
“Please.” Chi Menghan was still ethereal and graceful.
The two of them rose into the air at the same time, and then exchanged blows.

Shi Yongming was able to achieve a result of pseudo six stars, so his battle prowess at the same cultivation level naturally surpassed Zhu Yixiu’s. Moreover, he was also at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, while his battle prowess was at 26 Heavens.
Even though there was only a gap of two Heavens, this was enough to decide the outcome of
the battle.
However, Chi Menghan became stronger and stronger with each strike. Her palms danced lightly, and her jade-like palms looked weak and powerless, but every palm strike had a great
might that could shake heaven and earth, making Shi Yongming feel extremely
uncomfortable.
Similarly, within a hundred moves, Shi Yongming had no choice but to admit defeat.
-He did not have the Imperial Bloodline to burn. When he had used all his ultimate moves,
the only thing he could do was admit defeat.
Everyone believed that Chi Menghan was the super genius from the Donglin Imperial Clan who had scored seven stars.

Huoyang?
He had ignited his Imperial Bloodline.
After burning the Imperial Bloodline, it would take a very long time to recover.
As for how much time it would take, that would depend on the purity of the bloodline.
For those who had thinned their bloodline, they would only be able to recover two to three times in their
lifetime, at most.
Hence, after Fu Huoyang’s burst of power this time, the next burst of power could possibly be a hundred years, or a thousand years later.
Fu Huoyang naturally knew this as well.
His expression was dark, and ugly to the extreme.
He couldn’t bring himself to flirt with Chi Menghan anymore.
“Fairy Menghan, I would like to ask for guidance.” Zhu Yixiu stood up, clasping his hands in greeting towards Chi Menghan.
His potential certainly wasn’t as high as Fu Huoyang’s, and his battle prowess at the same cultivation level was far inferior to Ling Han’s.
However, what he was competing in now wasn’t potential and battle prowess at the same cultivation level!
He was the consummate level of Core Formation Tier, and his battle prowess was as high as 24 Heavens, so he was naturally qualified to battle her.
Chi Menghan stepped into the air, her white dress fluttering, as if she was a celestial being.
“Please.”
The two of them rose into the air, and then began fighting.
At first, Zhu Yixiu was very restrained, but after a few moves, he had no choice but to go all
out.
Chi Menghan was far too powerful.
Even though each of her attacks didn’t carry any heat and were extremely ethereal, they still exerted a tremendous amount of pressure on him.
He couldn’t hold back at all as he unleashed all of his powerful attacks.
However, this still didn’t change the outcome of the battle.
He was strong, and Chi Menghan’s battle prowess also increased accordingly.
She continued to maintain a huge
pressure on him.
After about a hundred moves, Zhu Yixiu took the initiative to admit defeat.
He had no choice but to admit defeat.
He wasn’t an idiot, so he could naturally tell that Chi Menghan still had power.
Moreover, Chi Menghan was a member of the Imperial Clan, and she could also combust her Imperial Bloodline.
Thus, she had many more trump cards.
Thus, taking advantage of the fact that he was only at a disadvantage at this moment, he obediently admitted defeat.
Otherwise, he would be in a difficult position.
Seeing Zhu Yixiu admit defeat, Sha Yang and Zhu Chengyun both shook their heads.
Sha Yang was not much stronger than Zhu Yixiu, and Zhu Chengyun’s cultivation level was too low.
His battle prowess was not even at 10 Heavens, so how was he supposed to fight?
Now, it was only up to Shi Yongming and Shen Yutang now.
Shi Yongming stepped out first, and said with a smile, “Please give guidance, Fairy
Menghan.”
“Please.” Chi Menghan was still ethereal and graceful.
The two of them rose into the air at the same time, and then exchanged blows.
Shi Yongming was able to achieve a result of pseudo six stars, so his battle prowess at the same cultivation level naturally surpassed Zhu Yixiu’s.
Moreover, he was also at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, while his battle prowess was at 26 Heavens.
Even though there was only a gap of two Heavens, this was enough to decide the outcome of
the battle.
However, Chi Menghan became stronger and stronger with each strike.
Her palms danced lightly, and her jade-like palms looked weak and powerless, but every palm strike had a great
might that could shake heaven and earth, making Shi Yongming feel extremely
uncomfortable.
Similarly, within a hundred moves, Shi Yongming had no choice but to admit defeat.
-He did not have the Imperial Bloodline to burn.
When he had used all his ultimate moves,
the only thing he could do was admit defeat.
Everyone believed that Chi Menghan was the super genius from the Donglin Imperial Clan who had scored seven stars.

chapters.title: Chapter 4014: Observing the mother tree
paragraphs: Shi Yongming had also lost. Everyone’s eyes turned towards Shen Yutang.

Shen Yutang, meanwhile, raised his hands, and said, “Firstly, I have no interest in fighting and killing. Secondly, I am only in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier. Do you guys think I can win?”
Er, this was the honest truth.

Excluding Chi Menghan, the two people with the highest potential here, Ling Han was in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, Shen Yutang was in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, and Ling Han’s cultivation level was far inferior to Chi Menghan’s. Thus, it was impossible for him to win.
“Hahaha, young friends, it’s rare for you to come here, so why don’t you stay here for a few days?” the old Sect Master said. This also announced the end of the prodigy gathering.
“Brother Ding, please come with me.” Chi Menghan nodded at Ling Han.
Ling Han stood up, and walked side by side with Chi Menghan.

This made everyone extremely envious. Chi Menghan was the seductive beauty ranked third on the Exquisite Leaderboard, and her potential value was as high as seven stars. Anyone would want to marry her, and it was practically a sure bet that she would definitely become a female Saint in the future.
This was of great significance.

Saint, the strongest in the present world. Additionally, if he could also become a Saint, that would mean having a lifespan of as long as a million years. Aside from Saints, who would be able to accompany him through such a long lifespan?
Hence, this kind of lover was really too rare.
“Fairy Menghan, I too wish to observe that mother tree.” Fu Huoyang immediately stood up. F***, you are really quite thick-skinned.
Everyone was speechless. You f****** have just embarrassed yourself so terribly, and you actually recovered so quickly?

Fu Huoyang couldn’t do anything about this. He was hell-bent on obtaining Chi Menghan. To him, this was a huge problem that concerned whether or not he could obtain the Imperial Techniques of both clans. Thus, so what if he lost face? He definitely had to cling to her. “Hehe, the mother tree can’t be disturbed by multiple auras. Young friend, it’s better to leave it for later,” the old Sect Master spoke up, directly rejecting his request.

Fu Huoyang was about to say something else, but the old Sect Master had already glared at him. His gaze was as terrifying as an ancient Demon God, and it instantly made Fu Huoyang’s chest constrict, rendering him speechless.
How blind!

The old Sect Master thought internally. Didn’t he see that even he was very polite towards Ding Yi? This was a son-in-law that their Chi Clan had their eye on. Why the f****** were you getting involved and causing trouble?
Did he really think that just because he was a member of the Fu Clan, he couldn’t kill him?
What a joke!
Ling Han and Chi Menghan left. Everyone felt very regretful, and had no interest in staying any longer. They all took their leave and left.
As for whether they would snipe Ling Han or not, that was not certain.
Ling Han followed Chi Menghan, but they didn’t go to the Medicinal Garden or whatnot. Instead, they arrived at the Transfer Formation.

“Do you think that this mother tree is on the Donglin Planet?” Chi Menghan shook her head, and said, “A planet can only nurture a single mother tree. Transplanting it will only cause the mother tree to die. Thus, the mother tree naturally isn’t on the Donglin Planet.”
Ling Han nodded in realization.
The two of them rode the Transfer Formation, and in a flash of white light, they had already arrived at another planet.

“Princess Han!” There were four guards outside the Transfer Formation. When they saw Chi Menghan, they all knelt down to pay their respects. Not only were they respectful, but there was also a kind of fanaticism about them.
Ling Han found this strange, and asked, “You’ve covered your face, and they can still recognize you?”
Chi Menghan felt a muscle twitch in her cheek. ‘Can’t you be a little more curious about something normal?’

Sometimes, Ling Han’s freakishness was unbelievable, making her certain that this person’s lowest accomplishment would have to be a Saint, and an incredibly powerful Saint at that. And if heaven and earth allowed it, this guy would even have a chance of breaking through to the Imperial Path.
However, sometimes, this guy’s thoughts would be so strange that others would be speechless, making her feel baffled.

If this guy became a Saint, would he become the most amusing Saint in history? “Follow me.” Chi Menghan led the way, and brought Ling Han to a Medicinal Garden that was heavily guarded. Not only was there a Sect Master, but there was also a great formation. At least, Ling Han was completely unable to break through it, and only knew that he would definitely die if he barged in.

There were too many Celestial medicines here, ranging from One Star to Seven Stars. There were so many that he wanted to drool. Unfortunately, they could only be seen and not harvested, which made him extremely depressed, and his whole person became listless.
Chi Menghan saw this, and she could guess why he was feeling so gloomy. She instantly wanted to laugh.

Anyone would want the Celestial medicine, but after entering the treasure mountain, they could only come out empty-handed. No one would be happy at that. However, who would be like Ling Han, who showed it on his face?
Sometimes, this guy was extremely cunning, and at other times, he was extremely innocent.
Finally, they arrived at the mother tree’s location.ree

This mother tree was not tall at all. At first glance, it looked like an ordinary peach tree. It was only about three meters tall, and stretched out a crown that was about six meters wide. Green leaves were all over it, and it looked very ordinary.
However, Ling Han saw very clearly that the bark and leaves were covered with strange veined patterns that looked like dragon scales, but also looked like phoenix patterns.

However, this mother tree’s roots had suffered severe damage, sustaining heavy slashes or strikes. In any case, it had been struck by a sharp weapon, and only a sliver of bark was left attached to it. It could be said that it was extremely difficult for it to live.
Ling Han’s heart jolted. If this mother tree hadn’t been so severely wounded, what grade of fruit would it have borne?
Saint Fruits?
Or Imperial Tier-level fruits that even Ancestral Kings would desire?

No wonder when he saw the veined patterns on the Spiritual Dao Fruit, he had a feeling like he was looking at an Imperial Technique. At the time, he was baffled. How could a Venerate Tier- level mother tree possibly have any relation with Imperial Techniques?
But now, he understood. Before this mother tree was injured, it was definitely a Great Emperor Tier-level Celestial Plant!
The Chi Clan probably didn’t know, right? Otherwise, they definitely wouldn’t have asked him
to come and observe.
“All right, you can just stay here and observe. I’ll give you ten days,” Chi Menghan said.
Ling Han bargained, “One month.”
Chi Menghan shook her head, “Impossible.”
“I won’t steal medicines, so a month isn’t a big deal. It’ll pass very quickly.” Ling Han didn’t
give up.
Chi Menghan hesitated for a moment, before saying, “I’ll give you a month’s time. At that time, I’ll take you away. However, if you dare to steal Celestial medicines, even if they’re only
One Star Celestial medicines, I’ll still sever your arms.”
“Che, am I that kind of person?”
Chi Menghan didn’t answer, but the gaze she directed at Ling Han was clearly filled with
certainty.
This guy dared to steal the mine of the Western Desert King when he was still in the
Netherworld. With prior incident as proof, who would believe him?
Faced with this kind of gaze, Ling Han could only laugh dryly.
He waved his hand, “Go on, go on.”
Chi Menghan was slightly infuriated. ‘Don’t you know that I’m ranked third on the Exquisite Beauty Leaderboard? And there is actually someone who took the initiative to chase me away?
It’s as if even the mother tree is more beautiful than me.’
That’s right, this guy had never seen her true appearance. Humph, then go on and look for the tree bark of the mother tree.
Chi Menghan turned around and left angrily.
Ling Han found this strange. He realized that Chi Menghan’s emotions had become a little
off, but this change was too baffling.
Forget it, who cares about her?
Ling Han sat down in a cross-legged position, right underneath the mother tree. He raised his head to look at every single leaf of the mother tree, as well as the veined patterns on the tree
trunk.

chapters.title: Chapter 4015: Treasured Technique Obtained
paragraphs: Why was Ling Han so determined to see this mother tree?
That was because before Ling Han ate the Spiritual Dao Fruit, he discovered that the patterns on the fruit actually had a common origin with the Heavenly Brilliance Technique.
He had a guess. It was possible that Ancestral King Donglin had studied this mother tree, and had a sudden inspiration, which led to the creation of this Imperial Technique.
Thus, Ling Han wanted to join in on the excitement and see if he could completely deduce this precious technique.
It was impossible for him to start from scratch. Who could create an Imperial Technique when they were in the Core Formation Tier?

However, he had already mastered half of the Heavenly Brilliance Technique, and he had more so used it together with Chi Menghan. Thus, he had a considerable understanding of this Heavenly Brilliance Technique. Thus, if he could obtain the original model of the technique, he still had a chance of successfully deducing it.
He sat quietly and comprehended. He corresponded the Heavenly Brilliance Technique with the veined patterns on the tree trunk, and instantly, an amazing enlightenment arose.

The first step was not to directly complete the restoration of the precious technique, but to correspond to the parts that he already had. In this way, the target that he had to focus on would be very clear.
After spending seven days, Ling Han matched some of the technique he had mastered with the veined patterns on the tree trunk and leaves.
Then, he didn’t need to care about this part of the veined patterns, and focused on the other veined patterns.
Bit by bit, his improvement was obvious.
He had turned into a stone statue. In fact, he didn’t even have any signs of life. This was because he was completely focused on comprehending.

A month later, Chi Menghan came over. At first, she was given a fright. Why had Ling Han’s life force disappeared? However, she soon discovered that it wasn’t that this guy had lost his life force, but that it was extremely weak.
With a sweep, she discovered that all of Ling Han’s divine sense had retreated to the depths of his mind, and was presently comprehending at the deepest level.
What was going on here?
Chi Menghan was incredibly astonished. ‘You can comprehend Dao just by looking at a mother tree? What kind of monster are you?’

This was definitely not an act. She could sense that there was Regulations circulating around Ling Han’s body. Though this was something that they could not touch at their present level, when they were comprehending Dao, the Regulations of heaven and earth would naturally take form.

Furthermore, she had also reached the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, and would soon be able to leap into the True Self Tier, and the True Self Tier would begin to cultivate the Regulations of heaven and earth. Thus, with her extraordinary talent, she was indeed qualified to come into contact with even a sliver of it.
Prodigy, he was really too prodigious.

Chi Menghan gave up on the idea of bringing Ling Han out of the Medicinal Garden. Instead, she decided to let Ling Han continue comprehending Dao. After all, it was rare for a cultivator to have such a chance to comprehend Dao on a deeper level.
If she knew that Ling Han was actually comprehending the Heavenly Brilliance Technique, she would definitely drag Ling Han out of this place.
No matter how much she admired Ling Han, there was no way she would allow the supreme celestial technique of her clan to be taught to outsiders.
Unfortunately, she did not know.

Ling Han could vaguely sense that someone was coming over, but they bore no malice towards him, so he did not awaken. After all, it was too rare for him to enter into this state. If he exited, he would definitely have to expend an extremely great amount of time to enter into this state again.
Time flew by, and in the blink of an eye, another two months had passed.
Ling Han finally awoke from his deep comprehension. He swayed his body, then stood up.
Heavenly Brilliance Technique, initial accomplishment!

However, he didn’t practice here. Firstly, this was the Medicinal Garden, and if he practiced here, the damage would be too great, and it would be hard to clean up. Then, he would really have to sell himself into service here. Secondly, if the Chi Clan found out that he had learnt the Heavenly Brilliance Technique, what would happen?
“Young Master Ding, you are finally awake!” Immediately, a man dressed as a servant walked over, “Please come with me, and I will take you away.”
He was very polite, and did not have the pride of a member of an Imperial Clan at all.

This was because he knew that this young man was extremely favored by the elders of the clan. In fact, it was even possible that he would become the ideal son-in-law of the Donglin Imperial Clan. How could he offend this young man?
Ling Han nodded, and followed that person out of the Medicinal Garden.

On the other side, the young man also sent out the news that Ling Han had woken up. Thus, when they walked out of the Transfer Formation and returned to Donglin Planet, they saw that there were already people waiting for them outside the Transfer Formation.
“Are you Ding Yi?” a delicate voice asked.

Ling Han looked over. This was a little girl who was only about ten years old. She was really beautiful, like a little fairy, but the way she looked at him was incredibly cunning. He reckoned that she was definitely not an obedient little girl, but rather a little demon.
“I am Ding Yi.” Ling Han smiled, “Young lady, what’s your name?”
“Yi, you’re not so good looking after all.” The little girl, however, acted very experienced. She circled around Ling Han once, as she sized him up, and made her final evaluation.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t be shocked by a little girl. He touched his face, and said narcissistically, “I think I’m extremely handsome, world-shakingly handsome.”
The little girl instantly laughed loudly, “As for you, you may not be handsome, but you are extremely shameless. Just in time, my sister is also very two-faced. The two of you are quite a
good match.”
What kind of honest lie was this young girl spouting?
“Who’s your sister?” Ling Han asked.
“Huh? You chased my sister for so long, so how could it be that you still don’t know that my
sister is Chi Menghan?” the little girl said.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “I really couldn’t tell. You are much more beautiful than your
sister.”
The little girl was instantly pleased, and nodded, “At least you have good taste. I think so
too.”

Seeing how Ling Han and the little girl were chatting more and more happily, the young man beside them hurriedly said, “Young Master Ding, Princess Shan, the Lords are still waiting.” “Come, brother-in-law, I’ll take you there.” The little girl directly changed her address of
him.
Even Ling Han’s expression darkened. This little girl really had changed her address. “Let’s go.” He naturally didn’t mind. In any case, he was now “Ding Yi”, and had nothing to
do with Ling Han.

The little girl brought Ling Han to a courtyard. There were pine trees that had been planted here for tens of thousands of years. They were verdant and dark green, and occasionally, there would be Earth Qi that would soar out, turning into multiple gray dragons. They were astonishingly mysterious.
Ling Han was surprised. This was because of the formation. There was a large formation set up here, and that was why the energy of heaven and earth was gathered here. In fact, there was
also something that he couldn’t see now, but could sense.
The Regulations of heaven and earth? “Sister, sister, I’ve brought my brother-in-law!” the little girl called out loudly.
Immediately, Chi Menghan flew out, but her pretty face was stern as she delivered a knock
right at the little girl.
“Wa!” The little girl instantly grabbed her head and screamed. This time, it was really quite a
heavy knock.

“Chi Menghan, you ungrateful brat. I called my brother-in-law over for you, yet you entered the bridal chamber and threw the matchmaker over the wall. You’re kicking me to the curb after I’ve outlived my usefulness!” The little girl was truly stubborn as she continued.
Even Ling Han was slightly impressed by her. Just how unafraid of death was she?
Sure enough, Chi Menghan was enraged. She grabbed the little girl and gave her another harsh
slap.
“Chi Mengshan, do you want to be imprisoned again?”

She could sense that there was Regulations circulating around Ling Han’s body.
Though this was something that they could not touch at their present level, when they were comprehending Dao, the Regulations of heaven and earth would naturally take form.

Furthermore, she had also reached the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, and would soon be able to leap into the True Self Tier, and the True Self Tier would begin to cultivate the Regulations of heaven and earth.
Thus, with her extraordinary talent, she was indeed qualified to come into contact with even a sliver of it.
Prodigy, he was really too prodigious.
Chi Menghan gave up on the idea of bringing Ling Han out of the Medicinal Garden.
Instead, she decided to let Ling Han continue comprehending Dao.
After all, it was rare for a cultivator to have such a chance to comprehend Dao on a deeper level.
If she knew that Ling Han was actually comprehending the Heavenly Brilliance Technique, she would definitely drag Ling Han out of this place.
No matter how much she admired Ling Han, there was no way she would allow the supreme celestial technique of her clan to be taught to outsiders.
Unfortunately, she did not know.
Ling Han could vaguely sense that someone was coming over, but they bore no malice towards him, so he did not awaken.
After all, it was too rare for him to enter into this state.
If he exited, he would definitely have to expend an extremely great amount of time to enter into this state again.
Time flew by, and in the blink of an eye, another two months had passed.
Ling Han finally awoke from his deep comprehension.
He swayed his body, then stood up.
Heavenly Brilliance Technique, initial accomplishment!
However, he didn’t practice here.
Firstly, this was the Medicinal Garden, and if he practiced here, the damage would be too great, and it would be hard to clean up.
Then, he would really have to sell himself into service here.
Secondly, if the Chi Clan found out that he had learnt the Heavenly Brilliance Technique, what would happen?
“Young Master Ding, you are finally awake!” Immediately, a man dressed as a servant walked over, “Please come with me, and I will take you away.”
He was very polite, and did not have the pride of a member of an Imperial Clan at all.
This was because he knew that this young man was extremely favored by the elders of the clan.
In fact, it was even possible that he would become the ideal son-in-law of the Donglin Imperial Clan.
How could he offend this young man?
Ling Han nodded, and followed that person out of the Medicinal Garden.
On the other side, the young man also sent out the news that Ling Han had woken up.
Thus, when they walked out of the Transfer Formation and returned to Donglin Planet, they saw that there were already people waiting for them outside the Transfer Formation.
“Are you Ding Yi?” a delicate voice asked.
Ling Han looked over.
This was a little girl who was only about ten years old.
She was really beautiful, like a little fairy, but the way she looked at him was incredibly cunning.
He reckoned that she was definitely not an obedient little girl, but rather a little demon.
“I am Ding Yi.” Ling Han smiled, “Young lady, what’s your name?”
“Yi, you’re not so good looking after all.” The little girl, however, acted very experienced.
She circled around Ling Han once, as she sized him up, and made her final evaluation.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t be shocked by a little girl.
He touched his face, and said narcissistically, “I think I’m extremely handsome, world-shakingly handsome.”
The little girl instantly laughed loudly, “As for you, you may not be handsome, but you are extremely shameless.
Just in time, my sister is also very two-faced.
The two of you are quite a
good match.”
What kind of honest lie was this young girl spouting?
“Who’s your sister?” Ling Han asked.
“Huh?
You chased my sister for so long, so how could it be that you still don’t know that my
sister is Chi Menghan?” the little girl said.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “I really couldn’t tell.
You are much more beautiful than your
sister.”
The little girl was instantly pleased, and nodded, “At least you have good taste.
I think so
too.”

Seeing how Ling Han and the little girl were chatting more and more happily, the young man beside them hurriedly said, “Young Master Ding, Princess Shan, the Lords are still waiting.” “Come, brother-in-law, I’ll take you there.” The little girl directly changed her address of
him.
Even Ling Han’s expression darkened.
This little girl really had changed her address.
“Let’s go.” He naturally didn’t mind.
In any case, he was now “Ding Yi”, and had nothing to
do with Ling Han.
The little girl brought Ling Han to a courtyard.
There were pine trees that had been planted here for tens of thousands of years.
They were verdant and dark green, and occasionally, there would be Earth Qi that would soar out, turning into multiple gray dragons.
They were astonishingly mysterious.
Ling Han was surprised.
This was because of the formation.
There was a large formation set up here, and that was why the energy of heaven and earth was gathered here.
In fact, there was
also something that he couldn’t see now, but could sense.
The Regulations of heaven and earth?
“Sister, sister, I’ve brought my brother-in-law!” the little girl called out loudly.
Immediately, Chi Menghan flew out, but her pretty face was stern as she delivered a knock
right at the little girl.
“Wa!” The little girl instantly grabbed her head and screamed.
This time, it was really quite a
heavy knock.
“Chi Menghan, you ungrateful brat.
I called my brother-in-law over for you, yet you entered the bridal chamber and threw the matchmaker over the wall.
You’re kicking me to the curb after I’ve outlived my usefulness!” The little girl was truly stubborn as she continued.
Even Ling Han was slightly impressed by her.
Just how unafraid of death was she?
Sure enough, Chi Menghan was enraged.
She grabbed the little girl and gave her another harsh
slap.
“Chi Mengshan, do you want to be imprisoned again?”

chapters.title: Chapter 4016: Son-In-Law Recruitment
paragraphs: The little girl, Chi Mengshan, finally became obedient after be She pouted, looking like she had a deep hatred.

“I say, Ding Yi, you’re really too disloyal. I’m speaking up for y show from the sidelines.” Unfortunately, the little girl’s mem minute, and she immediately began to court death again. “Sist husband. In any case, he looks too ordinary.”
Peng! “Ah!”
