She suffered another knock on the head, and the pain caused tears to stream down her face. “Chi Menghan, remember, when I grow up and become stronger than you, I’ll definitely take revenge!” the little girl sobbed. “At that time, I’ll marry you to whoever you hate the most!” Chi Menghan couldn’t help but chuckle upon hearing this. She could only shake her head in exasperation. This little sister of hers was far too mature, and she was more so fearless. Thus, there was nothing she could do about this.
“Brother Ding, please follow me.” She decided not to tangle with this little girl, and said to Ling Han.
Ling Han nodded, and followed her into the courtyard.

After entering the courtyard, Ling Han saw an old man watering flowers. He was holding a water bottle, and looked to be in his seventies or eighties. He was filled with the aura of an old man, and it felt like it wouldn’t be strange for him to die at any moment.
“Ninth Grandpa, Ding Yi is here,” Chi Menghan said respectfully to the old man.
The old man merely nodded, but did not stop what he was doing, nor did he turn around. Ling Han clasped his hands and bowed, saying, “Ding Yi pays respects to Senior.”

“Ninth Grandpa, Big Sister hit me again!” The little girl said angrily, “You don’t even discipline her, old man. With such violence, how will she be able to get married in future?” Chi Menghan’s expression darkened, and she felt an urge to beat someone up again. “Hahaha!” The old man laughed loudly. He finally put down the water bottle, then turned around, and said, “Mengshan, did you cultivate well today?”
Hearing these words, the little girl instantly became obedient. She lowered her head, and began playing with her fingers, pretending that she had not heard anything.
The elder turned to look at Ling Han again, and when their eyes met, Ling Han instantly felt his heart go blank. Then, he suddenly shivered, and came back to his senses.
He couldn’t help but feel shocked. Just how much time had passed?
It seemed like an instant, but also seemed like an eternity.
This elder was far too terrifying. Merely a single glance from him was enough to cause him to lose his sense of self.

“Yi?” The old man was surprised, “Young man is really too remarkable. He actually used only three breaths’ time to come back to his senses. Sigh, geniuses appear in every generation. Previously, I did not believe that anyone could be more outstanding than Menghan. I never thought, never expected it.”
He shook his head repeatedly, appearing to be extremely rueful.
F***, three breaths’ time had actually passed?
Meanwhile, Ling Han’s heart was beating wildly. He felt like only an instant had passed.
If that old man had wanted to kill him just now, he would have died who knew how many times over.

The elder turned to look at Ling Han again. This time, nothing strange happened. His eyes were also very gentle, and the gaze he directed at Ling Han was also filled with admiration, “Young man, what are your next plans?”
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “I’m naturally going to wander around and become an Emperor through hundreds of battles!”
This!
The old man couldn’t help but be rendered speechless. This brat was really boastful, actually directly aiming to become an Emperor.

However, when he recalled how Ling Han had previously shot out a pseudo eight stars, and his potential was even above Chi Menghan’s, he was indeed qualified to be arrogant. However, if you wander around, how would the Donglin Imperial Clan recruit you?

“Young people have ambitions in all directions. It’s a good thing to have such aspirations.” The old man nodded, “However, duckweed without roots is ultimately not stable enough, and does not have much confidence.”
He paused, then continued, “Are you interested in joining our Donglin Imperial Clan? I can arrange a good marriage for you. From now onwards, you would be half a son of our Chi Clan.”
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “Is it with this Chi Menghan, Miss Chi?”
The elder’s expression instantly darkened.
This damn brat’s appetite was really too big!
Although Ling Han was freakish, he was only a prodigy without any background, after all. How could he be qualified to marry the princess of their clan?

If Chi Menghan was about to marry, her partner would have to be an Imperial Son. In the future, when the two great elites joined, the child that they gave birth to would have a chance of breaking through to the Imperial Path.
“Young man, there are many beautiful women in our Donglin Imperial Clan,” the old man said with a smile.
“But I fell in love with Lady Menghan at first sight,” Ling Han also said with a smile.
F***, have you ever seen Chi Menghan’s true appearance? And you claim that it was love at first sight!

The elder mocked internally, but he was presently recruiting Ling Han, and not here to argue. Thus, he could only say, “Young man, consider carefully. If you join our Chi Clan, your future prospects would be boundlessly bright.”
“Alright, I’ll consider it,” Ling Han said with a casual nod.
Chi Menghan stood up in a timely manner, saying, “Brother Ding, I’ll send you off to rest
first.”
“I’ll have to trouble you,” Ling Han said.
The two of them exited the courtyard, and Ling Han used the excuse of wanting to see the large black dog. He passed through the Transfer Formation and arrived at the outskirts of the
Donglin Imperial Clan.
“Brat, you’ve been gone for a few months, and Grandpa Dog thought that you have married and had children in the Donglin Imperial Clan, and don’t even want to leave anymore,” the
large black dog said.
“Enough with the nonsense. Hurry up and let’s run,” Ling Han said.
“What’s wrong?” the large black dog asked.
“If we don’t leave now, I really have to stay behind to marry and have children.”
“F*ck! Is there such a good thing?”

Ling Han and the large black dog once again changed their appearance and soul fluctuations. Then, they used the Void Beast hide to hide themselves, and left quietly. Only after they had walked far away did they remove the hide, and quickly arrived at the Transfer Formation.
After paying, they activated the Transfer Formation. When they arrived at the next planet, they finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Afterward, they were teleported again and again, and they were already far away from
Donglin Planet.
After half a year, Ling Han and the large black dog finally returned to the North Heavenly Realm. After several more transgers, they returned to the Nine Suns Planet that they had long
been absent from.
They returned to their original appearance and entered the Holy Land. As for the trip to
Donglin Planet, they treated it as if it had never happened. Ding Yi and Ding Er would also be left behind in the past forever.
After exchanging longing feelings with Hu Niu and the empress, Ling Han began to practice the Heavenly Brilliance Technique.
Previously, he had only obtained the essence of the technique, and left in a hurry. He had not had the chance to truly practice.
He channeled the precious technique, and instantly, a terrifying aura circulated, terrifying
without bounds.
The Imperial Technique was naturally awesome.

After Ling Han delivered a few punches, he stopped, and began to recall the scene of him and Chi Menghan using the Heavenly Brilliance Technique together. Then, he made a comparison. The Heavenly Brilliance Technique he had grasped was slightly weaker in terms of power, but the Heavenly Brilliance Technique couldn’t have been used by one person in the first place.
Hence, it was logical that its might was weak now.
The might of this previous technique was equivalent to the Demonic Monkey Fists.
As expected, with both of them being Imperial Techniques, which was weaker than the other?
Ling Han laughed loudly. He had mastered another Imperial Technique, which allowed him to have another powerful move.

“Now, I’m only one step away from stepping out of the early stage of the Core Formation Tier. It’s time for me to buy natural treasures and make preparations for the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4017: Return to Moonlight Planet
paragraphs: In Ling Han’s mind, the only Celestial Cauldron was more or less melted. All the celestial substances had been absorbed by the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, and the Primal Chaos Celestial Core had inherited all its characteristics.

“The second step of the Core Formation Tier is to use various natural treasures to nurture the Celestial Core. The higher the level of the natural treasures, the stronger the Celestial Core would become.”
“These natural treasures are all used to nurture the soul.”

Ling Han rummaged through the Galaxy Network for relevant information. There were many soul nurturing treasures, and they could also be divided into extremely detailed categories according to their level. Very naturally, the lower the level, the easier it was to obtain, and the higher the level, the harder it was to obtain.

“Sigh, after advancing to this level, the use of Dao Stones is becoming lesser and lesser. At the drop of a hat, transactions would only accept trading of natural treasures. The high-level Celestial medicine is the real currency.”

Ling Han took a look. It was not that no one was selling soul nurturing treasures, but only extremely low grade Celestial medicines would be marked to be sold for Dao Stones. As long as they were of a slightly higher grade, they would all require Three Star or Four Star Celestial medicines to be traded in exchange.

“It’s not that I can’t cultivate with low-level treasures, but it would cause too much dregs to be dyed into the Celestial Core, and while it grows stronger, I still have to remove these impurities. Undoubtedly, it would waste a lot of time.”
“But there’s no other way now. I can’t get high-level natural treasures, so I’ll use this to make up the numbers first. It’s better than nothing.”
Ling Han began to buy wantonly. In any case, he did not lack money. Furthermore, what was the point of leaving money aside?

“However, now that I’ve advanced into the Core Formation Tier, should I return to the Celestial Sea Planet?” Ling Han mulled over this. Although he had already obtained the Nine Suns Saint’s cultivation technique, he had also promised the Nine Suns Saint that it wouldn’t be taught to outsiders.
Thus, after the empress and the others advanced into the Core Formation Tier, there would be no other cultivation technique that they could cultivate.

After returning to the Celestial Sea Planet and passing the Ancient Sun Saint’s third test, he would naturally be able to obtain the corresponding Core Formation Tier-level Ancient Sun Divine Scroll. This scroll would be given to the empress and the others to cultivate.

Furthermore, if he advanced another level, and crossed into the True Self Tier, he would be able to pass all the tests of the Ancient Sun Saint. Who knew how many good things the Ancient Sun Saint had left for him.
There should be a Saint Tool, right?
Ling Han conversed with the empress and Hu Niu, and then decided to set out immediately.
“Yi, why don’t I see those seven babies?” He swept an eye over them, and discovered that the seven Calabash Brothers had not appeared all this while.
“Hehe, they were chased out,” Hu Niu said.
Ling Han was astonished. Why had they been chased out?
“What’s going on?” he asked.
“You’ll know when you go see for yourself.” Hu Niu kept him in suspense.
That shouldn’t be a big problem.
Ling Han exited the Holy Land, and soon found the place according to the address that Hu Niu had provided.
This was a very large manor. When Ling Han leaped in, he saw a white python immediately swim over and coil towards him.
Yi?
Ling Han leaped to dodge, and very quickly, another white python attacked. Then, it was the third, the fourth, and a total of seven pythons.

Realization dawned on him. These were the snake eggs that he had brought out from the White Lotus Mystery Realm. Because neither Hu Niu nor the empress liked snakes, he had given them to his seven babies, one for each of them. Unexpectedly, after close to two years, not only had these snake babies hatched, they had even advanced into the Foundation Building Tier.
No wonder the seven babies had been chased out. With seven such large snakes, who would dare to let them stay?

“Father!” At this moment, the seven babies finally appeared. They all jumped onto the snakes’ heads, each occupying a spot. Under their command, the seven white pythons all stopped attacking, but they were still very fierce, and stuck out their tongues at Ling Han.
Ling Han was rendered speechless. These seven babies were already out of control, and now they seemed to have become even worse. Who knew what kind of little devils they would become in future.
What puzzled him was that they were all still babies. None of them had grown up in the slightest, which was indeed very strange.
When they found out that Ling Han wanted to go to Celestial Sea Planet, the seven babies were all in high spirits, and requested to go play together.
Ling Han pondered for a moment. He had truly failed in his duty these past few days. He hadn’t properly educated these kids, so he agreed.
He returned to the Holy Land, and was just about to call the empress, Hu Niu, and the large black dog to set out, when he saw that Song Lan had come to pay him a visit.
As it turned out, she had received news that Ling Han had returned.
Since she had gotten the news, would the news reach Prosperous Heaven late?
Sure enough, after a short while, the Holy Daughter of the Buddhist Sect of the North Heavenly Realm also arrived.

They all asked about Ling Han’s experiences in the past two years, and Ling Han naturally brushed them off. However, when they found out that Ling Han was about to leave again, the two women expressed their desire to go with him.
What was going on here?
Ling Han couldn’t stop others, so if you guys want to go together, then we could go together.

He made some last minute changes, and decided to go to the Moonlight Planet first. The Azure Dragon Majestic Empire had been destroyed, and now the Moonlight Planet had become the territory of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire. Strictly speaking, this was the territory of the Buddhist Race. Ling Han hadn’t returned for a very, very long time.

He wanted to take a look at Tang Yan. Though they had also contacted each other through the Galaxy Network, it had been a long time since they had last seen each other. Ling Han indeed wanted to take a look.
Moreover, wasn’t Prosperous Heaven accompanying them?
This was the Buddhist Race’s Holy Daughter. Just let her step out and ask for a pardon from
the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire. Then, the Tang Clan wouldn’t have to hide here and there
anymore.
Now that they had made their decision, everyone set out.
After transferring for almost a month, they arrived at the Moonlight Planet.

Of course, this naturally couldn’t compare to the Nine Suns Planet. The power of heaven and earth was clearly inferior by a level. After all, the planet had never produced a Saint before, so there couldn’t possibly be Regulations intertwined together. This was a power that only
Saints possessed.
Ling Han had long since contacted Tang Yan, and after telling him the address, had this former Little Marquis come over to meet him.
It wasn’t long before Tang Yan appeared.
“Ling Han!” Tang Yan strode over, his face full of smiles.
Ling Han also approached, embracing Tang Yan.
“How’s the situation recently?” Ling Han asked.
“It’s all right. I just moved a few more times,” Tang Yan said casually, appearing to be
completely unconcerned.
After the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire was destroyed, moving was already a common occurrence for him.
“What about you?” Tang Yan didn’t want to talk about this anymore. “Two years ago, I saw on the Galaxy Network that there was a person called Ling Han who was mighty. He even
defeated the Imperial Son, so it shouldn’t be you, right?”
To defeat the Imperial Son, this was like a fantasy story, a myth among myths. Thus, he would rather believe that this was only a coincidence. The two of them only had the
same name. Though he knew that Ling Han was very freakish, it was definitely impossible
that he would be freakish to this extent.
“Ling Han!”
“Tang Yan!”
Ling Han hadn’t even spoken yet, when he heard a loud shout filled with shock.
He looked over, and saw that it was a young man. He was about twenty-eight or twenty-nine years old, and his cultivation level was Earth Cauldron.
Yi, he looked a little familiara| oh!

Ling Han finally remembered. This person was Han Bing, and previously, just like him, he was also a hostage of the Jia Yuan Manor, and had also targeted him before. However, as he advanced into the Cauldron Forging Tier, returned to the Jia Yuan Manor, and gave Han Bing, Zhao Xiao, Liu Xunyu and the others a good beating, these people were also thrown to the
back of his mind.
Unexpectedly, he had just returned to Moonlight Planet, when he encountered this person
again.

sentences.text: In Ling Han’s mind, the only Celestial Cauldron was more or less melted.
All the celestial substances had been absorbed by the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, and the Primal Chaos Celestial Core had inherited all its characteristics.
“The second step of the Core Formation Tier is to use various natural treasures to nurture the Celestial Core.
The higher the level of the natural treasures, the stronger the Celestial Core would become.”
“These natural treasures are all used to nurture the soul.”
Ling Han rummaged through the Galaxy Network for relevant information.
There were many soul nurturing treasures, and they could also be divided into extremely detailed categories according to their level.
Very naturally, the lower the level, the easier it was to obtain, and the higher the level, the harder it was to obtain.
“Sigh, after advancing to this level, the use of Dao Stones is becoming lesser and lesser.
At the drop of a hat, transactions would only accept trading of natural treasures.
The high-level Celestial medicine is the real currency.”
Ling Han took a look.
It was not that no one was selling soul nurturing treasures, but only extremely low grade Celestial medicines would be marked to be sold for Dao Stones.
As long as they were of a slightly higher grade, they would all require Three Star or Four Star Celestial medicines to be traded in exchange.
“It’s not that I can’t cultivate with low-level treasures, but it would cause too much dregs to be dyed into the Celestial Core, and while it grows stronger, I still have to remove these impurities.
Undoubtedly, it would waste a lot of time.”
“But there’s no other way now.
I can’t get high-level natural treasures, so I’ll use this to make up the numbers first.
It’s better than nothing.”
Ling Han began to buy wantonly.
In any case, he did not lack money.
Furthermore, what was the point of leaving money aside?
“However, now that I’ve advanced into the Core Formation Tier, should I return to the Celestial Sea Planet?” Ling Han mulled over this.
Although he had already obtained the Nine Suns Saint’s cultivation technique, he had also promised the Nine Suns Saint that it wouldn’t be taught to outsiders.
Thus, after the empress and the others advanced into the Core Formation Tier, there would be no other cultivation technique that they could cultivate.
After returning to the Celestial Sea Planet and passing the Ancient Sun Saint’s third test, he would naturally be able to obtain the corresponding Core Formation Tier-level Ancient Sun Divine Scroll.
This scroll would be given to the empress and the others to cultivate.
Furthermore, if he advanced another level, and crossed into the True Self Tier, he would be able to pass all the tests of the Ancient Sun Saint.
Who knew how many good things the Ancient Sun Saint had left for him.
There should be a Saint Tool, right?
Ling Han conversed with the empress and Hu Niu, and then decided to set out immediately.
“Yi, why don’t I see those seven babies?” He swept an eye over them, and discovered that the seven Calabash Brothers had not appeared all this while.
“Hehe, they were chased out,” Hu Niu said.
Ling Han was astonished.
Why had they been chased out?
“What’s going on?” he asked.
“You’ll know when you go see for yourself.” Hu Niu kept him in suspense.
That shouldn’t be a big problem.
Ling Han exited the Holy Land, and soon found the place according to the address that Hu Niu had provided.
This was a very large manor.
When Ling Han leaped in, he saw a white python immediately swim over and coil towards him.
Yi?
Ling Han leaped to dodge, and very quickly, another white python attacked.
Then, it was the third, the fourth, and a total of seven pythons.
Realization dawned on him.
These were the snake eggs that he had brought out from the White Lotus Mystery Realm.
Because neither Hu Niu nor the empress liked snakes, he had given them to his seven babies, one for each of them.
Unexpectedly, after close to two years, not only had these snake babies hatched, they had even advanced into the Foundation Building Tier.
No wonder the seven babies had been chased out.
With seven such large snakes, who would dare to let them stay?
“Father!” At this moment, the seven babies finally appeared.
They all jumped onto the snakes’ heads, each occupying a spot.
Under their command, the seven white pythons all stopped attacking, but they were still very fierce, and stuck out their tongues at Ling Han.
Ling Han was rendered speechless.
These seven babies were already out of control, and now they seemed to have become even worse.
Who knew what kind of little devils they would become in future.
What puzzled him was that they were all still babies.
None of them had grown up in the slightest, which was indeed very strange.
When they found out that Ling Han wanted to go to Celestial Sea Planet, the seven babies were all in high spirits, and requested to go play together.
Ling Han pondered for a moment.
He had truly failed in his duty these past few days.
He hadn’t properly educated these kids, so he agreed.
He returned to the Holy Land, and was just about to call the empress, Hu Niu, and the large black dog to set out, when he saw that Song Lan had come to pay him a visit.
As it turned out, she had received news that Ling Han had returned.
Since she had gotten the news, would the news reach Prosperous Heaven late?
Sure enough, after a short while, the Holy Daughter of the Buddhist Sect of the North Heavenly Realm also arrived.
They all asked about Ling Han’s experiences in the past two years, and Ling Han naturally brushed them off.
However, when they found out that Ling Han was about to leave again, the two women expressed their desire to go with him.
What was going on here?
Ling Han couldn’t stop others, so if you guys want to go together, then we could go together.
He made some last minute changes, and decided to go to the Moonlight Planet first.
The Azure Dragon Majestic Empire had been destroyed, and now the Moonlight Planet had become the territory of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire.
Strictly speaking, this was the territory of the Buddhist Race.
Ling Han hadn’t returned for a very, very long time.
He wanted to take a look at Tang Yan.
Though they had also contacted each other through the Galaxy Network, it had been a long time since they had last seen each other.
Ling Han indeed wanted to take a look.
Moreover, wasn’t Prosperous Heaven accompanying them?
This was the Buddhist Race’s Holy Daughter.
Just let her step out and ask for a pardon from
the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire.
Then, the Tang Clan wouldn’t have to hide here and there
anymore.
Now that they had made their decision, everyone set out.
After transferring for almost a month, they arrived at the Moonlight Planet.
Of course, this naturally couldn’t compare to the Nine Suns Planet.
The power of heaven and earth was clearly inferior by a level.
After all, the planet had never produced a Saint before, so there couldn’t possibly be Regulations intertwined together.
This was a power that only
Saints possessed.
Ling Han had long since contacted Tang Yan, and after telling him the address, had this former Little Marquis come over to meet him.
It wasn’t long before Tang Yan appeared.
“Ling Han!” Tang Yan strode over, his face full of smiles.
Ling Han also approached, embracing Tang Yan.
“How’s the situation recently?” Ling Han asked.
“It’s all right.
I just moved a few more times,” Tang Yan said casually, appearing to be
completely unconcerned.
After the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire was destroyed, moving was already a common occurrence for him.
“What about you?” Tang Yan didn’t want to talk about this anymore.
“Two years ago, I saw on the Galaxy Network that there was a person called Ling Han who was mighty.
He even
defeated the Imperial Son, so it shouldn’t be you, right?”
To defeat the Imperial Son, this was like a fantasy story, a myth among myths.
Thus, he would rather believe that this was only a coincidence.
The two of them only had the
same name.
Though he knew that Ling Han was very freakish, it was definitely impossible
that he would be freakish to this extent.
“Ling Han!”
“Tang Yan!”
Ling Han hadn’t even spoken yet, when he heard a loud shout filled with shock.
He looked over, and saw that it was a young man.
He was about twenty-eight or twenty-nine years old, and his cultivation level was Earth Cauldron.
Yi, he looked a little familiara| oh!
Ling Han finally remembered.
This person was Han Bing, and previously, just like him, he was also a hostage of the Jia Yuan Manor, and had also targeted him before.
However, as he advanced into the Cauldron Forging Tier, returned to the Jia Yuan Manor, and gave Han Bing, Zhao Xiao, Liu Xunyu and the others a good beating, these people were also thrown to the
back of his mind.
Unexpectedly, he had just returned to Moonlight Planet, when he encountered this person
again.

chapters.title: Chapter 4018: All Arrived
paragraphs: “Hahaha, I didn’t expect the two of you to still dare to return!” Han Bing laughed loudly, but his voice was filled with killing intent.

This was natural. When they had been in Jia Yuan Manor, he, Zhao Xiao and Liu Xunyu had repeatedly targeted Ling Han because this guy knew how to concoct alchemical pills, and wanted to take his completed alchemical pills for their own. He had not thought that this guy would be so troublesome, and not long after entering into the Political Hostage Manor, he successfully left.
And all this naturally was due to Tang Yan’s involvement.
Thus, he hated Ling Han, and also hated Tang Yan.
As he saw it, the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire had already fallen, so Ling Han and Tang Yan had both become stray dogs. If they still dared to appear now, wouldn’t that be courting death?
What a coincidence, this was really too much of a coincidence.

“HanBing, don’t seek death!” Tang Yan said coldly. In these few years, he had been cultivating the Venerable Tier-level cultivation technique, and his cultivation level and abilities had improved very quickly. Now, he had already advanced into the early stage of the Core Formation Tier.

“Tang Yan, the present is not like how it used to be!” Han Bing was naturally unafraid. He stood with his hands clasped behind his back, looking down at Tang Yan in a condescending manner, “Aren’t you in some remote corner, staying with your tail between your legs, and you actually dare to jump out? You are the one seeking death!”
Tang Yan wanted to make a move, but thinking that there were too many people here, if he dared to commit murder here, he would definitely become a wanted criminal of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire.

Previously, though the Tang Clan had also been hiding here and there, that was because they were the surviving dregs of the previous dynasty. As a person, he had not received much attention. Otherwise, he would not have dared to come out to receive Ling Han.
Thus, he chose to endure.
“Get lost, don’t seek death!” He released the aura of Core Formation Tier.
Han Bing suffered the impact, and his face instantly paled. This was the suppression of the cultivation level of a major tier. He was completely unable to fight back.
However, he was not afraid, because he had said so much previously, and it was completely just to buy time.

In the past, he had already been no match for Ling Han. Though he had improved greatly now, he believed that compared to Ling Han, his battle prowess was still far inferior. Thus, he had long since contacted Zhao Xiao, Liu Xunyu, and Tan Zhengjie through the Galaxy Network.

That’s right. Even if they joined forces, they should not be able to defeat Ling Han. However, they were not all by themselves, but had rather established a strong foundation here. They were completely capable of mobilizing elites of the Core Formation Tier to come here.
Once there were too many of them, even drowning them in numbers would be enough to drown Ling Han and Tang Yan.
“Tang Yan, you can only talk tough now.” Though Han Bing’s face was frighteningly pale, he was still talking tough.
Tang Yan thought for a moment, then suddenly came to a realization. He said to Ling Han, “This guy is deliberately stalling for time!”
This caused Han Bing’s expression to change again. F*ck, the reinforcements were still on the way. If Ling Han and Tang Yan fled, he would not be able to stop them at all.
Yet Ling Han smiled, “Alright, we can settle the score today.”

He wasn’t afraid of blowing things up at all. Even if the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire appeared in the end, there was still the Holy Daughter of the Buddhist Race of the North Heavenly Realm with him. Was she not qualified to settle all this?
“Brother Ling!” Tang Yan wanted to persuade him. ‘Don’t be stubborn at this moment. The Shadow Moon Majestic Empire was in control now. We can’t go against them.’

“It’s all right. Have a good chat with this Fairy Prosperous Heaven. I guarantee that your Tang Clan will be fine.” Ling Han pointed at Prosperous Heaven. However, Prosperous Heaven, just like the empress and Hu Niu, had a white veil covering her face, so her true appearance could not be seen.
Otherwise, the first reaction of Tang Yan and Han Bing would have been stunned.
Tang Yan was completely baffled. Could it be that this masked woman was the princess of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire?
Yet Han Bing was delighted. If Ling Han didn’t run, very good. Then just wait for death.
One wanted to buy time, while the other was very cooperative. Not long after, Han Bing’s reinforcements naturally arrived.

Zhao Xiao, Liu Xunyu, Tan Zhengjie, as well as the elites that they had brought with them, numbered in the dozens of elites of Core Formation Tier. Of course, there was also a portion of them that were members of their own clan that had been summoned by Han Bing.

Tang Yan couldn’t help but feel nervous. He was only in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, and even if he cultivated the Venerate Tier-level technique, his abilities were only at the Third Heaven. He could only just barely match the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier. If he encountered the late stage of the Core Formation Tier or the consummate level, he would definitely be outmatched.
The problem was, there were actually 14 Core Formation Tier elites here, so how were they supposed to block this?
The problem was, there were actually 14 Core Formation Tier elites here, so how were they supposed to block this?
How was he going to deal with this?
Tang Yan’s heart was filled with anxiety. Could it be that he had to ask the elites of his clan to step out?
But firstly, there may not be enough time, and secondly, the elites of the Tang Clan were all wanted criminals. If they stepped out, the matter would become serious.
At this moment, he was in an extremely difficult position.
“Ling Han, Tang Yan, it really is you two!” Liu Xunyu forced out through gritted teeth, looking like she wanted nothing more than to devour them.
In her eyes, being thrashed by Ling Han in public was a stain on her life, the greatest humiliation.

At first, she had thought that Ling Han and Tang Yan would never appear again in this lifetime, so that she would not be able to get her revenge. She had not thought that only a few years had passed, and they would actually appear again.
Good, very good!
“Father, they’re so fierce!” Eldest Baby was in high spirits. “Why don’t we beat them up?”
This violent maniac was already unbearably thirsty.
Ling Han chuckled, “Sure.”

Eldest Baby immediately roared in excitement. A small white snake coiled around her arm immediately enlarged, turning into a colossal creature that measured 30 meters in length. Its vicious might was on full display, and the people in the surroundings all shivered in fear. This wasn’t a Demonic Beast, but rather a ferocious beast that only had the instinct to kill. Second Baby, Third Baby and the others also released the small white snakes one after another, turning into great fierce beasts. They stood on top of the snake’s head, making a big fuss, looking very excited.
Ling Han was astonished. He hadn’t expected that the White Snake would actually become so obedient under the guidance of the children, and shrink or enlarge obediently.
Weren’t they ferocious beasts?
Since when had he become so obedient?

“You’re nothing but a Foundation Building Tier vicious beast!” Liu Xunyu smirked coldly. By now, she was already at the Heaven Cauldron cultivation level, so she naturally wouldn’t take a few Foundation Building Tier small snakes and babies seriously.
“Old witch, take this!” The babies controlled the snakes to charge over.
Liu Xunyu was unafraid, and merely sent out a palm strike.
In her mind, the attack of Heaven Cauldron was enough to kill hundreds or even thousands of Foundation Building Tier cultivators.
However, the seven babies began to release their own auras, instantly causing her face to turn
pale.
The seven of thema| were all in the Core Formation Tier!
“Not good!” The few Core Formation Tier elites from the Liu Clan hurriedly rushed over and grabbed Liu Xunyu. They then hurriedly retreated, not daring to face this head-on.
Liu Xunyu had escaped death, and her pretty face was instantly as pale as a sheet. She was unable to come back to her senses for a long time.

“No wonder he dared to be so arrogant. As it turned out, there are also cultivators at the Core Formation Tiera|” A cultivator at the Core Formation Tier from the Liu Clan said. He was a cultivator at the Core Formation Tier, and he was confident in his abilities. However, what
were these seven kids?
Dao Protectors? How could there be such a small Dao Protectors?
But to say that they were hired thugs? Hehe, that was also a joke.
Most importantly, these seven babies were really too small. How could there possibly be such
a young Core Formation Tier cultivator? Thankfully, they were only in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier. Even if they were joining forces, they would not be a match for him.
“Humph, no matter what, in front of me, you guys can only wait helplessly for death,” he said proudly, “If you obediently restrain yourselves, you can also suffer less.”
Tang Yan had just relaxed a little, when he became nervous again. Now, there were eight of them in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier. Could they charge out of this siege?

chapters.title: Chapter 4019: Exterminated with a Single Strike
paragraphs: Ling Han patted Tang Yan’s shoulder, “Don’t worry. Even if the sky collapsed, there would still be someone taller to hold it up.”

“Ling Han, you think you’re that taller someone?” Tan Zhengjie couldn’t help but ask. He had suffered too much at Ling Han’s hands, and every time he thought about it, he couldn’t sleep well for a good few days.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Believe it or not, I will kill you on the spot?”
“Ha!” Tan Zhengjie almost spluttered in laughter. This was truly the biggest joke in the world.

“Come on!” He crooked a finger at Ling Han. Though he had not advanced into the Cauldron Forging Tier yet, there were still a considerable number of elites of the Core Formation Tier by his side. With such protection, Ling Han still wanted to kill him?
“I really want to see how you will die,” he said coldly.

Xiu, Ling Han’s figure moved. He was as fast as lightning, but also like a streak of light. In a flash, he had already appeared in front of Tan Zhengjie. With a palm strike, Tan Zhengjie was lifted up by the chest.
The defensive power of the Core Formation Tier elites was practically useless.
This!
F***, this caused Han Bing and the others’ eyes to almost pop out of their heads.
Core Formation Tier!
This guy was actually a Core Formation Tier cultivator.

“Impudence! Hurry up and release Zhengjie!” an elite from the Tan Clan roared. Tan Zhengjie was naturally the most beloved clansman of the Tan Clan. Even though his cultivation level wasn’t high, his status wasn’t low either.
Now that he had been captured by Ling Han, the members of the Tan Clan were naturally
nervous.

And in the eyes of Prosperous Heaven and the others, this was a matter of course. When Ling Han was in Cauldron Forging Tier, he had even overturned a cultivator in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier. Now that he had advanced into the Core Formation Tier, just how strong would his abilities be?
A normal Core Formation Tier consummate level martial artist couldn’t possibly rival him!
Yet Tang Yan did not know this. He was both pleased and worried.

What was delightful was the fact that Tan Zhengjie, this despicable person, had been captured by Ling Han. However, what worried him was the fact that Ling Han was also under heavy siege. Previously, it could be said that he had caught Tan Zhengjie off guard, but now that everyone was prepared, how was he supposed to charge back?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and completely ignored the elite from the Tan Clan. He merely looked at Tan Zhengjie and said slowly, “Tell me, do I dare to kill you?”
Tan Zhengjie didn’t know how to answer.

He was still in Ling Han’s hands. If he angered Ling Han, and Ling Han killed him, then even if the elite of the clan subsequently killed Ling Han and Ling Han paid with his life, what meaning would that have for him?
If he was dead, he was dead.
However, if his answer was weak, then similarly, there were a great many elites of the clan here. If news of this spread back, what would his ancestor think?
Would he still be doted upon?
Thus, he was stuck in a dilemma, not knowing whether to speak tough or admit defeat.
“Let him go!” the elite from the Tan Clan shouted.
“So noisy.” Ling Han shook his head. Boom, the Heavenly Dao Flames surged, instantly enshrouding Tan Zhengjie.

“Ah!” Tan Zhengjie immediately screamed in agony. He was only a martial artist at the Ultimate Foundation Tier, so how could he withstand such high-level energy? He felt as if his vitality was rapidly disappearing.
“B@stard!” The elites of the Tan Clan all moved, blasting towards Ling Han. Now, they naturally did not have any more reservations.
Peng, peng, peng! One after another, attacks landed on Ling Han’s body, all of them landing solidly.
Sigh, what was the point?

The elites from the Han Clan, Zhao Clan, and Liu Clan all shook their heads. For the sake of killing a measly Foundation Building Tier cultivator, they had actually sacrificed their lives as well. This was really not worth it, was it?
Tang Yan even stretched out a hand, his expression filled with grief.
In his eyes, Ling Han definitely wouldn’t be able to live for much longer, being simultaneously attacked by so many Core Formation Tier elites.
This was his brother!

“Don’t worry. Good people don’t live long, while bad people live for 1000 years.” The large black dog stretched out a paw and patted Tang Yan’s shoulder, “Little Han is just a cockroach. His life is tougher than you can imagine.”
As expected, when the brilliance of the attack disappeared, Ling Han was still standing there unscathed, while Tan Zhengjie had completely turned into dust, not even a bit left behind.
What!

Are you a f****** monster?
Being bombarded by a group of Core Formation Tier elites, he was actually completely unscathed.
This was too terrifying. How could there be such a person?
Ling Han’s cold eyes swept over them. Those few Core Formation Tier cultivators of the Tan Clan all stepped back in fear. As they saw it, Ling Han wasn’t even human.
“Scram!” Ling Han shouted. He couldn’t even be bothered to make a move on these minor characters.
The Core Formation Tier cultivators from the Tan Clan all exchanged looks before coming to a
stop.
Tan Zhengjie had been killed in front of them. If they still ran away with their tails between their legs, just what kind of punishment would they receive when they returned to the clan?

There was still the Core Formation Tier elites from the Zhao, Liu and Han Clans here. They didn’t believe that so many Core Formation Tier elites working together wouldn’t be able to deal with Ling Han.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “I gave you people a chance, yet you people insist on seeking death. Don’t blame me then.”
“Everyone, attack together!” The elites of the Tan Clan shouted.
“En!”
The Core Formation Tier elites from the Han, Zhao, and Liu Clans all nodded in agreement. This person was far too freakish, so they definitely had to team up to deal with him.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! These elites all jumped out, and joined forces to attack Ling Han. Ling Han was completely unconcerned, and merely sent out a murderous aura attack.

Weng, this was what true terror was. The murderous aura barrage ignored all distance, and instantly penetrated into everyone’s minds, turning into numerous black figures, exuding an endlessly terrifying aura.
It should be known that the strength of Ling Han’s present soul had reached the level of Sect
Master. What kind of concept was that?
Pa! Pa! Pa! Pa!
Those cultivators of the Core Formation Tier collapsed one after another. If one examined them closely, they would discover that their auras had been completely severed, and their
minds had all been shattered.

Even if he had ignited his Imperial Blood, and his battle prowess had surpassed Ling Han by ten Heavens, even a supreme prodigy like Fu Huoyang had almost become an idiot from the barrage of murderous aura. The rest were mediocre, and could not even withstand a single
blow.
Now, the only ones remaining on the opposing side were Han Bing, Zhao Xiao, and Liu Xunyu. However, their bodies were trembling continuously, as if they had gone mad.
They were scared out of their wits. This was too terrifying. There were a total of fourteen Core Formation Tier cultivators, and they had all died at the same time. How could they not be
scared silly?
To say nothing of them, even Prosperous Heaven and Song Lan were given a fright.
This battle prowess caused them to feel pressure and fear.
Meanwhile, it was as if Tang Yan had become a complete fool. He could only widen his eyes,
and had completely no reaction at all.
Ling Han shot out another finger. Pa, pa, pa! The heads of Han Bing, Zhao Xiao, and Liu Xunyu
exploded in unison.
Fine, an old grievance was completely settled.
“Impudence!” At this moment, the soldiers of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire also rushed
over. They all shouted at Ling Han, “Maniac, you actually dare to publicly commit murder here! Hurry up and surrender yourself!”
Tang Yan’s heart clenched, and he was already prepared to make a move. Worse come to

worst, he could just leave Moonlight Planet. The world was huge, so where couldn’t he go? “Humph, I have just taken office today, and have already caused such a great commotion. Brat, you are really courting death!” A voice rang out, and a figure stepped into the sky,
exuding an incredibly domineering aura.
True Self Tier!

chapters.title: Chapter 4020: Resolve
paragraphs: He was done for.

Tang Yan wailed in his mind. Ling Han was indeed powerful, and he had witnessed it with his own eyes. However, no matter how powerful a Core Formation Tier cultivator was, he was still only a Core Formation Tier cultivator. Compared to a True Self Tier cultivator, what could he do?

This True Self Tier elite looked to be around 40 years old, but his true age should be far from that. His body was sturdy, and he had a stocky build. His whole face was covered with sideburns, and he looked very rough.
Elites were elites. He merely stood there, and he was already exuding an extremely powerful aura, causing others to not even dare to breathe loudly.
This elite’s eyes swept over the empress, Song Lan and the other women, and his eyes involuntarily lit up.
Though their true appearance could not be seen, just from the looks of their figures, the women could be considered perfect, causing his heart to beat wildly.
Wasn’t power, status, and beautiful women the reason why men cultivated?
Now that he had both power and status, there was naturally no reason for him not to accept beautiful women.
“All of you, take off your veils!” he commanded.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Say, it’s best that you curb your lust. Otherwise, things won’t end well.”
“Brat, just how much do you want to die?” the True Self Tier elite said coldly. He stared at Ling Han, killing intent circulating within him.
Ling Han turned to look at Prosperous Heaven and said, “Little Prosperous, I’ll leave it to you.”

A muscle twitched in Prosperous Heaven’s cheek. When had she become Prosperous Heaven? But who asked her to have such a high opinion of Ling Han, and wanted to draw him into the Buddhist Race, so that he could become the Buddhist Son of the North Heavenly Realm?
Thus, she could only step forward.
“Step down,” she said calmly.
“Hehe, the youngsters nowadays are a bit too arrogant, aren’t they!” The True Self Tier elite shook his head, and said, “Fine, since you’re unwilling to take off your veils, let me help you!”
He stretched out a hand, and grabbed out at Prosperous Heaven.
“An!” Prosperous Heaven exclaimed. It was the Six Characters Bright King Curse.
She was the true heir of the Buddhist Race. With a soft exclamation, not only was she thought-provoking, a halo of Buddhist light appeared behind her head, making her appear sacred and elegant.
The True Self Tier elite was astonished. ‘F*ck! This is a disciple of the Buddhist Race!’

The entire Shadow Moon Majestic Empire believed in Buddhism, evey single one of them studied and discussed the studies of Buddhism, and those like the members of the Imperial Family would even join the Buddhist Race, learning the mysterious techniques of the Buddhist Race.
He wasn’t qualified to cultivate the Buddhist Race’s cultivation technique, but how could it be that he hadn’t seen it before?
The Six Characters Bright King Curse and the Buddha Halo were images that could only be possessed by those disciples of the Buddhist Race.
“Female Bodhisattva!” The masses around them all knelt down, their expressions filled with reverence.
The True Self Tier elite instantly started to hesitate. What should he do?

If he continued to insist, he would offend the higher-ups of the Buddhist Race. This wasn’t a joke. Now that the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire’s citizens were all praying to Buddha, even the emperor would treat the Buddhist Race disciples with utmost respect. Thus, how could he dare to offend them?
But these women’s figures were so captivating, and their bearing was so enchanting. He really did not want to give up.
He thought for a moment, then pointed at Prosperous Heaven and said, “You can leave.”
He didn’t dare to touch the disciples of the Buddhist Race, but as for the others? Hehe, he had every reason to capture them.
Prosperous Heaven couldn’t help but feel angry. This person was too tactless. He clearly knew her identity, yet still dared to have perverted thoughts.
“I am Prosperous Heaven, Holy Daughter of the Buddhist Race of North Heavenly Realm!” She revealed her own identity.
What, Holy Daughter!
The True Self Tier elite couldn’t help but shudder, revealing an expression of fear.
He naturally knew how powerful the Buddhist Race was. This was an Imperial Clan, one of the most powerful forces in the universe, and what did the Buddhist Race’s Holy Daughter
represent?
This was equivalent to the Imperial Daughter.
Who dared to offend the Imperial Daughter?
However, these three women... He was in an incredibly difficult position, and was very conflicted.

“Greetings, Holy Daughter!” At this moment, a few figures flew past in the sky, then descended. They were all wearing monk robes, both men and women, and there were cultivation levels ranging from the Core Formation Tier to the Spiritual Transformation Tier.
However, even the Spirit Transformation True Lord paid his respects with a reverent expression.
The True Self Tier elite sighed internally. Now that the elites of the Buddhist Race had arrived, how could he still have the right to speak?
He also clasped his hands in greeting, and said, “Greetings, Holy Daughter!”
Prosperous Heaven humphed and pointed at him, saying, “This person’s heart is filled with filth, and he needs to be purified.”
“As you command!” Those elites of the Buddhist Race moved, and apprehended that True
Self Tier elite, escorting him away.

As for how exactly he was going to be purified, that was unknown. The Buddhist Race specialized in purifying the mind. Probably, when that guy came out again, not only would he no longer lust after women, he would treat them as poison instead.

“Little Prosperous, be a good person until the end,” Ling Han said. “This brother of mine was originally from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire. Now that the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire has been destroyed, he’s also become a wanted criminal. Help me eliminate this
criminal record for him and his clan.”
Prosperous Heaven couldn’t help as her face darkened. She, a Holy Daughter, actually had to
do such a trivial thing?
“If you join the Buddhist Race and become a Buddha Son, this will naturally be a small matter.” However, she immediately switched from passive to active.
Ling Han shrugged and said, “Forget about it. You won’t even help me with such a small
favor, so what kind of good friends are we?”
This made Prosperous Heaven furious. Who was asking who for help? Did he not have any estimates in his heart?
There was neither anger nor fury; Buddha was merciful.
She hurriedly recited the Immovable Heart Sutra in her mind, stopping her anger and
irritation.
“Brother Tang, let’s go and pay you a visit,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“All right.” Tang Yan nodded. By now, he was really impressed by Ling Han.
This brother of his was doing far better than he had imagined. Not only was his abilities outstanding, he had even gotten to know the Holy Daughter of the Buddhist Race, and was
very strong.
Ling Han led everyone to the Tang Clan. They were presently living in seclusion in a remote valley, and had casually built a few dozen wooden houses. They were considerably simple and
crude.
Ling Han and the others received a warm welcome. Now that the Tang Clan had fallen, and everyone had betrayed them, those that could still come to visit the Tang Clan at this time
were real friends.
After Ling Han stayed for two days, he left quietly, heading towards Celestial Sea Planet.
He didn’t want Song Lan and Prosperous Heaven to know that he had obtained the inheritance of a Saint. Thus, he could use the Tang Clan as a cover.

Now that the Transfer Formation had also been constructed on the Celestial Sea Planet, it was much more convenient to go there. Entering the Transfer Formation would allow one to arrive immediately after exiting.
He had obtained the coordinates of the next Mystery Realm in the Azure Cloud Mystery Realm, so it was very easy for him to find the location. Then, he used a special method to open
it and enter.
The Viper Mystery Realm really lived up to its name. From top to bottom, this place was filled
with poisonous snakes.
However, this was the Ancient Sun Saint’s test for Core Formation Tier. Thus, these poisonous snakes were also at the level of the Core Formation Tier.
Ling Han didn’t need to attack at all as he continued to advance. He continued to unleash his
murderous aura, and the poisonous snakes here all turned over and died. They didn’t even
have the chance to attack.
This was something that even the Ancient Sun Saint wouldn’t have imagined, right? The test that he had set up had been so easily resolved by Ling Han.
The core of this test was in an ancient palace. As long as one entered, they would be able to
control the entire Mystery Realm, and thus obtain the Core Formation Tier portion of the
Ancient Sun Divine Scroll.
However, this ancient palace was covered with extremely poisonous snakes, and they were all ferocious beasts at the level of the Core Formation Tier. They only knew slaughter.
Ling Han smiled, and strode in.

chapters.title: Chapter 4021: Assassination
paragraphs: Ling Han strode into the palace.

Hiss, hiss, hiss! A large number of poisonous snakes slithered out and attacked him, but under the barrage of murderous aura, not one of them could get close at all. Their minds all cracked, their souls shattered, and they died soundlessly.
The might of the barrage of murderous aura was really too terrifying. With Ling Han’s current soul strength, killing Core Formation Tier was as easy as turning over his palm.
He effortlessly arrived at the depths of the palace, and obtained control of the Mystery Realm. He also obtained the things that the Ancient Sun Saint had left for him.
Ancient Sun Divine Scroll’s Core Formation Tier chapter, as well as three natural treasures.
These three natural treasures were all used to nurture the soul, and could be used to strengthen Ling Han’s Celestial Core, after he advanced into the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier.
Good!
Ling Han instantly felt that this trip had not been in vain. Merely for these three natural treasures, it was worth it.
He obtained the coordinates of the next and final Mystery Realm, the Honest Mystery Realm, as well as the method to open it. However, this would require him to advance into the True Self Tier first.

It was no big deal. These three Mystery Realms were only testing to see if Ling Han’s battle prowess had declined in this new cultivation level. Thus, as long as Ling Han maintained this freakish performance, passing through the last Mystery Realm would only be going through the motions.
He exited the Mystery Realm and returned to the Moonlight Planet. He didn’t contact or meet with Chen Fengyan.
Right now, the Dark North Nation had also submitted to the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire. As long as Chen Fengyan wasn’t planning to rebel, he would naturally be able to sit firmly on the throne.

This nephew of his should be trying to break through to the level of Sect Master, but it was too difficult to take this step. Thus, several years had already passed, and Chen Fengyan was still in a state of seclusion. Who knew when he would succeed.
Ling Han returned to the Tang Clan. Although Song Lan and Prosperous Heaven hadn’t seen him for two days, they would never have imagined that he would actually go to Celestial Sea Planet.
After staying in the Tang Clan for a few days, Ling Han decided to return to the Nine Suns Holy Land.
This matter had already been settled, and he had already seen him, so what was the point of him staying here any longer?

Everyone set out, and the Prosperous Heaven also resolved the matter of the Tang Clan. In future, the Tang Clan could completely appear openly on the Moonlight Planet, and the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire wouldn’t do anything.

Everyone began to traverse through the stars. This time, they were not so anxious. Every time they reached a planet, they would stop and ask around if there were any ancient sites that they could join in on.

Unfortunately, there were indeed ancient sites that had opened, but it was either Foundation Building Tier or Cauldron Forging Tier-level. The level was too low, so it did not have much benefit for them.
Who would do something without benefits?
They continued to advance. They were still three transfers away from returning to the Nine Suns Planet.
On this day, after they had rested and reorganized, they arrived at the Transfer Formation here.
Ling Han walked forwards. It was not just their group. There were also a few passers-by that were following him. They too wanted to go to the next planet.
Two people seemed to have had an argument. At first, they were still talking quietly, but very soon, it became serious. In fact, there was even a physical conflict.
Peng!
One of them pushed with all his might, and the other person was sent flying, crashing towards Ling Han.
Ling Han stretched out a hand, and a gentle power surged out, stabilizing the person that had crashed towards him.
Right at this moment, shua, the person that he had supported actually turned around quickly, and launched an attack at him. A cold light streaked out, and that was a piercingly cold saber
light.
At the same time, the few people who seemed to be completely unconcerned previously moved at the same time. They all drew their weapons, and attacked Ling Han.
‘Hmm?’
This was a planned assassination.
However, Ling Han shook his head. The mastermind had underestimated his strength too much. He had actually only mobilized forces of Core Formation Tier.
The murderous aura charged towards them!

Boom! A thought flashed through his mind. Pa, pa, pa! Immediately, three people fell from the sky and were knocked unconscious. Meanwhile, the remaining four people all wore twisted expressions, as if they were experiencing immense pain.
Effortlessly, this wave of assassination was easily resolved.
Prosperous Heaven and Song Lan moved, apprehending the remaining four people.

These four people weren’t weak, but firstly, Prosperous Heaven and Song Lan were both extremely powerful in the first place, and secondly, their souls were severely wounded, so their battle prowess dropped drastically. Naturally, they were completely outmatched.
“Who are you people? Why do you want to assassinate Ling Han?”
“Who commanded you?”
The large black dog immediately asked.
Unexpectedly, these four people were quite stubborn, and kept their mouths shut.
“If you don’t tell me, I’ll feed you guys to the dogs,” Hu Niu said, hands on her hips. Her expression was filled with fury. They actually dared to kill her Ling Han.
The large black dog bared his teeth. He had been innocently implicated.
“Feed to the snakes.” Eldest Baby and the others approached excitedly.
One of the assassins finally spoke up. However, his expression was filled with arrogance, and
he did not have the slightest awareness that he was a captive. He said, “Let me give you a word of advice. Hurry up and release us!”
“Heh, so you guys can assassinate me again?” Ling Han said with a smile.

“Don’t worry. As long as people from the Battle God Palace fails and are captured, the mission will be terminated,” the assassin said. Then, his tone changed, “However, if you dare to kill members of the Battle God Palace, you’re dead!”
“Next, there will be True Self Tier elites, Spiritual Transformation Tier elites, Sect Master
Tier assassins, right until they kill you.”
Yi, the Battle God Palace?
Ling Han was astonished. He had passed the test of the Young Dragon and obtained the Three
Styles of the God of War. This was a Saint-level celestial technique. Although it wasn’t the complete version, it was indeed extremely powerful. It was one of his most powerful
techniques from long ago.
Brother Monkey had said before that the Three Styles of the God of War was the ultimate technique of the Battle God Palace.
These people actually came from the Battle God Palace? The Battle God Palace was actually an organization of assassins?

Ling Han was a little dazed. As for the fact that he was targeted by an assassin organization, there was no need to make a fuss about it, because he had offended too many people, and there were a few among them that were rich and imposing, so it was normal for them to hire assassins to deal with him.
“Battle God Palace!” Prosperous Heaven frowned at the same time, appearing very wary.
“What do you know about the Battle God Palace?” Ling Han asked.

“The Battle God Palace is an ancient assassin organization that has produced more than one Saint.” Prosperous Heaven said first, “The Battle God Palace is very terrifying, because they are eternally in shadow. No one knows where their base is, how many people there are, and
how many supreme elites there are.”
“This organization specializes in assassination techniques, and it’s said that even Saints have been assassinated by them. They’re extremely difficult to deal with.”

“If it was a head-on confrontation, the Imperial Clan would only have to have the Saint bring the Imperial Weapon, and they would be able to easily destroy it. However, the difficulty lies in the fact that though the Battle God Palace has the word ‘palace’, no one knows where their headquarters are at all. It would not be easy to clear them out at all.”
“After innumerable years, this Battle God Palace has always been able to exist. Even the Imperial Clan is unwilling to easily offend it.”

The Imperial Clan was indeed awesome, being invincible in a head-on confrontation. However, they were assassins, and they didn’t engage in a head-on confrontation at all. Instead, they continued to launch sneak attacks from the shadows. Add to that the Saint-level assassin kings, and this was indeed enough to give the Imperial Clan a headache.
“So, let us go!” the assassin from before said. His face was filled with arrogance, as if he was certain that Ling Han would definitely compromise.

chapters.title: Chapter 4022: Battle God Palace
paragraphs: How arrogant.
Ling Han didn’t know what else to say. He had come here to assassinate him, and when he didn’t succeed, he still had the audacity to ask others to let him go. Just how thick-skinned was he?
“Let us go. We can guarantee that we will give up on this business deal,” the assassin said, his face filled with certainty, as if he was certain that he had Ling Han in his grasp.
This was natural. They dared to assassinate even the Imperial Clan, and even Saints had suffered grievances before. Naturally, they would not care about a minor character like Ling
Han.
I am in the dark, and I can continuously attack. This is my advantage, and even the members of the Imperial Clan would frown at this.
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, “In other words, if there is a request to kill me, you guys would still send someone to take action?”
“Naturally. Business is business,” the assassin replied without hesitation.
“All right.” Ling Han tapped out a finger. Pa, the assassin’s head immediately exploded like a watermelon.
This scene directly stupefied the other three assassins.
However, after only an instant, they looked angrily at Ling Han.
“You’re dead!”
“Now, even if there is no request, our Battle God Palace will still kill you!”
“Just you wait, there is no one in this world that can save you!”
“Even if you are the disciple of the Nine Suns Holy Land, our Killing Saint will still barge in with the Saint Tool, and take your life!”
“Hahaha, no one can kill a member of our Battle God Palace. The doors to hell have already been opened for you.”
The three of them said one after another, as if they were completely unafraid of death.
“Is that so?” Ling Han said calmly, “Bring it on, see what I’m afraid of!”
He stretched out a hand and pressed it on the head of an assassin. He began to search his soul, wanting to know where the Battle God Palace was.
However, he immediately discovered that there was a restriction in this person’s mind. It would explode at the slightest touch, and destroy that person’s mind.

As expected, there was no such simple matter. If the Battle God Palace could be so easily found, would it have stood for millions and millions of years, and become a poisonous tumor that even the Imperial Clans would have a headache over?

“Hahaha, don’t even think of finding out where the Battle God Palace is!” That assassin clearly knew what Ling Han was planning. He laughed loudly, “Even if I am willing to tell you, I don’t have to say it out loud. As long as you touch this memory, my mind will explode and die.”
“Thus, you should give up this thought, and just wait for your death!”
Ling Han was unmoved. He flicked out a finger, and pa, pa, pa, six taps shot out. The remaining six assassins were also killed by him.
F***, what he hated the most was being threatened. Furthermore, they had clearly come to kill him, and after failing, they actually wanted to leave boldly. How could there be such a good thing?
“Brother Ling!” Prosperous Heaven and Song Lan both frowned.
This wouldn’t be easy to deal with.

The Battle God Palace was definitely not the strongest force in the world, but the vitality of this organization was extraordinarily tenacious. It was said that there was always a Saint keeping watch, and they had always been in the dark. No one knew where exactly this Battle God Palace was.
Thus, this assassin organization had the right to threaten the Imperial Clan. Because they could only be thieves for 1000 days, how could one be on guard for 1000 days?

Ling Han smiled calmly, “Counter pawns with the king, and water with an earth weir. The Battle God Palace is only a force in the universe, so how could it be that it can blot out the skies single-handedly?”

The two women shook their heads. This time, the assassins from the Core Formation Tier had failed, so the assassins sent by the Battle God Palace could possibly be the True Self Tier elites. If they failed again, they would be the Spiritual Transformation Tier elites, the Sect Master elites, right until they killed Ling Han.
Moreover, these assassins all carried out assassinations, and it was impossible to guard against them.
Ling Han smiled faintly. He indeed could let these assassins go, and bear with it for the moment. In future, when his cultivation level had reached a certain level, he would seek
revenge.

However, firstly, this was out of character for him. If he had a grudge, he would take revenge. If he was bullied, he would immediately slap the perpetrator back. Secondly, he had so many enemies, and if every single one of them went to make a request, how many times would he have to spare the assassins from the Battle God Palace?
Hence, this was a dead end that could not be undone. It would be better to be forceful from the very beginning.
They rode the Transfer Formation back to Nine Suns Holy Land, and the news that Ling Han was targeted by the Battle God Palace also spread on the Galaxy Network.

Ling Han believed that this definitely wasn’t a leak from Song Lan or Prosperous Heaven. The most likely culprit was the person behind the assassination request, who was already jumping up in impatience.
“What, Ling Han is actually targeted by the Battle God Palace?”
“Then he’s definitely done for. No one who’s been targeted by this assassin organization has ever survived.”
“Who asked him to be too arrogant? He’s in the limelight too much, and has offended too
many people.”
“Going by that theory, I can even hire assassins to kill the Imperial Son?”
“Hehe, that would have to depend on whether the Battle God Palace accepts this request or
not.”
“Yi, isn’t the Battle God Palace unafraid of even the Imperial Clan?”

“You can’t say that. The Imperial Clan is too powerful, and the Battle God Palace won’t actively trifle with them either. Otherwise, when the Imperial Clan mobilizes the world to investigate, they’ll eventually find some clues. Then, the Saint of the Imperial Clan will carry the Imperial Weapon to suppress them, and the Battle God Palace will also collapse.”
“That’s true. The Battle God Palace is not stupid, and would not bring such great trouble to themselves.”
Upon entering the Holy Land, Ling Han was met with strange gazes all the way. It was as if they were looking at a corpse.
Unless Ling Han never left the Holy Land, once he left, it was possible that he would be

assassinated by the Battle God Palace, or if it really dragged on for too long, even the Killing Saint of the Battle God Palace could possibly move personally. Then, would the Nine Suns Holy Land be able to protect Ling Han?
Ling Han returned to his residence, and began to think of a strategy.
He couldn’t hide in the Holy Land forever. In fact, the Holy Land might not even be
completely safe.
Was it possible to counterattack?
This was much, much too difficult.
If the Battle God Palace was so easy to find, how could it have existed for so many years?
Then, since he could not destroy this assassin organization, he would have to increase his own strength, or the ability to preserve his life.

Strength was linked to cultivation level. Even if Ling Han was freakish beyond compare, he couldn’t possibly possess the battle prowess of a True Self Tier at this time. Moreover, even if he did, so what? It wasn’t like Battle God Palace didn’t have Spirit Transformation True Lord
assassins.
Thus, life-saving ability was the most important thing.
He had the Heavenly Dao Flames, and even Venerate Tier elites had to give him a wide berth. Otherwise, they would definitely die. This was his trump card.
Was there anything else?
The Spiritual Dao Fruit could take effect when he suffered a fatal injury, saving his life.
There was too little.
Ling Han went to the treasure storage of the Holy Land, wanting to start from formations,
and find another way.
Having unleashed might in Cauldron Forging Tier, winning glory for the North Heavenly
Realm, this naturally also gained great fame for once for the Nine Suns Holy Land. Thus, Ling Han was rewarded with a great many contribution points, which was enough for him to spend
lavishly.
He flipped through carefully. If he wanted to greatly increase his battle prowess for a short period of time, and turn this into his new trump card, then the only way was definitely
through formations.
After searching for a long time, Ling Han’s eyes suddenly lit up.
He hadn’t found an astonishingly powerful formation technique, but rather a method to use the power of heaven and earth. This could allow him to borrow the power of heaven and earth.
Theoretically speaking, he could borrow the power of the planet and instantly move from the northernmost point of the planet to the southernmost point.
Amazing, too amazing.
