Moreover, even if he did, so what?
It wasn’t like Battle God Palace didn’t have Spirit Transformation True Lord
assassins.
Thus, life-saving ability was the most important thing.
He had the Heavenly Dao Flames, and even Venerate Tier elites had to give him a wide berth.
Otherwise, they would definitely die.
This was his trump card.
Was there anything else?
The Spiritual Dao Fruit could take effect when he suffered a fatal injury, saving his life.
There was too little.
Ling Han went to the treasure storage of the Holy Land, wanting to start from formations,
and find another way.
Having unleashed might in Cauldron Forging Tier, winning glory for the North Heavenly
Realm, this naturally also gained great fame for once for the Nine Suns Holy Land.
Thus, Ling Han was rewarded with a great many contribution points, which was enough for him to spend
lavishly.
He flipped through carefully.
If he wanted to greatly increase his battle prowess for a short period of time, and turn this into his new trump card, then the only way was definitely
through formations.
After searching for a long time, Ling Han’s eyes suddenly lit up.
He hadn’t found an astonishingly powerful formation technique, but rather a method to use the power of heaven and earth.
This could allow him to borrow the power of heaven and earth.
Theoretically speaking, he could borrow the power of the planet and instantly move from the northernmost point of the planet to the southernmost point.
Amazing, too amazing.

chapters.title: Chapter 4023: Formation Grandmaster
paragraphs: If he could grasp this kind of teleportation, then Ling Han would really be safe.
Unless he encountered a terrifying existence like the Saint, who could destroy the entire planet with a single strike, even Venerate Tier elites would find it very difficult to kill him.
However, it was too difficult to master this kind of technique.
The requirements for formation mastery were too high, and only the highest grade of Grandmaster could cast this.

If this was before in the Nine Suns Holy Land, Ling Han would definitely have only been able to look and sigh in disappointment. However, things were different now. He had gone to the Netherworld and raised the strength of his soul to the level of the Spirit Transformation Tier, qualifying him to touch the Grandmaster level.
He spent all of his contribution points in an instant, and then obtained the right to study this technique.
To learn this kind of technique, there were two things that needed to be done.

Firstly, one would have an incredibly profound grasp of formations, and secondly, being able to teleport required one to have a complete understanding of the ley lines. Thus, every time one arrived at a new planet, one would need to once again grasp the ley lines.
Hence, this technique itself was not difficult. What was difficult was how to increase the level of formations, and then grasp the ley lines of a planet.
Ling Han logged into the Galaxy Network and rented a top-notch Time Chamber.
He wanted to quickly improve his formations skills.
This stay lasted for half a year.

In the eyes of outsiders, Ling Han was clearly terrified. He knew that there were people from the Battle God Palace waiting to assassinate him outside, so he had been cooped up in his abode for more than half a year. To say nothing of the Holy Land, he didn’t even dare to leave his own abode.

Rumors flew, and they were all belittling Ling Han. It could not be helped. Previously, he had been too famous. With the cultivation level of Cauldron Forging Tier, he had defeated the Core Formation Tier, and even the Imperial Son could only bow in submission. How many people were envious, jealous, and hateful of him for this?
Thus, many pairs of eyes were focused on him, hoping to grab hold of his sore spot, so that they could harshly belittle him.
This time, they had found a chance.
However, Ling Han was completely unaware.
Half a year had passed in the outside world, so how long had his soul spent on the Galaxy Network?
A whole twenty-five years!
After such a long time, he finally stepped into the Grandmaster level of formations.
It was extremely difficult. It was as difficult as ascending the heavens for him to create Grandmaster-level formation foundations. However, he didn’t need to set up such
formations. Instead, it was fine as long as he had this kind of understanding and could control the ley lines.
He ended his seclusion, and all of a sudden, his Universe Coins were completely exhausted. He was now extremely poor.
Ling Han naturally didn’t regret it at all. Wasn’t money used to strengthen his abilities? It was worth it.
Without money, he could just earn more.
Ling Han returned to reality, and as his feet stepped on the ground, endless enlightenment instantly rose up in him.
This planet was different from before. It was as if it had a life of its own, and was breathing. Ling Han closed his eyes, and touched it with his soul.

If he had only released his divine sense, he would only be able to sense any movement within a 500-kilometer radius. However, it was different now. It was as if he had fused with this planet. Every blade of grass, every tree, every rock and every drop of water had become his eyes and hands, allowing his senses to endlessly extend.
But if that was all, it was not enough for an instant.
Ling Han started to capture the ley lines.

He viewed planets as living beings, and ley lines were equivalent to the veins of the planet. Thus, after he grasped the ley lines, he could use them to surge, and instantly travel from one place to another.
His divine sense extended endlessly, penetrating deep into the land’s heart. Here, he touched an incredibly ancient willpower.

This was the willpower of a planet. Although it was incredibly powerful, it was also filled with Primal Chaos. It was like a giant infant. By nature, it was clearly powerful, yet it didn’t understand anything at all. It was filled with blankness.

Ling Han didn’t dare to come into contact with this kind of willpower. Although his current Spiritual Power was powerful, compared to the willpower of a planet, he was nothing but child’s play, unable to withstand a single blow.
He had grasped the ley lines. There was Earth Qi surging within, which was incredibly powerful.
Ling Han finally understood. If he could teleport on a planet and walk freely, it was because of this Earth Qi that he was able to traverse through the body of the planet.
The path of formations was truly amazing.
Ling Han’s interest was greatly piqued. He could imagine what kind of might could be unleashed by using this Earth Qi.

“No wonder it’s said that Formation Grandmasters can completely be regarded as elites of martial arts.” Ling Han nodded, “Furthermore, extracting Earth Qi to temper the body, though its effect on increasing cultivation level is not great, it can strengthen the physique to
a chilling extent.”
“The soil of the Five Elements represents defense in the first place.”
“Interesting, truly interesting.”
Ling Han continued to extend his divine sense, grasping the ley lines of the entire Nine Suns Planet. In this way, he felt that this planet was him, and he was this planet.
Theoretically, he could see every single part of the Nine Sung Planet, but in truth, there were too many places that he could not see through at all, as if they were enshrouded in fog.
There should be formations in these places, so they blocked his senses.

Not only that, but he also saw a few elites. He had just looked over with his willpower, when the other party sensed his presence. They shot out a punch, and easily destroyed the Earth Qi, causing him to instantly become blind.
Ling Han sighed. The strength of his soul was only at the Spiritual Transformation Tier, after all. If he encountered Sect Master-level or Venerate Tier-level elites, he would naturally be
discovered.
“Instant teleportation isn’t as easy as I thought.”

Ling Han frowned. The foundation of this instant teleportation was actually Earth Qi, but Earth Qi originated from the ley lines, and could be extended to a certain extent. However, it could not possibly seep out too far. Thus, if he wanted to instant teleport, firstly, he had to
stand near the ley lines.
Let’s give it a try first.
He walked for a while, and arrived at a ley line. Then, with a thought, an Earth Qi wrapped around him. Xiu, he was gone.
This was too amazing. It was clear that the ground was still whole, and there was no pit at all, but he just sank into the ground. It was as if he had fused with the ground.
With another thought, he had already appeared from underground, appearing at least 50,000
km away from Nine Suns Holy Land.
Of course, this place just happened to correspond to a ley line.
With another thought from Ling Han, xiu, xiu, xiu, he continuously shuttled through this
planet.
Wonderful, wonderful, this was really too wonderful.

In terms of intergalactic travel, he was definitely no match for the Venerate Tier elite. The latter could instantly travel millions and millions of miles by tearing a rip into the Void, but in terms of traveling on a planet, he should not be inferior to the Venerate Tier elite.
More importantly, with the ley lines as his eyes and ears, he could sense the killing intent in advance, and from there, prepare ahead of time.
In this way, even if he wasn’t near the ley lines, he could still have time to make
arrangements.
“Can I also teleport away from the ley lines?” Ling Han read the information, and said that
the true Formations Grandmasters could teleport anywhere, and did not have to be near the
ley lines.
He began experimenting, and discovered that this was feasible.
That was to wrap himself in Earth Qi. As long as he could stimulate Earth Qi, he would be able
to teleport.
“There is a limit to the extension of the Earth Qi. However, it can be replenished through
one’s own Spiritual Power, which connects with the Earth Qi, forming a passageway that
solves the problem of distance.”
“That would have to depend on the strength of my soul.”
“With the strength of my current Spiritual Power, this distance is about a hundred miles.”
“Just barely enough.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4024: Star Steps
paragraphs: Xiu, right at this moment, a figure appeared out of thin air.

Ling Han’s first reaction was that the people from the Battle God Palace had charged over. He was already prepared to use the ley lines to escape, but at the same time, he was also surprised. He had only mastered this kind of technique for half a day, so how did the people from the Battle God Palace know?
But in the next instant, Ling Han was relieved, because the person who had come was not an assassin from the Battle God Palace, but rather the Nine Mountains Venerate.
“Brat, you’ve already died once,” the Nine Mountains Venerate said solemnly.
Ling Han was astonished. ‘Didn’t I see through you?’

“Wrong. The reason why the assassins of the Battle God Palace are so hard to guard against is because they are not only good at launching sneak attacks from the shadows, but would also disguise themselves as someone familiar to you, causing you to be unguarded, and then succeed with a single strike,” the Nine Mountains Venerate said solemnly.
Ling Han nodded, then put on a defensive stance, “Then are you in disguise now?”
The Nine Mountains Venerate instantly laughed. This junior was truly worrisome. He had actually angered the Battle God Palace with a single trip.

“I really didn’t expect that you have actually mastered the Star Steps.” He sighed, “In that case, I will be at ease. Even if you are outmatched, you would still have a chance to escape.” “Star Steps?”
“Don’t you know that this is called the Star Steps?”
Only now did Ling Han know that this kind of technique that borrowed the power of Earth Qi to move was called the Star Steps.
True, he was walking within the planet, so wasn’t it Star Steps then?

“Such a young Formations Grandmaster!” The Nine Mountains Venerate was filled with emotion. “Martial arts, alchemy, formations, you’re proficient in all of them. You’re a prodigy in all of them, so how can there be a freak like you? You’re practically a little maniac.” Was this a compliment? Er, it could be considered a compliment.
Ling Han was extremely shameless, so he nodded and gladly accepted the Nine Mountains Venerate’s praise.

“At first, I had planned to be your Dao Protector for a while, but I never thought that a brat like you would actually cultivate the Star Steps. Now, I can rest assured,” the Nine Mountains Venerate continued.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel warmth in his heart. Hurriedly, he said, “Thank you for your concern, Senior.”

“However, even if you’ve mastered the Star Steps, you still can’t be careless,” the Nine Mountains Venerate said solemnly. “The Battle God Palace has been able to move unhindered for so many years, and it’s said that there is no one that they dare not or can’t kill. This definitely isn’t an empty boast.”
“Yes.” Ling Han nodded. He naturally could distinguish his good intentions.
“All right, let’s go back.” The Nine Mountains Venerate waved his hand, appearing very satisfied.

The Battle God Palace was indeed terrifying, but in history, there was no shortage of people who had been ordered to kill by the Battle God Palace. However, in the end, they were still alive and well, and this kind of person had all become a Saint in the end.
This kind of tribulation and pressure could stimulate a person’s potential a hundredfold.
Thus, as long as Ling Han didn’t die, he would definitely be able to become a Saint.
Ling Han returned to the Nine Suns Holy Land. At this time, the empress and the others also discovered that he had come out of seclusion, and all came to see him.
“I’ve now cultivated the Star Steps, and even Venerate Tier elites would find it difficult to wound me,” Ling Han said. They were all family here, so there was no need for him to deceive them.

The empress, the large black dog and the others all nodded. Though the Battle God Palace had a Killing Saint, if they still sent out a Saint to kill a Core Formation Tier cultivator, then wouldn’t the Battle God Palace be too demeaning?

Furthermore, the last time the Battle God Palace had failed was only the Core Formation Tier. Who knows, they might even send out the Gold-medal assassins, ultimate elite assassins, and so on from the Core Formation Tier. When they failed, only then would they send out True Self Tier elites. What kind of Saint would make a move right away?
Everyone relaxed.
After a few days, Lin Luo, Zhou Heng and the others came to bid farewell to Ling Han. They planned to venture into the galaxy.

In the Holy Land, though they did not have to worry about the problem of cultivation resources, it could only be considered standard. If they really wanted to obtain such good things like the Ghost Spirit Crystal, the Spiritual Dao Fruit, and so on, they would definitely have to fight for it themselves, and it not be bestowed upon them by anyone.
They were all ultimate elites in the Genesis World, so how could they accept being ordinary? Thus, they wanted to go and take a look.

Ling Han naturally wouldn’t object. He taught them all of the cultivation techniques of the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll. Unfortunately, if he could advance to the next level, he would be able to obtain the complete Ancient Sun Divine Scroll and teach it in one go.
There was no hurry. It wasn’t like Lin Luo and the others would never return.
After sending Lin Luo and the others off, Ling Han also felt like exercising.
Staying in the Holy Land, there was indeed no shortage of resources, but it was also impossible to obtain top-grade treasures.

He searched for the location of any martial arts tournament on the Galaxy Network. There was news of ancient ruins opening, but they were all too far away. By the time he arrived, the tournament would have long since ended, and the ancient site would have long since been
exploited.
He sighed, so bored that his bones were aching.
Since that was the case, he would get along well with his beautiful wife, and cherish this kind of peaceful, beautiful time.

However, this was destined to be an extravagant hope. After Prosperous Heaven found out that he had come out of seclusion, she immediately ran over, planning to expiate him and bring him into the Buddhist Race.
This annoyed Ling Han so much that he felt an urge to pummel this Holy Daughter of the
Buddhist Race.
Two days later, the large black dog ran over.
“Little Han, a big, big event!” This despicable dog was very excited.
“What is it? Have you discovered a female dog that has the same traits as you?” Ling Han’s mouth was also unforgiving.
“Shoo, shoo, shoo, don’t play this kind of dirty joke with Grandpa Dog!” The large black dog waved its paw, “The resting place of Divine Rain Venerate has appeared!”

Divine Rain Venerate?” A thought flashed in Ling Han’s mind, but he wasn’t too excited. After all, he had cultivated more than one Imperial Technique, and grasped quite a few Saint Techniques, so he naturally couldn’t take a Venerate Tier-level inheritance too seriously.
Of course, if he had the chance, he would definitely take it gladly.
“Little Han, now you’re a frog at the bottom of a well.” The large black dog chuckled, and said, “Do you know who Divine Rain Venerate’s ancestor is?”
“Who?”
“Ancestral King Lingtian!” the large black dog said in an exaggerated tone.
Only now did Ling Han feel shocked.
Ancestral King!
Which also meant-

“That’s right. This Divine Rain Venerate is in possession of the Ancestral King Lingtian’s inheritance.” The large black dog’s eyes almost popped out of his head. “Little Han, just think, the Ancestral King Lingtian’s inheritance... How many treasures are there?” “He’s Ancestral King Lingtian’s only descendant?” Ling Han found this strange. “That’s true,” the large black dog said. “The Ancestral King Lingtian’s branch has always had few people. Thus, with Divine Rain Venerate’s death, the Ancestral King Lingtian’s inheritance was completely severed.”
Ling Han couldn’t help but sigh in pity. Although the Nine Suns Saint had lost to Ancestral King Lingtian and failed to become an Emperor, at least there was still the inheritance of the
Nine Suns Holy Land. It was indestructible for all eternity.
But what about Ancestral King Lingtian?
Only a legend was left behind.
Thinking about it, it was the same for Brother Monkey. Wasn’t the Battle Saint Emperor also
an overlord of his own generation? But in the end, his descendant was suppressed at the foot of the mountain. If it was not for the fact that they were afraid that he was not completely
dead, Brother Monkey would have been done for eight hundred years ago.
“Little Han, are you going or not?”
“Of course I’m going.”
Ling Han snickered. He was currently so bored that his bones were aching.

He taught them all of the cultivation techniques of the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll.
Unfortunately, if he could advance to the next level, he would be able to obtain the complete Ancient Sun Divine Scroll and teach it in one go.
There was no hurry.
It wasn’t like Lin Luo and the others would never return.
After sending Lin Luo and the others off, Ling Han also felt like exercising.
Staying in the Holy Land, there was indeed no shortage of resources, but it was also impossible to obtain top-grade treasures.
He searched for the location of any martial arts tournament on the Galaxy Network.
There was news of ancient ruins opening, but they were all too far away.
By the time he arrived, the tournament would have long since ended, and the ancient site would have long since been
exploited.
He sighed, so bored that his bones were aching.
Since that was the case, he would get along well with his beautiful wife, and cherish this kind of peaceful, beautiful time.
However, this was destined to be an extravagant hope.
After Prosperous Heaven found out that he had come out of seclusion, she immediately ran over, planning to expiate him and bring him into the Buddhist Race.
This annoyed Ling Han so much that he felt an urge to pummel this Holy Daughter of the
Buddhist Race.
Two days later, the large black dog ran over.
“Little Han, a big, big event!” This despicable dog was very excited.
“What is it?
Have you discovered a female dog that has the same traits as you?” Ling Han’s mouth was also unforgiving.
“Shoo, shoo, shoo, don’t play this kind of dirty joke with Grandpa Dog!” The large black dog waved its paw, “The resting place of Divine Rain Venerate has appeared!”
Divine Rain Venerate?” A thought flashed in Ling Han’s mind, but he wasn’t too excited.
After all, he had cultivated more than one Imperial Technique, and grasped quite a few Saint Techniques, so he naturally couldn’t take a Venerate Tier-level inheritance too seriously.
Of course, if he had the chance, he would definitely take it gladly.
“Little Han, now you’re a frog at the bottom of a well.” The large black dog chuckled, and said, “Do you know who Divine Rain Venerate’s ancestor is?”
“Who?”
“Ancestral King Lingtian!” the large black dog said in an exaggerated tone.
Only now did Ling Han feel shocked.
Ancestral King!
Which also meant-
“That’s right.
This Divine Rain Venerate is in possession of the Ancestral King Lingtian’s inheritance.” The large black dog’s eyes almost popped out of his head.
“Little Han, just think, the Ancestral King Lingtian’s inheritance...
How many treasures are there?” “He’s Ancestral King Lingtian’s only descendant?” Ling Han found this strange.
“That’s true,” the large black dog said.
“The Ancestral King Lingtian’s branch has always had few people.
Thus, with Divine Rain Venerate’s death, the Ancestral King Lingtian’s inheritance was completely severed.”
Ling Han couldn’t help but sigh in pity.
Although the Nine Suns Saint had lost to Ancestral King Lingtian and failed to become an Emperor, at least there was still the inheritance of the
Nine Suns Holy Land.
It was indestructible for all eternity.
But what about Ancestral King Lingtian?
Only a legend was left behind.
Thinking about it, it was the same for Brother Monkey.
Wasn’t the Battle Saint Emperor also
an overlord of his own generation?
But in the end, his descendant was suppressed at the foot of the mountain.
If it was not for the fact that they were afraid that he was not completely
dead, Brother Monkey would have been done for eight hundred years ago.
“Little Han, are you going or not?”
“Of course I’m going.”
Ling Han snickered.
He was currently so bored that his bones were aching.

chapters.title: Chapter 4025: Ziming Mountain
paragraphs: Ling Han discussed with the empress and the others, and decided that he still wouldn’t bring them along this time.

After all, there were assassins from the Battle God Palace outside. Ling Han could take care of himself, but if he still had to bring his family with him, he might not be able to take care of them in time.
It was still the Holy Land that was safer.

If it was the large black dog, he wasn’t Ling Han’s relative, so no one knew about him and Ling Han. They only thought that they both came from the Nine Suns Holy Land. Moreover, he was a Demonic Beast, so it was unlikely that they would use the large black dog to threaten Ling Han.
“Where is the resting place of Divine Rain Venerate?”
“Nine Springs Planet, Ziming Mountain.”
“It seems a little far.”
“Er, should we go and find the Nine Mountains Old Baldy again?”
“F***, he’s not bald!”
Ling Han and the large black dog went to find the Nine Mountains Venerate, and asked this great elite for help, sending them directly to the Nine Springs Planet. This would save them a lot of time.
With how shameless Ling Han and the large black dog were, they naturally wouldn’t be too embarrassed to ask.
Regarding this, the Nine Mountains Venerate was speechless. These two little guys really didn’t treat him as an outsider.
However, he was also very optimistic about Ling Han’s future prospects. Thus, he did not mind helping Ling Han.
When a Venerate Tier elite made a move, it was naturally different. Merely nine days later, they had arrived at the Nine Springs Planet.
“Senior, are you not interested?” Ling Han asked.

The Nine Mountains Venerate pondered for a moment, then said, “I can’t say I’m not interested, but at my cultivation level, I believe even more in karma. If you want me to rummage through the tombs of cultivators of the same cultivation level, then it’s possible that Venerate Tiers would come to rummage through my tomb in the future.”

This was just like how even if new Ancestral Kings appeared, they would not plunder from those Imperial Clans. They would return the favor generation after generation. Though there were some rules that were not explicitly stated, they were silently adhered to.
Of course, if an Imperial Weapon really appeared in the tomb of Divine Rain Venerate, then to say nothing of Nine Mountains Venerate, even Saints would appear and join the battle for it.

Whether they would make a move or not would only depend on whether the temptation was strong enough. Moreover, since the treasure had appeared, for Nine Mountains Venerate and the others, it could not be considered as robbing a tomb.

Ling Han and the large black dog headed towards the Ziming Mountain. Ling Han immediately began to explore the ley lines here, while the dog checked the news on the Galaxy Network. This time, how many elites had come?

“Incredible, incredible, north, south, east, and west. The young prodigies from the four Heavenly Realms and elites from the older generation have all come.” The large black dog called out loudly, “Though Divine Rain Venerate himself does not have such great ability, it is very possible that he is related to an Emperor Tier inheritance. Even Saints would not be able to resist such temptation.”
“This time, it’s extremely likely that a Saint is hiding in the shadows. Once an Imperial Weapon or an Imperial Technique appears, they’ll join in on the robbery.”
The large black dog looked at Ling Han and said, “Little Han, could it be that we’ve worked for so long, yet ended up working for someone else?”
Ling Han chuckled, “So you’re quitting?”
“Of course not, no way!” The large black dog immediately jumped up again.

Ling Han had already grasped the ley lines of the Nine Springs Planet. With a thought, he brought him and the large black dog to the place nearest to the Ziming Mountains. If he went further, it would only be a mere 5000 km away.
“Little Han, this move is really convenient.” The large black dog nodded, “Grandpa Dog also wants to learn it.”
“So it would be convenient for you to steal things?”
“Er, so be it if you know. Why do you have to say it out loud?”
Not long after, they arrived at Ziming Mountain.

This mountain was as tall as the heavens, and was completely purple in colour. It was not covered with some kind of purple-coloured plants, but rather the mountain rocks were all purple in colour, exuding a faint light.

Originally, this mountain could not be considered all that mystical. It was just that the mountain rocks were different from other lands, but now, the whole mountain was enshrouded in purple-coloured clouds and mists, turning into the appearances of multiple
Divine Beasts.
This was not something as simple as looking mysterious, but rather that these Divine Beasts really had great might, and even Venerate Tier elites would not be able to break through them.
“As expected of the descendant of the Ancestral King. He’s also a Venerate Tier elite, and his methods are astonishing.”
“What do we do now? We can’t enter!”
“Huh? Don’t you know that the weaker one’s cultivation level, the more unrestricted they’ll
be?”
“A few days ago, there was a Foundation Building Tier cultivator who could enter. I’m sure that it won’t take too long for a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator to enter.”
“Sigh, I’m a Core Formation Tier cultivator, so how long do I have to wait?”
“I am in True Self Tier myself!”

There was a great deal of discussion on the Galaxy Network. It was not difficult at all to obtain relevant information. Thus, Ling Han and the large black dog also knew that they could not enter now, and would have to wait for a while.
“I’ve mastered a Grandmaster-level formation. Would it be able to open a path?” Ling Han
murmured.
He began to make an attempt.
This was indeed a formation. At present, Ling Han was not qualified to set it up. However, if it was just to carve out a path, this should still be feasible.
“Old Black, come.”
“What are you doing? Little Han, if you want to try it out, you can try it out on your own. Grandpa Dog should just wait outside for a while longer. I don’t mind at all! Hey, hey, hey,
why are you grabbing Grandpa Dog? Ah-”
The large black dog screamed in agony. Ling Han had grabbed him, and he was already walking toward the mist.
Boom, immediately, a Divine Beast pounced over.
This was formed from the energy of heaven and earth. Though it was not a physical body, it
was similarly boundlessly terrifying.
“Ah, I’m done for!” The large black dog didn’t even dare to look anymore.
Yet Ling Han stepped down. Weng, stimulated by Spiritual Power. the heaven and earth immediately underwent a subtle change.
He couldn’t set up formations with steps, but deactivating formations with steps, and creating a safe path wasn’t anything difficult.
Boom, this Divine Beast pounced past him. It was as if there was something wrong with its
eyes, and it had missed him by just a hair’s breadth.
Ling Han smiled, and continued to walk forwards. He saw another Divine Beast charge
towards him.
“Ah!”
“Yi!”
“Mother of God!”
The large black dog continued to wail in agony. After several times, he should have already realized that there was no problem. However, he still couldn’t calm down.
However, after walking for more than ten minutes, Ling Han finally walked out of the formation area. Ahead of him was still that purple mountain, but it was no longer enshrouded
in clouds and mist.
Ling Han tossed the large black dog onto the ground, and said, “Blackie, are you done yet?”
The large black dog had already begun to howl like a wolf. Hearing Ling Han’s words, it finally
stopped and scrambled to its feet. “Yi, we’ve already entered?”
Then, he became excited, “Great Emperor’s inheritance, Grandpa Dog is here!”
Pa, pa, pa! It broke out into a run and ran forwards.
In its mind, only Foundation Building Tier cultivators could enter at this moment. As a Nine Cauldrons, wasn’t it powerful enough to suppress all living beings?
Ling Han shook his head, and followed speechlessly.
They soon discovered a cave. It hadn’t been broken open for long, and Ling Han could see
clearly that the traces of broken mountain rock were very new.
Was this the abode where Divine Rain Venerate had passed away? Because the seal on the abode had been accidentally broken, the formation of the Ziming
Mountain was triggered, which led to the present situation.
“Little Han, quick.” The large black dog led the way.
“Be careful,” Ling Han warned. After all, this was where a Venerate Tier elite had passed
away. Anyhow, he could easily leave behind a trump card that could insta-kill a Core
Formation Tier.
“Grandpa Dog knows.”
However, they had not even entered into the cave, when they saw two people walk out from
within. They shouted at Ling Han and the large black dog, “Scram, you are not qualified to
enter!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4026: Abode
paragraphs: Ling Han and the large black dog both faltered upon hearing this. What was going on here? There was a restriction on unauthorized entry here?
“Grandpa Dog wants to enter, so what? Can you guys stop me?” the large black dog said with a chuckle.
“If you want to die, then come!” one of them declared disdainfully.

Right now, only Foundation Building Tier cultivators could enter this abode. As fellow Foundation Building Tier cultivators, did they need to be afraid? Moreover, there weren’t just two of them. There were also a large number of people in the abode. If they all came out, each of them could punch this person and dog into smithereens.

“Hehe, Grandpa Dog really doesn’t believe it.” The large black dog whistled, and walked towards the abode. At the same time, he turned around and warned Ling Han, “Little Han, Grandpa Dog will take care of everything here.”
With the large black dog’s personality of bullying the weak and fearing the strong, as well as his fondness of showing off, the present situation was really too suitable for him.
“You’re seeking death!” The two Foundation Building Tier cultivators both humphed and attacked the large black dog at the same time.

However, a Foundation Building Tier cultivator versus a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator... Moreover, one was at the level of the Nine Cauldrons at that. No matter how one looked at it, this would be a tragedy.

The large black dog unleashed his aura lightly. Pa, pa! The two of them instantly collapsed to the ground, feeling as if their hearts were about to jump out of their chests. This was an indescribably agonizing feeling.
“Brat, watch your eyes. Do you think I’m someone you can trifle with?” The large black dog wore a smug expression as he stepped on the two of them.
“Humph, a mere wild dog dares to strut around?” People continuously walked out of the abode. They were all Foundation Building Tier geniuses from various planets.
The large black dog was naturally enraged, and he waved his paw, saying, “Little b*stards, bring it on! Grandpa Dog will teach you a lesson!”
The prodigies all charged over, each of them brandishing their Spirit Tool and unleashing their full power.
“Lie down!” The large black dog unleashed his aura, and under the pressure of the Nine Cauldrons aura, pa, pa, pa, everyone collapsed to the ground. Not a single person could get back up.
This was suppression on the level of being. No matter how much of a prodigy you were, it was unavoidable, unless you had formed the Primitive Celestial Foundation like Ling Han had.
“Y-you’re a Cauldron Forging Tier elite!” With this, those young prodigies could also tell the large black dog’s cultivation level.
“That’s right. Grandpa Dog is a Cauldron Forging Tier elite!” the large black dog said proudly.
“How is this possible!” Those young prodigies were all dumbfounded. By now, only Foundation Building Tier cultivators should be able to enter. How could Cauldron Forging Tiers so quickly come in?

“All of you, hand over what you have found in the abode.” The large black dog wore a ferocious expression, “Behave yourself. If Grandpa Dog discovers that you dare to hide it, I guarantee that you will all suffer.”
All the prodigies shook their heads, and said that this abode was practically poor, and did not have any treasure at all.
The large black dog didn’t believe them, and he started to search them one by one.
“No, this sword is my inherited Spirit Tool!”
“I just bought this Celestial medicine on Galaxy Network.”
“Ah, this celestial technique was bestowed on me not too long ago by my seniors. Give it back to me quickly!”
Everyone exclaimed. This large black dog was really evil. He would snatch whatever valuable item he saw. He was completely like a gangster and a robber combined.
How could anyone possibly take out something that had entered into the large black dog’s pocket?
However, the large black dog shook his head at Ling Han, expressing that he had really not discovered anything that had originated from the ancient times.
“Little Han, it’s possible that we’ve all been tricked this time!” the large black dog said angrily.
F***, they had created such a huge commotion, yet in the end, there was nothing at all. Wasn’t this a joke?
“Yi, you are Ling Han?” Someone recognized Ling Han.

At first, they didn’t think so, because everyone knew that Ling Han had long since advanced into the Core Formation Tier, so how could he possibly come in? However, the large black dog was a Cauldron Forging Tier, and called Ling Han Little Han. Even if they didn’t believe it, they had to believe it.
“Haha, so you’re the supreme prodigy of the North Heavenly Realm?”
“Unfortunately, being targeted by the Battle God Palace, your only fate is death!”
Quite a few people smirked coldly, their animosity towards Ling Han very great.
The large black dog was displeased, and he said coldly to the others, “F***, you bunch of chickens, you actually dare to look down on my Little Han?”
“Hmph, we either come from a Holy Land, or come from a Venerate Tier force. What is there to be afraid of?”
“To be honest, no one has ever been able to live after the Battle God Palace issued a must-kill
order!”
“There’s not much time left for you.”
“North Heavenly Realm is the weakest among the four great Heavenly Realms, after all. Your glory is only short-lived this time, and is about to be beaten back to its original state.”
These people were really arrogant, and very stubborn.
The large black dog was naturally angered. Even a captive was so arrogant now?
It thrashed these people, then tied them up one by one, and said, “Aren’t these guys from extraordinary backgrounds? Sell them to their own clans, that should be worth a lot of
money.”
The prodigies were astonished, and they were all transfixed with shock.
You guys have robbed us quite a bit, and still want to sell us off for money?
This was too black-hearted, wasn’t it?
Ling Han nodded apprehensively, “This is not a bad idea.”
“Grandpa Dog also thinks it’s not bad.”

It asked Ling Han for the Essence Nurturing Gourd, and stuffed these people in one by one. “Brats, consider yourselves lucky to be able to strengthen your souls in this kind of treasured gourd. Shouldn’t I collect a little protection fee from you?”
Then, the large black dog looked towards Ling Han, “Are we just going to leave like this?”
Ling Han shook his head and said, “Since we’re already here, let’s just take a look. Moreover, they didn’t discover anything, but it doesn’t mean that we wouldn’t find anything either.”
“That’s right.”
Ling Han walked into the abode and began to search carefully.
This was an ordinary abode. The difference was that this place had changed the general trend

of heaven and earth. It was like the spirit of heaven and earth, and one could see spring water gushing out, bringing with it a dense Celestial Qi. Merely smelling it would make one’s pores open completely, and make one feel comfortable all over.
Yi?

Judging by the furnishings here, there should be two people living inside the abode, and it was not Divine Rain Venerate and his Dao Apprentice, but rather him and his dao partner, because they were obviously eating, drinking and sleeping together.
However, these two people seemed to have left this place long ago. Ling Han didn’t find any
clothes.
Could it be that this wasn’t the place where Divine Rain Venerate had died, but rather a place where he had once lived?
Just as Ling Han was about to leave, he suddenly faltered.
He had already released his divine sense to stimulate the ley lines, observing this abode from
all directions, and now, he suddenly made a discovery.
“Little Han, what are you standing around for? Let’s go!” the large black dog urged.
Ling Han shook his head, “Wait.”
“Yi, have you discovered something?” The large black dog immediately approached. He knew
Ling Han very well.
Ling Han nodded, “Don’t be anxious.”
He closed his eyes, and his whole mind and spirit became one with this planet. With the planet
as his eyes, he observed the abode, bit by bit, revealing all the details.
Very quickly, a smile appeared at the corners of his lips.
He walked to the side of a cabinet, then moved it away.
“Grandpa Dog has seen this place, but there are no hidden doors behind it,” the large black
dog couldn’t help but say. He didn’t want Ling Han to waste his time.
Ling Han shook his head, “Don’t be impatient.”
He continuously tapped on the wall, and his spiritual power drew on the power of heaven and earth. Multiple formation patterns actually appeared on the wall.

The two of them instantly collapsed to the ground, feeling as if their hearts were about to jump out of their chests.
This was an indescribably agonizing feeling.
“Brat, watch your eyes.
Do you think I’m someone you can trifle with?” The large black dog wore a smug expression as he stepped on the two of them.
“Humph, a mere wild dog dares to strut around?” People continuously walked out of the abode.
They were all Foundation Building Tier geniuses from various planets.
The large black dog was naturally enraged, and he waved his paw, saying, “Little b*stards, bring it on!
Grandpa Dog will teach you a lesson!”
The prodigies all charged over, each of them brandishing their Spirit Tool and unleashing their full power.
“Lie down!” The large black dog unleashed his aura, and under the pressure of the Nine Cauldrons aura, pa, pa, pa, everyone collapsed to the ground.
Not a single person could get back up.
This was suppression on the level of being.
No matter how much of a prodigy you were, it was unavoidable, unless you had formed the Primitive Celestial Foundation like Ling Han had.
“Y-you’re a Cauldron Forging Tier elite!” With this, those young prodigies could also tell the large black dog’s cultivation level.
“That’s right.
Grandpa Dog is a Cauldron Forging Tier elite!” the large black dog said proudly.
“How is this possible!” Those young prodigies were all dumbfounded.
By now, only Foundation Building Tier cultivators should be able to enter.
How could Cauldron Forging Tiers so quickly come in?
“All of you, hand over what you have found in the abode.” The large black dog wore a ferocious expression, “Behave yourself.
If Grandpa Dog discovers that you dare to hide it, I guarantee that you will all suffer.”
All the prodigies shook their heads, and said that this abode was practically poor, and did not have any treasure at all.
The large black dog didn’t believe them, and he started to search them one by one.
“No, this sword is my inherited Spirit Tool!”
“I just bought this Celestial medicine on Galaxy Network.”
“Ah, this celestial technique was bestowed on me not too long ago by my seniors.
Give it back to me quickly!”
Everyone exclaimed.
This large black dog was really evil.
He would snatch whatever valuable item he saw.
He was completely like a gangster and a robber combined.
How could anyone possibly take out something that had entered into the large black dog’s pocket?
However, the large black dog shook his head at Ling Han, expressing that he had really not discovered anything that had originated from the ancient times.
“Little Han, it’s possible that we’ve all been tricked this time!” the large black dog said angrily.
F***, they had created such a huge commotion, yet in the end, there was nothing at all.
Wasn’t this a joke?
“Yi, you are Ling Han?” Someone recognized Ling Han.
At first, they didn’t think so, because everyone knew that Ling Han had long since advanced into the Core Formation Tier, so how could he possibly come in?
However, the large black dog was a Cauldron Forging Tier, and called Ling Han Little Han.
Even if they didn’t believe it, they had to believe it.
“Haha, so you’re the supreme prodigy of the North Heavenly Realm?”
“Unfortunately, being targeted by the Battle God Palace, your only fate is death!”
Quite a few people smirked coldly, their animosity towards Ling Han very great.
The large black dog was displeased, and he said coldly to the others, “F***, you bunch of chickens, you actually dare to look down on my Little Han?”
“Hmph, we either come from a Holy Land, or come from a Venerate Tier force.
What is there to be afraid of?”
“To be honest, no one has ever been able to live after the Battle God Palace issued a must-kill
order!”
“There’s not much time left for you.”
“North Heavenly Realm is the weakest among the four great Heavenly Realms, after all.
Your glory is only short-lived this time, and is about to be beaten back to its original state.”
These people were really arrogant, and very stubborn.
The large black dog was naturally angered.
Even a captive was so arrogant now?
It thrashed these people, then tied them up one by one, and said, “Aren’t these guys from extraordinary backgrounds?
Sell them to their own clans, that should be worth a lot of
money.”
The prodigies were astonished, and they were all transfixed with shock.
You guys have robbed us quite a bit, and still want to sell us off for money?
This was too black-hearted, wasn’t it?
Ling Han nodded apprehensively, “This is not a bad idea.”
“Grandpa Dog also thinks it’s not bad.”
It asked Ling Han for the Essence Nurturing Gourd, and stuffed these people in one by one.
“Brats, consider yourselves lucky to be able to strengthen your souls in this kind of treasured gourd.
Shouldn’t I collect a little protection fee from you?”
Then, the large black dog looked towards Ling Han, “Are we just going to leave like this?”
Ling Han shook his head and said, “Since we’re already here, let’s just take a look.
Moreover, they didn’t discover anything, but it doesn’t mean that we wouldn’t find anything either.”
“That’s right.”
Ling Han walked into the abode and began to search carefully.
This was an ordinary abode.
The difference was that this place had changed the general trend
of heaven and earth.
It was like the spirit of heaven and earth, and one could see spring water gushing out, bringing with it a dense Celestial Qi.
Merely smelling it would make one’s pores open completely, and make one feel comfortable all over.
Yi?

Judging by the furnishings here, there should be two people living inside the abode, and it was not Divine Rain Venerate and his Dao Apprentice, but rather him and his dao partner, because they were obviously eating, drinking and sleeping together.
However, these two people seemed to have left this place long ago.
Ling Han didn’t find any
clothes.
Could it be that this wasn’t the place where Divine Rain Venerate had died, but rather a place where he had once lived?
Just as Ling Han was about to leave, he suddenly faltered.
He had already released his divine sense to stimulate the ley lines, observing this abode from
all directions, and now, he suddenly made a discovery.
“Little Han, what are you standing around for?
Let’s go!” the large black dog urged.
Ling Han shook his head, “Wait.”
“Yi, have you discovered something?” The large black dog immediately approached.
He knew
Ling Han very well.
Ling Han nodded, “Don’t be anxious.”
He closed his eyes, and his whole mind and spirit became one with this planet.
With the planet
as his eyes, he observed the abode, bit by bit, revealing all the details.
Very quickly, a smile appeared at the corners of his lips.
He walked to the side of a cabinet, then moved it away.
“Grandpa Dog has seen this place, but there are no hidden doors behind it,” the large black
dog couldn’t help but say.
He didn’t want Ling Han to waste his time.
Ling Han shook his head, “Don’t be impatient.”
He continuously tapped on the wall, and his spiritual power drew on the power of heaven and earth.
Multiple formation patterns actually appeared on the wall.

chapters.title: Chapter 4027: Entering
paragraphs: “F*ck! You can do this?” the large black dog immediately shouted.
It had clearly examined this wall, and there was nothing strange about it. However, in Ling Han’s hands, multiple patterns appeared, so how could it not be shocked?

“This is an entrance that has been concealed by a formation,” Ling Han said. “However, according to my deductions, even if I don’t break through it, this entrance will appear on its own in a very short period of time.”
“The same time that the formation outside dissipates?” the large black dog asked.
Ling Han nodded and said, “That’s probably the case.”

The formation of the entire Ziming Mountain seemed to be one and the same. Thus, when the formation enshrouding the outside disappeared, all the mechanisms and restrictions here would also lose their effects.

“Grandpa Dog is here for the inheritance of the Great Emperor!” The large black dog rubbed its paws together, appearing very excited, “In future, Grandpa Dog will also become an Ancestral King or Great Emperor. Mortals, tremble in front of Grandpa Dog!”
Ling Han laughed loudly, “If you ever became an Emperor, that would be a vile character getting his own way. The heavens are really too blind.”
“Go, go, go. Hurry up and break the formation.” The large black dog waved his paws, looking like he couldn’t be bothered to deal with Ling Han.
Very quickly, Ling Han broke through this formation, and a revolving doorway of light appeared on the wall.
“Little Han, will this be dangerous?” the large black dog asked Ling Han.
Ling Han spread out his hands, and asked, “How should I know?”
“Grandpa Dog has a solution.” The large black dog grabbed a person from the Essence Nurturing Gourd, and xiu, threw him into the doorway of light.
Shua, that unlucky guy was thrown in, but there was no terrifying event like his body being crushed by the doorway of light.
“There should be no problem,” the large black dog nodded.

Ling Han laughed, and walked towards the doorway of light. Not only was the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower floating above his head, but even the Starlight Screen had been activated, activating his strongest defense.
He stepped through the doorway of light, and an indescribable power surged out. Xiu, he appeared on a desolate plain.
The person who had been tossed in by the large black dog was lying on the ground, still unconscious.
However, Ling Han looked behind him, and there was no doorway of light.
This was a one-way transmission.
He tried to contact the large black dog, but discovered that this place could not connect to the Galaxy Network.
En, this should be a Mystery Realm that was cut off from the rest of the world.
No wonder Divine Rain Venerate and his dao partner’s change of clothes couldn’t be seen in the abode outside. As it turned out, this place was connected to another space.
Ling Han walked further away, and true enough, after only a while, a large black dog appeared out of thin air.
“Little Han, where is this?” the large black dog exclaimed in shock. “Yi, is this a Mystery Realm?”

“You guessed correctly.” Ling Han nodded, closed his eyes slightly, and began to search the ley lines here. He immediately discovered that there were pitifully few ley lines here, and the Earth Qi here was also incredibly weak.
This place... seemed to be missing something.
As a Formation Grandmaster, Ling Han was sensitive enough to discover that there was something missing in this heaven and earth, but as for what exactly it was, he could not say.
“This must be because my cultivation level is not high enough.”
“And linked to my cultivation level, that can only be the Regulations of heaven and earth.”
“What is missing here should be the Regulations of heaven and earth.”
“Under normal circumstances, how could there be no Regulations of heaven and earth? Thus, it is very possible that this is a small world created by a great elite, so the Regulations are incomplete.”

Just like the White Lotus Mystery Realm. Though the people there cultivated extremely fast, firstly, their lifespans were limited, and secondly, the True Self Tier was their limit, and they could not advance any further.
In terms of cultivation techniques, there was no shortage of high-level cultivation techniques.
Thus, since Spirit Transformation Tier was unable to appear, it could only be assumed that it lacked the corresponding Regulations of heaven and earth.

Ling Han related his deduction to the large black dog, and the large black dog nodded, “Thus, this Mystery Realm must be a small world like that, and that is why the signal to the Galaxy Network is cut off.”
“More or less.”
“Since there’s no turning back now, let’s continue forward?”
“M-hm.”
The large black dog stuffed the person on the ground back into the Essence Nurturing Gourd, then followed Ling Han’s footsteps.
“The energy of heaven and earth here is very weak, so it’s probably impossible for any powerful elites to appear,” the large black dog said as he walked.
“Oh, that’s right. Do you have any chance of attaining Ten Cauldrons?” Ling Han changed the
topic.

“Sigh, it’s hopeless.” The large black dog shook its head, and said, “I’ve already tried for half a year, yet there’s still no hope at all. Little Han, only a freak like you can reach Ten Cauldrons. Grandpa Dog is only so-so, just barely passable, and a Fusion Cauldron from Nine Cauldrons
is enough.”

When the Nine Cauldrons fused together, they would be on the level of Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter, all right? Furthermore, it was not every Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter that could successfully fuse the Nine Cauldrons. This large black dog was really showing off.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “All right. I’ll see if I can help you create the Fusion Cauldron.”

The man and dog walked on this desolate plain, their speed very fast. Merely half an hour later, they had walked out of the desolate plain, and a mountain range appeared ahead of them. It was a continuous chain of mountains, covered by green plants, exuding an exuberant
vitality.
“I can finally see signs of life. Grandpa Dog was almost scared to death. I thought this place was a land of death.” The large black dog patted his chest.

After they had climbed over the mountain, they saw a city appear before their eyes. It was rectangular in shape, and was surrounded by city walls. Furthermore, there was also a moat of water outside the city walls, but what flowed in the river was no ordinary river water, but
rather blue lightning.
This was very awesome, wasn’t it? There was actually a river comprised of lightning? “Little Han, this place doesn’t seem simple. There might be a local tyrant,” the large black
dog said.
“Are you comparing yourself to a powerful dragon?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“Wrong, we are ferocious dragons crossing the river, capable of toppling mountains and overturning seas,” the large black dog boasted shamelessly.
Ling Han shook his head, and took the lead. He had already gained a preliminary grasp of the ley lines here. Though the Earth Qi was weak, which would greatly decrease his mobility, it
could still be used in the end.

However, there were pitifully few ley lines here, only a dozen over. This greatly limited Ling Han’s “vision”, because his divine sense also had to be extended through the ley lines. Thus, he was also seriously lacking in understanding of this Mystery Realm. Otherwise, with a sweep of his divine sense, the general structure of a planet should be in his mind.
“Wait for Grandpa Dog!” The large black dog hurriedly followed behind him.

Very soon, they arrived at the city gates. There was a suspension bridge laid down here, and they could safely pass over the lightning river. They could clearly see that the power of lightning would occasionally soar into the skies with a terrifying momentum. However, neither Ling Han nor the large black dog took this to heart. Its might was only that
of Foundation Building Tier, so even if they entered the river, they could completely treat it
as a bath.
There were guards at the city gates, and there were quite a number of them.
“Stop!” Immediately, a soldier stretched out a hand towards them, and shouted loudly.
With these words, Ling Han’s heart calmed considerably.
It was human language, and he could understand. Ling Han stopped as instructed, appearing to be very cooperative.
“Entering the city will cost ten Dao Commands,” the soldier said.
Yi, Dao Commands?
With Ling Han’s intelligence, he naturally could immediately guess that the Dao Commands
was the currency of this place. However, he had just arrived here, so where would he get this
thing?
