chapters.title: Chapter 4028: Greed
paragraphs: Ling Han smiled, “This brother, you see, I am just a herb gatherer. I have just gone out and spent all my Dao Commands, so how about I use herbs as compensation?”
“Sure,” the soldier said.
Ling Han pretended to fumble around in his luggage, yet through his Spatial Tool, he found a Celestial medicine of the lowest level. Then, he took it out.
It could not be helped. With the height he was at now, the medicinal ingredients that he could store away were naturally Celestial medicines.
“Godly medicine!” The moment Ling Han took out the Celestial medicine, the soldier’s eyes almost popped out of his head.
“What!”
When the other soldiers heard the news, they all ran over. When they saw the medicinal herb that was exuding a soft red light in Ling Han’s hand, they could no longer maintain their composure.

This Celestial medicine was really very ordinary. It was left over from when Ling Han had concocted alchemical pills previously, and could not possibly be used in future. However, he had obviously underestimated the cultivation level of this place. It should be known that these soldiers were only Mystery Realm Tiers, and had not set foot on the Celestial Path. How could they not be shocked when they saw the Celestial medicine?
Ling Han gritted his teeth. He had thought that he had taken out an ordinary Celestial medicine, but in the end, these people’s level was too low, and they had all been shocked silly.
Forget it. In any case, it was not valuable to him, so he wouldn’t feel heartache even if he gave it away.
“Captain!”
“Captain!”
“Captain Qin!”
The soldiers all stepped aside, and then a middle-aged man with a large belly walked over. He looked to be in his forties, and was also a Mystery Realm Tier.
This captain was very good at putting on airs. As he walked, he swayed back and forth, appearing very overbearing.

Captain Qin snatched the Celestial medicine from the hands of the soldier. His eyes swept over it, and a greedy expression instantly appeared on his round, fat face. Then, he looked towards Ling Han, “How could such an ordinary medicinal herb be enough? At least ten!”
Hiss, when the soldiers heard this, they all shook their heads secretly. Looks like their captain was going to screw someone over again.
It could not be helped. Who asked his daughter to marry into such a good family? Even if he was a tyrant, so what? No one could deal with him.
Ling Han smiled. Looks like he had taken out this Celestial medicine too easily. Naturally, others would think that he had even more Celestial medicines on him, and their quality was even higher.
This was called having already revealed his wealth. Furthermore, Ling Han hadn’t revealed any background, so who else would they rip off if not a fat sheep like him?

“F***, you actually dare to scam us?” The large black dog immediately jumped up, “It has only ever been Grandpa Dog that would be slaughtering others. A mere Mystery Realm Tier like you dares to be insolent in front of Grandpa Dog?”

“Demonic, Demonic Beast!” Captain Qin’s expression changed drastically, and he took a few steps back. There was a look of shock on his face, and the other soldiers didn’t look any better. They all looked terrified.
Yi, was that really necessary?

The large black dog stood up on his hind legs, and asked, “What is it? Do you want to fight?” Captain Qin laughed loudly, and said, “Brat, you actually dare to collude with a Demonic Beast? Even if a Heavenly King comes, he won’t be able to save you!” In his eyes, this was a chance, and he could use this opportunity to apprehend Ling Han and confiscate all his property.
Couldn’t the people here be associated with Demonic Beasts?
“Guards, apprehend this human and demon pair!” Captain Qin retreated on his own, one hand pointing at Ling Han, while the other hand gripped tightly onto the Celestial medicine.
Although the soldiers were afraid of the large black dog, a Demonic Beast, they didn’t dare to retreat. They all raised their weapons and aimed them at Ling Han and the large black dog.
To be more precise, most of the weapons were targeted at the large black dog, and thought that it was more dangerous.

The people here seemed to have an extraordinary fear and disgust towards Demonic Beasts. The large black dog stood on his hind legs, hands on his hips, “Come on then. Grandpa Dog isn’t afraid of trash like you.”
It would definitely not miss out on a place where it could show off.
“Go, charge!” Captain Qin had already retreated to a place that he thought was safe enough, and began to order around again.

The soldiers were exasperated, so they could only grit their teeth and charge over. However, the large black dog merely sent a palm strike over, and pa, pa, pa, everyone collapsed to the ground, groaning and moaning.
Of course, this was because the large black dog had held back. Otherwise, how could it be that a Nine Cauldrons wouldn’t have been able to insta-kill a bunch of Mystery Realm Tiers?
Captain Qin was almost scared out of his wits by this scene. As he ran into the city, he shouted loudly, “Beast attack! Beast attack! The Demonic Beast is here!”
One could not help but be impressed. Even in such a state of fright, his hand was still tightly gripping onto that Celestial medicine, as if he would not let go even if he died.

Ling Han smiled, and his Spiritual Power transformed into a large hand that grabbed Captain Qin by force. Captain Qin’s legs were still moving rapidly, but his figure was retreating. Captain Qin was scared out of his wits, and his face became as white as a sheet.
“Hand it over!” The large black dog snatched the Celestial medicine back, and tossed it over to Ling Han.
“Give me back my Celestial medicine!” Captain Qin screamed, brandishing his claws, wanting to fight Ling Han to the death.
It was really rare to see someone who was so greedy that he was not afraid of death.
“Do you know who I am?” His eyes were red, as he shouted at Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled, “I really don’t know.”

“I am Qin Botao, and my son-in-law is Liu Long!” Captain Qin called out loudly. “Liu Long, do you know that he is the supreme prodigy of the Liu Clan, and has already been bestowed the title of Fifth Grade Guard by His Majesty, the Emperor!”

The large black dog approached, and examined Qin Botao closely. Then, he said to Ling Han, “With how this guy looks like, how good-looking can his daughter be? This Liu Long shouldn’t be all that impressive either, right?”
“Pei, my daughter is as beautiful as a celestial maiden!” Qin Botao hurriedly argued.
Ling Han and the large black dog exchanged a glance before shaking their heads in unison.
The large black dog added, “If your daughter is really as beautiful as a celestial maiden, then she must be the child of the old man next door.”
F***, how could a demonic dog like you be so vicious?

Qin Botao trembled in anger. In truth, he would also occasionally mull over how he could give birth to such a beautiful daughter with his appearance. He could only console himself that his child looked like her mother.

“Humph, a demon and a Demonic Beast actually dare to invade our Golden Fetus City!” A voice filled with a murderous aura rang out, and a man in full armor also strode out. There were Celestial Qi entwined around him, making him appear incredibly handsome. “Son-in-law, save me! Save me!” When Qin Botao saw this, he hurriedly waved his hand and
called out.

This man was none other than Liu Long, a well-known prodigy of martial arts. In fact, he had even gained the attention of the sovereign of the Galewind Nation, and bestowed the title of Fifth Grade City Guard on him.
For a young man who was only twenty-four or twenty-five years old, this was an honor.
Liu Long showed a hint of disgust. Towards his beautiful wife, he really liked her, but towards this money-grubbing, materialistic father-in-law, he absolutely detested him.
“Let him go!” he said coldly.
“What if I don’t?” The large black dog bared its teeth and asked.
“Then you can all die with him!” Liu Longhu said balefully.

“F***, this son-in-law is really two-faced.” The large black dog patted Qin Botao, “This son-in-law of yours is clearly using provocation tactics, wanting us to kill you in a fit of anger! Sigh, he probably has his eye on your wife, and wants to take in both mother and daughter. Tsk, tsk, tsk, too vulgar!”

sentences.text: Ling Han smiled, “This brother, you see, I am just a herb gatherer.
I have just gone out and spent all my Dao Commands, so how about I use herbs as compensation?”
“Sure,” the soldier said.
Ling Han pretended to fumble around in his luggage, yet through his Spatial Tool, he found a Celestial medicine of the lowest level.
Then, he took it out.
It could not be helped.
With the height he was at now, the medicinal ingredients that he could store away were naturally Celestial medicines.
“Godly medicine!” The moment Ling Han took out the Celestial medicine, the soldier’s eyes almost popped out of his head.
“What!”
When the other soldiers heard the news, they all ran over.
When they saw the medicinal herb that was exuding a soft red light in Ling Han’s hand, they could no longer maintain their composure.
This Celestial medicine was really very ordinary.
It was left over from when Ling Han had concocted alchemical pills previously, and could not possibly be used in future.
However, he had obviously underestimated the cultivation level of this place.
It should be known that these soldiers were only Mystery Realm Tiers, and had not set foot on the Celestial Path.
How could they not be shocked when they saw the Celestial medicine?
Ling Han gritted his teeth.
He had thought that he had taken out an ordinary Celestial medicine, but in the end, these people’s level was too low, and they had all been shocked silly.
Forget it.
In any case, it was not valuable to him, so he wouldn’t feel heartache even if he gave it away.
“Captain!”
“Captain!”
“Captain Qin!”
The soldiers all stepped aside, and then a middle-aged man with a large belly walked over.
He looked to be in his forties, and was also a Mystery Realm Tier.
This captain was very good at putting on airs.
As he walked, he swayed back and forth, appearing very overbearing.
Captain Qin snatched the Celestial medicine from the hands of the soldier.
His eyes swept over it, and a greedy expression instantly appeared on his round, fat face.
Then, he looked towards Ling Han, “How could such an ordinary medicinal herb be enough?
At least ten!”
Hiss, when the soldiers heard this, they all shook their heads secretly.
Looks like their captain was going to screw someone over again.
It could not be helped.
Who asked his daughter to marry into such a good family?
Even if he was a tyrant, so what?
No one could deal with him.
Ling Han smiled.
Looks like he had taken out this Celestial medicine too easily.
Naturally, others would think that he had even more Celestial medicines on him, and their quality was even higher.
This was called having already revealed his wealth.
Furthermore, Ling Han hadn’t revealed any background, so who else would they rip off if not a fat sheep like him?
“F***, you actually dare to scam us?” The large black dog immediately jumped up, “It has only ever been Grandpa Dog that would be slaughtering others.
A mere Mystery Realm Tier like you dares to be insolent in front of Grandpa Dog?”
“Demonic, Demonic Beast!” Captain Qin’s expression changed drastically, and he took a few steps back.
There was a look of shock on his face, and the other soldiers didn’t look any better.
They all looked terrified.
Yi, was that really necessary?
The large black dog stood up on his hind legs, and asked, “What is it?
Do you want to fight?” Captain Qin laughed loudly, and said, “Brat, you actually dare to collude with a Demonic Beast?
Even if a Heavenly King comes, he won’t be able to save you!” In his eyes, this was a chance, and he could use this opportunity to apprehend Ling Han and confiscate all his property.
Couldn’t the people here be associated with Demonic Beasts?
“Guards, apprehend this human and demon pair!” Captain Qin retreated on his own, one hand pointing at Ling Han, while the other hand gripped tightly onto the Celestial medicine.
Although the soldiers were afraid of the large black dog, a Demonic Beast, they didn’t dare to retreat.
They all raised their weapons and aimed them at Ling Han and the large black dog.
To be more precise, most of the weapons were targeted at the large black dog, and thought that it was more dangerous.
The people here seemed to have an extraordinary fear and disgust towards Demonic Beasts.
The large black dog stood on his hind legs, hands on his hips, “Come on then.
Grandpa Dog isn’t afraid of trash like you.”
It would definitely not miss out on a place where it could show off.
“Go, charge!” Captain Qin had already retreated to a place that he thought was safe enough, and began to order around again.
The soldiers were exasperated, so they could only grit their teeth and charge over.
However, the large black dog merely sent a palm strike over, and pa, pa, pa, everyone collapsed to the ground, groaning and moaning.
Of course, this was because the large black dog had held back.
Otherwise, how could it be that a Nine Cauldrons wouldn’t have been able to insta-kill a bunch of Mystery Realm Tiers?
Captain Qin was almost scared out of his wits by this scene.
As he ran into the city, he shouted loudly, “Beast attack!
Beast attack!
The Demonic Beast is here!”
One could not help but be impressed.
Even in such a state of fright, his hand was still tightly gripping onto that Celestial medicine, as if he would not let go even if he died.
Ling Han smiled, and his Spiritual Power transformed into a large hand that grabbed Captain Qin by force.
Captain Qin’s legs were still moving rapidly, but his figure was retreating.
Captain Qin was scared out of his wits, and his face became as white as a sheet.
“Hand it over!” The large black dog snatched the Celestial medicine back, and tossed it over to Ling Han.
“Give me back my Celestial medicine!” Captain Qin screamed, brandishing his claws, wanting to fight Ling Han to the death.
It was really rare to see someone who was so greedy that he was not afraid of death.
“Do you know who I am?” His eyes were red, as he shouted at Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled, “I really don’t know.”
“I am Qin Botao, and my son-in-law is Liu Long!” Captain Qin called out loudly.
“Liu Long, do you know that he is the supreme prodigy of the Liu Clan, and has already been bestowed the title of Fifth Grade Guard by His Majesty, the Emperor!”
The large black dog approached, and examined Qin Botao closely.
Then, he said to Ling Han, “With how this guy looks like, how good-looking can his daughter be?
This Liu Long shouldn’t be all that impressive either, right?”
“Pei, my daughter is as beautiful as a celestial maiden!” Qin Botao hurriedly argued.
Ling Han and the large black dog exchanged a glance before shaking their heads in unison.
The large black dog added, “If your daughter is really as beautiful as a celestial maiden, then she must be the child of the old man next door.”
F***, how could a demonic dog like you be so vicious?
Qin Botao trembled in anger.
In truth, he would also occasionally mull over how he could give birth to such a beautiful daughter with his appearance.
He could only console himself that his child looked like her mother.
“Humph, a demon and a Demonic Beast actually dare to invade our Golden Fetus City!” A voice filled with a murderous aura rang out, and a man in full armor also strode out.
There were Celestial Qi entwined around him, making him appear incredibly handsome.
“Son-in-law, save me!
Save me!” When Qin Botao saw this, he hurriedly waved his hand and
called out.
This man was none other than Liu Long, a well-known prodigy of martial arts.
In fact, he had even gained the attention of the sovereign of the Galewind Nation, and bestowed the title of Fifth Grade City Guard on him.
For a young man who was only twenty-four or twenty-five years old, this was an honor.
Liu Long showed a hint of disgust.
Towards his beautiful wife, he really liked her, but towards this money-grubbing, materialistic father-in-law, he absolutely detested him.
“Let him go!” he said coldly.
“What if I don’t?” The large black dog bared its teeth and asked.
“Then you can all die with him!” Liu Longhu said balefully.
“F***, this son-in-law is really two-faced.” The large black dog patted Qin Botao, “This son-in-law of yours is clearly using provocation tactics, wanting us to kill you in a fit of anger!
Sigh, he probably has his eye on your wife, and wants to take in both mother and daughter.
Tsk, tsk, tsk, too vulgar!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4029: Galewind Nation
paragraphs: Qin Botao thought about it. This son-in-law really had the suspicion of using someone else to do his dirty work.
He knew that Liu Long had always disliked him, but no matter what, he was still Liu Long’s father-in-law. His thoughts were really too vicious, weren’t they?

Meanwhile, Liu Long’s expression changed drastically. He had indeed thought of using someone else to do his dirty work, but now that the large black dog had exposed him in public like this, he naturally couldn’t bring himself to accept it.
“You’re seeking death!” He charged over, Celestial Qi overflowing from all over his body, like a god that had descended into the mortal world.
Neither Ling Han nor the large black dog took it to heart, because Liu Long had only just reached the Foundation Building Tier.

A cold smile tugged at the corners of Liu Long’s lips. ‘Humph, you actually dare to look down on me? Then I’ll kill all of you with a single strike. As for this father-in-law of mine, I’ll naturally kill him as well. My excuse is also very open and aboveboard. It’s inevitable that there will be accidental injuries.’
Qin Botao didn’t dare to look anymore. He closed his eyes tightly.
Pa, he suddenly heard a heavy sound, as if something heavy had fallen.
He opened his eyes, yet shockingly discovered that Liu Long was actually kneeling on the ground.
What was going on here?
In truth, Liu Long was even more stunned than he was.
He delivered a great blow, but all of a sudden, an indescribable fear rose up in him. Then, he knelt on the ground, completely baffled.
Was this because of the man in front of him?

He raised his head to look at Ling Han, only to see that Ling Han was about the same age as him. In fact, Ling Han was even younger than him. How could he possess such unfathomable strength that he couldn’t even resist?
This was absolutely unbelievable.

“How dare you, to actually dare insult the prized son of our Liu Clan!” A loud shout rang out, and an old man rode a weapon over. With a xiu, his figure descended. He looked to be quite old, his face covered with a white beard, and even his hair was greyish white.
This was the strongest elite of the Liu Clan. His name was Liu Kui, and he had already advanced into the Cauldron Forging Tier.

However, his lifespan was also nearing its end. It wasn’t easy for him to wait until a prodigy appeared in his clan that had stepped onto the Celestial Path. This gave the Liu Clan hope of having a successor. At that time, he could also enjoy life in peace and rest easy on his way to the afterlife.
But who would have expected that there would be such a calamity today? A Demonic Beast actually brought a villain with it, and trampled all over the prodigy of the Liu Clan.
However, the large black dog ignored him. Instead, he looked at Qin Botao, and said, “Old brother, what do you say we do with this brat?”

Qin Botao’s expression was filled with awkwardness. Just now, his son-in-law had wanted to get rid of him as well. With his cold-blooded nature, he naturally wanted nothing more than to get rid of him as well. However, the reason why he could have his current status was completely because of the Liu Clan and Liu Long. Without this son-in-law, what was he worth?
“Lord Demonic Dog, please be magnanimous and spare me and my son-in-law,” he hurriedly said with a smile.

“Old Qin, you really don’t have any backbone at all.” The large black dog shook his head, “Sigh, if worse comes to worst, you can just start all over again. You are still young. Even if you want to have another beautiful daughter, it would be completely in time. Furthermore, your daughter can just remarry.”
Both Qin Botao and Liu Long’s faces turned green. This damn dog’s mouth was really too despicable, wasn’t it?
“Let him go!” Liu Kui shouted with forced patience. If it was not for the fact that Liu Long was still in Ling Han’s hands, he would have made a move long ago.
“What if I don’t?” The large black dog wouldn’t lose to anyone verbally.

Shua, Liu Kui immediately charged towards the large black dog. He did not dare to touch Ling Han, because he was afraid of harming Liu Long. However, the large black dog did not have any hostages in his hands. Furthermore, he could also capture the large black dog, and use him as hostage, to trade with Ling Han for Liu Long.
The older one was, the wiser they were. He knew that he definitely could not allow Ling Han to lead him by the nose.
“You actually dare to make a move on Grandpa Dog? Where did you get such courage from?” The large black dog humphed. Boom! The aura of Nine Cauldrons exploded.
Pa!
Instantly, Liu Kui’s body shook, and he fell directly onto the ground.
He was only an Earth Cauldron, and was too far away from Nine Cauldrons. Not only could he not withstand a single blow, he was unable to withstand merely the aura alone.

At this, whether it was Liu Kui, Liu Long or Qin Botao, their expressions all changed drastically. Not good, this demonic dog’s strength was heaven-defyingly strong. There was no one in Golden Fetus City that could subdue it, and they had to seek help from the Imperial Capital.

“Come, Grandpa Dog will ask a question, and you all have to answer. Otherwise, don’t blame Grandpa Dog for being impolite. I will cut off your manhoods and feed them to others!” The large black dog threatened fiercely.
Liu Kui and the others were already completely intimidated, and nodded numbly.

The large black dog started to ask questions. They were all about the Mystery Realm, such as the distribution of forces, the overall level of cultivation of the Mystery Realm, and whether there were any treasures.
Liu Kui and the others said everything they knew.

This Mystery Realm had not been named by the natives. However, the territory occupied by humans was called the Galewind Nation, and correspondingly, there was the territory ruled by the Demonic Beasts. This was not a unified kingdom, but was rather divided into a dozen over scattered forces.

However, every large Demonic Beast led a force that was not inferior to the Human Race. Thus, the situation of the Human Race was not very good. They could only hide in the city, and did not dare to barge into the territory of the Demonic Beasts at all.

Because Demonic Beasts were aggressive, Demonic Beasts would often attack the territory of humans, attempting to conquer the territory of humans, reducing humans to slaves and rations. However, after so many years, humans had always stood firm, which was proof of
their toughness.
In this place, the strongest was the True Self Tier. Whether it was humans or Demonic Beasts, none of them could surpass this barrier.
The large black dog sent a message through divine sense to Ling Han, saying, “Little Han, do you think there’s an Ancestral King inheritance here?”
Ling Han frowned upon seeing this. Although this was a small world, its territory was extremely vast. If he wanted to search this whole place, perhaps 10,000 years wouldn’t be
enough.
“If Divine Rain Venerate really left behind an inheritance, then there would definitely be clues,” he said slowly.
“Then should we go to the Imperial Capital now?” the large black dog asked.
“All right.” Ling Han nodded.
“Then what about these people?”
“Just minor characters, there’s no need to pay attention to them.”
“All right.”

The large black dog ransacked all three of them. The currency circulating here was Dao Commands, but it was actually a currency forged from a rare metal. It was extremely difficult to forge, because there was a clear cost. The fake currency created were actually also worth a
lot of money.
He found a total of over 30,000 Dao Commands on the three of them. The majority came from Liu Kui, and they were in notes of 5,000. He had a total of six.
The large black dog waved his paw, and said, “Let’s go, Little Han. Grandpa Dog will treat you.”
Ling Han laughed loudly, and left with the large black dog.

By now, they had a comprehensive understanding of the Galewind Nation, so they naturally knew the way to the Imperial Capital. However, Demonic Beasts ran rampant on their way, launching attacks at them at the drop of a hat, not giving the large black dog any face at all.
It could not be helped. The man and dog walking together was practically in a dilemma. They were both seen as traitors by the humans, yet were not accepted by the Demon Race either.
Thankfully, they were strong enough, and after spending half a day’s time, they had also arrived at the imperial city of the Galewind Nation.
The large black dog transformed into a sturdy man. Right now, he didn’t want to cause any
trouble either.
The two “people” arrived at the city gates together, and were just about to hand over their coins to enter into the city, when a shield of light descended, landing on the large black dog.
Instantly, the large black dog’s true form appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 4030: Identity Revealed
paragraphs: The large black dog appeared in its true form, and instantly, a commotion broke out at the city gates.

In this Mystery Realm, humans and Demon Race were completely incompatible like fire and water. Whenever they met, it was as if they were meeting an enemy that had killed their father. Thus, the sudden appearance of a demonic dog at the city gates of the Imperial Capital was naturally going to cause chaos.
Was the Demon Race about to attack?

Everyone was in danger. Though the Demonic Beasts were sent retreating every time they invaded, and were unable to eliminate the human race, they had indeed caused massive damage. Thus, everyone was traumatized, and the first reaction they had when they saw the Demonic Beasts was there was going to be another invasion.
“Enemy attack!”
“Full alert!”
“Activate the great formation!”
There was an uproar, and it could not be resolved.

Ling Han looked upwards of the city gates. There was a mirror hanging there, and it was precisely this mirror that had shot out light, enshrouding the large black dog. It was because of this that the large black dog had revealed its true form.
This should be a Spirit Tool, possessing the ability to see through falsehoods.

Meanwhile, the large black dog was extremely innocent. He had only wanted to sneak into the city, and had completely no intention of invading. And now, he had become the public enemy? In just a short while, a large number of soldiers had already rushed out of the city, all of them holding crossbows. Then, they aimed at the large black dog.
“Hehe, Grandpa Dog bears no malice. Don’t be rash.” The large black dog stood on his hind legs, and smiled at the people around him.

It would have been fine if it had not smiled. He would just be an ordinary demonic dog, but this smile was filled with a despicable intent, causing one to involuntarily want to pummel it. Xiu, xiu, xiu! Suddenly, a sky full of arrows shot towards the large black dog.
“F***, who did Grandpa Dog offend?” The large black dog hurriedly dodged. Though these soldiers were very ordinary, the arrows they used were extraordinary arrows, which made even it feel threatened.
The large black dog used the Imminent Skyline, and its speed even surpassed the average Core Formation Tier cultivator. Naturally, not a single arrow hit it.
“I already said that Grandpa Dog has no malicious intent. If anyone dares to shoot Grandpa Dog again, Grandpa Dog will not be reserved!” the large black dog declared angrily.
However, no one paid any heed to it, and another barrage of arrows that filled the skies arrived.
“Grandpa Dog is angered now!” the large black dog roared. It was about to launch a counterattack.
Ling Han opened his mouth, and said, “Everyone, this is a demonic dog that I have raised. It will not hurt anyone.”

The large black dog almost bit him. This guy actually dared to take advantage of him. He was too despicable. However, they had come for the Great Emperor’s inheritance, and they were completely clueless now. Thus, it was best not to cause trouble, so that they could slowly investigate.
Thus, the large black dog still held back.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! However, not only did the rain of arrows not stop, some arrows even shot towards Ling Han.
Ling Han frowned. He stretched out a hand and pressed down. The rain of arrows that shot over all stopped, and then fell simultaneously onto the ground.

Even if these arrows were fired through a Spirit Tool, what level could an arrow fired by a Spirit Tool fired by a Mystery Realm Tier who had not yet entered the Celestial Path reach? With how strong his battle prowess was, he was naturally able to press them down easily.
This time, it also caused those soldiers to lose their wits in shock, and involuntarily, lowered the crossbow in their hands.
This was too shocking. Was he still human?
“Humph, are you also a member of the Demon Race in disguise?” Xiu, a person arrived in midair. It was a man in his thirties, dressed in military attire, appearing to be extraordinarily heroic.
“Seven Winds Marquis!”
“Greetings, Lord Marquis!”
Those soldiers hurriedly knelt, their expressions extremely respectful.

The Seven Winds Marquis, Xu Liang, was the Marquis of the Galewind Nation. His cultivation level was at the Core Formation Tier, and he stood in the second tier of cultivation here. It could be said that he was quite extraordinary.

Xu Liang stood with his hands clasped behind his back, “You two members of Demon Race are so bold, to actually want to sneak into the city! Hehe, your dog eyes are really blind. Don’t you know what kind of place this is?”
These words instantly angered the large black dog. What did he mean by ‘dog eyes are really blind’?
You clearly saw Grandpa Dog, yet still dare to deliberately say ‘dog eyes’. What kind of provocation was this?

chapters.title: Chapter 4031: The legend of opening the sky
paragraphs: The murderous aura attack was divine sense-level, and with a single thought, the attack would arrive.
Qian Lang instantly felt a pain in his head, and felt as if a foreign divine sense was invading, wanting to overturn his mind, causing extreme damage.
He hurriedly went to suppress it. In this way, the attack he delivered immediately slanted, and lost its accuracy.
Boom! This attack landed, yet it didn’t even touch a single hair on Ling Han’s head.
What!

Qian Lang was shocked. Was this guy really a Core Formation Tier cultivator? He could actually affect him? Then if he advanced into the True Self Tier, wouldn’t he be unable to survive even a single move from him?

He swept an eye over Xu Liang, who was kneeling on the ground, and actually gave an ‘oh’ in his heart. No wonder this person had knelt down. It was not because he was cowardly and weak, and had surrendered to the Demon Race, but rather his divine sense had been affected, and he had no choice.
Terrifying, what kind of Demonic Beast was this?
Could it be that it was the legendary Divine Beast, and that was why it had such might? However, humph!

No matter what, he was only a Core Formation Tier cultivator, which was good. He had to quickly get rid of him while he was still weak. Otherwise, he would definitely become a great problem in the future.
Qian Lang moved again, stretching out his right hand. Boom, this time, he was really going all out. Regulations materialized, turning into multiple divine chains of order that shot towards Ling Han.

This was formed from Regulations, and could be claimed to be indestructible. If he was hit head-on, his physical body would definitely be directly pierced through, and then he would be tied up by the divine chains, unable to escape.
Ling Han immediately turned around. Using the Imminent Skyline, he grabbed the large black dog and started to flee.
Xiu, in an instant, he had already disappeared without a trace.
Yi?
Qian Lang couldn’t help but be startled. He had never imagined that Ling Han and the large black dog would come to the Imperial Capital so arrogantly, and actually run off just like that.
He chased for a few steps before immediately stopping.
He could not give chase. What if this was a trap that the Demon Race had dug out for him? Then, if he gave chase, that would be equivalent to falling into a trap.

“Your Highness is mighty, Your Highness is domineering!” All the soldiers did not know of Qian Lang’s reservations. They only saw that Qian Lang had chased off the “two” members of the Demon Race, so they naturally raised their weapons and shouted in unison.

Qian Lang showed an expression of pride, as if everything was as it should be, but internally, an alarm bell rang. Just who exactly was that member from the Demon Race that had not revealed his true form? His Spiritual Power was too terrifying, that even he felt pressured.
It could be said that in terms of pure Spiritual Power, he was definitely no match.

Ling Han brought the large black dog with him and fled into the distance. If there was no need, he had no wish to show off his Star Steps. This was his trump card – the location of the Imperial Capital just happened to be one of the few ley lines exits in this place.

“Damn it, why is there a Demonic Mirror hanging at the city gates!” The large black dog cursed. If it was not for that thing causing trouble, he and Ling Han would have long since snuck into the city, so how could they have fled?

“It’s all right. Later, I’ll just sneak in alone.” Ling Han smiled. He didn’t know where the inheritance of Divine Rain Venerate was, so he had only wanted to enter the city to scout around and see if there were any clues.
“All right. Be careful, brat.” The large black dog nodded.

Ling Han changed his appearance and soul fluctuations, and returned to the city gates of the Imperial City. Because the matter of the Demonic Beast wanting to sneak into the city had just happened, the inspection here was considerably stricter now.

However, this did not have any effect on Ling Han. He was a human in the first place, and under the effects of the Soul Forming Technique, the fluctuation of his soul was completely different. Unless it was someone Sect Master-level and above, he would not be able to sense anything off.

After paying the entrance fee into the city, he entered into the Imperial Capital. First, he found an inn to stay in. Then, he used the hide of the Void Beast as cover, and quietly entered into the Imperial Palace to search for clues.

Listening to the discussions of the people in the palace, they were either discussing which Imperial Prince would inherit the throne, or discussing the threat of the Demonic Beasts. There was no mention of Divine Rain Venerate’s inheritance, what more the Ancestral King’s inheritance.
However, Ling Han heard someone grumble that it had something to do with “opening the sky”.
Yi, this small world giant could still “soar”?
Obviously not. This wasn’t the Genesis World.

Ling Han entered the Imperial History Pavilion. This place was heavily guarded, and aside from the core members of the Imperial Family, even the empress and the Imperial Princes were not qualified to enter.
What secrets were hidden here?
Ling Han took a look. It was nothing more than some cultivation techniques and martial arts techniques, but there was nothing especially profound. There was also a chronicle about this Mystery Realm.
This piqued Ling Han’s interest, and he immediately started to flip through the book.
After reading it once, Ling Han couldn’t help but murmur, “Divine Rain Venerate, are you that kind of person?”
In this historical record, the origins of this Mystery Realm were recorded in detail.

Many years ago, Divine Rain Venerate had fallen in love with a woman called Bai Nanzhen, and began an intense courtship. However, Bai Nanzhen already had a lover, so she chose to resolutely reject Divine Rain Venerate’s courtship.
Divine Rain Venerate flew into a rage out of humiliation, and split off the Bai Clan along with a large area from the great world, forming a small world independent of the heaven and earth.

It was unknown whether he was deliberately toying with the members of the Bai Clan, but Divine Rain Venerate had left behind a hatchet that could open the sky. Whoever could brandish this hatchet would be able to cut open the small world and return to the great world. However, after so many years, there was no one that could hold up this axe that opened the sky. Naturally, they were unable to break through the barrier, and have this Mystery Realm return to the great world.
Thus, it was extremely likely that Divine Rain Venerate was deliberately toying around with them, giving them false hope.
Ling Han searched for several days in the Imperial Palace, but did not find the so-called Sky Opening Axe. He exited the Imperial Palace and walked among the crowds, as if he was a
mortal.

He made some queries, and discovered that the common people had no doubts about the world they were in. They lived and died here, and their lives were ordinary and fulfilling. They had no intention of exploring the world outside the Galewind Nation.
In truth, since they were besieged by Demonic Beasts, they did not have that kind of ability
even if they did.

However, the common people haven’t even heard about Divine Rain Venerate and the Sky Opening Axe. This made Ling Han feel very strange. If they wanted to escape, shouldn’t they mobilize the entire population, and stimulate more people to work hard? Who knows, a person that could wield the Sky Opening Axe might really emerge.
After staying in the Imperial Capital for nine days, Ling Han finally left to find the large black
dog.
He related the matter, and the large black dog was also slightly dazed.
Had they been tricked into coming here?
There was no way back now, so how were they supposed to leave this Mystery Realm?

“This Divine Rain Venerate is really too much. If he likes her, he could have just snatched her back directly, but he actually imprisoned her. What hardcore tastes!” The large black dog mocked, “Little Han, we won’t be trapped here, right?”

Ling Han shook his head, and said, “That’s not the case. If we don’t come out for a long time, the Nine Mountains Venerate will definitely act. Since this Mystery Realm was created by a Venerate Tier, with the Nine Mountains Venerate’s power, it shouldn’t be a problem for him
to bring us out of here.”
“True.” The large black dog breathed a sigh of relief. At least, he didn’t have to worry about being trapped here forever.
“Since we’re free anyway, Little Han, come and help Grandpa Dog with the Fusion Cauldron.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4032: The large black creates a Fusion Cauldron
paragraphs: The large black dog had already cultivated Nine Cauldrons to its limit, and he had no hope of forming Ten Cauldrons either. Thus, if he didn’t fuse the Nine Cauldrons now, there was no point in dragging things out either.

Ling Han nodded. In any case, he didn’t have any ideas for the moment. He couldn’t find the way out, nor did he have any clues about Divine Rain Venerate’s inheritance. Since he had nothing to do, he might as well help the large black dog complete the Fusion Cauldron first. The man and dog began to experiment. This was undoubtedly incredibly difficult.

Even among the Imperial Clans, they would need to mobilize the Imperial Weapon to help shatter the Celestial Cauldrons with the Imperial Weapon, and there were very few who succeeded. It was not every Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter that could succeed.

Ling Han had the large black dog prepare on his own first. When he reached a certain extent, he would make his move. Weng, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower appeared from his mind, enshrouding the large black dog’s head.
Why was it that while the Imperial Clan could help others join the Fusion Cauldron, the Holy Land couldn’t?
The difference lay in the Imperial Weapon!

However, to say nothing of the Saint Tool, even the precious tool of a Venerate Tier could easily shatter the Celestial Cauldrons – even tit was a Primitive Celestial Cauldron, that was not enough in front of Venerate Tier-level power.
Then why was a Verate Tier-level precious tool, or Saint Tool unable to help create the Fusion Fuldron and only the Imperial Weapon could?
It could only mean one thing, and that was the extraordinary nature of the Imperial Weapon itself.

In terms of might, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower in Ling Han’s hands was only on the level of theCore Formation Tier and only a Three Star Celestial Tool. At most, it was only on the level of kings and overlords among Three Star Spirit Tools. There was definitely still a gap between it and the level of a Four Star Celestial Tool.
However, what was the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower made of?
Origin Gold!

Not only was it number one in the world, but it was also one of the strongest in the highest grade. Thus, Ling Han believed that using the unique trait of the Origin Gold, it may be possible to help the large black dog create his Fusion Cauldron.
If he succeeded, he would be able to help the empress, Hu Niu, Lin Luo, and the others combine the Fusion Cauldron, and he alone would be equivalent to an Imperial Clan.
Thus, this attempt was extremely important.
Weng, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower poured down Primal Chaos Qi, and a supreme pressure enshrouded. That was the might of the Origin Gold itself.
“Old Black, let’s begin!” Ling Han shouted through divine sense.
“Come at me!” the large black dog roared.
Boom!

The large black dog took the initiative to stimulate the nine Celestial Cauldrons in his body to collide with each other. Because it was an odd number, they could not correspond to each other. They could only engage in a chaotic battle. Peng, peng, peng!

The Primal Chaos Qi entered into the large black dog’s mind, forming a layer of protection, preventing the ripples caused by the Celestial Cauldrons’ collision from destroying the mind. Otherwise, it would not be a Fusion Cauldron, but rather death.
It was not enough!

Though the Primal Chaos Qi was awesome, he kept feeling like there was something missing, and could not stop all the shockwaves. One after another, shockwaves surged out, causing the large black dog to grunt repeatedly, and bleed from all his apertures.
After Ling Han frowned, he immediately stimulated the life force in the dimensions in his body to help the large black dog.
In the past, he had used this move himself, but this was the first time he had used it to help others.
It was effective!

A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. When the power of living beings surged into the large black dog’s mind, a wall of life was immediately built, blocking all the shockwaves. However, this was also extremely taxing on the power of living beings.
“Hurry!” “Hurry!” “Hurry!”

The large black dog clearly knew this as well, and continued to shatter the Celestial Cauldrons. Kuang, kuang, kuang! One after another, cracks appeared on the Celestial Cauldrons, and then they began to shatter.
Finally, the nine Celestial Cauldrons all shattered, but they varied in size. Some shards were as big as one fifth of the original Celestial Cauldron, while some were only ten thousandth.
At this time, the large black dog was already unable to continue, and Ling Han’s life force was also close to exhaustion.
Fusion Cauldron!
The large black dog ignored everything, and used a larger fragment as the core. Then, he drew all the shards over, and combined them to forge a Celestial Cauldron.

Because the Celestial Cauldron had not been completely shattered, reconstructing it was also filled with great difficulty. The large black dog had to work a little bit harder to fuse the only Celestial Cauldron.

However, when the Nine Cauldrons became one, they would not be able to cultivate a Mystical Power like Ling Han’s Mystical Power, which could absorb attacks. The Celestial Cauldron did not have the mark of the Divine Beasts. This was merely a step forward, and increased in
power.
Of course, this step was large enough to allow the large black dog to possess the battle prowess of a one or even two Heavens.
Meanwhile, Ling Han breathed a sigh of relief. Next, it could only depend on the large black dog.
He felt like his whole person was about to collapse, and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower also seemed to have something taken away from it, needing a considerable amount of
time to recover.

After all, this was helping another create a Fusion Cauldron. Even the Imperial Clan would only be able to nurture one or two such prodigies in each generation. Thus, it was not surprising that this would expend a lot of energy.
Ling Han rested for two days, recovering to his prime condition.

The large black dog was still in deep seclusion. By the looks of it, he still needed some time before he could successfully createthe Celestial Cauldron. Ling Han pondered for a moment, but still didn’t act on his own volition. Instead, he remained by the large black dog’s side as a
protector.

He wasn’t idle, either. He had been cultivating all this while. He had already cultivated to the end of the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, and was just a little bit away from advancing into the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier. However, he was just that little
bit away.

Ling Han knew that this was because his cultivation level had increased too quickly, and required a certain amount of time to accumulate. Thus, he was not in a rush, and merely stabilized his foundations. The more solid his foundations were, the higher he would reach when he definitely broke through.
“At present, merely in terms of raw power, I have reached Tenth Heaven. The majority of Core Formation Tier elites would not be able to withstand a single punch from me.”
“However, if I encounter those guys ranked in the top ten, merely the suppression of the Primal Chaos Celestial Core would not be enough for me to win. I would have to use the
murderous aura to barrage them.”

The barrage of murderous aura now was too terrifying. It couldn’t be helped. Who asked Ling Han’s soul strength to advance into the Spiritual Transformation Tier? If it weren’t for the fact that the Core Formation Tier was still unqualified to come into contact with the Regulations of heaven and earth, with the strength of his soul, it was possible that he could even kill the True Self Tier.
After dragging on for half a month, the large black dog finally succeeded.
It severed the internal demon in its heart, and successfully cultivated the only Celestial
Cauldron.
“Little Han, Grandpa Dog has succeeded!” the large black dog shouted in excitement.
With its current accomplishments, it was not the slightest bit inferior to an Imperial Son or
Imperial Daughter.
Ling Han was also very happy. The large black dog had succeeded, which meant that this path could be taken. The empress, Hu Niu and the others could all create the Fusion Cauldron.
This was too awesome!
“Let’s go and investigate the situation.”
Ling Han set off again, entering into the Imperial Capital. This time, it was bustling with
noise and excitement.

Close to twenty days had passed, and the great formation of Ziming Mountain had further weakened. Not only could the Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators enter, even the Core Formation Tier cultivators were no longer restricted.

Thus, large amounts of Core Formation Tier cultivators and Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators surged in. Because the humans and Demon Race cultivators here were absolutely hostile toward each other, the humans and Demon Race cultivators that entered each went their own
way.

And it was precisely at this moment that Bai Xiangming, the nation leader of the Galewind Nation, threw out the legend of opening the sky, and guaranteed that as long as the Demon Race was eliminated, every subject that had performed meritorious service could try and see if they could pick up the Sky Opening Axe.

He also said that there was a secret hidden in the Sky Opening Axe, regarding the inheritance of a supreme elite, but only those who could hold the axe would be able to see clearly. Because of this guarantee, everyone was eager to give it a try, wanting to cooperate with the Galewind Nation to eliminate all the Demon Race elites.

chapters.title: Chapter 4033: Taking advantage of the chaos
paragraphs: Ling Han returned, and told the large black dog what he had found out.
“What are we going to do?” the large black dog asked. “Could it be that we sneak our ways into the army that’s going to battle?”
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “I keep feeling that Divine Rain Venerate wouldn’t do such a thing out of boredom.”
“That’s right. He can snatch whatever girl he likes,” the large black dog expressed his full agreement, “Even if he can’t snatch her, he can still steal some underpants!”
Ling Han shot out a kick, “Only a despicable dog like you would do that!”

He retracted his foot, and said, “Firstly, to reject an elite like Divine Rain Venerate would require extraordinary courage. Even if that Miss Bai is extremely loyal to her beloved, how could her lover be like this as well? Would her clan be so stubborn?”
“That’s right!” The large black dog clapped his paws, “That is a Venerate Tier elite, and in fact, he even has the secret of the Emperor’s inheritance!”
This kind of temptation was something that even a Holy Land would not be able to resist. They would be willing to gift a Holy Daughter in exchange, right?

“So, there’s a problem with the Bai Clan’s resolute refusal.” Ling Han pondered for a moment, then said, “Don’t forget, all of this originates from the Bai Clan’s records. And if you were asked to write your own biography, would you beautify yourself?”
“That’s for sure. Who doesn’t want to be worshipped for all eternity, but rather be notorious for all eternity?” The large black dog nodded.

“Heh, as for you? Whether you beautify it or not has only one result. You’re destined to be infamous for ten thousand years.” Ling Han struck a blow at the large black dog, then continued, “So, what we’re seeing now is only one side of the story from the Bai Clan. As for the truth, that may not be the case.”
“Then what do you mean?” the large black dog asked.
Ling Han smiled, “Let’s go and take a look at the Demon Race.”
“Great! Now, Grandpa Dog doesn’t need to hide anymore. Instead, you’re going to become Grandpa Dog’s human pet!” The large black dog was instantly amused. “Come, call me master dog.”
“Get lost!”
Ling Han and the large black dog set off. The large black dog was naturally his original form, and Ling Han was also his original form. He only had to say that he had taken human form.
-The Imperial Family had a “Demonic Mirror”, and the Demon Race also had a “Human Mirror”?
They had not walked for too long, when they saw a majestic group of people, all of them human.

“Yi, they’re moving so fast, they’re already mobilized?” Ling Han activated his Eye Technique. With a glance, he discovered a great many elites, mainly those in the Cauldron Forging Tier and the Core Formation Tier. There were also a considerable number of Foundation Building Tiers, but there were not many True Self Tier elites, only two.
A killing intent suddenly appeared in his eyes.
Fu Huoyang.
He actually saw that heir of the Imperial Clan, Fu Huoyang. Even if there were True Self Tier elites standing guard here, Fu Huoyang was still extremely arrogant, putting on airs.
Hehe, he was merely a member of a side branch of the Imperial Clan. What was so impressive about that?
It was not just Fu Huoyang. There was also Lu Qi, Feng Jixing, and so on. There was really quite a number of top-notch prodigies.

Ling Han felt an urge to charge over and kill Fu Huoyang and the others, but when he thought about how there were two True Self Tier elites here, it would be too difficult to kill someone right in front of their eyes.
Thus, Ling Han forcefully suppressed this urge.
“Little Han, what do you plan to do?” the large black dog approached and asked.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Let’s follow them. Aren’t they going to start a war with the Demon Race? At that time, we can just kill those guys, and treat it as a greeting gift to the Demon Race.”
“Alright.” The large black dog was in high spirits. He loved screwing others over.
The man and dog followed this group, advancing very quickly. Thus, in just half a day’s time, they had arrived in front of a great mountain.

“This is the territory of the Blue Demon Tiger King,” someone introduced. “The Blue Demon Tiger King is a Demonic King of the True Self Tier. Though there is only one True Self Tier elite here, the battle prowess of the Blue Demon Tiger King is extremely terrifying. It has the ability to fight one against two, or even in fact, against three.”

“Of course, the commander-in-chief, the Sea City King and the Solemn Heavenly King are also well-known figures among True Self Tier elites. If the two Lords join forces, it would be enough to match the Blue Demon Tiger King!”

“Our purpose this time is to destroy all the Demon Race elites under the True Self Tier. Merely the Blue Demon Tiger King alone would not be able to cause much damage, and there would eventually come a day when it would die of old age.”

This strategy was very good. With a large population, only would it be able to ensure that a race’s prosperity would not decline. Otherwise, so what if it was the descendant of someone as strong as a Great Emperor? Even Brother Monkey had been suppressed by a Venerate Tier
force!
“All right, we will begin our attacks. If we encounter enemies, there is no need to show mercy, and not a single one will be spared!”
After a round of pre-battle mobilization, this army began to charge.

On the other side, the Blue Demon Tiger King was already prepared. When the expedition army rushed out for more than ten miles, a large number of Demonic Beasts suddenly appeared on the mountain, greeting the army below them, and birds appeared in the skies, launching a surprise attack.

“Aerial team, move out!” Qian Lang was one of the commanders-in-chief. His expression was calm, and with a wave of his hand, multiple cultivators flew on their respective weapons, launching an offensive against those birds in the skies.
“Little Han, should we make a move now?” The large black dog rubbed his paws together, eager to give it a try.

It had just successfully created the Fusion Cauldron, and its battle prowess had soared into the Core Formation Tier. It was presently impatient to test out its own strength. “Wait,” Ling Han said with a shake of his head. “We’ll act after the commander-in-chief arrives and makes his move.”
Ling Han didn’t want to be targeted by those two True Self Tier cultivators.
“All right.” The large black dog nodded. In this kind of situation, he naturally could not allow
his temper free rein.
“Insolent human, you actually dare to violate my authority!” With a loud roar, an incredibly burly man leaped into the air. However, though he had a human body, he retained a thick and
long tail, which was waving back and forth.
The Blue Demon Tiger King!
“Charge!” The Sea City King the Solemn Heavenly King leaped into the air at the same time,
and charged towards the Blue Demon Tiger King.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The three elites exchanged blows, battling fiercely in the skies. One after another, shockwaves rippled out, and shards of Regulations surged out.
This was too terrifying. No one dared to approach, and even those in the Core Formation Tier would have to keep their distance.

This Blue Demon Tiger King’s force naturally had outsiders from the Demon Race as well. They deliberately avoided the humans that had entered here, and instead made a move on the people of the Galewind Nation. On the other side, it was the same for the humans that had come from outside. They only made a move on the native Demonic Beasts, each killing their
own.
“The chance is here!” Ling Han said.
The large black dog’s expression was also filled with excitement. He could finally show his
strength.
“Charge!”
The man and dog also charged out, and quickly separated, each finding their own opponent.
Ling Han changed his appearance and soul fluctuations. Killing a member of the Imperial Clan in public, killing fellow disciples, the implications were too great and too terrible. Thus, it
was better to let someone who did not exist bear the blame.
He quickly cut in, and was already very close to Fu Huoyang.

At this moment, Fu Huoyang was unleashing a massacre on the Demonic Beasts. Although he couldn’t combust his Imperial Bloodline anymore, his battle prowess at the Fifteenth Heaven surged. If it wasn’t a supreme prodigy, how could anyone rival him?
Thus, killing Demonic Beasts was as easy as cutting weeds for him. He was completely
unmatched.
“How dare you, human! You actually dared to kill a member of our Demon Race! I’ll kill you!” Ling Han roared as he charged over.

“Wait,” Ling Han said with a shake of his head.
“We’ll act after the commander-in-chief arrives and makes his move.”
Ling Han didn’t want to be targeted by those two True Self Tier cultivators.
“All right.” The large black dog nodded.
In this kind of situation, he naturally could not allow
his temper free rein.
“Insolent human, you actually dare to violate my authority!” With a loud roar, an incredibly burly man leaped into the air.
However, though he had a human body, he retained a thick and
long tail, which was waving back and forth.
The Blue Demon Tiger King!
“Charge!” The Sea City King the Solemn Heavenly King leaped into the air at the same time,
and charged towards the Blue Demon Tiger King.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The three elites exchanged blows, battling fiercely in the skies.
One after another, shockwaves rippled out, and shards of Regulations surged out.
This was too terrifying.
No one dared to approach, and even those in the Core Formation Tier would have to keep their distance.
This Blue Demon Tiger King’s force naturally had outsiders from the Demon Race as well.
They deliberately avoided the humans that had entered here, and instead made a move on the people of the Galewind Nation.
On the other side, it was the same for the humans that had come from outside.
They only made a move on the native Demonic Beasts, each killing their
own.
“The chance is here!” Ling Han said.
The large black dog’s expression was also filled with excitement.
He could finally show his
strength.
“Charge!”
The man and dog also charged out, and quickly separated, each finding their own opponent.
Ling Han changed his appearance and soul fluctuations.
Killing a member of the Imperial Clan in public, killing fellow disciples, the implications were too great and too terrible.
Thus, it
was better to let someone who did not exist bear the blame.
He quickly cut in, and was already very close to Fu Huoyang.
At this moment, Fu Huoyang was unleashing a massacre on the Demonic Beasts.
Although he couldn’t combust his Imperial Bloodline anymore, his battle prowess at the Fifteenth Heaven surged.
If it wasn’t a supreme prodigy, how could anyone rival him?
Thus, killing Demonic Beasts was as easy as cutting weeds for him.
He was completely
unmatched.
“How dare you, human!
You actually dared to kill a member of our Demon Race!
I’ll kill you!” Ling Han roared as he charged over.

chapters.title: Chapter 4034: Your Grandpa Ding
paragraphs: Not only had Ling Han’s appearance changed, but he even had a tail behind him.
This naturally was imitating the Blue Demon Tiger King, which was equivalent to announcing that he was a member of the Demon Race.

The Demon Race cultivators here had been massacred by Fu Huoyang, and they were already on the verge of collapse. When they saw Ling Han step forward, it was as if they had seen their savior. They all roared loudly, cheering Ling Han on.
Fu Huoyang was slightly surprised. This Demon Race cultivator was clearly not a native of this place, so why had he taken the initiative to provoke him?
They had long since formed a tacit understanding, and that was to kill their own targets, and not interfere with each other.
This was very normal. A great many people had powerful backgrounds. Could it be that they would have to fight to the death for the sake of the natives of this small Mystery Realm?

If it weren’t for the sake of obtaining the Sky Opening Axe as soon as possible, they wouldn’t have needed to make a move at all. As long as they waited until the True Self Tier elite or even the Spirit Transformation Tier elite entered this space, would the natives still have the right to speak?
But this member of the Demon Race actually dared to trifle with him!
Are you blind? Don’t you know that I am Fu Huoyang from the Imperial Clan?

“You’re seeking death!” Fu Huoyang was a member of the Imperial Clan, so how arrogant and domineering was he? It had always been him who trifled with others, so how could he allow others to bully him?
‘It doesn’t matter whether you’re truly stupid or just pretending to be stupid. Just die!’
Boom, his palm struck out, its might soaring to the heavens.
Ling Han smiled slightly, and casually used a Venerate Tier-level Technique, clashing with Fu Huoyang.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

The two of them exchanged blows, but the gap in battle prowess was too wide. Naturally, it was Ling Han who was forced into continuous retreat, but the Primal Chaos Celestial Core showed its might, easily dispersing the power that was assailing him, so it naturally could not wound him in the slightest.
“Yi!” Fu Huoyang wasn’t stupid, and he immediately came to a realization.
The other’s abilities were clearly far inferior to his, but the force of his attack did not cause any damage at all. What did this mean?
This guy could absorb power attacks!

He had only seen this kind of Mystical Power on one person, and this kind of Mystical Power was too unique. He did not believe that he would be able to encounter any random person that also had this power.
Thus, there was only one truth.
This member of the Demon Race was that person, the guy who had caused him great humiliation.
“Ding Yi!” Fu Huoyang roared through gritted teeth. “So it’s you!”

“Haha, it’s your Grandpa Ding!” Ling Han laughed loudly. Since he had been recognized, there was nothing for him to hide. Shua, a murderous aura burst out, and Fu Huoyang instantly grabbed his head and screamed.
The barrage of this murderous aura was too terrifying. It could be considered Ling Han’s strongest killing move.
He took advantage of the opening to charge over, and shot out a punch.

However, Fu Huoyang was a prodigy of the Imperial Clan, after all. Moreover, he had also entered into the Netherworld and obtained many benefits. The strength of his soul had advanced into the True Self Tier, and his willpower was also extremely tenacious. In the end, he still managed to catch his breath.
“Damn it!” He shot out a punch, greeting Ling Han’s attack.
Peng!
However, the result of this punch was that he was sent flying. He was completely no match for Ling Han.
Under the barrage of murderous aura, it was already good enough that he could fight back. How much battle prowess did he want to keep?
“Impressive!”
“Formidable!”
“Brave warrior!”
When the Demon Race saw this, they immediately cheered Ling Han on.

Fu Huoyang was beside himself with rage, and he wanted nothing more than to tear Ling Han into pieces. However, during the “spar” at the Donglin Imperial Clan, he had been inferior to Ling Han. Even after combusting his Imperial Bloodline to raise his battle prowess by 10 Heavens, he had still been brutally pummeled by Ling Han.
Now, how could he possibly be a match for Ling Han?
Let’s go!

He made a prompt decision, and immediately turned to flee. There was no need for him to fight head-on with Ling Han now. When he advanced into the True Self Tier, he would use the advantage of a major tier to kill Ling Han.
Ling Han smirked coldly. Since he had already made his move, how could he allow you to
escape?
Primal Chaos Divine Lightning!
Zi, a bolt of lightning shot out. It had not even reached him, when Fu Huoyang’s figure suddenly paused, as if he had become stupid.
He had fallen into an illusion.

Though the black light of illusion was intertwined with the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, it itself was effective on divine sense. It could reach its target as long as it was within the rangen of attack.
Thus, before the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning had even struck him, the black light of illusion ha I already affected Fu Huoyang’s mind.
However, the speed at which the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning was sent flying was also extraordinarily fast. Just as Fu Huoyang was startled, the divine lightning had already struck
him.
Zi, lightning flashed, and a charred hole had already appeared in Fu Huoyang’s chest.
However, after sustaining such a heavy blow, Fu Huoyang finally came back to his senses from the illusion. At this moment, Ling Han also charged over with a punch, his killing intent
blazing.
Fu Huoyang was astonished. He had never seen Ling Han use this move before.
Was this a new ultimate technique that this person had obtained, or was this person hiding his strength, and had not used it all this while?
However, how could he have the time to mull over this at this moment? He hurriedly launched an attack, greeting Ling Han’s attack. Otherwise, his only fate would be death.
Peng!
In this exchange of blows, Fu Huoyang was once again sent flying. He was completely outmatched by Ling Han.

This was natural. He had been suppressed in battle prowess by three Heavens, and his chest had also been severely wounded. At most, he could only unleash battle prowess on par with eleven Heavens. And what about Ling Han? His base power was as high as Tenth Heaven. If he used any Saint Technique, he would be able to overwhelm him in terms of battle prowess.
Ling Han caught up to him, unleashing a barrage of deadly attacks.
Fu Huoyang was both furious and shocked, yet he could only take the beating passively.

Previously, in that “spar”, though he had not ignited all his Imperial Blood, there was not much left. It was far from enough to allow him to reignite it. Thus, he was really at his wit’s end now. He did not have any trump card that he could use at all.
He could only suffer a beating. Under a series of attacks, he screamed repeatedly.
What made him even more depressed was the fact that though every strike from Ling Han was
heavy, it was not fatal.
-If it was a little heavier, and threatened his life, the treasure in his possession would show
its might, and teleport him away.
This guy must have done it on purpose.
Fu Huoyang shouted in fury. As a member of the Imperial Clan, he was actually being toyed with like this. What justice was there left in this world?
Peng!

Finally, Ling Han’s punch landed. This power was a little heavy, and directly threatened Fu Huoyang’s life. Instantly, a ray of light wrapped around him. Xiu! Then, he disappeared. The treasure unleashed its might, saving him from death. It even allowed him to travel millions and millions of kilometers to ensure that he was safe enough.
However, could he really succeed?
Ling Han was now a Formations Grandmaster, and keenly discovered that in truth, as that
light surged, it had also extracted Qi from the ley lines, borrowing the power to send Fu
Huoyang away.
Hehe, so this was the principle of the Ten Thousand Escape Talisman.
Ling Han stood quietly, and spread out his divine sense, entering into the ley lines.
There were pitifully few ley lines in this Mystery Realm, and there were only a dozen over.
Thus, it was a very simple matter to investigate.
Found it.
A smile spread across Ling Han’s face. Xiu! He instantly disappeared as well.
It was unknown whether it was his luck or Fu Huoyang’s misfortune, but there just happened
to be a ley line here, so he didn’t need to move to another place.
On the other side.
With a flash, Fu Huoyang was teleported out through the ley lines. At this moment, he was at
least tens of thousands of miles away from the battlefield, so it was naturally impossible for
Ling Han to find him.
He touched the necklace around his neck. It was this thing that had saved his life, and he could activate it a total of seven more times.
The background of the Imperial Clan was indeed astonishing. Their life-saving trump card
could actually be used so many times.
He would heal his injuries first, and then make plans.
However, before he could even take out his medicine, a figure flashed before him, and a
person appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 4035: Killing Fu Huoyang
paragraphs: Ling, Ling Han!
At this moment, Fu Huoyang was completely stupefied.
What was going on?
‘I was teleported here, so how did you follow me out as well?’
Even if you have the means to travel ten thousand miles, with such a large area, how did you know that I was here?
“How could it possibly be you!” Fu Huoyang exclaimed in shock. He had really gotten a scare. Ling Han cracked a smile, “Why can’t it be me? You can run, but I am not allowed to chase?”
‘This isn’t a question of running or chasing. Rather, it’s a question of how you can possibly catch up to me!’
Fu Huoyang naturally didn’t believe that Ling Han would be so lucky and just happened to catch him in the path of escape. Without another word, he broke into a run and fled.
Ling Han caught up to him, unleashing his full battle prowess as he launched an attack at Fu Huoyang.
Fu Huoyang parried, but his injuries had not been treated. As time passed, they were still worsening. This caused his battle prowess to fall further, so how could he possibly be a match for Ling Han?

In just a few moves, he was “killed” again. A ray of light swept past, sending him away again. “Where did you go this time?” Ling Han murmured. His divine sense spread out, and he followed the ley lines to search for Fu Huoyang.
“Found it.”
Xiu, he also followed the ley lines. With a flash, he too quickly disappeared.
On the other side, Fu Huoyang immediately broke into a run as soon as the teleportation ended. He didn’t know if Ling Han would chase after him, but he didn’t dare to take the risk.
However, he had only run a short distance, when he saw a figure appear out of thin air behind him.
Ling Han!
As expected, this guy had come again.

“Fu Huoyang, why are you running?” Ling Han asked as he pursued Fu Huoyang. With Fu Huoyang’s current state, how much of his speed could he unleash? Ling Han caught up to him in just two or three steps.
Subsequently, it was naturally another violent beating.
Needless to say, Fu Huoyang was “killed” again in just a few moments. With a flash of white light, he once again disappeared without a trace.

“Even if you have a hundred chances to escape, I will still continue to pursue you, right until I send you on your way to the afterlife!” Ling Han murmured. This time, there was absolutely no way he would let the other go.
Fu Huoyang finished the teleportation, and this time, he didn’t run again.
A prodigy like him naturally had no lack of decisiveness. He knew that there was no way he could escape. Thus, the most effective method was not to flee, but to counterattack with all his might.
He waited for Ling Han to appear. Once Ling Han appeared, he would launch a powerful attack.
-Having just come out of the teleportation, Ling Han would definitely be careless, and this was the best chance for him to attack.
If he could kill Ling Han, then not only would he be able to solve the problem of being hunted down, he would also be able to get his revenge completely.
Xiu, after a while, Ling Han appeared as expected.
“Die!” Fu Huoyang roared. He unleashed his full power as he launched an attack at Ling Han.
In this strike, he had really gone all out. With what little power he had left, he shot out the Imperial Technique, swearing that he would kill Ling Han with a single strike.
However, how could Ling Han not be on guard?
Peng!
When this attack arrived, it did not even manage to penetrate the defenses of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. It was blocked by the air of Primal Chaos.

“What?!” Fu Huoyang’s expression was filled with disbelief. He had used the Imperial Technique to attack Ling Han, catching him completely off guard. Yet, he hadn’t even managed to penetrate Ling Han’s defenses?
“Fu Huoyang, no matter how many times you flee, you’ll still die!” Ling Han said calmly. He was already determined to kill Fu Huoyang.
Fu Huoyang gritted his teeth, and said, “Who are you? Who exactly are you!”
“I’m your uncle,” Ling Han said with a smile, completely having no intention of revealing his identity.

Fu Huoyang fought as he retreated, “I know that Ding Yi is definitely not your true identity. What is it? Are you afraid to show yourself? Your true identity is very lowly, and you are the son of a prostitute?”
He was naturally trying to deliberately enrage Ling Han, wanting to worm out Ling Han’s true identity.
However, how could Ling Han fall for it? He simply increased the speed of his punches.
After a few punches, Fu Huoyang was “killed” again.

Again and again. Fu Huoyang’s expression became uglier and uglier. He was only left with one last chance to teleport. If he was “killed” by Ling Han again, he couldn’t die again. Otherwise, he would be consigned to eternal damnation.

“Ding Yi, there’s actually no great enmity between us.” He switched to a gentle strategy, and played the sympathy card, “Why don’t we turn from enemies into friends? I am the prodigy of the Imperial Clan. If you have a friend like me, it would be greatly beneficial for you.”

Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, saying, “Fu Huoyang, is this your first day out? You’re actually saying such childish things? Since you’ve planted your own cause, even if you die, you have to straighten your back and endure the consequences!”
No kidding, he didn’t want to die.
Fu Huoyang roared in fury, “No, I am the prodigy of the Imperial Clan. I will definitely become a Saint in future, and cannot die!”
“No one can’t die, what more trash like you.” Ling Han said calmly, “If you become a Saint, wouldn’t that be the misfortune of heaven and earth?”
Peng!
He threw another punch, and Fu Huoyang was sent on his way again. This was another
teleportation.
“How many more times can you teleport?” Ling Han searched the ley lines, and soon located
Fu Huoyang. With a flash, he immediately set off in pursuit.
This time, Fu Huoyang was completely flustered.
He no longer had a trump card, and could no longer save his life.
Ling Han knew what he was doing with a single glance, and said, “Looks like your life-saving technique has been used up.”
Fu Huoyang clenched his fists. He would never have dreamed that he would be forced to this
extent by Ling Han.
He had a total of seven life-saving chances, and Ling Han had actually caught up to him every time. Not a single time had he managed to successfully escape.
What could he do? What could he do?
Thoughts flashed through his mind like lightning, yet he couldn’t think of any strategy.
At this moment, Fu Huoyang felt extreme despair and regret.
He naturally didn’t regret refining the Ten Thousand Spirit Blood Pill. Nor did he regret being
so overbearing toward Ling Han. Rather, he regretted not killing Ling Han while he was still
weak.

It couldn’t be helped. He knew that he was the heir of the Imperial Clan, and his cultivation level far surpassed Ling Han. Even in his dreams, he would never have imagined that there would come a day when he would actually be forced into desperate straits by Ling Han.

“Your uncle will always be your uncle!” Ling Han had already charged over, and once again used the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning. As the attack landed, another hole appeared in Fu Huoyang’s chest. This time, it was in his heart.
Fu Huoyang roared loudly, and began to combust his Celestial Core. He was going to take the
final gamble.
“Die!” Ling Han launched another attack, and amidst the barrage of murderous aura, Fu
Huoyang’s action of burning the Celestial Core suddenly came to an abrupt stop. Then, he collapsed onto the ground, his vitality rapidly dissipating.

Ling Han didn’t feel a shred of sympathy. Fu Huoyang had sought death on his own; he actually wanted to use the blood of millions of living beings to concoct the Ten Thousand Spirit Blood Pill. Just for this, this guy deserved to die.
He grabbed Fu Huoyang’s corpse, and with a flash, he had already returned to the battlefield.
However, the battle had already ended.
“Little Han!” The large black dog ran over, “How is it?”
“I killed one.” Ling Han nodded.
“The one surnamed Fu?”
“M-hm.”
“All right!” The large black dog appeared very excited, “Grandpa Dog has already formed
relations with that great tiger. Let’s go.”
