Ling Han caught up to him in just two or three steps.
Subsequently, it was naturally another violent beating.
Needless to say, Fu Huoyang was “killed” again in just a few moments.
With a flash of white light, he once again disappeared without a trace.
“Even if you have a hundred chances to escape, I will still continue to pursue you, right until I send you on your way to the afterlife!” Ling Han murmured.
This time, there was absolutely no way he would let the other go.
Fu Huoyang finished the teleportation, and this time, he didn’t run again.
A prodigy like him naturally had no lack of decisiveness.
He knew that there was no way he could escape.
Thus, the most effective method was not to flee, but to counterattack with all his might.
He waited for Ling Han to appear.
Once Ling Han appeared, he would launch a powerful attack.
-Having just come out of the teleportation, Ling Han would definitely be careless, and this was the best chance for him to attack.
If he could kill Ling Han, then not only would he be able to solve the problem of being hunted down, he would also be able to get his revenge completely.
Xiu, after a while, Ling Han appeared as expected.
“Die!” Fu Huoyang roared.
He unleashed his full power as he launched an attack at Ling Han.
In this strike, he had really gone all out.
With what little power he had left, he shot out the Imperial Technique, swearing that he would kill Ling Han with a single strike.
However, how could Ling Han not be on guard?
Peng!
When this attack arrived, it did not even manage to penetrate the defenses of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
It was blocked by the air of Primal Chaos.
“What?!” Fu Huoyang’s expression was filled with disbelief.
He had used the Imperial Technique to attack Ling Han, catching him completely off guard.
Yet, he hadn’t even managed to penetrate Ling Han’s defenses?
“Fu Huoyang, no matter how many times you flee, you’ll still die!” Ling Han said calmly.
He was already determined to kill Fu Huoyang.
Fu Huoyang gritted his teeth, and said, “Who are you?
Who exactly are you!”
“I’m your uncle,” Ling Han said with a smile, completely having no intention of revealing his identity.
Fu Huoyang fought as he retreated, “I know that Ding Yi is definitely not your true identity.
What is it?
Are you afraid to show yourself?
Your true identity is very lowly, and you are the son of a prostitute?”
He was naturally trying to deliberately enrage Ling Han, wanting to worm out Ling Han’s true identity.
However, how could Ling Han fall for it?
He simply increased the speed of his punches.
After a few punches, Fu Huoyang was “killed” again.
Again and again.
Fu Huoyang’s expression became uglier and uglier.
He was only left with one last chance to teleport.
If he was “killed” by Ling Han again, he couldn’t die again.
Otherwise, he would be consigned to eternal damnation.
“Ding Yi, there’s actually no great enmity between us.” He switched to a gentle strategy, and played the sympathy card, “Why don’t we turn from enemies into friends?
I am the prodigy of the Imperial Clan.
If you have a friend like me, it would be greatly beneficial for you.”
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, saying, “Fu Huoyang, is this your first day out?
You’re actually saying such childish things?
Since you’ve planted your own cause, even if you die, you have to straighten your back and endure the consequences!”
No kidding, he didn’t want to die.
Fu Huoyang roared in fury, “No, I am the prodigy of the Imperial Clan.
I will definitely become a Saint in future, and cannot die!”
“No one can’t die, what more trash like you.” Ling Han said calmly, “If you become a Saint, wouldn’t that be the misfortune of heaven and earth?”
Peng!
He threw another punch, and Fu Huoyang was sent on his way again.
This was another
teleportation.
“How many more times can you teleport?” Ling Han searched the ley lines, and soon located
Fu Huoyang.
With a flash, he immediately set off in pursuit.
This time, Fu Huoyang was completely flustered.
He no longer had a trump card, and could no longer save his life.
Ling Han knew what he was doing with a single glance, and said, “Looks like your life-saving technique has been used up.”
Fu Huoyang clenched his fists.
He would never have dreamed that he would be forced to this
extent by Ling Han.
He had a total of seven life-saving chances, and Ling Han had actually caught up to him every time.
Not a single time had he managed to successfully escape.
What could he do?
What could he do?
Thoughts flashed through his mind like lightning, yet he couldn’t think of any strategy.
At this moment, Fu Huoyang felt extreme despair and regret.
He naturally didn’t regret refining the Ten Thousand Spirit Blood Pill.
Nor did he regret being
so overbearing toward Ling Han.
Rather, he regretted not killing Ling Han while he was still
weak.
It couldn’t be helped.
He knew that he was the heir of the Imperial Clan, and his cultivation level far surpassed Ling Han.
Even in his dreams, he would never have imagined that there would come a day when he would actually be forced into desperate straits by Ling Han.
“Your uncle will always be your uncle!” Ling Han had already charged over, and once again used the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning.
As the attack landed, another hole appeared in Fu Huoyang’s chest.
This time, it was in his heart.
Fu Huoyang roared loudly, and began to combust his Celestial Core.
He was going to take the
final gamble.
“Die!” Ling Han launched another attack, and amidst the barrage of murderous aura, Fu
Huoyang’s action of burning the Celestial Core suddenly came to an abrupt stop.
Then, he collapsed onto the ground, his vitality rapidly dissipating.
Ling Han didn’t feel a shred of sympathy.
Fu Huoyang had sought death on his own; he actually wanted to use the blood of millions of living beings to concoct the Ten Thousand Spirit Blood Pill.
Just for this, this guy deserved to die.
He grabbed Fu Huoyang’s corpse, and with a flash, he had already returned to the battlefield.
However, the battle had already ended.
“Little Han!” The large black dog ran over, “How is it?”
“I killed one.” Ling Han nodded.
“The one surnamed Fu?”
“M-hm.”
“All right!” The large black dog appeared very excited, “Grandpa Dog has already formed
relations with that great tiger.
Let’s go.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4036: The base of the Demon Race
paragraphs: Ling Han and the large black dog walked into the mountains, while the large black dog talked about the battle situation after Ling Han left.
It was very tragic, with many people and Demonic Beasts dying. However, most of them were natives of this place, and not many outsiders had died.
Precisely because both sides had suffered heavy losses, the generals on both sides called for a retreat.
“Grandpa Dog!”
“Grandpa Dog!”
When they entered into the camp of the Tiger King, they saw that there were minor demons calling out to the large black dog along the way, looking like they were trying to curry his favour.
“Yi, you seem to be doing quite well?” Ling Han found this a little strange.
“Of course,” the large black dog said proudly. “Grandpa Dog almost became sworn brothers with that tiger. How can these lackeys not flatter Grandpa Dog?”

Ling Han clicked his tongue. He hadn’t spent much time hunting down Fu Huoyang, yet the large black dog had already developed such a strong “friendship” with the Tiger King. This was truly impressive.
“How did you, er, lie to the tiger?” he asked, smiling.
“What lie!” The large black dog’s expression was filled with righteousness, “Grandpa Dog only shared his views on underpants with him.”
Ling Han was instantly speechless. This damn dog was really too indecent.

This was the territory of the Demonic Beasts, and the Demonic Beasts’ aesthetic tastes were naturally completely different from humans’. The buildings here were all built of stone, and there was no beauty to be seen at all, but it was really rugged.

“Brother Black!” They had not even walked to the largest stone house, when they saw the Blue Demon Tiger King come out to receive them, his face all smiles, “Come, come, come. I’ve been waiting for you for a long time.”
“Brother Tiger!” The large black dog nodded, his face full of smiles, looking extremely despicable.
Ling Han couldn’t bear to watch, and turned his head away.

They entered into this stone house. Actually, this should be considered a great hall. It was very wide and tall inside, and there were multiple stones placed there. They could be considered stools, and most of them were occupied.
Ling Han swept an eye over them, and already knew what was going on. These were basically the members of the Demon Race from the outsiders.
“Ling Han!”
Seeing Ling Han enter, a considerable number of Demon Race elites immediately stood up, revealing covetous expressions.

Even the Imperial Son had been defeated, which caused Ling Han to become completely popular. As long as they were prodigy-level, most of them had seen Ling Han’s appearance before. This was an opponent that they had to be extremely wary of.

Now, everyone was clearly separated. The Human Race was on the side of the Galewind Nation, while the Demon Race was on the other side. Yet, you, a mere human, had come here. What was the meaning of this?
“Yi, you are a human?” The Blue Demon Tiger King asked, his voice booming, bringing with it endless might.
The large black dog hurriedly said, “Brother Tiger, don’t be anxious. My brother is a human with a beast in his heart. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have become his best friend.”

“Humph, those who are not of our race must have ulterior motives!” A Demon Race member declared coldly. He had a pair of goat horns on his head. This was obviously a deliberate manifestation, showing that he was a member of the Demon Race.

The large black dog immediately retorted, and said, “Hehe, speaking of non-humans, it seems like you’re not a member of the Tiger Race either, right? Grandpa Dog doesn’t think that you look to have a very righteous heart either! Moreover, you should be a member of the Goat Race, and your race have been devoured quite a bit by the Tiger Race. You must be displeased with Brother Tiger!”
That Demon Race cultivator was so infuriated that the corners of his mouth twitched. He was a member of the Iron Goat Race. This race was born powerful, so how could they be eaten by a tiger?
“Bullsh*t, our Iron Goat Tribe has produced a Demonic Saint before, what elite of the Tiger Race have we not killed before?” he couldn’t help but retort.
However, as soon as the words left his mouth, he knew that he was done for.
“Humph, you’ve even killed a tiger before?” The Blue Demon Tiger King glared over, its eyes filled with might, exuding a powerful killing intent.
“No! No!” That member of the Iron Goat Race said, “That is a matter of my ancestors, and has nothing to do with me.”

“Little lamb, don’t you know what a father’s debt is repaid by his son?” the large black dog said calmly. “Brother Tiger, I think this guy doesn’t look like a good person at first glance. With such a protruding back of his head, he must be rebellious!”
That Iron Goat Race member really wanted to come up and fight the large black dog to the death. ‘Do I have any enmity with you? Is there any need to smear my name so harshly?’
The Blue Demon Tiger King did not respond at the first instant, but rather looked coldly at the Iron Goat Race member.

“Hehe, everyone calm down!” A tall, slender man stood up, and waved his hand at the Blue Demon Tiger King and Iron Goat Race member. “In the end, we are all members of the Demon Race, and are all descendants of the primitive Divine Beasts, so we can be considered a family. However, this human is a different story!”
He pointed at Ling Han, and changed the topic.

The Iron Goat Race member thought that this was right. His original intention for stepping out was to reveal Ling Han’s identity as a human. At the very least, he wanted to chase Ling Han away. Why had the large black dog changed the topic, dragging himself into the matter? Meanwhile, Ling Han said to the Blue Demon Tiger King, “Lord Tiger King, may I speak with you in private?”
The Blue Demon Tiger King glanced at him, and nodded slowly, “All right.”

He was at the True Self Tier, and his strength was also formidable. If he exchanged blows with a cultivator of the same cultivation level, one of him could match two of them. Thus, he was completely unafraid that Ling Han would play any tricks.
The two of them arrived at a secluded place. Ling Han took out Fu Huoyang’s corpse, tossed it onto the ground, and said, “Milord, can this prove my sincerity?”

The eyes of the Blue Demon Tiger King immediately lit up. Though he had not taken Fu Huoyang seriously, he had seen how Fu Huoyang had gone on a killing spree, and slaughtered a considerable number of his subordinates. His abilities were definitely extraordinary.
“I trust you!” He nodded, a smile appearing on his face.
“However, this person’s identity is extraordinary. Please keep it a secret for me, Lord,” Ling
Han said.
“All right.” The Blue Demon Tiger King nodded.

They returned to the stone house, and the Blue Demon Tiger King immediately announced, “From this moment onwards, no one is allowed to speak of Ling Han’s human identity again. If you speak of this again, don’t blame me for taking actions!”
This caused all the Demon Race elites to feel surprised. Just what had Ling Han said to the Blue Demon Tiger King that he had managed to convince him so quickly?
“Tiger King, when are we going to attack the Imperial Capital of the Human Race?” someone
asked.
The Blue Demon Tiger King pondered for a moment, “This is extremely difficult!”
“If we join forces with the other Demonic Beasts, how could it be that we won’t be able to conquer the human race?” another person asked.

The Blue Demon Tiger King shook his head slowly, “The human race has deep roots, and is not as weak as we think! Us great Demon Kings, as well as our ancestors, have tried to conquer the Imperial Capital of the human race, generation after generation, and all ended in failure.” Everyone exchanged looks. According to their understanding, there were at most ten True Self Tier elites in the human race, and in the case of the Demon Race, not only were there even more True Self Tier elites, but their battle prowess was also terrifying. One of them was equivalent to two of them, so how could they not be able to break through the defenses of the
human race?

“Humans have a powerful weapon that will unleash its might at the most critical moment.” The Azure Demon Tiger King shook its head, “My father was severely wounded by that powerful weapon, and died when he was only two thousand years old.”
What kind of deadly weapon was so awesome?
Was this a treasure that had been left behind by Divine Rain Venerate?
Everyone’s eyes lit up. They had finally found out a sliver of the secret of Divine Rain
Venerate’s inheritance.
However, the Blue Demon Tiger King stopped here, and did not continue this topic. He even
told everyone to go and rest.
With this shooing order, everyone naturally could only leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 4037: Shi Yuan
paragraphs: Ling Han communicated with the large black dog through divine sense, telling it to probe again. With how despicable the large black dog was, it should be able to discover a lot of secrets that others didn’t know.
The large black dog nodded and left, calling out, “Brother Tiger, wait for me.”
Ling Han crossed his arms behind his back, planning to walk around. Was there any Celestial medicine in this mountain?
Now that he had grasped the ley lines, it was equivalent to having eyes and ears all over this world. The chances of finding Celestial medicine was very high.
“Ling Han!” A voice rang out from behind him.
Ling Han suddenly stopped in his tracks, and turned around to look.
This was a young man. He was tall and sturdy, and there was actually a circle of golden fur around his neck. It was thick and long, making him appear furry.
“I am Shi Yuan,” the man declared proudly.
“None of my business!” Ling Han retorted.
-If the other had spoken politely, he naturally would not mind speaking calmly, but this guy looked like he had come to cause trouble, so what was the point of being polite?
Shi Yuan faltered upon hearing this. He hadn’t expected Ling Han to speak so vulgarly.
He humphed and said, “I’ll only say one thing. I’m from the Western Heavenly Realm!”
“Are you retarded?” Ling Han shrugged, “What business is it of mine where you come from?” T-twice!
Shi Yuan bared his teeth, a cold glint in his eyes.
“Hahaha, this brat is going to be in big trouble. Shi Yuan is one of the few prodigies of the West Heavenly Realm and is ranked 27th on the Galaxy Network.”
“This brat suppressed the Western Heavenly Realm to the point of having lost so much face. He’ll definitely be targeted!”
“Hehe, the North Heavenly Realm wants to step out? The so-called prodigy can only be short-lived.”
There were also some people around, and they all shook their heads. Naturally, they were not the slightest bit optimistic about Ling Han.

Shi Yuan had already calmed down. “Ling Han, you’re far too arrogant! You’ve only defeated a few weaklings, yet you still dare to treat everyone else with such disdain! Today, I’ll let you know that the prodigies of the West Heavenly Realm are people that you can only look up to!”

Ling Han scoffed, and said, “You’re at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, and I’m only at the early stage of the Core Formation Tier. Are you using your advantage in cultivation level to suppress me?”
“I’m the same age as you, so how could it be unfair?” Shi Yuan said. He lashed out with his right hand. Boom! Power condensed, transforming into a gigantic golden claw that slammed down at Ling Han.
Ling Han activated the Imminent Skyline and casually dodged, saying, “No, no, no. You’re at least over fifty. I’m still young!”
When Shi Yuan heard this, he instantly exploded in fury.

He was indeed in his fifties, but no matter where he was, a fifty-year-old Core Formation Tier consummate level martial artist would be incredibly young, a top grade prodigy. Now, he was actually being looked down on by Ling Han, so how could he not be furious?

Even though Ling Han was only in his twenties, the three barriers of the early stage of Core Formation Tier, the middle stage of Core Formation Tier, and the late stage of Core Formation Tier were like a block. When Ling Han reached the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, he would at least be in his forties or fifties.
“Damn it!” he roared in fury. He pounced over, swinging his claws one after another. Innumerable golden threads streaked past, interweaving into a net.

He was indeed strong, with battle prowess as high as 23 Heavens. He was practically comparable to Fu Huoyang, who was burning Imperial Blood, which made Ling Han completely unqualified to match him. He could only use Imminent Skyline to dodge. However, Shi Yuan had also mastered a high-level movement technique. The moment he channeled it, he instantly followed closely behind Ling Han like a shadow.
In this way, Ling Han only had to make the slightest mistake, and he would be hit by Shi Yuan.

Everyone shook their heads. There was no one who would not make a mistake. Then, with the strength of Shi Yuan’s battle prowess, he would be able to kill Ling Han or severely injure him with a single strike.
However, they didn’t care. Firstly, because Ling Han was a human, and secondly, he was from the North Heavenly Realm, so who cares.
“You really have no end!” Ling Han said coldly. The other party didn’t know what was good for him, which angered him as well.

“Haha, you can only talk tough for a while.” Shi Yuan’s confidence had completely returned. It was fine even if he couldn’t win in a verbal battle with Ling Han. In martial arts, strength was what mattered, and not the ability to speak glibly.
“Die!” he roared loudly. Weng, his voice actually took form, turning into the head of a lion, which opened its mouth to bite at Ling Han.
Lion Roar!
Ling Han immediately felt a tremor in his mind, causing boundless waves to rise up, as if his mind was about to be shattered.

Realization dawned on him. Even though Shi Yuan had unleashed this attack with a roar, the lion’s head that he had taken form in was merely a pretense. The true killing move was the divine sense attack. With a roar, it had reached him, and was already wreaking havoc in his
mind.
If anyone believed that the lion’s head was the main force of attack, they would have already been hit.
Ling Han smiled faintly. Launch a divine sense attack on him? Hehe, didn’t he know that the strength of his divine sense had already advanced into the Spirit Transformation Tier?
He focused slightly, and his mind instantly calmed down.
“It’s impolite not to reciprocate. Take a strike from me as well!” Ling Han said. He then roared, unleashing a murderous aura attack.
Weng! Shi Yuan’s body instantly faltered, and then his expression became twisted. He suddenly grabbed his head and screamed in agony.
This!
Everyone was stunned, and even felt that this was unreal.

When it came to divine sense attacks, the Lion Roar of the Lion Race was definitely top-notch. It was said that the Buddhist Race’s Lion Roar Technique had been inspired by the Lion Race. Now, Shi Yuan clearly had the advantage in cultivation level, and was also skilled in divine sense attacks, but not only had he not been able to defeat Ling Han, he had instead been wounded by the latter’s divine sense attack. How could they accept this?
However, Shi Yuan was a prodigy, after all, so it wasn’t long before he dispelled the
murderous aura. However, tears of blood were already streaming from his eyes, and his
expression was terrifyingly twisted.
“Detestable brat!” he spat through gritted teeth. Being defeated by someone in his field of
expertise was truly a terrible feeling.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “You provoked me first, so you’ll have to suffer the consequences of failure!”

“I’m going to kill you!” Shi Yuan roared as he lunged at Ling Han. He unleashed all of his powerful attacks, and the image of a nine-headed lion materialized behind him. It was as if this lion had boosted his power, causing him to become even more ferocious. Ling Han was unafraid. The Primal Chaos Celestial Core was activated, and instantly, an ancient and vicissitude aura of Primal Chaos surged out, causing Shi Yuan’s battle prowess to drop directly by three Heavens.
However, even though he still had 20 Heavens of battle prowess remaining, Shi Yuan was still
able to crush Ling Han.
Ling Han exchanged a blow with the other, and a deep power surged over, instantly sending him flying. He was completely outmatched.
Hiss, he gritted his teeth, and felt a salty taste at the corner of his lips. When he wiped it away,
it was all blood.
Even if he had the Primal Chaos Celestial Core that could neutralize six Heavens of power, he
was still wounded.
It couldn’t be helped. The power gap was a little too wide.
While he was sighing with emotion, he didn’t know that the spectators had all turned green
with fear.
F***, the gap in battle prowess was at least ten Heavens, but Ling Han actually only spat out
a little blood after taking a blow head-on?
Was there anyone like you?
Shi Yuan also faltered upon hearing this.
At first, when he saw Ling Han exchange blows with him, he was filled with pleasant surprise, because he had not thought that Ling Han would “seek his own death” either, but he had
never imagined that the latter would actually be so durable.
How was this possible? This was absolutely impossible! Ling Han cracked a smile, “Nothing is impossible. Come, take this!”
He communicated with the ley lines, stimulating the Earth Qi. Instantly, an earthen-yellow great dragon shot out of the ground by Ling Han’s feet, baring its fangs and brandishing its claws.

With how despicable the large black dog was, it should be able to discover a lot of secrets that others didn’t know.
The large black dog nodded and left, calling out, “Brother Tiger, wait for me.”
Ling Han crossed his arms behind his back, planning to walk around.
Was there any Celestial medicine in this mountain?
Now that he had grasped the ley lines, it was equivalent to having eyes and ears all over this world.
The chances of finding Celestial medicine was very high.
“Ling Han!” A voice rang out from behind him.
Ling Han suddenly stopped in his tracks, and turned around to look.
This was a young man.
He was tall and sturdy, and there was actually a circle of golden fur around his neck.
It was thick and long, making him appear furry.
“I am Shi Yuan,” the man declared proudly.
“None of my business!” Ling Han retorted.
-If the other had spoken politely, he naturally would not mind speaking calmly, but this guy looked like he had come to cause trouble, so what was the point of being polite?
Shi Yuan faltered upon hearing this.
He hadn’t expected Ling Han to speak so vulgarly.
He humphed and said, “I’ll only say one thing.
I’m from the Western Heavenly Realm!”
“Are you retarded?” Ling Han shrugged, “What business is it of mine where you come from?” T-twice!
Shi Yuan bared his teeth, a cold glint in his eyes.
“Hahaha, this brat is going to be in big trouble.
Shi Yuan is one of the few prodigies of the West Heavenly Realm and is ranked 27th on the Galaxy Network.”
“This brat suppressed the Western Heavenly Realm to the point of having lost so much face.
He’ll definitely be targeted!”
“Hehe, the North Heavenly Realm wants to step out?
The so-called prodigy can only be short-lived.”
There were also some people around, and they all shook their heads.
Naturally, they were not the slightest bit optimistic about Ling Han.
Shi Yuan had already calmed down.
“Ling Han, you’re far too arrogant!
You’ve only defeated a few weaklings, yet you still dare to treat everyone else with such disdain!
Today, I’ll let you know that the prodigies of the West Heavenly Realm are people that you can only look up to!”
Ling Han scoffed, and said, “You’re at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, and I’m only at the early stage of the Core Formation Tier.
Are you using your advantage in cultivation level to suppress me?”
“I’m the same age as you, so how could it be unfair?” Shi Yuan said.
He lashed out with his right hand.
Boom!
Power condensed, transforming into a gigantic golden claw that slammed down at Ling Han.
Ling Han activated the Imminent Skyline and casually dodged, saying, “No, no, no.
You’re at least over fifty.
I’m still young!”
When Shi Yuan heard this, he instantly exploded in fury.
He was indeed in his fifties, but no matter where he was, a fifty-year-old Core Formation Tier consummate level martial artist would be incredibly young, a top grade prodigy.
Now, he was actually being looked down on by Ling Han, so how could he not be furious?

Even though Ling Han was only in his twenties, the three barriers of the early stage of Core Formation Tier, the middle stage of Core Formation Tier, and the late stage of Core Formation Tier were like a block.
When Ling Han reached the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, he would at least be in his forties or fifties.
“Damn it!” he roared in fury.
He pounced over, swinging his claws one after another.
Innumerable golden threads streaked past, interweaving into a net.
He was indeed strong, with battle prowess as high as 23 Heavens.
He was practically comparable to Fu Huoyang, who was burning Imperial Blood, which made Ling Han completely unqualified to match him.
He could only use Imminent Skyline to dodge.
However, Shi Yuan had also mastered a high-level movement technique.
The moment he channeled it, he instantly followed closely behind Ling Han like a shadow.
In this way, Ling Han only had to make the slightest mistake, and he would be hit by Shi Yuan.
Everyone shook their heads.
There was no one who would not make a mistake.
Then, with the strength of Shi Yuan’s battle prowess, he would be able to kill Ling Han or severely injure him with a single strike.
However, they didn’t care.
Firstly, because Ling Han was a human, and secondly, he was from the North Heavenly Realm, so who cares.
“You really have no end!” Ling Han said coldly.
The other party didn’t know what was good for him, which angered him as well.
“Haha, you can only talk tough for a while.” Shi Yuan’s confidence had completely returned.
It was fine even if he couldn’t win in a verbal battle with Ling Han.
In martial arts, strength was what mattered, and not the ability to speak glibly.
“Die!” he roared loudly.
Weng, his voice actually took form, turning into the head of a lion, which opened its mouth to bite at Ling Han.
Lion Roar!
Ling Han immediately felt a tremor in his mind, causing boundless waves to rise up, as if his mind was about to be shattered.
Realization dawned on him.
Even though Shi Yuan had unleashed this attack with a roar, the lion’s head that he had taken form in was merely a pretense.
The true killing move was the divine sense attack.
With a roar, it had reached him, and was already wreaking havoc in his
mind.
If anyone believed that the lion’s head was the main force of attack, they would have already been hit.
Ling Han smiled faintly.
Launch a divine sense attack on him?
Hehe, didn’t he know that the strength of his divine sense had already advanced into the Spirit Transformation Tier?
He focused slightly, and his mind instantly calmed down.
“It’s impolite not to reciprocate.
Take a strike from me as well!” Ling Han said.
He then roared, unleashing a murderous aura attack.
Weng!
Shi Yuan’s body instantly faltered, and then his expression became twisted.
He suddenly grabbed his head and screamed in agony.
This!
Everyone was stunned, and even felt that this was unreal.
When it came to divine sense attacks, the Lion Roar of the Lion Race was definitely top-notch.
It was said that the Buddhist Race’s Lion Roar Technique had been inspired by the Lion Race.

murderous aura.

expression was terrifyingly twisted.

expertise was truly a terrible feeling.

able to crush Ling Han.

chapters.title: Chapter 4038: Earth Dragon
paragraphs: Formations Grandmaster, setting up formations with steps.
Ling Han wasn’t that powerful, and he couldn’t set up formations with steps. However, if he only had to stimulate Earth Qi attacks, it wouldn’t be too difficult for him.
What kind of celestial technique was this?
Everyone’s eyes widened, and just stared blankly at the great earthen-yellow dragon, guessing what celestial technique Ling Han had used.
“In front of the True Dragon, aren’t you going to kneel down obediently, kitten?” Ling Han said with a smile.
Shi Yuan roared, “You are only in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier. Even if you can summon the True Dragon, how could I be afraid of you!”
He charged over, and with a swipe of his palm, it turned into five golden threads that sliced towards Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and maneuvered the Earth Dragon to greet those five silken threads.
Shi Yuan chuckled coldly. His attacks were incredibly sharp, and they were indestructible. ‘Just you wait, Earth Dragon.’
Pu!
The Earth Dragon crashed into the silk thread, and without a doubt, the silk thread broke. The Earth Dragon was practically unhindered, and continued to rush forwards.
What!
Shi Yuan’s expression was extremely colourful. After a moment of shock, he hurriedly dodged. Peng!
The Earth Dragon missed its target, and crashed into the mountain rock. However, it actually did not cause any damage, and silently sank in.

This made everyone extremely confused. If it was to be said that the might of this Earth Dragon was strong, they had all witnessed it with their own eyes. When the attack landed on the ground, no matter what, it should have caused the earth to shake and mountains to quake.
It was so soundless, and so bizarre to the extreme.
What kind of technique was this?
Meanwhile, Ling Han shook his head.

After the Earth Qi had condensed, it could be used to attack. This was proven. However, he was only using it at the initial stage, after all. This Earth Dragon could not change at all, and could only go straight ahead. In other words, he could only use it in a head-on confrontation.
He mulled over it again. Strengthening his attainments in formations should be able to make the Earth Dragon become even more agile.
“I don’t believe this!” Shi Yuan roared. He charged over again.

He was at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, and his battle prowess was as high as 23 Heavens, ranked 27th in the Galaxy Network, and in a head-on confrontation, he was actually inferior to Ling Han?
Impossible, absolutely impossible!
Ling Han smiled faintly, and pointed a finger at Shi Yuan. The Earth Dragon appeared once more, roaring as it blasted towards Shi Yuan.
Shi Yuan didn’t dare to face this attack head-on. He hurriedly turned around to dodge, and then pounced again.

However, Ling Han only needed to extract more Earth Qi, and form another Earth Dragon. One, two, three... There were more and more Earth Dragons, and only when he summoned his 17th Earth Dragon did the first Earth Dragon dissipate due to the exhaustion of Earth Qi.
Which also meant that sixteen Earth Dragons could exist at the same time, and the battle prowess of each one of them could probably reach the True Self Tier. What kind of concept was that?
Shi Yuan was completely unqualified to oppose him, and could only dodge.
However, the Earth Dragon’s weakness was also very obvious. It had lost its agility, and its speed was not too fast either. There was nothing it could do against Shi Yuan.

It was also a sudden idea that had popped in Ling Han’s mind, and that was why he had thought of condensing Earth Qi to form an attack. He had not thought that this effect would actually be so extraordinarily good.

This was naturally all because the strength of his soul had reached the Spiritual Transformation Tier, which was why he could extract so much Earth Qi. Otherwise, at most, it would only be equivalent to him having an additional Imperial Technique.

He couldn’t help but think that Formation Grandmasters were truly terrifying, killing people with formations and killing people with Earth Qi, completely not inferior to cultivators of the same level.
He was sighing with emotion, yet Shi Yuan was on the verge of tears.

The dignified Dao Child of the Nine-Headed Lion Holy Land, ranked 27th on the Galaxy Network, and he was actually forced to flee in a panic by a cultivator at the early stage of the Core Formation Tier. What face would he have left?
“I get it!” Someone suddenly slapped his thigh, “This is not a celestial technique, but rather condensed from Earth Qi!”
“What!” Everyone exclaimed in shock.

“Formations Grandmaster, stimulating the ley lines and extracting Earth Qi, this can be called the Earth Dragon! Hence, when this attack landed on the ground, it was soundless, because the Earth Dragon originated from the ground.”
“Impossible, such a young Formations Grandmaster?”

“That’s right. Although the cultivation level of martial arts is not considered for Formation Grandmasters, and the only factor is formation mastery, without a strong enough soul, one wouldn’t be able to touch the threshold of Grandmaster.”
“Don’t you guys tell me that the strength of this guy’s soul has reached the level of at least Spiritual Transformation Tier!”

Everyone discussed among themselves. The Demon Race here were all top-notch. Even if they themselves did not cultivate formations, there was definitely no lack of understanding. It was just that they had not thought of formations at all previously.
Now that they were reminded, Ling Han’s “technique” was instantly pieced together.
Their mouths were spouting words of disbelief, but in truth, they were already certain of their own judgement.
This freakish guy with freakish natural talent in martial arts was actually a Formations Grandmaster!
Heavens, the heavens must have been blinded. Otherwise, how could it possibly cause a person to be so freakish?
Shi Yuan had also heard the conversation between the others. He finally knew what that earthen-yellow great dragon was, but knowing it was one matter, and how to resolve it was
another matter.
His only option was to flee.

Right now, Shi Yuan only had one thought on his mind, and that was Ling Han was only at the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, after all. The strength of his soul was definitely limited. Thus, his divine sense couldn’t withstand such expenditure, and it definitely wouldn’t be able to last long.
As a supreme prodigy, he had no lack of firm beliefs. Thus, after having this sliver of hope, he gritted his teeth and persisted, unwilling to give up.
However, reality was incredibly cruel.
Ling Han controlled the Earth Dragon, appearing to be extremely relaxed, and did not look
like he was about to collapse at all.
‘F*ck! You’re far too freakish!’

Everyone was complaining endlessly. Being able to become a Formations Grandmaster when he was only in the Core Formation Tier was already extremely inconceivable, breaking records. However, summoning so many Earth Dragons was obviously extremely exhausting on divine sense, and definitely couldn’t last for too long, but Ling Han’s spiritual power was
like a bottomless pit.
-Just like how battle prowess would be incredibly terrifying after combusting the Imperial Blood, right? But the Imperial Blood would soon be exhausted, and would not be able to last
for too long.
That should be the case as well.
And among them, the one who felt the greatest despair was Shi Yuan.

Ling Han looked completely at ease, and he was about to lose his patience. Willpower could take effect for a short period of time, allowing one to burst out with extraordinary power, but how could it last?

He was really dissatisfied. Ling Han’s cultivation level was far inferior to his, and in terms of battle prowess, it was indeed one-sided to his advantage, but just because the latter was also a Formations Grandmaster, casually summoning a few Earth Dragons, he was beaten to the point of having no temper at all.
However, what he didn’t know was that Ling Han still had many ultimate moves that he hadn’t used yet.

For example, what if the murderous aura attack was combined with the Earth Dragon? Under the effects of the murderous aura, he would fall into a temporary state of confusion. At this time, the Earth Dragon would pounce towards him, so what could he use to block it?
From this aspect, Ling Han had already been very merciful.
“Don’t say, Ling Han is really quite a good person. Even after being provoked by Shi Yuan like
this, he didn’t kill him.”
“That’s right. This kind of person is really hard to come by. He can be considered benevolent.”
“He would be a worthy friend.”
Everyone nodded, seeing Ling Han in a new light.
However, if the large black dog had been here, he would definitely have come to a completely
different conclusion.
-How was Ling Han benevolent? He was simply practicing his technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 4039: Another Version
paragraphs: This battle finally ended with Shi Yuan admitting defeat.
Ling Han was still unsatisfied. He had developed the amazing use of Earth Qi, and was just about to grasp it even more proficiently. He had not thought that Shi Yuan would be so decisive.
Sigh, it would have been better if you had persisted a few more times.

Shi Yuan could not bear to stay any longer, and left dejectedly. Meanwhile, the others began to chat with Ling Han. Their words were all very polite, expressing their desire to become friends with him.
Originally, Ling Han had come from the North Heavenly Realm. This was a label of

humiliation. People from the other Heavenly Realms would feel disdain towards him at first sight, but it was a different case now. Ling Han had already used his abilities to prove that he was extraordinary.
Furthermore, such a young Formation Grandmaster was really too awesome.
What did one need the most to explore an ancient site?
Formation Master!
With an extraordinary Formation Master in the team, it could at least double the chances of survival or finding the treasure trove.
Thus, no one would want to offend this kind of person.
Ling Han didn’t put on any airs. He chatted with the others, forming some connections. In the future, when he went to the West, East and South Heavenly Realms, he would at least have a foothold.
After chatting for a while, Ling Han excused himself to rest, and arrived at the stone house that the Demon Race had arranged for him.
Not long after, the large black dog ran over.
“Little Han, you definitely couldn’t expect what Grandpa Dog has found out,” it said mysteriously.
“Speak.”
“You guess.”
“F***, you already said that I wouldn’t think of it, and still want me to guess. Just how much are you asking for a beating?”
“Er!”
The large black dog stuck his tongue out and started to explain.
As it turned out, this Demon Race being actually had a very deep relationship with Divine Rain Venerate as well.

In the past, when Divine Rain Venerate traveled the world, he had also subdued a considerable number of powerful Demonic Beasts, and they becames his beast pets. For Demonic Beasts, being able to follow a Venerate Tier, who was also the descendant of an Ancestral King, this naturally wasn’t embarrassing....
Afterwards, Divine Rain Venerate unexpectedly fell in love when he passed by a place.

Of course, the woman that had moved Divine Rain Venerate was Bai Nanzhen. From then onwards, Divine Rain Venerate lost his lofty aspirations, and settled down here for a long time. In fact, he even established a small world, isolated from the rest of the world. Though those beast pets were unwilling to be mediocre, they still held onto some hope. Who knows, Divine Rain Venerate may have just lost his senses in a moment of love, and would soon come back to his senses. However, Divine Rain Venerate did not come back to his senses. Instead, he very quickly died.

This scared the crap out of those beast pets. A great and mighty Venerate Tier, and his lifespan was hundreds of thousands of years. Even if he couldn’t live to this limit, 80,000 or 90,000 years shouldn’t be a problem, right?
However, when Divine Rain Venerate passed away, he was only 40,000 years old.
This was clearly not right.
Those beast pets suspected that it was the Bai Clan’s doing, and their motive was to snatch the inheritance of Divine Rain Venerate-not only Venerate Tier-level, but also Emperor- level.
Thus, the beast pets worked together to attack, wanting to take down the Bai Clan.
However, they discovered that Divine Rain Venerate had placed restrictions on them, preventing them from attacking humans.
As a result, this battle ended noiselessly.
And before the death of Divine Rain Venerate, everyone had been sealed into this small world. Thus, those beast pets could only die of depression in the end.

Afterwards, the descendants of those beast pets took over the mission of their fathers, wanting to defeat the Bai Clan. Firstly, to seek justice for Divine Rain Venerate, and secondly, to obtain the inheritance of Divine Rain Venerate and leave this small world. Thus, war broke out.

However, the Regulations of this small world were incomplete, and ultimately, the second generation of the beasts could only reach True Self Tier ultimately, which was equivalent to the supreme elites of the Bai Clan. Though they had the advantage in numbers and physique, the Bai Clan was also protected by the precious tool left behind by Divine Rain Venerate, making them return empty-handed.

Yi?

Venerate Tier elite?

axe.”

together.

Thus, if they launched an attack now, they should be able to take down the Imperial Capital.

would join in battle!

“Boys, charge with me!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4040: Platform
paragraphs: The Bear King was the first to charge over.

On the city wall, the Sea City King smirked coldly. All the cities of the human race had defenses laid out by Divine Rain Venerate, especially the Imperial Capital, which was not something that a True Self Tier could break through at all.
As expected, when the Bear King approached, a flash of light slashed out from within the city.
Pu, even someone as strong as the Bear King was hit. His chest was struck, and blood spurted out madly.
“Hahaha!” Sea City King sneered, “Ignorance!”
This was practically courting death, and he still dared to think of fighting his way into the city?
When the Demon Kings saw this, they all frowned. The defenses of the humans had not weakened at all. This time, they would return empty-handed again.
At this time, the Bear King had also been saved. His face was pale like a piece of golden paper, which was very frightening.
“Don’t retreat!” Yet the Bear King spoke up, “I can feel that the might of that Spirit Tool has weakened considerably. Otherwise, my injuries would probably be a few times worse.”
“Really?” All the Demon Kings perked up.
“If anyone doesn’t believe me, then battle me for 300 rounds!” The Bear King stood up with great difficulty, brandishing its twin hammers, looking incredibly rough.
“All right, we will continue to besiege them!” All the Demon Kings nodded, and decided not to retreat.
Seeing the Demon Race encircle and not attack, the humans on the city wall were all slightly puzzled.
This was illogical.
Human prodigies such as Lu Qi and Feng Jixing also appeared on the city wall, wearing puzzled expressions.

The natives here had already battled countless times, and it could be said that they knew each other very well. However, the present battle situation was illogical. That must be because of the outsiders, which had led to a variable.
What on earth were these people trying to do?
After the Demonic Beasts surrounded the city for a while, they launched an attack from afar to test the might of the city defense.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Multiple attacks were launched, but the Spirit Tool in the city would channel on its own every time, slashing out fierce light, completely destroying all the attacks that assaulted it.

One day, two days, three days, and by the fourth day, everyone shockingly discovered that the light that was shot out was gradually becoming weaker. Some attacks had been intercepted, yet did not disintegrate. They still shot over, and blasted onto the city walls, causing considerable damage.
“Great!” The members of the Demon Race all cheered, and the expressions of the generals and soldiers of the Galewind Nation changed drastically.
After so many years, this was the first time that they discovered that the precious treasure that guarded the city would actually be useless one day.

“Boys, fight for me, make the barrage even fiercer!” All the Demon Kings roared loudly. Even the Bear King had returned. He had already recovered sixty to seventy percent, and was completely capable of fighting again.

It could be clearly seen that the city-guarding Spirit Tool was becoming weaker and weaker, and the power of the light it shot out was becoming weaker and weaker, causing even more attacks to land on the city walls, and also caused the city walls to sway slightly.
“Prepare to charge!” the great Demon Kings all shouted. The obsessions of their ancestors and fathers were finally about to be fulfilled in their hands.
In the end, the city-guarding treasure was completely useless, and no more streak of light slashed out.
“Charge!”

Instantly, the Demonic Race launched an assault. Thousands of Demonic Beasts charged towards the city wall. This was really a stampede of ten thousand beasts. Hong long long, the ground was wailing, raising clouds of dust that covered the skies.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! On the city wall, countless crossbow bolts shot down, turning into a rain of
arrows.
“Mere tricks!” The Horse King soared into the skies, turning into a massive pegasus. It opened its mouth and spat out a screen of light, which instantly blocked all the arrows that filled the skies.
“Horse King, let me fight you!” Sea City King also shot into the skies, and began a fierce battle with Horse King.

In the human race, more and more elites appeared. The Demon Race had already launched an all-out offensive. At this time, no one could just sit by and watch. Even the Emperor of the Galewind Nation, Bai Xiangming, had also stepped into battle. His battle prowess was incredibly powerful, and he actually managed to block two Demon Kings by himself.

It should be known that the individual battle prowess of the Demon Race was superior to the human race. Usually, only the Demon King would be able to fight one against two, or even in fact, against three, but this Bai Xiangming was actually capable of being so strong?
Ling Han looked at him for a while, and realization dawned on him.

It wasn’t that Bai Xiangming was powerful, but rather that the Battle Armor he was wearing was a high-grade precious tool that had boosted his astonishing power, allowing him to possess such awesome battle prowess.
Was this left behind by Divine Rain Venerate?
But even if Bai Xiangming was so strong, faced with this vast army of Demon Race, he was still unable to turn the situation around.
There were too many Demonic Beasts. He would have to block at least ten of them to be able to balance out the battle prowess of the True Self Tier elites on both sides. However, this was
obviously unrealistic.
Thus, the human race was slowly being defeated.
The outsiders all knew their limits. In this kind of situation, they naturally had to prioritize self-preservation. They had no reason or position to risk their lives.
After less than half a day, the human race was routed.
Bai Xiangming had no choice but to surrender.
“Hand over the Sky Opening Axe!” the Demonic Beasts shouted one after another. They naturally hoped to obtain the inheritance of Divine Rain Venerate, and they also thought that
they were the true heirs of Divine Rain Venerate.
The Bai Clan? Hehe, they were just the culprits.
Bai Xiangming shook his head, and said, “I only know where the Sky Opening Axe is, but I
can’t pick it up.”
True, if he could pick it up, he would have long since obtained the inheritance of Venerate Divine Rain Venerate. Could there still be so many things going on?
All the Demon Kings escorted Bai Xiangming to find the Sky Opening Axe. The outsiders

followed him, one after another. Whether it was the humans or the Demon Race, this was a battle that had nothing to do with them. Their only purpose was to obtain the inheritance of Divine Rain Venerate.
The Demon Kings knew that these outsiders had astonishing backgrounds, so they didn’t
press them.

It wasn’t long before they arrived at the foot of a tall mountain behind the Imperial Palace. Bai Xiangming activated several layers of formations, and finally, a platform with a radius of around 21 meters appeared before them. In the middle of the platform, a short-handled axe had struck the platform.
“That is the Sky Opening Axe?” All the Demon Kings’ eyes were burning, and the eyes of the outsiders lit up as well.
This was related to the inheritance of a Venerate Tier elite, and may even be related to the
Imperial Technique.
“That’s right.” Bai Xiangming nodded, “However, to say nothing of picking up the axe, there are not many that can even walk to the front of the Sky Opening Axe.”
“Ha, I don’t believe it!” The Bear King immediately jumped out. He was really an impatient person. Previously, he dared to charge even against the city-guarding Spirit Tool, what more
now.
However, he had just rushed onto the platform, when his figure immediately slowed down. His whole face was wrinkled, as if he was using all his might. Even so, after taking a few steps,
he could no longer move.
“Old Bear, what’s going on?” a Demon King asked.
The Bear King did not answer. Instead, Bai Xiangming spoke up, and said, “The gravity fields on this platform are incredibly terrifying. Furthermore, due to the change in cultivation level,
the higher the cultivation level, the greater the gravity fields.”
So that was the case.
At this moment, the outsiders were all rubbing their fists in anticipation. Under such conditions, the True Self Tier elites wouldn’t be able to gain any advantage at all, and they
would have a chance.
The Demonic Beasts refused to give up, and they all leaped onto the platform. They were much stronger than humans at the same cultivation level, so there was no reason that they couldn’t do the same.
However, these Demon Kings had only rushed forward a few steps, when they were defeated
just like the Bear King.
“Hahaha!”
The outsiders roared with laughter as they entered the arena.

chapters.title: Chapter 4041: Influencing Formations
paragraphs: The platform’s design obviously was not to allow elites to win, but rather depended on natural talent.
The higher one’s natural talent, the stronger one would be at the same cultivation level. Only then would one be able to reach the end and pick up the Sky Opening Axe.

As expected, the Demonic Beasts couldn’t do it, but there was no shortage of top-notch prodigies among the outsiders. They were completely capable of resisting the weight of gravity, and walked steadily forwards.
“Get lost!”
“You’re the one who should get lost!”
“The Sky Opening Axe is mine!”
Everyone came to blows, stopping others from surpassing themselves.

Though prodigies like Feng Jixing and Lu Qi were also affected by the gravity fields, and could no longer use movement techniques, each step was extremely steady. They had only descended to walking like a normal person, and for them, how long would a distance of 21 meters take?

However, they weren’t the only prodigies. At present, top-notch prodigies from the North, South, East, and West Heavenly Realms had also arrived. At least a dozen over people were no weaker than Feng Jixing and the others, and the competition was extremely intense.
They attacked each other, each wanting to stop the others, so that they could take the initiative.

In this situation, Feng Jixing and the other former Cauldron Forging Tier prodigies were completely at a disadvantage. Though their natural talent was not inferior to others at all, their cultivation level was too low. They were merely in the early stage of Core Formation Tier, and their battle prowess could not possibly exceed Tenth Heaven, at most. How could they compete with the veteran prodigies of Core Formation Tier?
Right now, Sha Yang, Zhu Yixiu, and the others were the ones in the lead. They were all ranked in the top ten Core Formation Tiers on the Galaxy Network.

“Little Han, quick, we can’t allow others to snatch away the Sky Opening Axe!” the large black dog called out. He had instigated the Tiger King to join forces with the other Demonic Kings in this battle with all his might, so how could he allow others to take advantage of it?
Ling Han nodded in understanding. He leaped into the arena, and he instantly felt a burst of power pulling him toward the ground.
However, this kind of gravity field was completely no big deal for him. He didn’t need to use much power to completely disperse it.
Was this a gravity formation?
Ling Han was extremely interested in formations at this moment, so he immediately unleashed his divine sense to investigate this formation.
“Yi, Little Han, why aren’t you moving?” The large black dog asked in confusion. Even he
didn’t feel much pressure, so Ling Han was definitely having an easier time. Why was he not moving?
“You go first,” Ling Han said.
“But the Sky Opening Axe!” the large black dog exclaimed anxiously.
Ling Han smiled and said, “It’s fine. There are too many people competing now, so the result won’t be decided in the short term.”
The large black dog was rendered speechless upon hearing this.
Ling Han multitasked. As he conversed with the large black dog, he had already begun to study this formation.
Very quickly, a smile appeared at the corners of his lips.

If he wanted to set up such a formation again, merely learning the formation patterns would need a considerably long amount of time. However, if he only had to make slight changes, this was very simple.
‘Come, let’s play around.’
Ling Han stepped lightly on the ground, and his divine sense instantly surged, causing the Earth Qi to undergo a slight change.
All of a sudden, those prodigies that were battling stumbled, and almost fell.
“What’s going on?”
“The weight of gravity has suddenly increased tenfold!”
“Why did the formation suddenly change?”

Everyone exclaimed in shock. This was too inconceivable. Their cultivation levels had not changed, so the effects of the gravity formation on them should also be unchanging. Why was it suddenly different?
No one knew why, but after being stunned for a moment, everyone immediately began
fighting again.
Ling Han smiled, and with another stomp of his foot, a slight change once again took place in the formation.
Instantly, all the prodigies were thrown off their feet.
“F*ck! The gravity field has weakened now!”

Regardless of whether the gravity fields were strong or weak, they would have an effect as long as they existed, especially in an intense battle. The gravity fields fluctuating in strength would have too great an effect on them.
Everyone was cursing. What was going on here? Couldn’t they fight properly?
They were all baffled. However, the large black dog turned to look at Ling Han. Was this guy the one who had screwed them over?

That must be it. Looking at the sly smile on this guy’s face, there was definitely no mistake. Ling Han found this very interesting. With each step, he continuously affected the Earth Qi, causing subtle changes to take place in the formation, causing the gravity field that everyone endured to fluctuate in strength, causing everyone to complain endlessly.
“Ling Han, is this your doing?” a member of the Demon Race shouted.

“That’s right, was it you?” Another few Demon Race cultivators came to a sudden realization. They had seen the battle between Ling Han and Shi Yuan before. Shi Yuan clearly possessed an absolute advantage in terms of battle prowess, yet he had still been defeated by Ling Han with the help of Earth Qi.
This proved that Ling Han possessed the ability of a Formations Grandmaster.

The gravity fields on this platform differed from person to person. That was obviously a formation. Thus, when the gravity fields changed strangely, it must be Ling Han’s doing. “Hahaha!” The large black dog immediately laughed loudly. These idiots finally came to a realization. Sigh, they were so stupid, yet they still claimed that they were prodigies. Ling Han spread his hands, and asked with a smile, “What did I do?”
“It must be you!”
Seeing his expression, how could everyone not understand? They all charged over.

Ling Han smiled, and his divine sense once again affected the formation. Instantly, these prodigies all fell to the ground. Now, the gravity field that targeted them had suddenly reached the level of the True Self Tier. Even if their battle prowess reached over twenty Heavens, so what? They could only fall down solidly.
“Why are you so fierce? You make me so scared!” Ling Han shook his head, and looked
towards the large black dog, “Come, let’s get to work!”
“Work on what?” The large black dog was a little confused.
“What are you acting for? Just do your old job!” Ling Han said.
“Oh, Grandpa Dog understands now!” The large black dog snickered, and began to search
them one by one.
No matter what treasures you have on you, I’ll take them all.
“Damn dog, return my Spatial Spirit Tool!”
“Ah, my Ten Thousand Year Treasured Herb!”
“My Thousand Essence Gold!”
Everyone screamed in agony. They hadn’t obtained the inheritance of Divine Rain Venerate,
yet their treasures had been cleaned out. How could they endure this?
“Thank you, thank you, everyone!” The large black dog thanked them cheekily as he
ransacked them cleanly. His dog’s eyes were all smiles.
“Ling Han, you are too despicable!”
“If you can, fight me openly!”
“I look down on you!”
Everyone called out. Some were really furious, while others were just trying to spur him on.
Ling Han shrugged and said, “You speak as if I wasn’t the one who suppressed you guys with
my abilities.”
Everyone was furious. Indeed, it was Ling Han that had trapped them on the ground, but this formation was not laid out by Ling Han, so what was there to be so smug about?
“Little Han, it’s done.” The large black dog ran over, “Watch Grandpa Dog swing the axe and
open the sky!”
It walked to the side of the Sky Opening Axe, stretched out a paw, and assumed a very bold posture, but the awkward thing was that the axe did not move the slightest bit.
“This... that... this time doesn’t count. Let’s do it again!” Even with how thick-skinned the
large black dog was, he was still slightly unable to bear it. Hurriedly, he placed his other paw
on it as well, and exerted all his strength.
However, the axe still did not move in the slightest.

chapters.title: Chapter 4042: Opening the Heavens
paragraphs: “F***, get out for Grandpa Dog!”
“You’re teasing Grandpa Dog!”
“What kind of damn axe is this? Grandpa Dog will fight you to the death!”
The large black dog howled in pain as he desperately tried to pull out the axe. However, the axe remained unmoving, and this caused the large black dog to want to vomit blood.
This was too humiliating.

Ling Han was also surprised. The large black dog had fused the Nine Cauldrons into one, and even he did not have the right to pull out the Sky Opening Axe. Then even if Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter came, they would only be able to watch helplessly, right?
“Old Black, let me try.” He walked over.
The large black dog was still unwilling to give up, and called out ‘yi, yi, yi, yi’ for a long time, before finally letting go, “Pei, it must be that this axe does not match Grandpa Dog’s horoscope.”

Ling Han stretched out a hand and grabbed it. Then, he took a slight breath, and began to pull. Instantly, he discovered that an extremely weak power was transmitted from within the axe. It could also be called a wave, and it was flowing into his body.
Ling Han hurriedly let go. This was the instinctive reaction of a cultivator.
“Little Han, what’s wrong?” the large black dog asked.
“Did you feel a ripple from the axe just now?” Ling Han asked.
“Yes, but it doesn’t have much effect.” The large black dog looked especially bold and casual about it.
Fine then.
However, when everyone saw this, they all thought that Ling Han was clearly unable to pull out the axe, yet had found an excuse for himself.
“Ling Han, hurry up and let me up. I’ll pull out the Sky Opening Axe. If I obtain the inheritance of Divine Rain Venerate, I can let you benefit from it as well.”
“Let me do it. I’m the seventh strongest elite in Core Formation Tier of the South Heavenly Realm.”
“I’ll go!”
Everyone called out, and began to place bids, promising benefits. Even the large black dog’s eyes lit up in excitement.
Yet Ling Han smiled, and said to the large black dog, “Looks like you didn’t search thoroughly enough.”
“I fell for it!” The large black dog slapped his thigh, and said, “Good one, you people! You actually dare to keep this a secret! Hand it over to Grandpa Dog!”
It went to do another body search.

Ling Han once again gripped the Sky Opening Axe. That feeling came again. This time, Ling Han did not let go, and merely guarded his mind tightly. However, this wave of power had directly rushed into his mind.
This?

Ling Han sensed for a while, and discovered that this wave did not have much destructive power. Rather than calling it an attack wave, it would be better to call it a scanning wave, which was very similar to Wally’s scan.
With this in mind, he no longer resisted, and allowed this wave of power to surge into the mind.
Instantly, the Primal Chaos Celestial Core vibrated lightly.
This wave immediately subsided like the ebbing tide, and instantly retreated out of Ling Han’s mind.
Yi, going back and forth, what was it playing at?
Ling Han thought for a moment, and ignored this. He exerted some force in his hand, and discovered that the axe had loosened slightly.
He exerted some more force, and saw that the Sky Opening Axe had been pulled out.
Was it difficult?
Not even a little bit!
“F***, have you cheated, brat?” The large black dog saw this from the corner of his eye, and immediately jumped up. He was so shocked that his eyes were about to pop out of his head.
“What cheat? Speak reasonably!” Ling Han said with a smile.

Everyone was also stunned. They had not thought that the second person to attempt would be able to pull out the Sky Opening Axe. F***, you speak so mysteriously, and the result? There was no difficulty level at all, all right?
However, Bai Xiangming was shocked to the extreme. Generation after generation of the Bai Clan had attempted this before, from low to high cultivation level, but none of them had succeeded.
This brat was practically a freak.
Ling Han gave a powerful wave, and slashed the Sky Opening Axe at the skies. Instantly, a cold light slashed out from the axe, and a fissure actually appeared in the skies.
F***, could this thing really open the sky?
Ling Han was shocked. When he had been in the small world, he had opened the sky once, but the situation now was completely different.
The sky split apart, and a blue light surged out, enshrouding Ling Han. Instantly, Ling Han’s figure floated up out of thin air, flying towards the opening that had been created.
“Old Black!” Ling Han roared loudly. He spread open his right hand, and Earth Qi surged out, surging out of the ground like a fountain. The large black dog flew towards Ling Han with a swoosh.
If the large black dog stayed at the bottom, he would definitely be torn to shreds by the
masses.
“Holy motherf*cker!” the large black dog wailed in agony. He covered his behind with his front paws, tears streaming down his face.
F***, it hurt too much.

Ling Han stretched out a hand, and grabbed hold of the large black dog that was flying over. Xiu, with a flash of blue light, he and the large black dog were both sucked into that crack in the skies. Then, the crack closed, and everything returned to normal.
Yi?
What happened to opening the sky?

Once Ling Han left, the effects on the formation immediately disappeared. All the prodigies stood up. They raised their heads to look at the sky. The sky had indeed split open for a while, but it immediately closed back up again. What the hell was this?
Right at this moment, a great many figures flew over, exuding an incredibly powerful aura.
True Self Tier!
Everyone tensed up as realization dawned on them. The restriction of the formation had disappeared further, and now, elites of the True Self Tier could enter.
“What’s going on?” a True Self Tier elite asked.

After everyone explained, these True Self Tier elites were all stunned. What was going on? They had just arrived, and the sky had already opened, and the inheritance had also disappeared. Then what was the point of them working so hard?
“When Ling Han comes out, if he obtains the inheritance of the Great Emperor, he definitely
can’t enjoy it alone!”
These True Self Tier elites reached a consensus.

Meanwhile, Ling Han and the large black dog were sucked into that crack. Instantly, the blue light disappeared, and they both fell from the sky. Thankfully, with their strength, they naturally could not possibly land painfully. They both straightened their backs and stood
upright.
Where was this?
The surroundings were pitch-black, and there was not the slightest bit of light.
Ling Han activated his eye technique, and instantly, even the darkness couldn’t stop him. He
saw that this was a stone chamber. It wasn’t big, and there was a stone table in the corner with
something on it.
“Aiyo, Grandpa Dog’s a** is about to explode!” Meanwhile, the large black dog was still moaning. That Earth Qi just happened to hit his behind, and even with the protection of his
iron underwear, he still felt a deep pain.
“Little Hann, what kind of sky-opening act is this?” After groaning for a while, the large
black dog asked.
Ling Han smiled, “Opening the sky is only one way of putting it. Looks like this place was set
up by Divine Rain Venerate, and we will soon get the answer.”
He walked towards the wall, then stopped by the stone table.
The large black dog also approached, covering his behind as he did so. There was a personal
note on the stone table, as well as a jade pendant.
“This should have been left behind by Divine Rain Venerate.”
“Let’s take a look.”
They took the logbook and began to flip through it.
As expected, this had been left behind by Divine Rain Venerate. It could be considered a diary,
but it could also be considered a will.
In the notebook, Divine Rain Venerate started to talk about the events of who knew how many millenia ago from his point of view.

When Divine Rain Venerate met Bai Nanzhen, he fell in love with her at first sight, and thus stopped his travels. He was completely focused on accompanying the woman he loved, and after spending two years together, he asked the Bai Clan for her hand in marriage.
For the Bai Clan, being able to take in a Venerate Tier as a son-in-law, what kind of glory was
that?
Without any obstruction, Divine Rain Venerate married the woman he loved and lived a happy
life.
If it only ended here, then everyone should be happy. How could there possibly appear two completely different versions of the story in the Bai Clan and the Demon Race?
Ling Han and the large black dog continued to read. What led to the accident was precisely the identity of Divine Rain Venerate as the descendant of an Ancestral King.

When Divine Rain Venerate met Bai Nanzhen, he fell in love with her at first sight, and thus stopped his travels.
He was completely focused on accompanying the woman he loved, and after spending two years together, he asked the Bai Clan for her hand in marriage.
For the Bai Clan, being able to take in a Venerate Tier as a son-in-law, what kind of glory was
that?
Without any obstruction, Divine Rain Venerate married the woman he loved and lived a happy
life.
If it only ended here, then everyone should be happy.
How could there possibly appear two completely different versions of the story in the Bai Clan and the Demon Race?
Ling Han and the large black dog continued to read.
What led to the accident was precisely the identity of Divine Rain Venerate as the descendant of an Ancestral King.

chapters.title: Chapter 4043: Third Version
paragraphs: At first, the Bai Clan did not know that Divine Rain Venerate was a descendant of a Great Emperor, but in a coincidental conversation, they found out about this fact.
This caused the Bai Clan to have devious thoughts.
This was the Great Emperor’s inheritance. If they could obtain it, the Bai Clan would become the strongest force in the world in a single leap.

They immediately put their plans into action, and had Bai Nanzhen hold back Divine Rain Venerate. Otherwise, Divine Rain Venerate would have already planned to leave with Bai Nanzhen, and take a look at the various planets in the universe.

Sure enough, it was true that Divine Rain Venerate, who had fallen into a tender trap, decided to stay here for a while longer for the sake of his beloved wife. That was because his beloved wife had said that after she left, who knew how many years it would be before she would return. She would miss her parents and family, and wanted to spend more time with them
now.
In the end, the Bai Clan made use of the resources of Divine Rain Venerate to buy a slow- acting poison on the Galaxy Network, which Bai Nanzhen placed in the food of Divine Rain Venerate.

Of course, Bai Nanzhen did not know that she had poisoned her husband, and only thought that it was a tonic, so that they could quickly have a child. Thus, she was too embarrassed to tell Divine Rain Venerate about this.
When Divine Rain Venerate discovered that he had been poisoned, the poison had already seeped into his bones, and could no longer be treated.
That was because he would never have imagined that the woman he loved would actually poison him.

Then, he made a decision. He removed the Bai Clan and its subordinate regions from the great world, and used materials on the level of Great Emperor to construct a small world, imprisoning the Bai Clan in it eternally.
“F***, why don’t we kill those people from the Bai Clan?” The large black dog roared in anger, “If it was Grandpa Dog, Grandpa Dog would kill whoever dares to harm me!”

Ling Han was also confused. This Divine Rain Venerate was truly a big-hearted person. She had already poisoned you, yet you had only imprisoned her. In this Mystery Realm, the Bai Clan was still mighty and domineering, not receiving the punishment that they deserved at all.

He continued reading. As it turned out, Divine Rain Venerate loved Bai Nanzhen too much, and was actually afraid that she would find out the truth of the matter, and feel bitterly disappointed at her clan.
-In any case, he was about to die, so what need was there to make the woman he loved feel sad?
“Grandpa Dog is really speechless!” The large black dog supported its head with its paw, “How could there be such an idiot? Grandpa Dog is about to go crazy!”
Ling Han sighed, “Perhaps this is true love.”
“Che, Grandpa Dog isn’t that kind!” the large black dog humphed.

When they read further, this Divine Rain Venerate was practically the number one good person in the world. Part of the reason why he had trapped the Bai Clan in this Mystery Realm was to punish the Bai Clan, but the more important reason was actually because he wanted the Bai Clan to know that wealth would lead to ruin.
Without enough strength, even if you were given the inheritance of the Ancestral King, it would only cause you to die even faster.

Thus, Divine Rain Venerate had set up the test of the Sky Opening Axe. Only those who had formed Nine Cauldrons and completed the Fusion Cauldron with their own power would be qualified to receive his inheritance.

This was the lowest standard for becoming a Great Emperor. Otherwise, without the support of the corresponding background, obtaining the Imperial Technique would only attract covetous eyes, and cause death.
Unfortunately, after so many years, the Bai Clan had not produced a single person that met the criteria.
Nine Cauldrons was something that even the Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter could not accomplish, what more when it was the members of the Bai Clan.

“No wonder Grandpa Dog couldn’t hold up the Sky Opening Axe. As it turned out, this actually required one to use one’s own power to complete the Fusion Cauldron!” The large black dog finally knew why. He looked towards Ling Han, “Aside from a freak like you, even an Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter would not be able to do it, right?”

Ling Han nodded slowly. It was no wonder that the Imperial Clan couldn’t produce a second Ancestral King. That was because the lowest standard for becoming a Great Emperor was fusing the Nine Cauldrons, and one would have to rely on one’s own power to accomplish that. The Imperial Clan had completely relied on the Imperial Weapon to produce the Fusion Cauldron, which was equivalent to ending their own path.
But since Divine Rain Venerate knew about this, then the other Imperial Clan elites should also know. Why would they still use the Imperial Weapon to create the Fusion Cauldron?

Because it was too difficult to fuse the Nine Cauldrons into one. Without the help of the Imperial Weapon, these Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters could only watch helplessly. In that case, since they couldn’t become a Great Emperor, they would naturally use the Imperial Weapon to attain the Fusion Cauldron to make themselves as powerful as possible. This was equivalent to cultivating an additional cultivation level, and they would always be stronger than cultivators of the same cultivation level in the future.

From this, it could be seen how difficult it was to become a Great Emperor. Fusing the Nine Cauldrons was only the lowest requirement. In future, there would also be various freakish requirements, and only then would it be able to stump generation after generation of
prodigies.

Throughout history, those who could become Emperors could really be counted on one hand. Divine Rain Venerate could be considered to have put in a lot of effort. The elites of the Bai Clan were too weak, and had absolutely no ability to protect the Emperor-level inheritance, yet insisted on being greedy. Divine Rain Venerate could only imprison them, unless there was a prodigy that could fuse the Nine Cauldrons into one with his own power. Only then would he be qualified to walk out of the Mystery Realm.

“After talking for so long, where exactly is the Emperor’s inheritance?” The large black dog became anxious. He very much disagreed with Divine Rain Venerate’s actions, and thought that he was extremely idiotic. However, Divine Rain Venerate had been dead for who knew how many years, so he would not vent his anger on a dead person. Thus, he only paid attention to the whereabouts of the Emperor-level inheritance.
They continued reading, yet were surprised.

As it turned out, Ancestral King Lingtian hadn’t passed down the inheritance of the Imperial Weapon. Instead, in his old age, he took the Imperial Weapon to the edge of the universe. From then onwards, there was no news of him ever again.

People never wanted to die. Someone as powerful as the Ancestral King, who ruled over the world, naturally wanted even less to die. However, even though the Great Emperor was invincible, he was still no match for the passing of time. There would eventually come a day
when he died.

Thus, Ancestral King Lingtian rushed to the edge of the universe in search of immortality. “Yi, why is it the same as Brother Monkey’s ancestor?” Ling Han murmured. The Battle Saint Emperor had also gone to the edge of the universe to seek the method of immortality. The two Ancestral Kings had chosen the same path one after another. Did this mean that there really was a technique of immortality in this world?
But if there was, then why hadn’t the Battle Saint Emperor and Ancestral King Lingtian
returned?
Could it be that there was anywhere in this world that could trap an Ancestral King?

Moreover, why did the Great Emperor only go there in his old age? Was it because that place was extremely dangerous, and even the invincible Great Emperor didn’t have much confidence, so that was why he only went there at the end of his life?

All of a sudden, countless guesses surged through Ling Han’s mind. He also had an urge to immediately set out to the periphery of the universe to explore the truth of that place. However, without the means of the Great Emperor, he probably wouldn’t be able to reach anywhere even if he spent his entire lifespan on the Transfer Formation, because there was no Transfer Formation there at all. He could only go on foot. With his mere cultivation level of the Core Formation Tier, he wouldn’t be able to reach the edge of the universe even if he ran
for 10,000 years.
“I really want to immediately become a Great Emperor!” Ling Han mumbled to himself. He
was too curious.
“Don’t worry, you can definitely do it, brat.” The large black dog patted Ling Han’s shoulder, “At that time, Grandpa Dog will go with you.”
Ling Han laughed loudly, and said, “All right. When the time comes, we’ll go and explore. What secrets are hidden there that can allow one to live forever?”
“However, let’s just see what Divine Rain Venerate left for us first!” The large black dog’s expression immediately changed, and it was filled with greed.
