chapters.title: Chapter 4044: Ten Cultivation Technique
paragraphs: Aside from a notebook, Divine Rain Venerate had also left behind a jade pendant.
Jade pendant?

“We’re done for. Just this jade pendant? Is it so that Grandpa Dog can pick up girls?” The large black dog screamed. The sky had been opened with great difficulty, and in the end, they had only found out the truth of the matter all those years ago, as well as a jade pendant.
Ling Han picked up the jade pendant and inserted his divine sense into it. Mysterious symbols instantly appeared in his mind.
Pa, the jade pendant instantly shattered.
“Say, Little Han, even if you’re angry, there’s no need to crush the jade pendant. Who knows, it might even be worth some money,” the large black dog said gloomily.
“The jade pendant contains a cultivation technique!” Ling Han said solemnly.
“Imperial Technique?” The large black dog immediately perked up.
Ling Han shook his head, “I don’t know yet. My mind is filled with extremely complicated seals, and I can’t analyze them at the moment. Wait for a while.”
“Go ahead! Go ahead!” The large black dog rubbed his paws together, looking very excited.
Ling Han began to analyze these seals, using his super strong comprehension ability to investigate the secrets within.
Bit by bit, a secret technique revealed its true appearance to him.
“Ten Cultivation Technique!”

Ling Han murmured. This was a secret technique that he had analyzed from these seals. It was not a cultivation technique that refined heaven and earth’s energy, nor was it a martial arts technique that attacked and killed enemies, but a healing technique.

No matter how serious his injuries were, he would be able to recover very quickly if he channeled the Ten Cultivation Technique. The time would depend on the extent of his injuries, and if he had cultivated the Ten Cultivation Technique to the highest cultivation level, as long as his lifespan was not exhausted, he would be able to reconstruct his body with a single thought.
However, to cultivate to the point of rebirth with a single thought, the prerequisite was the cultivation level of Great Emperor Tier.
Hehe.
To say the least, Saints could be reborn from a drop of blood, while Venerate Tiers could regrow their severed limbs, which was incredibly amazing.
Because this was an Imperial Technique!

“This is something good!” Even Ling Han was excited. After he explained the effects of the Ten Cultivation Technique to the large black dog, the large black dog also jumped up and down in excitement. This was too practical; this was a life-saving divine technique.

At present, Ling Han was still unable to teach the Ten Cultivation Technique to the large black dog, because though he had analyzed the secrets of these seals, he was unable to turn them into words to be heard by the large black dog.
That was too profound.
Thus, Ling Han had to master it first, and then reconstruct these seals. Then, he would teach these seals to the large black dog, so that it could comprehend on its own.
Then, if he could learn it, he could learn it. If he couldn’t learn it, there was nothing he could do.
Imperial Technique was naturally not something that anyone could learn just because they wanted to.
Ling Han began to practice the Ten Cultivation Technique, completely forgetting the passing of time. After who knew how long, he suddenly came to a realization.
The process of cultivating the Ten Cultivation Technique was a process of reconstructing these seals, and then combining them into a seal.

Combining the seals in different ways would have completely different effects. As for how to achieve the best effects, that could only be done as one’s cultivation level increased, and their cognition of the seals would also increase, continuously increasing the might of the seals. After these seals were combined, Ling Han channeled them, and these seals were extracting high-level energy. However, it was completely different from the high-level energy that Ling Han had previously come into contact with. This kind of energy was filled with vitality and flowed in his body, instantly healing a few hidden injuries.
Impressive!
Ling Han didn’t continue to cultivate. Instead, he opened his eyes, looked at the large black dog, and asked, “How long have I been in seclusion for?”
“Grandpa Dog is about to become a fossil. How long do you think it was?” The large black dog sighed.
Er, he could still speak so cheekily, which meant that not too much time had passed.
Sure enough, the large black dog soon revealed the time that Ling Han had actually spent. It was a month and a half.
One and a half months to master a secret technique. This was really slow.
Ling Han stretched out a finger and tapped the large black dog’s forehead. Instantly, countless seals surged towards him.
The large black dog humphed upon hearing this. He couldn’t endure receiving so many symbols at once, and it was as if his mind were about to explode.
However, the large black dog quickly adjusted his state of mind and started to cultivate.
Meanwhile, Ling Han walked around. This stone chamber wasn’t big, and he couldn’t see any mechanism at all. How could he open it?
A thought flashed in his mind. The inheritance here was the Ten Cultivation Technique, so if he stimulated this secret technique, would it resonate with the stone chamber and open it?
It was possible.
However, the large black dog was still cultivating, so he would give it some time first. At least, it could digest those seals first. As for combinations, he could take his time in the
future.

He couldn’t help but think that the members of the Bai Clan had gone to great lengths to obtain the inheritance of the Ancestral King, and though this Ten Cultivation Technique was a genuine Imperial Technique, if it was obtained by the members of the Bai Clan, it would only make them a target to be hunted down.
-The Ten Cultivation Technique could not help a clan become a Venerate Tier, Saint Tier, or even a Great Emperor-level force in a single leap.

At that time, Ancestral King Lingtian definitely created the Imperial Technique, which was not just limited to the Ten Cultivation Technique. However, it was unknown whether it had been lost, or it was the deliberate actions of Divine Rain Venerate. Now, there was only one Imperial Technique, which was passed down.
After feeling rueful for a while, Ling Han decided to break through to the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier.

Previously, he was still lacking a bit of experience, but in the past month or so, he had been studying the Imperial Technique, and had actually unknowingly gained enough experience. Thus, he now possessed the qualifications to attempt breaking through to the middle stage of
the Core Formation Tier.
‘Come then. I can’t waste any more time.’
Ling Han sat down cross-leggedly, and began to charge towards the next stage.
Breaking through to the next minor level wasn’t difficult for Ling Han. Since he had grasped
an opportunity, he naturally leaped over it.

Instantly, an earth-shattering and tsunami-like change took place in his body. Even if this place was in some unknown time and space, there was still endless energy that came from the heaven and earth, and was madly absorbed by Ling Han.
His power was skyrocketing!
This process continued for close to a day, and only then did it finally slow down from its violent state, turning into a trickle, and finally stop.

In Ling Han’s mind, the only Celestial Cauldron had completely disappeared. Now, there was only that Primal Chaos Celestial Core, floating, exuding a boundless primal, supreme aura. As long as one’s cultivation level was inferior to Ling Han, he could only prostrate in front of
him.
The middle stage of the Core Formation Tier!
Ling Han stimulated his power, and couldn’t help but look pleasantly surprised.
“Fifteenth Heaven!”
“Haha, once I break through to the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, my original
power will directly soar to 15 Heavems. Going by that logic, if I reach the end of the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, then how much power will I be able to reach? Twenty
Heavens?”

If he could reach 20 Heavens, then he could cast the celestial technique, and use the Primal Chaos Celestial Core to further weaken the opponent’s battle prowess. Then, he would completely be able to fight a guy with battle prowess of 25th or 26th Heaven.
Just ask the world, how many people could reach battle prowess above twenty-five Heavens?
Impressive, too impressive!
After Ling Han secretly delighted for a while, he decided to continue cultivating.
The second step of the Core Formation Tier was to nurture the Celestial Core.

He drew out the natural treasures that he had long since prepared, including the three precious treasures that the Ancient Sun Saint had left behind, and began to refine them. These natural treasures were refined one after another, and Ling Han’s Celestial Core was also slowly growing stronger. The speed at which he refined the mystical power was getting faster and faster, and the effects were getting better and better.

The inheritance here was the Ten Cultivation Technique, so if he stimulated this secret technique, would it resonate with the stone chamber and open it?
It was possible.
However, the large black dog was still cultivating, so he would give it some time first.
At least, it could digest those seals first.
As for combinations, he could take his time in the
future.

He couldn’t help but think that the members of the Bai Clan had gone to great lengths to obtain the inheritance of the Ancestral King, and though this Ten Cultivation Technique was a genuine Imperial Technique, if it was obtained by the members of the Bai Clan, it would only make them a target to be hunted down.
-The Ten Cultivation Technique could not help a clan become a Venerate Tier, Saint Tier, or even a Great Emperor-level force in a single leap.
At that time, Ancestral King Lingtian definitely created the Imperial Technique, which was not just limited to the Ten Cultivation Technique.
However, it was unknown whether it had been lost, or it was the deliberate actions of Divine Rain Venerate.
Now, there was only one Imperial Technique, which was passed down.
After feeling rueful for a while, Ling Han decided to break through to the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier.
Previously, he was still lacking a bit of experience, but in the past month or so, he had been studying the Imperial Technique, and had actually unknowingly gained enough experience.
Thus, he now possessed the qualifications to attempt breaking through to the middle stage of
the Core Formation Tier.
‘Come then.
I can’t waste any more time.’
Ling Han sat down cross-leggedly, and began to charge towards the next stage.
Breaking through to the next minor level wasn’t difficult for Ling Han.
Since he had grasped
an opportunity, he naturally leaped over it.
Instantly, an earth-shattering and tsunami-like change took place in his body.
Even if this place was in some unknown time and space, there was still endless energy that came from the heaven and earth, and was madly absorbed by Ling Han.
His power was skyrocketing!
This process continued for close to a day, and only then did it finally slow down from its violent state, turning into a trickle, and finally stop.
In Ling Han’s mind, the only Celestial Cauldron had completely disappeared.
Now, there was only that Primal Chaos Celestial Core, floating, exuding a boundless primal, supreme aura.
As long as one’s cultivation level was inferior to Ling Han, he could only prostrate in front of
him.
The middle stage of the Core Formation Tier!
Ling Han stimulated his power, and couldn’t help but look pleasantly surprised.
“Fifteenth Heaven!”
“Haha, once I break through to the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, my original
power will directly soar to 15 Heavems.
Going by that logic, if I reach the end of the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, then how much power will I be able to reach?
Twenty
Heavens?”
If he could reach 20 Heavens, then he could cast the celestial technique, and use the Primal Chaos Celestial Core to further weaken the opponent’s battle prowess.
Then, he would completely be able to fight a guy with battle prowess of 25th or 26th Heaven.
Just ask the world, how many people could reach battle prowess above twenty-five Heavens?
Impressive, too impressive!
After Ling Han secretly delighted for a while, he decided to continue cultivating.
The second step of the Core Formation Tier was to nurture the Celestial Core.
He drew out the natural treasures that he had long since prepared, including the three precious treasures that the Ancient Sun Saint had left behind, and began to refine them.
These natural treasures were refined one after another, and Ling Han’s Celestial Core was also slowly growing stronger.
The speed at which he refined the mystical power was getting faster and faster, and the effects were getting better and better.

chapters.title: Chapter 4045: Coercion from the Venerate Tiers
paragraphs: When one had reached the Core Formation Tier, cultivation could be considered a two-step process.

The first step was changes to the Celestial Core. This determined the power of the cultivator, and the other was the accumulation of mystical power. This would determine the endurance of the cultivator in battle.
For Ling Han, his endurance had long since reached the level of Sect Master. Thus, what he had to do was very simple. He only had to focus on improving the Celestial Core.
One month, two months, three months. Time passed very quickly, and when Ling Han refined all the natural treasures he had prepared, the large black dog finally finished analyzing all those seals.
Analyzing it was one matter, and reconstructing it was another.
Thus, if the large black dog wanted to truly use the Ten Cultivation Technique, it would probably take at least a year.
However, it was fine as long as he had a preliminary grasp of it. That way, he would not forget it as time passed.
“Old Black, we should leave,” Ling Han said.
Now, he really couldn’t stay any longer. The cultivation resources he had prepared had already been used up, and it would only be a waste of time.
“All right.” The large black dog nodded, “However, how do we get out?”
“Let me give it a try.”

Ling Han pressed his hands on the wall, then channelled the Ten Cultivation Technique. A miraculous thing happened. The whole wall actually began to light up, then became transparent, and finally disappeared.
Yi?
When they appeared out of thin air, they saw that they were presently in a desolate plain, and there were people all around them. There were people of all cultivation levels.
They had come out!
Ling Han could grasp the things that had disappeared in the Mystery Realm. Those were the Regulations of heaven and earth. Only the true great world possessed them, and they were complete.
“He’s out!”
“Ling Han is out!”
“Finally!”
All around them, everyone was cheering loudly, appearing to be incredibly excited.
Ling Han chuckled. What did it have to do with these people whether he came out or not? Why were they so excited?

“Ling Han, you’ve obtained the inheritance of Divine Rain Venerate, haven’t you?” someone immediately asked. This was a True Self Tier elite, and he had a sense of superiority from a superior position.
-No matter how outstanding you are, if there is a gap of a major tier in cultivation level, you are trash in my eyes.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Whether I have obtained it or not, this is my personal matter. What business is it of yours?”
“Humph, what an arrogant brat. You haven’t even entered the True Self Tier yet!” the True Self Tier elite said in displeasure.
“Enough with the nonsense!” Another True Self Tier elite stepped out, “Hand over the inheritance of the Divine Rain Venerate. This is not yours alone!”
Ling Han laughed loudly, “You guys want to become robbers?”

As he spoke, he communicated with the ley lines. This was a great world, and there were naturally many ley lines on a real planet. The nearest ley line exit was only more than 15km away from him. It was completely usable.
In this way, he was naturally filled with confidence.
“What a stubborn guy. If we don’t make him suffer a little, it looks like he won’t listen!” someone sneered.
This was a Sect Master elite!
Now that such an elite had spoken, no matter how prodigious he was, he could only obediently shut his mouth.
“You want to pick on the weak?” Ling Han glared at the Sect Master, not backing down at all.

“Ha, you’re courting death!” The Sect Master moved, and grabbed out at Ling Han. He had absolutely no intention of interrogating Ling Han. He would directly search Ling Han’s soul, and only then would he be able to obtain all the secrets.

“Humph, you dare to touch the disciple of our Nine Suns Holy Land?” With a cold laugh, xiu, a figure had already stood in front of Ling Han. Then, he raised a palm, and delivered a slap at the Sect Master elite.
This person’s speed was too fast. He had stepped right in between Ling Han and the Sect Master, and then shot out a palm strike. Everything happened in one go, and even time seemed to have stopped.

Thus, the Sect Master couldn’t react in time at all. Pa! He was instantly struck head-on, and he was sent tumbling through the air. He then crashed to the ground, causing a cloud of dust and sand to billow into the air.
Hiss, the dignified Sect Master was actually sent flying with a single slap?
Everyone was stunned. F***, who was this person that had come? He was too awesome, wasn’t he?
This naturally was the Nine Mountains Venerate.
“Nine Mountains, isn’t it demeaning to show off your might to a junior?” A voice rang out.
The Nine Mountains Venerate looked towards a certain direction, and asked, “Dragon Seventh?”ree

“Hehe, it’s been a few thousand years since we parted, so you still remember me?” An old man walked out. He was tall and slender, and there was actually a pair of horns on his head. They looked a little like antlers, but were much longer.

The Dragon Seven Venerate was from the Dragon Race. Of course, this Dragon Race was self-proclaimed by them, and actually belonged to the Flood Dragon Race. It was completely unrelated to the True Dragon.
After the death of the first generation Divine Beast, there were no more pure-blooded Divine Beasts in the world.
The Nine Mountains Venerate humphed, and said, “Someone bullied my disciple, so can’t I
slap him?”

Dragon Seventh Venerate chuckled, “I can’t be bothered to interfere in this matter. However, your disciple has obtained the inheritance of Divine Rain Venerate. I am very interested, so allow me to search his soul. I can guarantee that I will not harm him in the slightest.” “What a joke!” The Nine Mountains Venerate instantly rebuked coldly, “Your divine sense is so powerful. If you search his soul once, would he still have any future prospects?” “Hehe, I didn’t take his life, am I not merciful enough?” the Dragon Seventh Venerate said with a smile.
In the eyes of a Venerate Tier elite, no matter how brilliant you were, you were only an ant.
Was it not enough to spare your life?

Ling Han looked over at Dragon Seventh Venerate, committing this old geezer’s appearance and soul fluctuations to memory. When he became a Venerate Tier in the future, he would definitely slap this old b@stard’s mouth.
The Nine Mountains Venerate shook his head, and said, “Step back. I’m bringing my disciple
back!”
“Nine Mountains, even if I agree not to make things difficult for you, there are still a great many people that would not agree.” Dragon Seventh Venerate smirked coldly.
“That’s right. I disagree.”
“I also disagree.”
“I too am very interested in the inheritance of Divine Rain Venerate.”

Multiple voices rang out, and one after another, elderly men and women walked out from the surroundings. However, there was also one that was very young. He looked to be thirty years old at most, and his true age was at most a few thousand years old. The flame of life was incredibly vigorous, and was boundlessly terrifying.
The Nine Mountains Venerate’s eyes focused on that person, and his pupils involuntarily contracted slightly. “Luo Wuding!”
Luo Wuding from the Imperial Clan, he had become a Venerate Tier elite after cultivating for 5000 years. Everyone said that he had hopes of becoming a Saint.
Luo Wuding smiled faintly, “Brother Nine Mountains.”
The Nine Mountains Venerate couldn’t help but feel rueful, saying, “The first time I saw you,
you were only at the Core Formation Tier. I never thought that after such a long time, you
would already become a Venerable Tier elite, capable of being my equal.”
“Nine Mountains, don’t talk about unrelated matters!” Dragon Seventh Venerate said impatiently, “Do you still want to protect your disciple now?”
The Nine Mountains Venerate, said proudly, “With me here, don’t even think of touching a
single hair on his head!”
“Nine Mountains, what need is there for this?” An old woman spoke up. Her appearance and height was no different from an ordinary person, but her skin was purple-gold in colour,
which was very bizarre.
She was called Purple Gold Venerate, but she liked others to call her Grandma ZijinR.

“Nine Mountains, though you are not weak, we have at least ten Venerate Tier elites here,” another skinny old man said. “Those that can cultivate to Venerate Tier are more or less standing at the peak of martial arts. All of them are prodigies among prodigies, and neither is weaker than the other.”
“In a battle of one against ten, you will definitely lose!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4046: Queue for a Challenge
paragraphs: The Nine Mountains Venerate grinned, and said, “Really?”
With a shake of his right hand, an ancient-looking umbrella appeared. It was definitely quite old.
“F***, Nine Suns Parasol!”
“Saint Tool!”
Seeing this umbrella, all the Venerate Tier elites took a few steps back. Even Luo Wuding revealed a shocked expression.

The Nine Suns Parasol was a Saint Tool that had been personally forged by the Nine Suns Saint. It had accompanied the Nine Suns Saint to his battles all over the world. In fact, it had even defeated the Ancestral King Lingtian before. Just how domineering was this?

A Venerate Tier wielding a Saint Tool was enough to allow the Saint Tool to unleash its full might for a short period of time. Killing a Venerate Tier would be as easy as harvesting weeds for him. How could these Venerate Tiers not be stunned?

However, everyone knew that the Nine Mountains Venerate wouldn’t really kill someone with a Saint Tool. This was because Venerate Tier elites all had powerful backgrounds. Some of them had even come from the Imperial Clan. If they were really killed, then there would be a great many Venerate Tiers carrying the Saint Tool or even the Imperial Weapon and charge into the Nine Suns Holy Land.
Thus, this was only a form of intimidation, and also a statement of stand. If anyone dared to touch Ling Han, then they would have to face the fury of the Saint Tool.
Who would have thought that the Nine Mountains Venerate would actually bring a Saint Tool with him when he went out this time? Naturally, everyone was stunned.

“Nine Mountains, you’re really ruthless!” the Dragon Seventh Venerate said. His tone was slightly strange. It was unknown whether he was sighing at the Nine Mountains Venerate’s resoluteness or venting his displeasure.

“Now, I can take my people and leave, right?” the Nine Mountains Venerate asked calmly. “Wait!” The Dragon Seventh Venerate spoke again, “Nine Mountains, you have the Saint Tool in your possession, and your present strength is indeed enough to suppress everyone. However, you can protect this boy once, but can you do the same twice, or thrice? Will you stay by this boy’s side for all eternity?”
“What do you mean by this?” The Nine Mountains Venerate said with a frown. There was already anger in his voice.

Yet the Dragon Seventh Venerate was unafraid, and said, “Previously, this boy obtained the inheritance of the Divine Rain Venerate, so it can only be considered luck, and not due to strength. Thus, now, let others challenge him. If it is proven that his strength is undisputed, and he is worthy of this inheritance, then I will approve of him.”
“That’s right,” Grandma Zijin also spoke up, “This brat is only slightly proficient with formation techniques, and just happened to seize this opportunity. He is not showing his strength at all.”
“Hehe, I too think that this is only fair, and give the others a chance.”

All the Venerate Tier elites expressed their stand, wanting Ling Han to accept everyone’s challenge, proving that he indeed had the ability to obtain this inheritance, and was not relying on luck, and the fact that he just happened to know some formation techniques. Ling Han smiled, and said, “Sure, in a battle of equals, who would I be afraid of?”
The Nine Mountains Venerate had already won him a chance for a fair battle. Next, it would be up to him.
Hearing these words, the Nine Mountains Venerate couldn’t help but turn to look at Ling Han.
Ling Han did not speak, and merely nodded, his face filled with confidence.
“All right, who will challenge this junior?” the Dragon Seventh Venerate asked.
“I’ll go!”
“I’ll go!”
“Let me!”

Everyone scrambled over each other. Ling Han was indeed freakish, but firstly, there was no formation for Ling Han to borrow the power of, and secondly, he was only in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, so how strong could his battle prowess be?
“Don’t be anxious, don’t be anxious!” The large black dog immediately jumped out, “If you want to challenge my Little Han, that’s fine. Show me the stakes!”
Stakes?
Everyone was stunned. What was the meaning of this?

“Oh, if you win, you’ll be able to obtain Little Han’s treasure, but if you lose, you can leave without a second thought? How could there be such a good thing!” The large black dog shook his head, “Take out the stakes, and if you win, you can take it away along with your winnings, but if you lose, I’m sorry, but leave the stakes behind!”
This sounded very logical, but why did it exude an air of sordidness?
Ling Han didn’t say anything. With the large black dog around, the task of playing the bad guy was naturally up to him.

“All right, let me!” A Core Formation Tier cultivator jumped out. He was in the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, while his abilities were as high as Fifteenth Heaven. Naturally, he thought that he would definitely win, so he didn’t mind taking out the stakes. In any case, he could take it back.
He took out a treasured ginseng. This was a Celestial medicine that could revive one’s blood and Qi, and could save one’s life at critical moments.

“Come, come, come. Those who want to issue a challenge, come and register with Grandpa Dog. Those who do not register are not allowed to participate.” The large black dog was all smiles, as if he was manning a new shop that had opened. He was really very cordial.
This made people want to beat it up. They weren’t wealth-delivering boys, so why were you so happy?
“Ling Han, admit defeat obediently. Don’t waste both of our time,” the Core Formation Tier
said.
“Next,” Ling Han said.
“You!” The Core Formation Tier cultivator almost exploded in fury. ‘I’ve just stepped onto the stage, and you’re already saying ‘next’. Just how much are you looking down on me?’
Peng!
But he had not even finished this thought, when he saw an iron fist strike towards him, sending him flying.
Pa, he fell onto the ground, already unconscious.
Defeat.
“Come, come, come. Next.” The large black dog’s eyes swept over them, and pointed at a
person, “Brother, it’s your turn.”

The cultivator from the Core Formation Tier revealed a solemn expression. He was a consummate level cultivator from the Core Formation Tier, and his battle prowess had already surpassed 20 Heavens. However, Ling Han had won with a single punch. This battle prowess was a little shocking.
How could a mere early stage of the Core Formation Tier cultivator be so strong?
“Apologies, I’m not in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier. I advanced into the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier a few months ago,” Ling Han kindly explained.
‘Motherf*cker!’

This caused everyone to curse internally. With how freakish Ling Han was, taking this step was enough to increase his battle prowess by four to five Heavens. However, no matter how strong he was, he was only in the middle stage of the Core
Formation Tier.
The second Core Formation Tier cultivator stepped into the air. His battle prowess had reached the 21st Heaven, and he thought that he had a good chance of winning.
“I will defeat you!” he shouted loudly, and launched an attack from the skies. This person was quite cautious. First, he used long-distance attacks to test Ling Han’s
strength.
Ling Han let out a battle cry, and also rose into the air, charging over against the other’s
firepower.

In the three months that the large black dog had been away, he had refined all the natural treasures on him. The Primal Chaos Celestial Core had become a whole lot stronger than before, and his base power was no longer Fifteenth Heaven, but Eighteenth Heaven!

Boom, Ling Han had already arrived, and shot out a punch. “Haha, I have to admit, you really are extraordinary. Not long after advancing into the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, your battle prowess has already reached the 20th Heaven!” The second Core Formation Tier said coldly, “However, my battle prowess is 21 Heavens!”
After probing Ling Han several times, he also found out about Ling Han’s strength. Naturally,
he withdrew his cautiousness, and faced Ling Han head-on.
Ling Han smiled. The Primal Chaos Celestial Core activated, causing the other’s battle
prowess to instantly decrease by three Heavens.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and that Core Formation Tier elite was immediately sent
flying. He was completely no match for Ling Han.
There was a difference of two Heavens between their battle prowess, and he didn’t have the
Primal Chaos Celestial Core that could absorb the power of attacks. If he wasn’t sent flying,
who would?
However, in everyone’s eyes, this was filled with comical effects.
...Previously, the Core Formation Tier cultivator had been praising himself and looking down
on Ling Han. In the end, Ling Han sent him flying with a single punch. This was practically a
big joke.
However, this also surprised everyone. Ling Han’s battle prowess was too terrifying, wasn’t
it?

“Wait!” The Dragon Seventh Venerate spoke again, “Nine Mountains, you have the Saint Tool in your possession, and your present strength is indeed enough to suppress everyone.
However, you can protect this boy once, but can you do the same twice, or thrice?
Will you stay by this boy’s side for all eternity?”
“What do you mean by this?” The Nine Mountains Venerate said with a frown.
There was already anger in his voice.
Yet the Dragon Seventh Venerate was unafraid, and said, “Previously, this boy obtained the inheritance of the Divine Rain Venerate, so it can only be considered luck, and not due to strength.
Thus, now, let others challenge him.
If it is proven that his strength is undisputed, and he is worthy of this inheritance, then I will approve of him.”
“That’s right,” Grandma Zijin also spoke up, “This brat is only slightly proficient with formation techniques, and just happened to seize this opportunity.
He is not showing his strength at all.”
“Hehe, I too think that this is only fair, and give the others a chance.”

All the Venerate Tier elites expressed their stand, wanting Ling Han to accept everyone’s challenge, proving that he indeed had the ability to obtain this inheritance, and was not relying on luck, and the fact that he just happened to know some formation techniques.
Ling Han smiled, and said, “Sure, in a battle of equals, who would I be afraid of?”
The Nine Mountains Venerate had already won him a chance for a fair battle.
Next, it would be up to him.
Hearing these words, the Nine Mountains Venerate couldn’t help but turn to look at Ling Han.
Ling Han did not speak, and merely nodded, his face filled with confidence.
“All right, who will challenge this junior?” the Dragon Seventh Venerate asked.
“I’ll go!”
“I’ll go!”
“Let me!”
Everyone scrambled over each other.

Ling Han was indeed freakish, but firstly, there was no formation for Ling Han to borrow the power of, and secondly, he was only in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, so how strong could his battle prowess be?
“Don’t be anxious, don’t be anxious!” The large black dog immediately jumped out, “If you want to challenge my Little Han, that’s fine.
Show me the stakes!”
Stakes?
Everyone was stunned.
What was the meaning of this?
“Oh, if you win, you’ll be able to obtain Little Han’s treasure, but if you lose, you can leave without a second thought?

How could there be such a good thing!” The large black dog shook his head, “Take out the stakes, and if you win, you can take it away along with your winnings, but if you lose, I’m sorry, but leave the stakes behind!”
This sounded very logical, but why did it exude an air of sordidness?
Ling Han didn’t say anything.
With the large black dog around, the task of playing the bad guy was naturally up to him.
“All right, let me!” A Core Formation Tier cultivator jumped out.
He was in the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, while his abilities were as high as Fifteenth Heaven.
Naturally, he thought that he would definitely win, so he didn’t mind taking out the stakes.
In any case, he could take it back.
He took out a treasured ginseng.
This was a Celestial medicine that could revive one’s blood and Qi, and could save one’s life at critical moments.
“Come, come, come.
Those who want to issue a challenge, come and register with Grandpa Dog.
Those who do not register are not allowed to participate.” The large black dog was all smiles, as if he was manning a new shop that had opened.
He was really very cordial.
This made people want to beat it up.
They weren’t wealth-delivering boys, so why were you so happy?
“Ling Han, admit defeat obediently.
Don’t waste both of our time,” the Core Formation Tier
said.
“Next,” Ling Han said.
“You!” The Core Formation Tier cultivator almost exploded in fury.
‘I’ve just stepped onto the stage, and you’re already saying ‘next’.
Just how much are you looking down on me?’
Peng!
But he had not even finished this thought, when he saw an iron fist strike towards him, sending him flying.
Pa, he fell onto the ground, already unconscious.
Defeat.
“Come, come, come.
Next.” The large black dog’s eyes swept over them, and pointed at a
person, “Brother, it’s your turn.”
The cultivator from the Core Formation Tier revealed a solemn expression.
He was a consummate level cultivator from the Core Formation Tier, and his battle prowess had already surpassed 20 Heavens.
However, Ling Han had won with a single punch.
This battle prowess was a little shocking.
How could a mere early stage of the Core Formation Tier cultivator be so strong?
“Apologies, I’m not in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier.
I advanced into the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier a few months ago,” Ling Han kindly explained.
‘Motherf*cker!’
This caused everyone to curse internally.
With how freakish Ling Han was, taking this step was enough to increase his battle prowess by four to five Heavens.
However, no matter how strong he was, he was only in the middle stage of the Core
Formation Tier.
The second Core Formation Tier cultivator stepped into the air.
His battle prowess had reached the 21st Heaven, and he thought that he had a good chance of winning.
“I will defeat you!” he shouted loudly, and launched an attack from the skies.
This person was quite cautious.
First, he used long-distance attacks to test Ling Han’s
strength.
Ling Han let out a battle cry, and also rose into the air, charging over against the other’s
firepower.
In the three months that the large black dog had been away, he had refined all the natural treasures on him.
The Primal Chaos Celestial Core had become a whole lot stronger than before, and his base power was no longer Fifteenth Heaven, but Eighteenth Heaven!
Boom, Ling Han had already arrived, and shot out a punch.
“Haha, I have to admit, you really are extraordinary.

Not long after advancing into the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, your battle prowess has already reached the 20th Heaven!” The second Core Formation Tier said coldly, “However, my battle prowess is 21 Heavens!”
After probing Ling Han several times, he also found out about Ling Han’s strength.
Naturally,
he withdrew his cautiousness, and faced Ling Han head-on.
Ling Han smiled.
The Primal Chaos Celestial Core activated, causing the other’s battle
prowess to instantly decrease by three Heavens.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and that Core Formation Tier elite was immediately sent
flying.
He was completely no match for Ling Han.
There was a difference of two Heavens between their battle prowess, and he didn’t have the
Primal Chaos Celestial Core that could absorb the power of attacks.
If he wasn’t sent flying,
who would?
However, in everyone’s eyes, this was filled with comical effects.
...Previously, the Core Formation Tier cultivator had been praising himself and looking down
on Ling Han.
In the end, Ling Han sent him flying with a single punch.
This was practically a
big joke.
However, this also surprised everyone.
Ling Han’s battle prowess was too terrifying, wasn’t
it?

chapters.title: Chapter 4047 Xu Luo
paragraphs: 4047 Xu Luo
“Next,” Ling Han said calmly.
The large black dog swept his eyes through the crowd, pointed at a person, and said, “You, you, you, it’s your turn.”

That person was slightly embarrassed, because his battle prowess was inferior to the previous person. Though he was also very strong, and had reached the 20th Heaven, but even a person at the 21st Heaven was sent flying with a single punch, so what was he worth?
He didn’t dare to step out. Instead, he turned around and pretended not to hear anything.
The large black dog snickered, and did not push him too far. Instead, he said, “Fine, even if you forfeit, the stakes cannot be refuted! Next.”
What a scam!
He forfeited and the stakes were still not refunded?

Previously, there were a great many people that had sought out the large black dog for registration, and they were all scrambling over one another, but now, they would rather forfeit the wager than step forward to battle.
—If they stepped forwards to accept the challenge, not only would they lose, they would also be humiliated in public. It would be best for them to cower.
In this moment, a great many people forfeited.
Those Venerate Tier elites all saw this, and they all looked shocked.

Of course, they had also come from the Core Formation Tier, and in the end, they had become Venerate Tier elites. It could be imagined that they had definitely been prodigies among prodigies in the past. However, if they were honest with themselves, when they were at the same cultivation level as Ling Han, just how far was the gap between them and Ling Han?
This was practically incomparable!
Only the Nine Mountains Venerate revealed a smile. He stroked his beard, feeling very pleased with himself.
Perhaps, in the future, the Nine Suns Holy Land would not only produce a Saint, but would even create the path of an Emperor!

Just the thought of it made him extremely excited. At the same time, an endless fighting spirit rose up in him. Whoever dared to touch Ling Han, he would kill them even if it meant sacrificing his life.
“Ling Han, right?” Finally, a young man did not cower from the battle. He walked out smilingly, his skin sparkling and translucent, as if he was a Divine Physique.
“I am Xu Luo,” he said.
Instantly, the whole area was filled with exclamations of shock.
“Xu Luo of the East Heavenly Realm?”

“Hiss, this guy is incredible. It is said that he came from a Holy Land, and in a mere half year’s time, he has rushed up to be ranked ranked nineteenth in the Core Formation Tier on the Galaxy Network!”
“Previously, this person kept a very low profile, yet suddenly rose up. He is overwhelmingly awesome.”
“If he is ranked 19th in the Galaxy Network, then his battle prowess is at least at the level of 23rd Heaven.”
“Wrong, it should be more than that. It’s only the hierarchical battle system on the Galaxy Network that limits his ranking.”
“I’m guessing that he should have battle prowess worthy of being in the top ten.”
“Hiss!”
Ling Han also heard the discussions of the masses, and couldn’t help but feel quite intrigued. He asked, “Your battle prowess has reached 24 Heavens?”

This was a barrier that only the top ten prodigies of the Galaxy Network were qualified to cross. However, at the same time, this was also the limit. Even Jing Hao, who was number one in the Galaxy Network, only had this kind of battle prowess.
...Unless it was the Imperial Clan, only would they be able to break this limit.
“You’ll naturally find out after experiencing it for yourself,” Xu Luo said calmly. There was a powerful confidence in his voice.
“Sure.” Ling Han nodded. Now, aside from the prodigies of the Imperial Clan, was there anyone else that could match him?
“Then let us battle in the skies!” Xu Luo soared into the skies, and stood at a height of three thousand meters. Boom, he released his aura without reservations, like tsunami waves.
Ling Han also ascended the sky step by step. When he arrived at about the same height as Xu Luo, he stopped, and stood with his hands clasped behind his back.

He had the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, which could disperse all power attacks within the range of six Heavens. Thus, in his heart, he had too much of an advantage, and did not take him to heart at all.
“Your mentality is not too bad,” Xu Luo remarked. “I hope that after this battle, you would not be traumatized by me.”
Ling Han cracked a smile, “I shall return these words exactly as they were!”
Xu Luo’s smile disappeared, and a sliver of anger rose up in him.

As a top-grade prodigy, the gap between them could be said to be in the sligthest of millimeters. Thus, to say nothing of the fact that he was superior to Ling Han by two minor levels, even if Ling Han had already advanced into the late stage of Core Formation Tier, he should still be overwhelmed by him.

“Humph, you really don’t know what’s good for you!” He charged out, his hands scissoring, and a pair of golden shears flew towards Ling Han. The shears were covered with seals, and continued to emit endless divine might.
Ling Han smiled, and greeted the incoming attack with a punch.
Peng!
The punch landed, and Ling Han’s body instantly trembled, sliding backwards.
As expected, this guy’s battle prowess had reached 24th heaven. Though this attack was a long-distance attack, it still had the might of 22nd heaven, surpassing Ling Han’s maximum battle prowess.
However, the Primal Chaos Celestial Core vibrated slightly, and the force that was attacking him was instantly dispersed completely. Ling Han merely slid backwards, completely unscathed.
After the attack, Xu Luo’s expression finally became solemn.
This opponent was no pushover. His battle prowess was far too terrifying.
Was this guy really in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier?
“Heaven Wolf Fist!” He charged out, and engaged in close-quarter combat with Ling Han.
Ling Han activated the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, and Xu Luo’s battle prowess instantly fell drastically, falling to the level of 21 Heavens.
That was enough.
Ling Han channelled the God Slaying Technique and clashed head-on with Xu Luo.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The two of them clashed fiercely, neither losing to the other.
There was no harm done if there was no comparison. Everyone saw this, and they were all shocked speechless.
Xu Luo, who had battle prowess of twenty-fourth heaven, actually tied with Ling Han, who was only in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier!
Who could believe this?
What kind of freak was this?

Yet Xu Luo was furious. This opponent of his possessed a rare treasure that could actually allow his battle prowess to weaken by three Heavens. Otherwise, with the advantage of three Heavens, he was completely capable of crushing Ling Han.
‘Alright, since you’ve used a rare treasure, I naturally won’t be reserved either.’

Xu Luo humphed softly, and a ball of light surged over his body. It was so bright that no one could see it clearly. When this ball of light disappeared, everyone could see that a suit of armor had appeared on Xu Luo’s body.
This Battle Armor was extremely light, and was silvery white in colour. When worn, it looked more like a piece of clothing, though it was filled with a metallic feel.
But in the next instant, this Battle Armor was exuding a brilliant light, making Xu Luo look as if he was a god.
Xiu, he once again charged towards Ling Han, and his speed actually increased explosively.
Yi?
Ling Han was astonished. However, he didn’t give this much thought, and he immediately exchanged another blow with Xu Luo.
Peng, he was instantly sent flying. Thankfully, the Primal Chaos Celestial Core showed its might, and he was not injured.
—Xu Luo’s battle prowess had increased by around two Heavens.
Ling Han’s eyes fell upon that suit of armor. This was a Spirit Tool, a tool that could increase battle prowess, and the increase was as high as two Heavens.

“Ling Han, you have a rare treasure on you that can weaken battle prowess by three Heavens, and can also disperse power attacks,” Xu Luo said proudly, “But in terms of background, how could I possibly lose to you!”
With a shake of his right hand, a shining long sword appeared. There were silver veined patterns on the sword, interwoven into a complicated pattern.
“Die!” He charged over, sword in hand, a frightening aura surging. The might of this strike was incredibly shocking.
Ling Han couldn’t help but shake his head internally. This guy knew nothing, and actually said that his two Mystical Powers were the might of a Spirit Tool.
Fine then, do you think I only have two “Spirit Tools”?
The murderous aura charged forwards!

chapters.title: Chapter 4048 Shameless
paragraphs: 4048 Shameless
“Ah!” Xu Luo instantly grabbed his head and screamed in agony.
No matter how prodigious you were, so what? In front of the barrage of murderous aura, you could only grab your head and groan, unless your cultivation level was a level higher than Ling Han.
Unfortunately, Xu Luo was only in the Core Formation Tier.

Ling Han took advantage of the opening to attack, and used the God Slaying Technique. Though this was created by a Saint, it could completely be called the Pseudo-Emperor Technique. Furthermore, at the level of the Core Formation Tier, neither of them could unleash the full might of the Saint Technique or the Imperial Technique, and it was completely up to who had the deeper grasp.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

Ling Han seized this opportunity to attack Xu Luo madly, and Xu Luo was sent flying. However, the Battle Armor he was wearing was truly powerful. It had the effect of absorbing a portion of the power of the attack. Thus, he wasn’t defeated by Ling Han in a single wave.
“You really have a lot of rare treasures on you!” Xu Luo finally steadied himself. He looked coldly at Ling Han, his killing intent overflowing.

Originally, he had only wanted to defeat Ling Han and obtain the inheritance of Divine Rain Venerate. However, Ling Han had beaten him so horribly in public, causing him to lose all face. Naturally, his baleful killing intent was aroused.

Of course, unleashing killing intent was one matter, and being able to do it was another matter. Even if his battle prowess overwhelmed Ling Han’s, the Nine Mountains Venerate was standing right below him, so how could he possibly kill him?
Ling Han shook his head, “Frog at the bottom of a well.”
Xu Luo was enraged. This person actually dared to insult him?
“Die!”
He charged over, his hands scissoring, and that pair of golden shears shot towards him again.
This was made up of pure energy, but it was imbued with high-level energy. Furthermore, it was amplified by the Battle Armor, so its destructive power was extremely terrifying.
Ling Han was completely unafraid, and raised his fist to face it head-on.
Peng, peng, peng!

In terms of battle prowess, he was now two Heavens weaker than Xu Luo, but when he used his Eye Technique, he could completely see through the weak points in Xu Luo’s attacks. He could avoid the strong and aim for the weak points. Even if he only used his strongest attack occasionally, with the Primal Chaos Celestial Core’s ability to dispel attacks, what did he have to fear?
However, after battling for a long time, both their battle prowess dropped by a significant amount.
It could not be helped. Whether it was the Imperial Technique or the Saint Technique, how could they be channelled continuously?

But after only an instant, Ling Han’s battle prowess became stronger again. This God Slaying Technique could no longer be used. How could it be that he could not use the Heavenly Brilliance Technique? Could he not use the Demonic Monkey Fist?
He had mastered more than one Imperial Technique.

Everyone was watching in a daze, stunned by Ling Han’s battle prowess, and elites such as Nine Mountains Venerate knew what he was doing. They could clearly see that Ling Han had not used some rare treasure, and was clearly using his own might.
Thus, Xu Luo had already lost.
This was a being that possessed the battle prowess of one of the top 10 in Core Formation Tier on the Galaxy Network. Even he couldn’t do anything to Ling Han, so who else could?
Was it the Imperial Son or the Imperial Daughter?
Perhaps this was possible, but aside from Luo Wuding, was there still an Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter present?
Unfortunately, Luo Wuding had long since become a Venerate Tier elite. How could he bring himself to personally deal with Ling Han?

“Enough!” A Venerate Tier elite moved, and grabbed Xu Luo back. There was no point in continuing the stalemate like this. At least, they would have to fight for a few days and nights. When the mystical power of both sides were almost exhausted, the one with the stronger reserves would be able to win.
How could a mighty Venerate Tier cultivator have so much free time to watch two Core Formation Tier cultivators fight for a few days?
“Let go of me! I’m about to win!” Xu Luo roared. He was unwilling to give up.
The large black dog snickered, and shouted at the top of his lungs, “Next, is there anyone else?”

No one answered. Everyone understood. At present, aside from the Imperial Clan, who else could defeat Ling Han at the same cultivation level? Even those at the same cultivation level could not, what more those at the same minor cultivation level.
The large black dog called out again, and couldn’t help but look regretful. He hadn’t scammed too many people out of their bets.
The Nine Mountains Venerate smiled, and said, “Since no one is challenging, I’m going to bring Ling Han back.”
The Nine Mountains Venerate glared at him, “What is it? Does your Flood Dragon Race still have prodigies that want to make a move?”
“Dragon Race, it’s Dragon Race!” Dragon Seventh Venerate hurriedly corrected, then thought for a moment, “He Shun, you do it.”
“Me?” A middle-aged man replied, appearing very surprised.
The Nine Mountains Venerate was enraged, and said, “Dragon Seventh, do you still have any shame? This person is in the True Self Tier!”

“Hehe, at that time, the True Self Tier also entered into the Mystery Realm; they just had a narrow miss.” Dragon Seventh Venerate said smilingly, “Furthermore, He Shun is only in the early stage of the True Self Tier, and his age is similar to Ling Han’s, so it can be considered a fair battle.”
“Fair your sister!” Even the Nine Mountains Venerate couldn’t help but curse, “That clansman of yours is at least seventy to eighty years old, and how old is Ling Han?”
Shameless! He was really too shameless!

Yet the Dragon Seventh Venerate was completely unconcerned about this, and said calmly, “Fine, I won’t bully this brat either. As long as this brat can block a blow from He Shun, he’ll be considered to have passed!”

Nine Mountains scoffed. Who didn’t know that there was a gap of a major cultivation level? That was an absolute one-sided suppression. Furthermore, Ling Han was only in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier. Aside from the gap of a major cultivation level, there was still the gap of two minor cultivation levels.
Was this not bullying?
“All right.” Yet Ling Han suddenly interrupted. He descended, his hands clasped behind his back, an uncaring expression on his face, “One move is too little, so I’ll block three moves.”
Pu!
A great many people spluttered. You think one move is too little?
How could there be such an idiot?
Ling Han smiled, and turned to look at the Venerate Tier elites, “Seniors, this time, we have an agreement. If this junior can block three moves from that idiot, there won’t be any more trouble!”

All the Venerable Tier elites were slightly embarrassed. They were all people who cared about their pride, and they really couldn’t bring themselves to tell Ling Han to fight with a True Self Tier elite. Only the Dragon Seventh Venerate would be so shameless.
The Nine Mountains Venerate said, “If anyone has any more objections, I’ll beat them up with the Saint Tool.”
No one replied. These Venerate Tier elites all knew that the Nine Mountains Venerate had already reached his limit in tolerance.
In truth, if it was them, they would also be furious. They had really never seen someone as shameless as the Dragon Seventh Venerate.
The Dragon Seventh Venerate remained calm and collected, and merely said coldly, “He Shun, what are you standing around for?”
Long He Shun walked out. He was a little embarrassed. Being stared at by so many people, and every gaze was filled with disdain, he could not bear it.
‘Then I’ll end the battle as soon as possible!’
He gave a loud shout, and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han.

After advancing into the True Self Tier, one would be qualified to come into contact with the Regulations of heaven and earth. As he delivered this palm strike, it turned into a fiery red giant hand, with several divine chains of order entwined around it. That aura was incredibly terrifying.

All the prodigies of Core Formation Tier held their breaths. If they advanced into the True Self Tier, they believed that none of them would lose to Long He Shun. However, now that there was a gap of a major tier between them and the True Self Tier, none of them dared to take this attack head-on.
He was definitely going to die.
However, Ling Han actually didn’t dodge!
Was this guy really courting death?

The Nine Mountains Venerate frowned, but did not make a move, because he knew that Ling Han was a Formations Grandmaster, and could instantly teleport to another corner of the planet with the help of ley lines.
However, this was a trump card to deal with the assassination of the Battle God Palace. Was it appropriate to expose it just like that?

sentences.text: 4048 Shameless
“Ah!” Xu Luo instantly grabbed his head and screamed in agony.
No matter how prodigious you were, so what?
In front of the barrage of murderous aura, you could only grab your head and groan, unless your cultivation level was a level higher than Ling Han.
Unfortunately, Xu Luo was only in the Core Formation Tier.
Ling Han took advantage of the opening to attack, and used the God Slaying Technique.
Though this was created by a Saint, it could completely be called the Pseudo-Emperor Technique.

Furthermore, at the level of the Core Formation Tier, neither of them could unleash the full might of the Saint Technique or the Imperial Technique, and it was completely up to who had the deeper grasp.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
Ling Han seized this opportunity to attack Xu Luo madly, and Xu Luo was sent flying.
However, the Battle Armor he was wearing was truly powerful.
It had the effect of absorbing a portion of the power of the attack.
Thus, he wasn’t defeated by Ling Han in a single wave.
“You really have a lot of rare treasures on you!” Xu Luo finally steadied himself.
He looked coldly at Ling Han, his killing intent overflowing.
Originally, he had only wanted to defeat Ling Han and obtain the inheritance of Divine Rain Venerate.
However, Ling Han had beaten him so horribly in public, causing him to lose all face.
Naturally, his baleful killing intent was aroused.
Of course, unleashing killing intent was one matter, and being able to do it was another matter.
Even if his battle prowess overwhelmed Ling Han’s, the Nine Mountains Venerate was standing right below him, so how could he possibly kill him?
Ling Han shook his head, “Frog at the bottom of a well.”
Xu Luo was enraged.
This person actually dared to insult him?
“Die!”
He charged over, his hands scissoring, and that pair of golden shears shot towards him again.
This was made up of pure energy, but it was imbued with high-level energy.
Furthermore, it was amplified by the Battle Armor, so its destructive power was extremely terrifying.
Ling Han was completely unafraid, and raised his fist to face it head-on.
Peng, peng, peng!
In terms of battle prowess, he was now two Heavens weaker than Xu Luo, but when he used his Eye Technique, he could completely see through the weak points in Xu Luo’s attacks.
He could avoid the strong and aim for the weak points.
Even if he only used his strongest attack occasionally, with the Primal Chaos Celestial Core’s ability to dispel attacks, what did he have to fear?
However, after battling for a long time, both their battle prowess dropped by a significant amount.
It could not be helped.
Whether it was the Imperial Technique or the Saint Technique, how could they be channelled continuously?
But after only an instant, Ling Han’s battle prowess became stronger again.
This God Slaying Technique could no longer be used.
How could it be that he could not use the Heavenly Brilliance Technique?
Could he not use the Demonic Monkey Fist?
He had mastered more than one Imperial Technique.
Everyone was watching in a daze, stunned by Ling Han’s battle prowess, and elites such as Nine Mountains Venerate knew what he was doing.
They could clearly see that Ling Han had not used some rare treasure, and was clearly using his own might.
Thus, Xu Luo had already lost.
This was a being that possessed the battle prowess of one of the top 10 in Core Formation Tier on the Galaxy Network.
Even he couldn’t do anything to Ling Han, so who else could?
Was it the Imperial Son or the Imperial Daughter?
Perhaps this was possible, but aside from Luo Wuding, was there still an Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter present?
Unfortunately, Luo Wuding had long since become a Venerate Tier elite.
How could he bring himself to personally deal with Ling Han?
“Enough!” A Venerate Tier elite moved, and grabbed Xu Luo back.
There was no point in continuing the stalemate like this.
At least, they would have to fight for a few days and nights.
When the mystical power of both sides were almost exhausted, the one with the stronger reserves would be able to win.
How could a mighty Venerate Tier cultivator have so much free time to watch two Core Formation Tier cultivators fight for a few days?
“Let go of me!
I’m about to win!” Xu Luo roared.
He was unwilling to give up.
The large black dog snickered, and shouted at the top of his lungs, “Next, is there anyone else?”
No one answered.
Everyone understood.
At present, aside from the Imperial Clan, who else could defeat Ling Han at the same cultivation level?
Even those at the same cultivation level could not, what more those at the same minor cultivation level.
The large black dog called out again, and couldn’t help but look regretful.
He hadn’t scammed too many people out of their bets.
The Nine Mountains Venerate smiled, and said, “Since no one is challenging, I’m going to bring Ling Han back.”
The Nine Mountains Venerate glared at him, “What is it?
Does your Flood Dragon Race still have prodigies that want to make a move?”
“Dragon Race, it’s Dragon Race!” Dragon Seventh Venerate hurriedly corrected, then thought for a moment, “He Shun, you do it.”
“Me?” A middle-aged man replied, appearing very surprised.
The Nine Mountains Venerate was enraged, and said, “Dragon Seventh, do you still have any shame?
This person is in the True Self Tier!”

“Hehe, at that time, the True Self Tier also entered into the Mystery Realm; they just had a narrow miss.” Dragon Seventh Venerate said smilingly, “Furthermore, He Shun is only in the early stage of the True Self Tier, and his age is similar to Ling Han’s, so it can be considered a fair battle.”
“Fair your sister!” Even the Nine Mountains Venerate couldn’t help but curse, “That clansman of yours is at least seventy to eighty years old, and how old is Ling Han?”
Shameless!
He was really too shameless!
Yet the Dragon Seventh Venerate was completely unconcerned about this, and said calmly, “Fine, I won’t bully this brat either.
As long as this brat can block a blow from He Shun, he’ll be considered to have passed!”
Nine Mountains scoffed.
Who didn’t know that there was a gap of a major cultivation level?
That was an absolute one-sided suppression.
Furthermore, Ling Han was only in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier.
Aside from the gap of a major cultivation level, there was still the gap of two minor cultivation levels.
Was this not bullying?
“All right.” Yet Ling Han suddenly interrupted.
He descended, his hands clasped behind his back, an uncaring expression on his face, “One move is too little, so I’ll block three moves.”
Pu!

chapters.title: Chapter 4049 Blocking Three Moves
paragraphs: 4049 Blocking Three Moves
Right at this moment, Ling Han finally made his move.
He did not flee. Instead, he beckoned with his right hand, and instantly, the Earth Qi was drawn out by him. Boom, it turned into an Earth Dragon.
Peng!
Long He Shun’s attack landed on the Earth Dragon, instantly shattering it. However, the might of his attack was more or less destroyed.
“Yi!” “En?” “Ya?”
However, with this one move, all the Venerate Tier elites’ eyes widened, appearing to be in disbelief.

As they saw it, to say nothing of the fact that Ling Han was only at the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, even if it were those freaks from the Imperial Clan who were at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, they still wouldn’t be able to take this attack from Long He Shun head-on. They would simply be seeking death.
Thus, the only strategy was to dodge.
However, Ling Han summoned an Earth Dragon, forcefully blocking this attack.
Was he a monster?
Core Formation Tier elites couldn’t unleash the might of True Self Tier even if they used Four Stars Spirit Tools.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “The first move.”

Long He Shun instantly felt his face burn. With this strike, not only did the Core Formation Tier not die, he was completely unwounded. He had probably made history. However, he was like a green leaf that was the background to Ling Han’s blooming brilliance, completely a negative example.
He flew into a rage out of humiliation, and delivered another attack towards Ling Han. This time, the might of the attack had increased slightly.
He was not willing to be remembered as a joke by history. Thus, even if he was mocked now, it would still be better than having his name stink for ten thousand years, right?
Ling Han raised a finger. Xiu, xiu! At this moment, two Earth Dragons appeared at the same time, greeting Long He Shun’s attack.
Peng, peng!
Long He Shun’s attack was still domineering, easily shattering the two Earth Dragons. However, this attack of his was no longer effective.
This!

Even the Venerate Tier elites couldn’t help but sigh in emotion. The information they had obtained was too inaccurate. Ling Han was not only slightly familiar with formations, he was practically a Formation Grandmaster, all right?

The Nine Mountains Venerate squinted his eyes and smiled. He naturally knew that Ling Han had already become a Formations Grandmaster. However, Ling Han had only been able to channel the Star Steps at that time, unlike now, when he could actually extract Earth Qi to target the enemy.
The more he looked at this young man, the more satisfied he was.
“Ah!” Long He Shun roared loudly. This time, he was really going all out. He channelled out the Saint Technique, which blasted towards Ling Han.

The True Self Tier could come into contact with heaven and earth’s Regulations, and similarly blast out Saint Techniques; it was too terrifying! Even if there was a Core Formation Tier that could reach the level of True Self Tier, the power from blasting out Saint Techniques was definitely inferior. It couldn’t be helped; there was still a gap of the Regulations of heaven and earth.
Hence, this attack was incredibly terrifying, and finally, only a little bit of Saint-level might was unleashed.

Only when one had reached the True Self Tier, only would the Imperial Technique, the Saint Technique, and the Venerate Technique have a clear difference. Once it involved the Regulations of heaven and earth, there would be a clear hierarchy.
This attack blasted over, and even the heaven and earth reacted. Energy manifested into multiple small flood dragons, filling the skies.
Long He Shun was seen pushing this attack over, his murderous aura cold.
This was very impressive, but!
Ling Han smiled, and flicked his index finger. Xiu, xiu, xiu! One after another, Earth Dragons appeared, totalling ten.

Peng, peng, peng! The Saint Technique unleashed its might, and these Earth Dragons crumbled upon contact, turning back into heaven and earth energy that dissipated. However, every Earth Dragon was equivalent to an early stage True Self Tier elite. After the Saint Technique broke through ten “people” in a row, its might naturally decreased by more or less.
Ling Han threw another punch, which erased the last bit of might of the Saint Technique.
Three moves passed.

Long Heshun still wanted to deliver another blow, but he immediately felt a throbbing in his heart, feeling like a mouse being targeted by a cat. He turned his head, and saw that the Nine Mountains Venerate was staring at him with an extremely stern gaze.
He was so scared that his legs almost went weak, and hurriedly stepped aside obediently.

“Haha, this little friend is really rare. He cultivates both martial arts and formations, and has reached an astonishing height in both,” Grandma Zijin said with a smile. “Little friend, are you married yet? I have a great-granddaughter who is extremely beautiful!”
When everyone heard this, they were all confused. What was going on here? She had just been overbearing just now, so why was she marrying off her great-granddaughter all of a sudden?
They naturally didn’t know how these Venerate Tier elites were feeling. Just how stunned were they!
For a freak like Ling Han, they could only either long since trample him to death, or in a few thousand years, this guy would be able to grow to the height of equals with them, just like Luo Wuding.
Furthermore, once Ling Han became a Venerate Tier, he would definitely be an overlord among Venerate Tiers.
Thus, they could either kill him as soon as possible, or express goodwill now, and form a good relationship with him.
—Did they really think that these Venerate Tier elites were just cultivating in seclusion? Which one of them was not an old fox?

Meanwhile, the Nine Mountains Venerate didn’t allow anyone to disturb Ling Han. He directly grabbed Ling Han and the large black dog, tore a rip into space, and left. As for Lu Qi? Hehe, just go back the way he came.
Seeing the space close up again, Lu Qi revealed a resentful expression, clenching his fists tightly.
“Didn’t the Battle God Palace claim that there was no one they dared not and couldn’t assassinate? Why is this damn guy still alive and kicking after such a long time?”

This should be the question of many people, but previously, Ling Han was either at the Nine Suns Holy Land or when he came out for the first time, he had also stayed in the Mystery Realm, so how could the Battle God Palace have any chance of assassination?
Meanwhile, the Nine Mountains Venerate tore open space continuously, and soon brought Ling Han and the large black dog back to the Nine Suns Holy Land.
“What you obtained in the Mystery Realm is your private property,” the Nine Mountains Venerate said. “There’s no need to tell anyone, nor is there any need to hand it over to anyone. Understand?”
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel warm in his heart. This Venerate Tier elite was truly considering for his sake.
“I understand.” He nodded.
“Go on.” The Nine Mountains Venerate waved his hand dismissively.
The large black dog hurriedly ran off with Ling Han, saying, “Little Han, we’re rich now!”

Previously, many people had issued challenges to Ling Han, but not one of them had succeeded. Naturally, there was a large pile of stakes left behind, and they were all natural treasures — the large black dog’s eyes were very sharp. He would not accept anything that was not good.
The man and dog shared the spoils, one for you and one for me. After dividing the spoils among themselves, they each went their own way.
Ling Han had already contacted the empress, Hu Niu, and the others through the Galaxy Network. After returning to the abode, the three of them naturally wanted to be intimate with each other.

After two days of languishing, Ling Han asked about the empress and Hu Niu’s cultivation progress. The two women had both cultivated to the Nine Cauldrons, but there was really no hope for the Ten Cauldrons.
It should be known that a great many Ancestral Kings were only Nine Cauldrons, and then completed Fusion Cauldrons with their own power. Ten Cauldrons was not the standard.
‘Then I’ll leave it at that.’

Ling Han helped the empress and Hu Niu create the Fusion Cauldron. Although he succeeded, it also caused great damage to his vitality and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Thankfully, he had won a lot of tonics and nourishing items this time, so he just had to eat like crazy.
Afterwards, Ling Han contacted Lin Luo, Zhou Heng and the others. Calculating the time, these ultimate elites should have reached the Nine Cauldrons by now, and could create the Fusion Cauldron.
However, Lin Luo, Zhou Heng, and Chu Hao had already created their Fusion Cauldron.
Yi, so awesome?

chapters.title: Chapter 4050 Assassination Again
paragraphs: 4050 Assassination Again

After Ling Han asked around, he found out that Lin Luo and the others had obtained great fortune when they were exploring a dangerous place. With the help of the power of heaven and earth, they had completed the Fusion Cauldron.
Then could this be considered as creating the Fusion Cauldron with their own power, or borrowing the power of another?

Ling Han couldn’t figure it out either, but thinking about it, heaven and earth probably couldn’t be considered others. Thus, Lin Luo and the others should belong to the category of creating their Fusion Cauldron with their own power.
In other words, these three people possessed the qualifications to attempt breaking through to the Imperial Path.
Of course, the Imperial Path was long, and this was only one of the requirements. Who knew how difficult it would be in future.
Ling Han nodded. Becoming a Great Emperor not only required natural talent, but also great fortune.

There were many people who had come out of Genesis World, but there were not many that Ling Han was grateful to and missed. Lin Luo and the others had already created the Fusion Cauldron, and Karmic Life Heavenly Venerable was slightly inferior. Though he had also cultivated Nine Cauldrons, he had already broken through to the Core Formation Tier first before creating the Fusion Cauldron.

Any one of these once supreme elites was restless, and had long since fled to various corners of the galaxy. With how proud and arrogant they were, how could they be willing to be taken care of by Ling Han for a long time?
This was good too. Ling Han only needed to take care of himself and his family.
Ling Han began to concoct alchemical pills with all his might. He was out of money, and needed a large amount of Universe Coins to buy natural treasures to nourish the Celestial Core.
Moreover, the empress and Hu Niu weren’t far from reaching the Core Formation Tier. They were severely short of money.

Aside from concocting alchemical pills, Ling Han would also use Earth Qi to temper himself. In addition, the empress, Hu Niu and the large black dog would also benefit from this, and would similarly be tempered by the Earth Qi.

To put it bluntly, Earth Qi was actually the energy of heaven and earth. Tempering oneself could not increase one’s cultivation level, but it could strengthen one’s physique, which naturally had boundless benefits.
In these few months, the physiques of the three people and one dog had all improved greatly, which made Ling Han very pleased.
However, this was all he could do. After all, his energy was limited. Having to temper four beings at the same time was already his limit.
“Little Han, are you going to retrieve the goods again?”
On this day, after the four of them had finished tempering their bodies, the large black dog saw Ling Han walking out, and asked casually.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Where would I get so many natural treasures? I’m going to sell medicines.”
“I’m free anyway, so Grandpa Dog will accompany you.” The large black dog scuttled out.

The man and dog left the Holy Land and headed to the office of the Chang Clan. Basically, as long as the overall level of cultivation of the planet was slightly higher, there would definitely be an office established by the Chang Clan.
After Ling Han sent the alchemical pills to be delivered, he walked back with the large black dog.
‘Hmm?’
Ling Han suddenly felt a killing intent. Though this was very weak, how could it hide from his terrifying divine sense?
However, he remained calm and collected. Instead, he used the ley lines to gather everything in his surroundings into his mind.
One, two, three, four... A faint smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. There were a total of four assassins, and they were all in the True Self Tier.
Hehe, after being silent for so long, the Battle God Palace finally sent assassins again.

—Putting aside the ability to assassinate, in a head-on battle, their strength was really only average.
“Haha, come over if you can!” the large black dog shouted.
A True Self Tier cultivator actually couldn’t do anything to a cultivator in the Core Formation Tier. This was indeed something that could be boasted about for a lifetime.
After failing time and time again, the four assassins all released a sharp cry. Then, they all retreated, and in an instant, had disappeared without a trace.
If he missed, he would immediately flee into the distance. This was an assassin. Otherwise, he would be a death warrior.

Ling Han sighed. This time, though he had successfully repelled the assassins from the Battle God Palace, from the Core Formation Tier to the True Self Tier, this assassin organization was already upgrading the assassins they mobilized.
Then what about the next time? Would it be the turn of the Spirit Transformation Tier assassins?
Faced with such an assassin, even the Earth Dragon was useless. Ling Han could only use the Star Steps and run.

He wasn’t used to being on the back foot like this, but in terms of taking the initiative to attack, firstly, he was only a mere Core Formation Tier cultivator, and secondly, he had absolutely no idea where the Battle God Palace was, so how could he take the initiative to attack?
The man and dog walked back. After walking for a while, Ling Han’s wrist suddenly lit up.
“Yi, what is this?” The large black dog, approached to take a look.
Ling Han was also taken aback. Why was his wrist glowing?
He pulled up his sleeves to take a look, and saw that a complicated seal was glowing, and before this, this had never manifested.

Ling Han thought for a moment. He had entered and exited too many ancient sites, and had also been “stamped” many times. Thus, for a moment, he did not know which ancient site the stamp had been stamped on had activated.
However, just how astonishing was his memory? He immediately came to his senses.
“F*ck! Not good!”
“What’s going on?” the large black dog hurriedly asked.

Ling Han didn’t have the time to reply, and he immediately channeled the Soul Forming Technique. A subtle change instantly took place in his spiritual fluctuation, and his appearance also changed accordingly.
“Yi, Ding Yi!” the large black dog exclaimed in surprise. Why had Ling Han suddenly turned back into Ding Yi? Hadn’t they agreed to bury this person forever?
Xiu! Right at this moment, a streak of light surged over and enveloped Ling Han. In the next instant, Ling Han had already disappeared from sight.
The large black dog’s expression was completely dumbfounded. What the hell was this?
